info.description: Cloudastructure, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud-based artificial intelligence video surveillance and remote guarding solutions. Its solutions include AI Surveillance, Remote Guarding, and Mobile Surveillance. The company was founded by Rick Bentley on March 28, 2003 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Cloudastruct, Inc. 從事提供基於雲端的人工智慧視訊監控和遠端防護解決方案。其解決方案包括人工智慧監控、遠端監護和行動監控。該公司由 Rick Bentley 於 2003 年 3 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Ethos Technologies, Inc. provides life insurance services. Its policies cover debt, income, mortgages, and education. The company was founded by Ling Ke Wang and Peter Colis in July 2016 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Ethos Technologies, Inc. 提供人壽保險服務。其保單涵蓋債務、收入、抵押貸款和教育。該公司由 Ling Ke Wang 和 Peter Colis 於 2016 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Creative Media & Community Trust Corp. is a real estate investment trust that seeks to own, operate, and develop premier multifamily and creative office assets in vibrant and emerging communities throughout the United States. It operates through the following segments: Office, Hotel, and Lending. The Office segment consists of the rental of office space and other tenant services, including tenant reimbursements, parking, and storage space rental. The Hotel segment involves the operation of hotel properties. The Lending segment focuses on loans to small businesses. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 辦公室
info.description_zh: Creative Media & Community Trust Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，致力於在美國各地充滿活力的新興社區擁有、經營和開發優質的多戶型和創意辦公資產。它透過以下部門運作：辦公室、飯店和貸款部門。辦公部門包括辦公空間租賃和其他租戶服務，包括租戶報銷、停車和儲存空間租賃。酒店分部涉及酒店物業的經營。貸款部門專注於向小型企業提供貸款。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Direxion Daily MSFT Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of MSFT. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in MSFT that is equal, on a daily basis, to 150% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 MSFT 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資收益（未計費用和開支）為 MSFT 每日業績的 150%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 MSFT 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報相當於該基金淨資產價值的 150%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MSFT Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Microsoft Corporation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It aims to generate 2 times the daily performance of the underlying stock for a single day. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MSFT Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為微軟公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。它的目标是在单日内产生标的股票日表现的 2 倍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fossil Group, Inc. engages in the design, marketing and distribution of consumer fashion accessories. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its products include men's and women's fashion watches, jewelry, handbags, small leather goods, belts, sunglasses, shoes, soft accessories and clothing which are sold through department stores, specialty retail locations, specialty watch and jewelry stores, owned retail and factory outlet stores, mass market stores, owned, and affiliate internet sites. The company was founded by Tom Kartsotis in 1984 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Fossil Group, Inc. 從事消費時尚配件的設計、行銷和分銷。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲和亞洲。其產品包括男士和女士時尚手錶、珠寶、手袋、小皮具、皮帶、太陽眼鏡、鞋子、軟配件和服裝，透過百貨公司、專賣零售店、專賣手錶和珠寶店、自營零售店和工廠直銷店、大眾市場商店、自營和附屬網路網站銷售。該公司由 Tom Kartsotis 於 1984 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: FibroBiologics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of cell therapies. It focuses on treatments and potential cures for chronic diseases using fibroblast cells and fibroblast-derived materials. The firm's product pipeline includes CybroCell, CYMS101, CYWC628, TCB190, and CYTER915. The company was founded by Peter O'Heeron on April 8, 2021 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: FibroBiologics, Inc. 從事細胞療法的開發和商業化。它專注於使用成纖維細胞和成纖維細胞衍生材料來治療和潛在治癒慢性疾病。該公司的產品線包括 CybroCell、CYMS101、CYWC628、TCB190 和 CYTER915。該公司由 Peter O'Heeron 於 2021 年 4 月 8 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: UFP Technologies, Inc. engages in designing and custom manufacturing of components, subassemblies, products and packaging utilizing specialized foams, films, and plastics primarily for the medical market. The firm manufactures its products by converting raw materials using laminating, molding, radio frequency, and impulse welding and fabricating manufacturing techniques. Its products include military uniform and gear components, automotive interior trim, athletic padding, environmentally friendly protective packaging, air filtration, abrasive nail files, and protective cases and inserts. The company was founded by Richard L. Bailly, Robert W. Drew, Sr. and William H. Shaw in 1963 and is headquartered in Newburyport, MA.
info.description_zh: UFP Technologies, Inc. 致力於利用主要面向醫療市場的專用泡棉、薄膜和塑膠設計和客製化組件、組件、產品和包裝。該公司透過使用層壓、成型、射頻、脈衝焊接和製造技術轉換原材料來製造產品。其產品包括軍服和裝備部件、汽車內飾、運動襯墊、環保防護包裝、空氣過濾、磨料指甲銼以及防護盒和襯墊。該公司由 Richard L. Bailly、Robert W. Drew, Sr. 和 William H. Shaw 於 1963 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州紐伯里波特。

info.description: Uranium Royalty Corp. operates as an exploration company, which engages in acquiring and assembling a portfolio of royalties, and investing in companies with exposure to uranium and physical uranium. The company was founded by Amir Adnani on April 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Uranium Royal Corp. 是一家勘探公司，從事收購和整合特許權使用費投資組合，以及投資於鈾和實體鈾業務的公司。該公司由Amir Adnani於2017年4月21日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Digi International, Inc. engages in providing Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity products, services, and solutions. It operates through the IoT Products and Services, and IoT Solutions segments. The IoT Products and Services segment includes embedded and wireless modules, console servers, enterprise, and industrial routers. The IoT Solutions segment involves SmartSense and the Managed Network-as-a-Service (MNaaS) business. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Hopkins, MN.
info.description_zh: Digi International, Inc. 致力於提供物聯網 (IoT) 連接產品、服務和解決方案。它透過物聯網產品和服務以及物聯網解決方案部門運作。物聯網產品和服務部分包括嵌入式和無線模組、控制台伺服器、企業和工業路由器。物聯網解決方案部門涉及 SmartSense 和託管網路即服務 (MNaaS) 業務。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州霍普金斯。

info.description: Replimune Group, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in the business of developing oncolytic immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer. The company was founded by Philip Astley-Sparke, Colin A. Love, and Robert Coffin in March 2015 and is headquartered in Woburn, MA.
info.description_zh: Replimune Group, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生技公司。它從事開髮用於治療癌症的溶瘤免疫療法的業務。該公司由 Philip Astley-Sparke、Colin A. Love 和 Robert Coffin 於 2015 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃本。

info.description: Information Services Group, Inc. engages in the provision of sourcing advisory services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific. The firm offers business advisory, human resources technology and delivery services, organizational change management and software advisory services to the aerospace, defense, automotive, banking, energy, healthcare, and insurance industries. The company was founded by Michael P.Connors on July 20, 2006 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Information Services Group, Inc. 從事提供採購諮詢服務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲和亞太地區。該公司為航空航太、國防、汽車、銀行、能源、醫療保健和保險業提供商業諮詢、人力資源技術和交付服務、組織變革管理和軟體諮詢服務。該公司由 Michael P.Connors 於 2006 年 7 月 20 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Impinj, Inc. engages in the designing, sale, and licensing of a platform for wireless item-to-cloud connectivity. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Malaysia, Taiwan, and Others. The company was founded by Christopher Diorio in April 2000 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Impinj, Inc. 從事無線專案到雲端連接平台的設計、銷售和授權。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、馬來西亞、台灣和其他地區。該公司由 Christopher Diorio 於 2000 年 4 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Eurodry Ltd. engages in the provision of worldwide ocean-going transportation services. It owns and operates drybulk carriers that transport major bulks, such as iron ore, coal and grains, and minor bulks, which includes bauxite, phosphate, and fertilizers. The company was founded on January 8, 2018 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: Eurodry Ltd. 從事提供全球遠洋運輸服務。該公司擁有並經營乾散貨船，運輸鐵礦石、煤炭和穀物等大宗散貨，以及鋁土礦、磷酸鹽和化肥等小宗散裝貨物。該公司成立於2018年1月8日，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of different therapeutics for the treatment of neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental diseases. Its lead compound, ANAVEX2-73, is being developed to treat Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and central nervous system diseases, including Rett syndrome. The company was founded by Harvey Lalach and Athanasios Skarpelos on January 23, 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Anavex Life Sciences Corp.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療神經退化性疾病和神經發育疾病的不同療法。其主要化合物 ANAVEX2-73 正在開發用於治療阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症以及中樞神經系統疾病，包括雷特氏症。該公司由 Harvey Lalach 和 Athanasios Skarpelos 於 2004 年 1 月 23 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Microsoft Corp. engages in the development and support of software, services, devices, and solutions. It operates through the following segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The Productivity and Business Processes segment is composed of products and services relating to productivity, communication, and information services such as Office Commercial, Office Consumer, LinkedIn, and Dynamics business solutions. The Intelligent Cloud segment consists of public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services for businesses and developers, as well as enterprise and partner services. The More Personal Computing segment refers to products and services including Windows operating system, Windows cloud services, Surface, HoloLens, personal computer accessories, Xbox hardware, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Microsoft News, and Microsoft Edge. The company was founded by Paul Gardner Allen and William Henry Gates, III in 1975 and is headquartered in Redmond, WA.
info.description_zh: Microsoft Corp. 從事軟體、服務、裝置和解決方案的開發和支援。它透過以下部門運作：生產力和業務流程、智慧雲端和更多個人運算。生產力和業務流程部門由與生產力、通訊和資訊服務相關的產品和服務組成，例如 Office Commercial、Office Consumer、LinkedIn 和 Dynamics 業務解決方案。智慧雲端部分包括企業和開發人員的公有、私有和混合伺服器產品和雲端服務，以及企業和合作夥伴服務。更多個人運算部分是指包括 Windows 作業系統、Windows 雲端服務、Surface、HoloLens、個人電腦配件、Xbox 硬體、Xbox 雲端遊戲、Microsoft News 和 Microsoft Edge 在內的產品和服務。該公司由 Paul Gardner Allen 和 William Henry Gates, III 於 1975 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州雷德蒙。

info.description: Blackrock TCP Capital Corp. is an externally managed, closed-end, non-diversified management investment company. It invests in debt securities of middle-market companies. The company was founded on April 2, 2012 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: Blackrock TCP Capital Corp. 是一家外部管理、封閉式、非多元化管理投資公司。它投資於中間市場公司的債務證券。該公司成立於2012年4月2日，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: Perpetua Resources Corp. is an exploration and development stage company, which engages in acquiring mining properties with the intention of exploring, evaluating and placing into production. The firm's principal business is the exploration, redevelopment, restoration and operation of the Stibnite Gold Project in Idaho, USA. Its mineral project is the Stibnite Gold Project, which contains mineral deposits and focuses on exploring, evaluating and redeveloping all of the deposits known as the Hangar Flats Deposit, West End Deposit and Yellow Pine Deposit, all of which are located within the Stibnite Gold Project. The company was founded in the year 1899 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.
info.description_zh: Perpetua Resources Corp. 是一家勘探和開發階段的公司，從事收購採礦業，目的是勘探、評估和投入生產。該公司的主要業務是美國愛達荷州輝銻礦金礦計畫的勘探、再開發、修復和營運。其礦產項目為輝銻礦金礦項目，包含礦藏，重點在於勘探、評估和再開發所有位於輝銻礦金礦項目內的礦床，包括Hangar Flats礦床、West End礦床和Yellow Pine礦床。該公司成立於 1899 年，總部位於愛達荷州博伊西。

info.description: AXT, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture and distribution of compound and single element semiconductor substrates. It also sells specialty material substrates and raw materials used to make substrates and other related products. The company was founded by Morris S. Young and Davis Zhang in 1986 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: AXT, Inc. 從事化合物和單元素半導體基板的設計、開發、製造和分銷。它還銷售特殊材料基材以及用於製造基材和其他相關產品的原材料。該公司由 Morris S. Young 和 Davis Zhang 於 1986 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of air transportation. The company was founded on July 5, 1994 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. 從事提供航空運輸業務。該公司成立於1994年7月5日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: J&J Snack Foods Corp. engages in the manufacturing of nutritional snack foods and distribution of frozen beverages to the food service and retail supermarket industries. It operates through the following segments: Food Service, Retail Supermarkets, and Frozen Beverages. The Food Service segment includes soft pretzels, frozen novelties, churros, handheld products, and baked goods. The Retail Supermarkets segment offers soft pretzel products including Superpretzel, frozen juice treats and desserts, including Luigi's real Italian ice, Minute Maid juice bars and soft frozen lemonade, Whole Fruit frozen fruit bars and sorbet, Philly Swirl cups and sticks, ICEE Squeeze-Up Tubes and dough enrobed handheld products including Patio burritos. The Frozen Beverages segment provides frozen beverages to the food service industry primarily under the names ICEE, SLUSH PUPPIE, and PARROT ICE in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, as well as repair and maintenance services. The company was founded by Gerald B. Shreiber in 1971 and is headquartered in Mount Laurel, NJ.
info.description_zh: J&J Snack Foods Corp. 從事營養休閒食品的製造以及向食品服務和零售超市行業分銷冷凍飲料。它透過以下部門運作：食品服務、零售超市和冷凍飲料。食品服務部門包括軟椒鹽捲餅、冷凍新奇食品、油條、手持產品和烘焙食品。零售超市部門提供軟椒鹽捲餅產品，包括 Superpretzel、冷凍果汁和甜點，包括 Luigi's 真正的意大利冰、Minute Maid 果汁棒和軟冷凍檸檬水、Whole Fruit 冷凍水果棒和果汁冰糕、Philly Swirl 杯子和棒、ICEE Squeeze-Up Tubes 和裹著麵團的手持產品，包括 Patio 捲餅。冷凍飲料部門主要在美國、墨西哥和加拿大以 ICEE、SLUSH PUPPIE 和 PARROT ICE 的名稱向食品服務業提供冷凍飲料，以及維修和保養服務。該公司由 Gerald B. Shreiber 於 1971 年創立，總部位於新澤西州勞雷爾山。

info.description: InterDigital, Inc. is a global research and development company, which engages in the business of wireless, video, artificial intelligence, and related technologies. It focuses on the design and development of communications, and entertainment products and services. The company was founded by Sherwin I. Seligsohn in 1972 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: InterDigital, Inc.是一家全球研發公司，從事無線、視訊、人工智慧及相關技術業務。它專注於通訊、娛樂產品和服務的設計和開發。該公司由 Sherwin I. Seligsohn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Porch Group, Inc. engages in the development and operation of a vertical software platform. It operates through Vertical Software and Insurance segments. The Vertical Software segment provides software and services to home services companies, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies and loan officers, title companies, moving companies, real estate agencies, utility companies, and others. The Insurance segment operates both as an insurance carrier underwriting home insurance policies, and as agent selling home and auto insurance and also includes porch's warranty service offering. The company was founded by Matt Ehrlichman & Ronnie Castro in 2011 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Porch Group, Inc.從事垂直軟體平台的開發和營運。它透過垂直軟體和保險部門運作。垂直软件部门为家庭服务公司提供软件和服务，例如房屋检查员、抵押贷款公司和信贷员、产权公司、搬家公司、房地产机构、公用事业公司等。保險部門既作為承保家庭保險的保險公司，又作為銷售家庭和汽車保險的代理商，也提供門廊的保固服務。該公司由 Matt Ehrlichman 和 Ronnie Castro 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Sprott Active Gold & Silver Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing 80% of its net assets in shares of gold and silver, focused companies that are engaged in exploring, developing and mining; or royalty and streaming companies engaged in the financing of gold and silver assets. The investment strategy of the fund is value oriented and contrarian. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Gold & Silver Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金尋求透過將80%的淨資產投資於黃金和白銀的股票來實現其投資目標，重點關注從事勘探、開發和採礦的公司；或從事黃金和白銀資產融資的特許權使用費和串流媒體公司。該基金的投資策略為價值導向、逆向投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Newegg Commerce, Inc. is an e-commerce company. It offers direct sales and an online marketplace platform for IT computer components, consumer electronics, entertainment, smart home and gaming products. The firm also provides third-party logistics services globally. The company was founded on July 22, 2003 and is headquartered in City of Industry, CA.
info.description_zh: Newegg Commerce, Inc. 是一家電子商務公司。它為 IT 電腦組件、消費性電子產品、娛樂、智慧家庭和遊戲產品提供直接銷售和線上市場平台。該公司在全球也提供第三方物流服務。該公司成立於2003年7月22日，總部位於加州工業城。

info.description: Themes Silver Miners ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the STOXX Global Silver Mining Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to global companies in the large-, mid- and small- capitalization segments that have significant exposure to the silver mining industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the Index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Silver Miners ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球白銀礦業指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為全球大、中、小型資本市場公司提供投資機會，這些公司在銀礦開採行業擁有大量投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成指數的證券以及基於指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Longeveron, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of cellular therapies for specific aging-related and life-threatening conditions. Its lead product, LOMECEL-B, is a cell-based therapy product, which is derived from culture-expanded medicinal signaling cells that are sourced from bone marrow of young, healthy, adult donors. The company was founded by Joshua M. Hare and Donald M. Soffer on October 9, 2014 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Longeveron, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發針對特定老化相關和危及生命的疾病的細胞療法。其主導產品 LOMECEL-B 是一種基於細胞的治療產品，源自於培養擴增的醫學訊號細胞，這些訊號細胞源自年輕、健康的成年捐贈者的骨髓。該公司由 Joshua M. Hare 和 Donald M. Soffer 於 2014 年 10 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Sabre Corp. is a software and technology company, which engages in the provision of technological solutions to the global travel and tourism industry. It operates through the Travel Solutions and Hospitality Solutions segments. The Travel Solutions segment provides global travel for suppliers and buyers through a business-to-business travel marketplace. The Hospitality Solutions segment provides software and solutions, through SaaS and hosted delivery models, to hoteliers around the world. It provides data-driven business intelligence, mobile, distribution, and software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: Sabre Corp.是一家軟體和科技公司，致力於為全球旅遊和旅遊業提供技術解決方案。它透過旅行解決方案和酒店解決方案部門運作。旅行解決方案部門透過企業對企業旅行市場為供應商和買家提供全球旅行服務。酒店解決方案部門透過 SaaS 和託管交付模式向世界各地的酒店經營者提供軟體和解決方案。它提供數據驅動的商業智慧、行動、分發和軟體即服務 (SaaS) 解決方案。該公司成立於2006年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: Touchstone Large Company Growth ETF utilizes a high-conviction, bottom-up investment approach to identify large-capitalization companies possessing durable competitive advantages and the potential for reliable long-term earnings growth. The strategy integrates a distinct valuation discipline into its selection process, aiming to participate in capital appreciation while maintaining price sensitivity within the growth equity universe by typically maintaining a concentrated portfolio of 25 to 35 equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone大型公司成長ETF採用高信念、自下而上的投資方法來識別擁有持久競爭優勢和可靠的長期獲利成長潛力的大資本公司。該策略將獨特的估值規則融入其選擇過程中，旨在參與資本增值，同時透過通常維持由 25 至 35 種股票證券組成的集中投資組合來維持成長股票領域內的價格敏感度。

info.description: Zoom Communications, Inc. engages in the provision of a communications and collaboration platform. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia Pacific, and Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The company was founded by Eric S. Yuan in 2011 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Zoom Communications, Inc. 致力於提供通訊和協作平台。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞太地區、歐洲、中東和非洲。該公司由 Eric S. Yuan 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: SailPoint, Inc. engages in the provision of a comprehensive identity security platform for the enterprise. Its solutions enable organizations to establish, control, and automate policies that help them define and maintain a robust security posture and achieve regulatory compliance. The company was founded by Mark David McClain in 2005 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: SailPoint, Inc. 致力於為企業提供全面的身份安全平台。其解決方案使組織能夠建立、控制和自動化策略，幫助他們定義和維護強大的安全態勢並實現法規遵循。該公司由 Mark David McClain 於 2005 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Thornburg Focus Growth Fund is an actively managed U.S. equity strategy that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a concentrated yet diversified portfolio of 40-60 high-quality businesses identified through rigorous bottom-up fundamental research. The fund utilizes a unique three-basket portfolio construction to balance exposures across the growth spectrum, primarily targeting mid-to-large-capitalization U.S. companies that possess sustainable competitive advantages and trade below their estimated long-term intrinsic value.
info.description_zh: Thornburg Focus Growth Fund 是一項積極管理的美國股票策略，透過投資於透過嚴格的自下而上的基礎研究確定的 40-60 家優質企業的集中而多元化的投資組合，以實現長期資本增值。該基金利用獨特的三籃子投資組合結構來平衡整個成長範圍的風險敞口，主要針對擁有可持續競爭優勢且交易價格低於其估計長期內在價值的大中型美國公司。

info.description: First Solar, Inc. is a solar technology company, which engages in the provision of solar modules. It is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of cadmium tellurid (CdTe) solar modules, which convert sunlight into electricity. The company was founded by Michael J. Ahearn in 1999 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: First Solar, Inc.是一家太陽能技術公司，從事提供太陽能模組業務。該公司從事碲化鎘（CdTe）太陽能組件的設計、製造和銷售，該組件可將陽光轉化為電能。該公司由 Michael J. Ahearn 於 1999 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: TPG, Inc. operates as a global, diversified alternative asset management firm. The firm invests across five multi-product platforms: Capital, Growth, Impact, Real Estate, and Market Solutions. It aims to build dynamic products and options for its clients while also instituting discipline and operational excellence across the investment strategy and performance of its portfolio. The company was founded by Jim Coulter and David Bonderman in 1992 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.

info.description: 9F, Inc. is an Internet technology company, which operates as a digital financial account platform integrating and personalizing financial services. It provides financial products and services across loan products, online wealth management products, and payment facilitation, all integrated under a single digital financial account. The company was founded by Lei Liu and Li Xing Chen in August 2006 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 9F, Inc.是一家網路科技公司，致力於整合和個人化金融服務的數位金融帳戶平台。它提供涵蓋貸款產品、線上理財產品和支付便利的金融產品和服務，所有這些都整合在一個數位金融帳戶下。該公司由劉雷和陳李星於2006年8月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Avnet, Inc. engages in the provision of distribution and sale of electronic components. It operates through the Electronic Components and Farnell segments. The Electronic Components segment markets and sells semiconductors, interconnect, passive and electromechanical devices, and integrated components. The Farnell segment focuses on the distribution of electronic components and related products to the electronic system design community utilizing multi-channel sales and marketing resources. The company was founded by Charles Avnet in 1921 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Avnet, Inc. 從事電子元件的分銷和銷售業務。它透過電子元件部門和派睿電子部門運作。電子元件部門行銷和銷售半導體、互連、被動和機電設備以及整合元件。 Farnell 部門專注於利用多通路銷售和行銷資源向電子系統設計界分銷電子元件和相關產品。該公司由 Charles Avnet 於 1921 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Founder-Led 2x Daily ETF is an actively managed fund seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to 200% of the daily performance of the Founder-Led Index. The strategy targets a basket of the largest U.S. publicly traded companies where at least one original founder currently serves in a key executive leadership role, utilizing daily leverage to magnify price movements of these firms.
info.description_zh: 創辦人主導的 2x 每日 ETF 是一款積極管理的基金，尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於創始人主導的指數每日表現的 200%。該策略針對一籃子美國最大的上市公司，其中至少有一名原始創辦人目前擔任關鍵的執行領導角色，利用每日槓桿來放大這些公司的價格變動。

info.description: Satellogic, Inc. operates as a vertically integrated geospatial company. It is creating and continuously enhancing the first scalable, fully automated EO platform with the ability to remap the entire planet at both high-frequency and high-resolution, providing accessible and affordable solutions for customers. The company was founded by Emiliano Kargieman and Gerardo Richarte in July 2010 and is headquartered in Davidson, NC.
info.description_zh: Satellogic, Inc. 是一家垂直整合的地理空間公司。它正在創建並不斷增強第一個可擴展、全自動的 EO 平台，能夠以高頻和高解析度重新繪製整個地球，為客戶提供易於使用且價格合理的解決方案。該公司由 Emiliano Kargieman 和 Gerardo Richarte 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州戴維森。

info.description: Ondas, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, and sale of wireless radio systems for secure, wide area mission-critical business-to-business networks. It operates through the Ondas Networks and Ondas Autonomous Systems segments. The Ondas Networks segment provides wireless connectivity solutions enabling mission-critical Industrial Internet applications and services. The Ondas Autonomous Systems segment designs, develops, and markets commercial drone solutions via the Optimus System and Scout System. The company was founded on December 22, 2014 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Ondas, Inc. 從事安全、廣域任務關鍵型企業對企業網路的無線電系統的開發、行銷和銷售。它透過 Ondas Networks 和 Ondas Autonomous Systems 部門運作。 Ondas Networks 部門提供無線連接解決方案，支援任務關鍵型工業互聯網應用和服務。 Ondas Autonomous Systems 部門透過 Optimus System 和 Scout System 設計、開發和銷售商用無人機解決方案。該公司成立於2014年12月22日，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Forrester Research, Inc. engages in the provision of advisory services. It operates through the following business segments: Research, Consulting, and Events. The Research segment includes the revenues of the research, connect, and analytics products. The Consulting segment consists of project consulting organization. The Events segment refers to developing and hosting in-person and virtual events. The firm serves the business-to-business marketing, sales, information technology, business-to-consumer marketing, and customer experience sectors. The company was founded by George F. Colony on July 7, 1983 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Forrester Research, Inc. 從事提供顧問服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：研究、諮詢和活動。研究部門包括研究、連結和分析產品的收入。諮詢部門由專案諮詢組織組成。活動部分指開發和舉辦現場和虛擬活動。該公司為企業對企業行銷、銷售、資訊科技、企業對消費者行銷和客戶體驗領域提供服務。該公司由 George F. Colony 於 1983 年 7 月 7 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: iShares Defense Industrials Active ETF seeks to maximize total return by investing in companies that fund management believes are well-positioned to benefit from increased global defense and security spending. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. defense and related industrials companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Defense Industrials Active ETF 尋求透過投資基金管理公司認為能夠從全球國防和安全支出增加中受益的公司來最大化總回報。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款投資於美國和非美國國防及相關工業公司發行的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of mission critical products, services and solutions for United States national security priorities. It operates through the Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) and Unmanned Systems (US) segments. The KGS segment consists of an aggregation of KGS operating segments, including microwave electronic products, space, satellite and cyber, training solutions. The US segment refers to the unmanned aerial, unmanned ground, unmanned seaborne and related command, control and communications system businesses. The company was founded on December 19, 1994, and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
info.description_zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 致力於為美國國家安全優先事項提供關鍵任務產品、服務和解決方案。它透過 Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) 和 Unmanned Systems (US) 部門運作。 KGS 部門由 KGS 營運部門組成，包括微波電子產品、太空、衛星和網路、培訓解決方案。美國業務涉及無人機、無人地面、無人海上及相關指揮、控制和通訊系統業務。該公司成立於1994年12月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州朗德羅克。

info.description: Invesco NASDAQ Internet ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq CTA Internet IndexSM. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of companies engaged in Internet-related businesses that are listed on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE"), NYSE American, Cboe Exchange ("Cboe") or The Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ Internet ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq CTA Internet IndexSM 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤在紐約證券交易所（“NYSE”）、紐約證券交易所美國證券交易所（NYSE American）、芝加哥期權交易所（“Cboe”）或納斯達克股票市場（“納斯達克”）上市的從事互聯網相關業務的公司的業績。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: StepStone Group, Inc. is a private markets investment firm. It focuses on providing customized investment solutions and advisory and data services to clients. The firm serves public and private defined benefit and defined contribution pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and insurance companies, prominent endowments, foundations, family offices and private wealth clients, which include high-net-worth and mass affluent individuals. The company was founded by Monte M. Brem, Jose A. Fernandez, Steve R. Mitchell, Thomas Porter Keck, and Robert A. Waldo in January 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 行健資本集團 (StepStone Group, Inc.) 是一家私募市場投資公司。它專注於為客戶提供客製化的投資解決方案以及諮詢和數據服務。該公司為公共和私人固定福利和固定繳款退休基金、主權財富基金和保險公司、知名捐贈基金、基金會、家族辦公室和私人財富客戶（其中包括高淨值和大眾富裕人士）提供服務。該公司由 Monte M. Brem、Jose A. Fernandez、Steve R. Mitchell、Thomas Porter Keck 和 Robert A. Waldo 於 2007 年 1 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Brown Advisory Sustainable Growth ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of domestic companies that meet the sustainable investment criteria of the fund, collectively the "investment criteria."
info.description_zh: Brown Advisory 永續成長 ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於符合基金可持續投資標準（統稱為「投資標準」）的國內公司的股本證券。

info.description: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the IPOX  -100 Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of the equity securities of the 100 largest and typically most liquid initial public offerings ("IPOs") (including spin-offs and equity carve-outs) of companies that are economically tied to Europe. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求與稱為 IPOX -100 Europe Index（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在衡量與歐洲經濟相關的 100 家規模最大且通常流動性最強的首次公開發行（「IPO」）（包括分拆和股權分拆）公司的股票表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MongoDB, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a general-purpose database platform. The firm's products include MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Atlas, and Community Server. It also offers professional services including consulting and training. The company was founded by Eliot Horowitz, Dwight A. Merriman, Kevin P. Ryan, and Geir Magnusson Jr. in November 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MongoDB, Inc. 從事通用資料庫平台的開發和提供。該公司的產品包括 MongoDB Enterprise Advanced、MongoDB Atlas 和 Community Server。它還提供包括諮詢和培訓在內的專業服務。該公司由 Eliot Horowitz、Dwight A. Merriman、Kevin P. Ryan 和 Geir Magnusson Jr. 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: IES Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of designing and installing integrated electrical and technology systems. It operates through the following segments: Communications, Residential, Infrastructure Solutions, and Commercial and Industrial. The Communications segment provides technology infrastructure services such as designing, building, and maintaining communications infrastructure within data centers for co-location and managed hosting customers. The Residential segment offers electrical installation services for single-family housing and multi-family apartment complexes, as well as heating, ventilation, and air conditioning and plumbing installation services in certain markets. The Infrastructure Solutions segment includes electro-mechanical solutions for industrial operations including apparatus repair and custom-engineered products such as generator enclosures used in data centers and other industrial applications. The Commercial and Industrial segment is involved in electrical and mechanical design, construction, and maintenance services to the commercial and industrial markets in various regional markets and nationwide in certain areas of expertise such as the power infrastructure market and data centers. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: IES Holdings, Inc.從事設計和安裝整合電氣和技術系統的業務。它透過以下部門運作：通訊部門、住宅部門、基礎設施解決方案部門以及商業和工業部門。通訊部門提供技術基礎設施服務，例如為主機代管和託管客戶設計、建置和維護資料中心內的通訊基礎設施。住宅部門為單戶住宅和多戶公寓大樓提供電氣安裝服務，並在某些市場提供暖氣、通風、空調和管道安裝服務。基礎設施解決方案部門包括用於工業運營的機電解決方案，包括設備維修和客製化設計產品，例如資料中心和其他工業應用中使用的發電機外殼。商業和工業部門在電力基礎設施市場和資料中心等某些專業領域為各個區域市場和全國的商業和工業市場提供電氣和機械設計​​、施工和維護服務。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Aptera Motors Corp. is an automotive technology company focused on the development, production, and distribution of energy-efficient, solar-powered, battery-electric vehicles. Its flagship product, the Aptera, is a three-wheeled, two-seat solar vehicle designed to reduce reliance on traditional charging by utilizing integrated solar panels. The company was founded by Steve Fambro and Chris Anthony and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Aptera Motors Corp. 是一家汽車技術公司，專注於開發、生產和分銷節能型太陽能電池電動車。其旗艦產品 Aptera 是一款三輪兩座太陽能車，旨在透過利用整合式太陽能板來減少對傳統充電的依賴。該公司由 Steve Fambro 和 Chris Anthony 創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Level Four Large Cap Growth Active ETF seeks maximum total return and above peer average risk-adjusted return. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of carefully selected, high-quality U.S. companies. The fund invests primarily in the domestic equity securities of companies selected by Level Four Capital Management, LLC for their growth potential within various market sectors.
info.description_zh: 第四級大盤成長主動 ETF 尋求最大總回報和高於同業平均風險調整回報。本基金主要投資於精心挑選的優質美國公司的股本證券。該基金主要投資於 Level Four Capital Management, LLC 因其在各個市場領域的成長潛力而選擇的公司的國內股本證券。

info.description: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。该基金是一只主动管理的交易所交易基金（“ETF”），旨在通过利用人工智能增强的投资策略来实现其投资目标。在正常情况下，该基金将至少80%的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款金额）投资于美国上市大型资本公司的证券。

info.description: First Trust Growth Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called The Growth Strength Index. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts ("REITs") that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to a mix of domestic equities with filters for liquidity, return on equity, long-term debt, revenue and cash flow growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Growth Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called The Growth Strength Index. Under mal market conditions, 電話borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts ("REITs") that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to a mix of domestic equities with domes for liquidity, turn liued, re書 liue growth.它是非多元化的。

info.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. engages in the retailing of home products. It operates through the following segments: Pottery Barn, West Elm, Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn Kids and Teen and Other. The Other segment includes net revenues from international franchise operations, Rejuvenation and Mark and Graham. The company was founded by Charles E. Williams on September 15, 1956 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 從事家居產品零售。該公司透過以下部門營運：Pottery Barn、West Elm、Williams Sonoma、Pottery Barn Kids and Teen and Other。其他部門包括來自國際特許經營業務、Rejuvenation 以及 Mark and Graham 的淨收入。該公司由 Charles E. Williams 於 1956 年 9 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: iRhythm Holdings, Inc. is a digital healthcare company, which engages in the provision of design, development, and commercialization of device-based technology to provide ambulatory cardiac monitoring services. It also provides solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease. The company was founded by Uday N. Kumar in September 2006 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: iRhythm Holdings, Inc. 是一家數位醫療保健公司，從事基於設備的技術的設計、開發和商業化，以提供動態心臟監測服務。它還提供檢測、預測和預防疾病的解決方案。該公司由 Uday N. Kumar 於 2006 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Varex Imaging Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of imaging components. It operates through the Medical and Industrial segments. The Medical segment delivers and services x-ray imaging components, including X-ray tubes, digital detectors, high voltage connectors, image-processing software and workstations, and three-dimensional reconstruction software. The Industrial segment offers x-ray imaging products for use in security, and nondestructive testing and inspection applications. The company was founded on July 18, 2016 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Varex Imaging Corp. 從事成像組件的設計、製造和銷售。它透過醫療和工業部門運作。醫療部門提供 X 光成像組件並提供服務，包括 X 光管、數位偵測器、高壓連接器、影像處理軟體和工作站以及三維重建軟體。工業部門提供用於安全、無損測試和檢查應用的 X 射線成像產品。該公司成立於2016年7月18日，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: iShares Enhanced Large Cap Core Active ETF seeks to outperform the Russell 1000 Index (the "Russell 1000 Index"). The fund is actively managed and seeks to pursue its investment objective while seeking to maintain a low tracking error to the Russell 1000 Index. The fund invests in a portfolio of large cap equity securities in a disciplined manner, using proprietary return forecast models that incorporate quantitative analysis. While the fund primarily invests in securities included in the Russell 1000 Index, the fund may also hold securities that are not included in the Russell 1000 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 增強型大盤核心主動 ETF 力求跑贏 Russell 1000 指數（「Russell 1000 指數」）。該基金採用積極管理方式，力求實現其投資目標，同時力求維持對羅素 1000 指數的低追蹤誤差。本基金採用結合定量分析的專有報酬預測模型，以嚴格的方式投資於大盤股證券投資組合。雖然該基金主要投資於羅素 1000 指數中包含的證券，但該基金也可能持有未包含在羅素 1000 指數中的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long SNAP Daily ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to provide 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Snap Inc. (SNAP). The strategy is a tactical, high-conviction tool designed for professional traders to amplify daily price movements of the underlying social media company through the use of financial derivatives.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long SNAP Daily ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，旨在提供 Snap Inc. (SNAP) 普通股 200% 的每日表現。該策略是一種戰術性的、高度可信的工具，專為專業交易者設計，透過使用金融衍生品來放大基礎社交媒體公司的每日價格變動。

info.description: Argent Large Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Large Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資大型公司的股權證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. engages in the operation of a general consumer product retail and wholesale business selling to customers through various channels including retail locations, websites, catalogs, and mobile applications. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Subscription, and Wholesale. The Retail segment includes store and digital channels including Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands. The Subscription segment consists of the Nuuly brand, which is a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service. The Wholesale segment focuses on sale through department and specialty stores worldwide. The company was founded by Richard A. Hayne and Scott A. Belair in 1970 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Urban Outfitters, Inc. 從事一般消費品零售和批發業務，透過零售地點、網站、目錄和行動應用程式等多種管道向客戶銷售產品。它透過以下部門運作：零售、訂閱和批發。零售部門包括商店和數位管道，包括 Anthropologie、Free People、FP Movement 和 Urban Outfitters 品牌。訂閱部門由 Nuuly 品牌組成，該品牌提供每月女裝訂閱租賃服務。批發部門專注於透過全球百貨公司和專賣店進行銷售。該公司由 Richard A. Hayne 和 Scott A. Belair 於 1970 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Brown Advisory Flexible Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital. Under normal conditions, Brown Advisory LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the value of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. The fund invests primarily in a portfolio of equity securities issued by large, middle, and small capitalization companies that the Adviser believes have strong, or improving, long-term business characteristics and share prices that do not reflect certain favorable fundamental attributes.
info.description_zh: Brown Advisory 彈性股票 ETF 致力於實現資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，Brown Advisory LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券來實現基金的投資目標。該基金主要投資於由大、中、小型公司發行的股本證券投資組合，顧問認為這些公司具有強勁或不斷改善的長期業務特徵，且股價並未反映某些有利的基本屬性。

info.description: Aurora Cannabis, Inc. engages in the production, distribution, and sale of cannabis and cannabis-derivative products. It operates through the following business segments: Cannabis and Plant Propagation. The company was founded by Terry Booth and Steve Dobler on December 21, 2006 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aurora Cannabis, Inc. 從事大麻及大麻衍生產品的生產、分銷和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：大麻和植物繁殖。該公司由 Terry Booth 和 Steve Dobler 於 2006 年 12 月 21 日創立，總部位於加拿大埃德蒙頓。

info.description: Novanta, Inc. engages in the provision of core technology solutions to healthcare and advanced industrial original equipment manufacturers. It operates through the following segments: Automation Enabling Technologies and Medical Solutions. The Automation Enabling Technologies segment enagages in the designing, manufacturing and marketing of laser beam steering and scanning solutions, laser sources, robotic and precision motion, robotic end-of-arm tooling, and bearing spindles to customers worldwide. The Medical Solutions segment is involved in the designing, manufacturing and marketing of medical grade technologies, including medical insufflators and endoscopic pumps and related disposables, imaging, identification and RFID solutions, advanced motion control solutions, light engines, and integrated operating room technologies. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Bedford, MA.
info.description_zh: Novanta, Inc. 致力於為醫療保健和先進工業原始設備製造商提供核心技術解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：自動化支援技術和醫療解決方案。自動化支援技術部門致力於向全球客戶設計、製造和行銷雷射光束轉向和掃描解決方案、雷射源、機器人和精密運動、機器人臂端工具和軸承主軸。醫療解決方案部門從事醫療級技術的設計、製造和行銷，包括醫用氣腹機和內視鏡幫浦及相關一次性用品、影像、辨識和RFID解決方案、先進運動控制解決方案、光引擎和整合式手術室技術。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州貝德福德。

info.description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: New Mountain Finance Corp. is a business development company, which engages in providing direct lending solutions to upper middle-market companies in the United States. It offers equity and debt financing, including senior secured loans, buyout financing, mezzanine financing, and growth capital solutions. The company was founded on June 29, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: New Mountain Finance Corp. 是一家業務開發公司，致力於為美國中高端市場公司提供直接貸款解決方案。它提供股權和債務融資，包括優先擔保貸款、收購融資、夾層融資和成長資本解決方案。該公司成立於2010年6月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Artificial Intelligence and Robotics ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq CTA Artificial Intelligence and Robotics IndexSM (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies engaged in the artificial intelligence ("AI") and robotics segments of the technology, industrial and other economic sectors.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克人工智慧和機器人 ETF 尋求與名為納斯達克 CTA 人工智慧和機器人指數 SM（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤技術、工業和其他經濟領域的人工智慧（「AI」）和機器人領域公司的表現。

info.description: Fastenal Co. engages in the distribution of fasteners and tools. It also operates hardware stores. The company was founded by Robert A. Kierlin, Michael M. Gostomski, Henry K. McConnon, John D. Remick, and Stephen M. Slaggie in November 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, MN.
info.description_zh: Fastenal Co. 從事緊固件和工具的分銷。它還經營五金店。該公司由 Robert A. Kierlin、Michael M. Gostomski、Henry K. McConnon、John D. Remick 和 Stephen M. Slaggie 於 1967 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州威諾納。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Automation ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive automation companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性自動化 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性自動化公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the Nasdaq International Rising Dividend Achievers Index. Launched in February 2026, the fund targets high-quality, dividend-paying companies in developed markets outside the United States. To qualify for inclusion, companies must demonstrate consistent growth in both dividends and earnings-per-share, while maintaining strong balance sheet health characterized by high cash-to-debt ratios and conservative payout ratios. The fund uses an indexing approach to provide exposure to international "dividend achievers" with the potential for both income and capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF 是一支被動管理的交易所交易基金，追蹤納斯達克國際 Rising Dividend Achievers 指數。該基金於 2026 年 2 月推出，目標投資於美國以外已開發市場的優質、派息公司。為了獲得入選資格，公司必須表現出股息和每股收益的持續增長，同時保持強勁的資產負債表健康狀況，其特點是高現金債務比率和保守的派息率。該基金採用指數化方法，向具有收入和資本增值潛力的國際「股息實現者」提供投資機會。

info.description: HCM Large Cap Growth ETF is an actively managed fund constructed utilizing a proprietary quantitative multi-factor modeling process to identify high-conviction large-cap stocks and sectors within the Russell 1000 Index universe based on fundamental and technical ranking metrics. The investment strategy overweights highly ranked broad market sectors and focuses allocations on individual equities falling within the top quartile of its systemic scores, supplemented by subjective macroeconomic and risk management analysis from the adviser's investment committee.
info.description_zh: HCM 大盤成長 ETF 是一款主動管理基金，利用專有的定量多因素建模流程構建，根據基本面和技術排名指標識別羅素 1000 指數範圍內高可信度的大盤股和板塊。此投資策略超重排名靠前的廣泛市場板塊，並將配置重點放在系統得分前四分之一的個股上，並輔以顧問投資委員會的主觀宏觀經濟和風險管理分析。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long Nem Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NEM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NEM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍長期 Nem 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NEM 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 NEM 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Boston Scientific Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of medical devices that are used in interventional medical procedures. It operates through the MedSurg and Cardiovascular segments. The MedSurg segment includes Endoscopy, Urology, and Neuromodulation. The Cardiovascular segment consists of Cardiology and Peripheral Interventions. The company was founded by John E. Abele and Pete Michael Nicholas on June 29, 1979 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: 波士頓科學公司 (Boston Scientific Corp.) 從事介入性醫療手術中使用的醫療設備的開發、製造和行銷。它透過 MedSurg 和心血管部門運作。 MedSurg 部分包括內視鏡檢查、泌尿外科和神經調節。心血管部分由心臟病學和周邊幹預組成。該公司由 John E. Abele 和 Pete Michael Nicholas 於 1979 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Global X DAX Germany ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the price and yield performance of the DAX Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The index tracks the segment of the largest and most actively traded companies - known as blue chips - on the German equities market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X DAX 德國 ETF 力求提供在費用和開支之前與 DAX 指數的價格和收益率表現密切相關的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該指數追蹤德國股票市場上規模最大、交易最活躍的公司（稱為藍籌股）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 8x8, Inc. engages in the provision of enterprise communication solutions. It offers solutions to the business services, education, financial services, government, healthcare, and manufacturing industries. The company was founded in February 1987 and is headquartered in Campbell, CA.
info.description_zh: 8x8, Inc. 從事提供企業通訊解決方案。它為商業服務、教育、金融服務、政府、醫療保健和製造業提供解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 2 月，總部位於加州坎貝爾。

info.description: abrdn Focused U.S. Small Cap Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities issued by U.S. small-cap companies. The fund will be managed pursuant to a "focused" strategy whereby the fund's investment adviser will typically invest the fund's assets in a small number of issuers. Generally, the Advisor expects to hold approximately 35 to 45 issuers.
info.description_zh: abrdn 專注於美國小型股主動 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於美國小型公司發行的股本證券。該基金將根據「集中」策略進行管理，基金的投資顧問通常將基金的資產投資於少數發行人。一般來說，顧問預計將持有約 35 至 45 家發行人。

info.description: Democratic Large Cap Core ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Democratic Large Cap Core Index. The index is a subset of the S&P 500 Index designed to provide exposure to large capitalization companies that make political contributions to Democratic Party candidates and political action committees above a certain threshold. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies included in the index.
info.description_zh: 民主大盤核心 ETF 旨在追蹤民主大盤核心指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是標準普爾 500 指數的子集，旨在為向民主黨候選人和政治行動委員會提供超過一定門檻的政治捐款的大型資本公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於指數所包含公司的證券。

info.description: SGI Enhanced Market Leaders ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and seeks to achieve its objective by investing under normal circumstances at least 80% of the net assets of the portfolio (including borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of large-capitalization companies. It will also invest in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型市場領導者 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將投資組合淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）至少80%投資於大型公司的證券來實現其目標。它還將投資於尋求產生當前收入的期權策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ALPS/CoreCommodity Natural Resources ETF seeks to maximize real returns, consistent with prudent investment management. The fund seeks to achieve its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of natural resources companies. The fund's investments in equity securities will primarily consist of investments in common stock. Its investments in foreign markets include investments in companies located in emerging markets.
info.description_zh: ALPS/CoreCommodity 自然資源 ETF 力求實際回報最大化，同時遵循審慎的投資管理。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於自然資源公司的股本證券來實現其目標。該基金對股本證券的投資將主要包括對普通股的投資。其在國外市場的投資包括對位於新興市場的公司的投資。

info.description: WEBs Consumer Discretionary XLY Defined Volatility ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLY Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the consumer discretionary sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs 非必需消費品 XLY 定義波動率 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax 定義波動率 XLY 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場非必需消費品產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Humilis US Focused Opportunities ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified equity strategy that integrates top-down macroeconomic analysis with bottom-up fundamental research to build a high-conviction portfolio of large-capitalization U.S. companies. The fund targets high-quality corporate issuers demonstrating strong earnings per share growth, solid balance sheets, stable operating margins, and historical dividend appreciation across different phases of the business cycle.
info.description_zh: Humilis US Focused Opportunities ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化股票策略，將自上而下的宏觀經濟分析與自下而上的基本面研究相結合，以建立大市值美國公司的高信念投資組合。該基金的目標對像是在商業週期不同階段表現出強勁的每股盈餘成長、穩健的資產負債表、穩定的營業利潤率以及歷史股息增值的優質企業發行人。

info.description: Global X Conscious Companies ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Concinnity Conscious Companies Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies listed in the U.S. that operate their businesses in a sustainable and responsible manner, as measured by their ability to achieve positive outcomes that are consistent with a multi-stakeholder operating system ("MsOS"), as defined by the provider of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: Global X Conscious Companies ETF 尋求提供與 Concinnity Conscious Companies Index 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在為以可持續和負責任的方式運營業務的美國上市公司提供投資機會，衡量標準是其實現與多利益相關者操作系統（“MsOS”）一致的積極成果的能力，由基礎指數提供商定義。

info.description: iShares MSCI Europe Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Europe Small Cap Index composed of small-capitalization developed market equities in Europe. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted, market capitalization-weighted index that captures small-capitalization representation across the 15 developed market countries in Europe.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 歐洲小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤由歐洲小型已開發市場股票組成的 MSCI 歐洲小型股指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，反映了歐洲 15 個已開發市場國家的小型股代表性。

info.description: Invesco Top QQQ ETF seeks total return through long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective through exposure to the top companies in the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "Nasdaq-100"), as represented in the Nasdaq-100 Mega Index (the "Index"). The Nasdaq-100 consists of securities of 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Top QQQ ETF透過資本的長期成長尋求總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資 Nasdaq-100 指數（「Nasdaq-100」）中的頂級公司（如 Nasdaq-100 Mega Index（「指數」）所代表的公司）來實現其投資目標。納斯達克 100 指數由在納斯達克股票市場有限責任公司上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司的證券（按市值計算）組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of U.S. companies and the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust. The fund invests in equity securities of U.S. companies through exchange-traded futures contracts, equity securities of U.S. companies and ETFs that primarily invest in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund invests up to 15% of its total assets in the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust.
info.description_zh: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於美國公司的股本證券和灰階比特幣信託基金。該基金透過交易所交易的期貨合約、美國公司股本證券以及主要投資於美國公司股本證券的ETF投資於美國公司股本證券。該基金將其總資產的 15% 投資於灰階比特幣信託基金。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform 500 ETF seeks investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of Morningstar US Large Cap Select Index composed of large-capitalization U.S. equities. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index or in depositary receipts representing component securities in the underlying index. The underlying index targets the largest 500 U.S. stocks by market capitalization and weights them by float-adjusted market capitalization.
info.description_zh: Engine No. 1 Transform 500 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前與由大盤美國股票組成的晨星美國大盤精選指數表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券或代表相關指數組成證券的存託憑證。基礎指數以市值最大的 500 隻美國股票為目標，並以流通市值對其進行加權。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 註冊地為美國。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI USA Leaders ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended ESG Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of U.S. companies that have favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI USA Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Extended ESG Leaders Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵的美國公司的股票表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Ocean Park International ETF seeks to provide total return and to limit exposure to downside risk. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund's assets between unaffiliated international equity ETFs and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in underlying ETFs.
info.description_zh: 海洋公園國際ETF旨在提供總回報並限制下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在獨立的國際股票 ETF 和現金等價物之間戰術性地分配基金資產來實現其投資目標。在正常市場條件下，顧問預計將其大部分資產投資於基礎 ETF。

info.description: Royal Gold, Inc. engages in the business of acquiring and managing precious metal streams, royalties, and similar interests. It operates under the Acquisition and Management of Stream Interests, and Acquisition and Management of Royalty Interests segments. The Acquisition and Management of Stream Interests segment focuses on metal streams, which are purchase agreements that provide, in exchange for an upfront deposit payment, the right to purchase all or a portion of one or more metals produced, at a price determined for the life of the transaction. The Acquisition and Management of Royalty Interests segment is involved in non-operating interests in mining projects that provide the right to revenue or metals produced from the project. The company was founded by Stanley Dempsey in 1981 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Royal Gold, Inc. 從事收購和管理貴金屬流、特許權使用費和類似權益的業務。它在流權益的收購和管理以及特許權權益的收購和管理部門下運作。流權益的收購和管理部門專注於金屬流，這是一種購買協議，提供以交易期間確定的價格購買全部或部分所生產的一種或多種金屬的權利，以換取預付定金。特許權權益的收購和管理部門涉及採礦項目的非經營權益，這些權益提供了從該項目生產的收入或金屬的權利。該公司由 Stanley Dempsey 於 1981 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: Global X S&P 500 Catholic Values ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, of the S&P 500 Catholic Values Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is based on the S&P 500 Index, and generally comprises approximately 500 or less U.S. listed common stocks. From this starting universe, constituents are screened to exclude companies involved in activities which are perceived to be inconsistent with Catholic values as outlined in the Socially Responsible Investment Guidelines of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops.
info.description_zh: Global X S&P 500 Catholic Values ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Catholic Values Index 的價格和收益率表現相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數以標準普爾 500 指數為基礎，通常包含約 500 隻或更少的美國上市普通股。從這個起始範圍開始，對選民進行篩選，以排除參與被認為與美國天主教主教會議社會責任投資指南中概述的天主教價值觀不一致的活動的公司。

info.description: Superior Group of Cos., Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of uniforms, corporate identity apparel, career apparel, and accessories to the medical and health fields as well as for the industrial, commercial, leisure, and public safety industries. It operates through the following segments: Branded Products, Healthcare Apparel, and Contact Centers. The Branded Products segment produces and sells customized merchandising solutions, promotional products and branded uniform programs. The Healthcare Apparel segment manufactures and sells a wide range of healthcare apparel, such as scrubs, lab coats, protective apparel and patient gowns. The Contact Centers segment offers outsourced, nearshore business process outsourcing, contact and call-center support services. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Superior Group of Cos., Inc. 從事醫療和健康領域以及工業、商業、休閒和公共安全行業的製服、企業形象服裝、職業服裝和配件的製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：品牌產品部門、醫療保健服裝部門和聯絡中心部門。品牌產品部門生產和銷售客製化行銷解決方案、促銷產品和品牌制服項目。醫療保健服裝部門生產和銷售各種醫療保健服裝，例如手術服、實驗室外套、防護服和病人服。聯絡中心部門提供外包、近岸業務流程外包、聯絡和呼叫中心支援服務。該公司成立於 1920 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: CAE, Inc. engages in the provision of digital immersion and training services for the civil aviation, defense and security, and healthcare markets. It operates through the Civil Aviation, and Defense and Security segments. The Civil Aviation segment focuses on aviation professionals, airlines, business aviation operators, and aircraft manufacturers. The Defense and Security segment offers a portfolio of training centers, training services, and simulation products across the air, land, naval, and public safety markets. The company was founded by Kenneth R. Patrick in 1947 and is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Canada.
info.description_zh: CAE, Inc. 致力於為民航、國防和安全以及醫療保健市場提供數位沉浸式和培訓服務。它透過民用航空、國防和安全部門運作。民用航空部門專注於航空專業人士、航空公司、公務航空業者和飛機製造商。國防和安全部門提供涵蓋空中、陸地、海軍和公共安全市場的訓練中心、訓練服務和模擬產品組合。該公司由 Kenneth R. Patrick 於 1947 年創立，總部位於加拿大聖洛朗。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Enhanced U.S. Equity ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities issued by small-, mid- and large-cap U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: 高盛增強型美國股票 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於美國小型、中型和大型公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: Oracle Corp. engages in the provision of products and services that address aspects of corporate information technology environments, including applications and infrastructure technologies. It operates through the following business segments: Cloud and License, Hardware, and Services. The Cloud and License segment markets, sells, and delivers enterprise applications and infrastructure technologies through cloud and on-premise deployment models including cloud services and license support offerings. The Hardware segment provides infrastructure technologies including Oracle Engineered Systems, servers, storage, industry-specific hardware, operating systems, virtualization, management, and other hardware-related software. The Services segment offers consulting, advanced support, and education services. The company was founded by Lawrence Joseph Ellison, Robert Nimrod Miner, and Edward A. Oates on June 16, 1977 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Oracle Corp. 提供解決企業資訊科技環境各方面問題的產品和服務，包括應用程式和基礎架構技術。它透過以下業務部門運作：雲端和授權、硬體和服務。雲端和許可證部門透過雲端和本地部署模型（包括雲端服務和許可證支援產品）行銷、銷售和交付企業應用程式和基礎設施技術。硬體部門提供基礎設施技術，包括 Oracle 工程系統、伺服器、儲存、行業特定硬體、作業系統、虛擬化、管理和其他硬體相關軟體。服務部門提供諮詢、高階支援和教育服務。該公司由 Lawrence Joseph Ellison、Robert Nimrod Miner 和 Edward A. Oates 於 1977 年 6 月 16 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLI ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLI Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the industrial sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLI ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLI 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場工業部門公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Metaverse ETF seeks to provide investment returns that correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the performance of the Fidelity Metaverse IndexSM. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the index and in depositary receipts representing securities included in the index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of a global universe of companies that develop, manufacture, distribute, or sell products or services related to establishing and enabling the Metaverse. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Fidelity Metaverse ETF 力求提供與 Fidelity Metaverse IndexSM 的表現（扣除費用和開支之前）相對應的投資回報。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數所含證券以及代表指數所含證券的存託憑證。該指數旨在反映全球範圍內開發、製造、分銷或銷售與建立和啟用元宇宙相關的產品或服務的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cocrystal Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing novel antiviral therapeutics that target the replication process of influenza viruses, coronaviruses (including SARS-CoV-2), noroviruses and hepatitis C viruses. Cocrystal employs unique structure-based technologies to create first- and best-in-class antiviral drugs. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Bothell, WA.
info.description_zh: Cocrystal Pharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發針對流感病毒、冠狀病毒（包括 SARS-CoV-2）、諾羅病毒和丙型肝炎病毒複製過程的新型抗病毒療法。 Cocrystal 採用獨特的結構為基礎的技術來創造一流的抗病毒藥物。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於華盛頓州博塞爾。

info.description: Daktronics, Inc. engages in designing and manufacturing electronic scoreboards, programmable display systems and large screen video displays for sporting, commercial and transportation applications. It operates through the following segments: Commercial, Live Events, High School Park and Recreation, Transportation, and International. The Commercial segment sells video, display systems, digital billboards, Galaxy, and Fuelight product lines to resellers, out-of-home companies, national retailers, quick-serve restaurants, casinos, shopping centers, cruise ships, commercial building owners, and petroleum retailers. The Live Events segment provides scoring and video display systems to college and professional sports facilities and convention centers and the sale of mobile display technology to video rental organizations and other live events type venues. The High School Park and Recreation segment engages in the sale of scoring systems, Galaxy displays, and video display systems to primary and secondary education facilities. The Transportation segment consists of sales of Vanguard and Galaxy product lines to governmental transportation departments, airlines, and other transportation related customers. The International segment is composed of sales of all product lines outside the United States and Canada. The company was founded by Aelred J. Kurtenbach and Duane E. Sander in 1968 and is headquartered in Brookings, SD.
info.description_zh: Daktronics, Inc. 致力於設計和製造用於體育、商業和交通應用的電子記分牌、可編程顯示系統和大螢幕視訊顯示器。它透過以下部門運作：商業、現場活動、高中公園和娛樂、交通和國際。商業部門向經銷商、戶外公司、全國零售商、快餐店、賭場、購物中心、遊輪、商業建築業主和石油零售商銷售影片、顯示系統、數位廣告看板、Galaxy 和 Fuellight 產品線。現場活動部門為大學和專業體育設施和會議中心提供計分和視訊顯示系統，並向視訊租賃組織和其他現場活動類型場所銷售行動顯示技術。高中公園和娛樂部門向中小學教育設施銷售計分系統、Galaxy 顯示器和視訊顯示系統。運輸部門包括向政府運輸部門、航空公司和其他運輸相關客戶銷售 Vanguard 和 Galaxy 產品線。國際部門由美國和加拿大以外所有產品線的銷售組成。該公司由 Aelred J. Kurtenbach 和 Duane E. Sander 於 1968 年創立，總部位於南達科他州布魯金斯。

info.description: Comcast Corp. engages in the provision of video, Internet, and phone services. It operates through the following segments: Residential Connectivity and Platforms, Business Services Connectivity, Media, Studios, and Theme Parks. The Residential Connectivity and Platforms segment consists of residential broadband and wireless services and Sky-branded entertainment television networks and advertising. The Business Service Connectivity segment offers broadband, wireline voice and wireless services through small to medium customers and large enterprises through the HFC network. The Media segment consists of NBCUniversal's television and streaming platforms, including national, regional, and international cable networks. The Studios segment focuses on NBCUniversal's film and television studio production and distribution operations. The Theme Parks segment operates Universal theme parks in Orlando, Florida, Hollywood, California, Osaka, Japan, and Beijing, China. The company was founded by Ralph Roberts in 1963 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Comcast Corp. 從事提供視訊、網路和電話服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅連接和平台、商業服務連接、媒體、工作室和主題公園。住宅連接和平台部門包括住宅寬頻和無線服務以及Sky品牌的娛樂電視網路和廣告。商業服務連接部門透過 HFC 網路為中小型客戶和大型企業提供寬頻、有線語音和無線服務。媒體部門由 NBCUniversal 的電視和串流媒體平台組成，包括國家、地區和國際有線電視網絡。工作室部門專注於 NBCUniversal 的電影和電視工作室製作和發行業務。主題樂園部門在佛羅裡達州奧蘭多、加州好萊塢、日本大阪和中國北京經營環球主題樂園。該公司由 Ralph Roberts 於 1963 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of customized transportation and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Contract Logistics, Intermodal, and Trucking. The Contract Logistics segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Intermodal segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Trucking segment includes dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul, and refrigerated operations, transporting a broad range of commodities including automotive parts, machinery, building materials, food products, steel, and other industrial and consumer goods. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Warren, MI.
info.description_zh: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供客製化運輸和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：合約物流、多式聯運和卡車運輸。合約物流部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。多式聯運部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。卡車運輸部門包括乾貨車、平板車、重載和冷藏業務，運輸各種商品，包括汽車零件、機械、建築材料、食品、鋼鐵以及其他工業和消費品。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於密西根州沃倫。

info.description: The Clorox Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of consumer and professional products. It operates through the following business segments: Health and Wellness, Household, Lifestyle, and International. The Health and Wellness segment consists of cleaning products, professional products and vitamins, minerals and supplements mainly marketed and sold in the United States. The Household segments consists of bags and wraps, grilling products and cat litter marketed and sold in the United States. The Lifestyle segment refers to food, natural personal care products and water-filtration products marketed and sold in the United States. The International segment covers products sold outside the United States, excluding natural personal care products. The company was founded by Edward Hughes, Charles Husband, William Hussey, Rufus Myers, and Archibald Taft on May 3, 1913 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Clorox Co. 從事消費品和專業產品的製造和行銷。它透過以下業務部門運作：健康與保健、家庭、生活方式和國際。健康與保健部門包括主要在美國行銷和銷售的清潔產品、專業產品以及維生素、礦物質和補充劑。家用部門包括在美國行銷和銷售的袋子和包裝、燒烤產品和貓砂。生活風格部門是指在美國行銷和銷售的食品、天然個人護理產品和水過濾產品。國際部門涵蓋在美國境外銷售的產品，不包括天然個人護理產品。該公司由 Edward Hughes、Charles Husband、William Hussey、Rufus Myers 和 Archibald Taft 於 1913 年 5 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。
