info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Industrials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Industrials Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the industrials sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Industrials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Industrials Index 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的工業領域美國小型公司的證券表現。

info.description: Adamas Trust, Inc. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the acquisition, investment, finance, and management of mortgage-related single-family and multi-family residential assets. Its investment portfolio includes credit sensitive single-family and multi-family assets. The company was founded on September 26, 2003 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 抵押貸款
info.description_zh: Adamas Trust, Inc. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事與抵押貸款相關的單戶和多戶住宅資產的收購、投資、融資和管理。其投資組合包括信用敏感的單戶和多戶資產。該公司成立於2003年9月26日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, which is actively managed, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of (i) companies that are engaged in the mining, exploration, production, development, distribution or recycling of metals and raw materials that frequently are used to support growing global demand for energy and (ii) royalty and streaming companies engaged in financing such metals and raw materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用主動管理方式，在正常情況下，力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於 (i) 從事金屬和原材料採礦、勘探、生產、開發、分銷或回收的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些金屬和原材料經常用於支持全球不斷增長的能源需求，以及 (ii) 從事為此類金屬和原材料的特許經營權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TappAlpha SPY Growth & Daily Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation and to seek exposure to the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust ("SPY"), subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund's manager seeks to achieve its investment objectives through the use of a call option strategy that combines a long position in SPY, an exchange-traded fund designed to track the performance of the S&P 500 Index, with short positions in certain call options. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TappAlpha SPY 成長和每日收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時保持資本增值前景，並尋求接觸 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信託（「SPY」）的業績，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金經理人尋求透過使用看漲期權策略來實現其投資目標，該策略結合了SPY（一種旨在追蹤標準普爾500指數表現的交易所交易基金）的多頭頭寸和某些看漲期權的空頭頭寸。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Spok Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of communication solutions. It provides call center operations, clinical alerting and notifications, one-way and advanced two-way wireless messaging services, mobile communications and public safety solutions. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Spok Holdings, Inc. 從事提供通訊解決方案。它提供呼叫中心運營、臨床警報和通知、單向和高級雙向無線訊息服務、行動通訊和公共安全解決方案。該公司成立於 1965 年，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: TCW Compounders ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to invest in the companies that the Adviser believes will benefit from transformation as a result of technological innovations, market dynamics, and/or changes in client preferences. It aims to actively capture returns from companies that show long-term growth, quality, and durability characteristics as a result of such economic transformation or play a central role of enabling other companies to do the same. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW Compounders ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在投資顧問認為將因技術創新、市場動態和/或客戶偏好變化而從轉型中受益的公司。它的目標是積極獲取那些因經濟轉型而表現出長期成長、品質和持久特徵的公司的回報，或是在使其他公司也能做到這一點方面發揮核心作用的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Nickel Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Nickel Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, or production of nickel ("Nickel Mining Companies"); (ii) investments in nickel that represent all or a significant portion of their assets, and/or (iii) supplying nickel. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Nickel Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和支出之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Nickel Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 鎳採礦、勘探、開發或生產的公司（「鎳礦業公司」）； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的鎳投資，和/或 (iii) 供應鎳。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Fund seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 ("QQQ") up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against 12% (before fees and expenses) of QQQ losses over the one-year Target Outcome Period. The Fund's investment objective is to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the Target Outcome Period. In seeking to achieve this investment objective, the Fund's upside cap over the period January 1, 2025 through March 31, 2025 is 3.75% (before fees and expenses).
info.description_zh: 該基金旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1（「QQQ」）的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時提供針對一年目標結果期間 12%（扣除費用和開支）的 QQQ 損失的下行緩衝。該基金的投資目標是為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 在目標結果期內的前 12%（未計費用和開支）損失提供下行緩衝。為了實現這一投資目標，該基金在2025年1月1日至2025年3月31日期間的上漲上限為3.75%（未計費和開支）。

info.description: ARS Core Equity Portfolio ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities or ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, the managers define equity securities as common stock or securities with similar characteristics, including American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 核心股票投資組合 ETF 旨在實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於股本證券或提供股本證券敞口的ETF。就基金的 80% 政策而言，管理人將股本證券定義為普通股或具有類似特徵的證券，包括美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI EAFE Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EAFE Small Cap Index composed of small-capitalization developed market equities, excluding the U.S. and Canada. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index represents the small-capitalization segment of the MSCI EAFE IMI Index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI EAFE 小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤由小型開發市場股票（不包括美國和加拿大）組成的 MSCI EAFE 小型股指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數代表 MSCI EAFE IMI 指數的小型股部分。

info.description: Broadcom Inc. is a global technology company, which designs, develops, and supplies semiconductors and infrastructure software solutions. It operates through the Semiconductor Solutions and Infrastructure Software segments. The Semiconductor Solutions segment refers to product lines and intellectual property licensing. The Infrastructure Software segment relates to mainframe, distributed and cyber security solutions, and fibre channel storage area networking business. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Broadcom Inc. 是一家全球科技公司，設計、開發和供應半導體和基礎設施軟體解決方案。它透過半導體解決方案和基礎設施軟體部門運作。半導體解決方案部門涉及產品線和智慧財產權授權。基礎設施軟體部門涉及大型主機、分散式和網路安全解決方案以及光纖通道儲存區域網路業務。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of transportation services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Domestic, Atlantic, Pacific, and Latin America. The company was founded on December 30, 1968 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: United Airlines Holdings, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供運輸服務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：國內、大西洋、太平洋和拉丁美洲。該公司成立於1968年12月30日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Jpmorgan International Value ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities and equity-related instruments of foreign companies, including foreign subsidiaries of U.S. companies. The fund may invest in issuers located in both developed foreign and emerging market countries. Developed foreign countries include Australia, Canada, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, the United Kingdom, most of the countries of Western Europe and Hong Kong; emerging market countries include most of the other countries in the world.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通國際價值ETF尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於外國公司的股本證券和股本相關工具，包括美國公司的外國子公司。該基金可投資於國外已開發國家及新興市場國家的發行人。國外已開發國家包括澳洲、加拿大、以色列、日本、紐西蘭、新加坡、英國、西歐大部分國家和香港；新興市場國家包括世界上大多數其他國家。

info.description: Repligen Corp. is a global life sciences company, which engages in providing bioprocessing technologies and solutions used in the process of manufacturing biological drugs. It operates through the North America. Europe, and Asia Pacific Region or Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Alexander G. Rich and Paul R. Schimmel in May 1981 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Repligen Corp.是一家全球生命科學公司，致力於提供生物藥物製造過程中使用的生物加工技術和解決方案。它的業務遍及北美。歐洲、亞太地區或其他地理區域。該公司由 Alexander G. Rich 和 Paul R. Schimmel 於 1981 年 5 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Switzerland Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Switzerland Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 瑞士指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克瑞士指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: First Trust RBA Deglobalization ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Richard Bernstein Advisors U.S. Deglobalization Index. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities that comprise the index. According to the index provider, the index is designed to measure the performance of U.S. companies that will benefit from accelerating deglobalization and its implications. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust RBA 去全球化 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Richard Bernstein Advisors 美國去全球化指數的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數提供者表示，該指數旨在衡量將從加速去全球化及其影響中受益的美國公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: State Street My2031 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a target maturity strategy, primarily investing in high-yield corporate bonds scheduled to mature in 2031. The fund utilizes a bottom-up security selection process to overweight attractive sectors and issuers while seeking to maximize current income and preserve capital as it approaches its planned liquidation date on or about December 15, 2031.
info.description_zh: State Street My2031 高收益公司債 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，採用目標到期日策略，主要投資於計劃於 2031 年到期的高收益公司債。該基金利用自下而上的證券選擇流程來增持有吸引力的行業和發行人，同時在接近 2031 年 12 月 15 日左右的計劃清算日期時尋求最大化當前收入並保留資本。

info.description: Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. engages in the manufacture of arc welding equipment, consumable welding products, and other welding and cutting products. It operates through the following segments: Americas Welding, International Welding, and The Harris Products Group. The Americas Welding segment includes welding operations in North and South America. The International Welding segment primarily deals with welding operations in Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The Harris Products Group segment refers to the company's global cutting, soldering, and brazing businesses as well as the retail business in the United States. The company was founded by John C. Lincoln and James F. Lincoln on December 5, 1895 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. 從事弧焊設備、消耗焊接產品以及其他焊接和切割產品的製造。它透過以下部門運作：美洲焊接部門、國際焊接部門和哈里斯產品集團。美洲焊接部門包括北美和南美的焊接業務。國際焊接部門主要從事歐洲、非洲、亞洲和澳洲的焊接業務。 Harris Products Group 部門是指該公司的全球切割、焊接和釬焊業務以及美國的零售業務。該公司由 John C. Lincoln 和 James F. Lincoln 於 1895 年 12 月 5 日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Ferrovial NV engages in the design, financing, construction, operation, and maintenance of infrastructure projects. It operates through the following segments: Construction, Highways, Airports, Energy, and Other. The Construction segment consists of the design and building of public and private works, including most notably the construction of public infrastructures. The Highways segment carries out the development, financing, and operation of highways. The Airports segment is involved in developing, financing, and operating airports. The Energy segment focuses on innovative solutions for the promotion, construction, and operation of energy generation and transmission infrastructures. The company was founded by Rafael del Pino y Moreno on December 18, 1952 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Ferrovial NV 從事基礎設施專案的設計、融資、建造、營運和維護。它透過以下部門運作：建築、高速公路、機場、能源和其他。建築部門包括公共和私人工程的設計和建造，其中最引人注目的是公共基礎設施的建設。公路部門從事公路的開發、融資和營運。機場部門從事機場的開發、融資和營運。能源部門專注於能源發電和輸電基礎設施的推廣、建設和營運的創新解決方案。該公司由Rafael del Pino y Moreno於1952年12月18日創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc. engages in the operation of healthy grocery stores. The firm specializes in fresh, natural and organic products. Its products include fresh produce, bulk foods, vitamins and supplements, grocery, meat and seafood, deli, bakery, dairy, frozen foods, body care and natural household items. The company was founded by Stan Boney, Shon Alexander Boney, and Kevin K. Easler on July 11, 2002 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc. 從事健康雜貨店的經營。該公司專注於新鮮、天然和有機產品。其產品包括新鮮農產品、散裝食品、維生素和補充劑、雜貨、肉類和海鮮、熟食店、麵包店、乳製品、冷凍食品、身體護理和天然家居用品。該公司由 Stan Boney、Shon Alexander Boney 和 Kevin K. Easler 於 2002 年 7 月 11 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Motley Fool Innovative Growth Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Innovative Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the Innovative Growth Fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Innovative Growth Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Innovative Growth Index 的總回報表現大致相符的投資結果。一般情況下，創新成長基金總資產的至少80%會投資於該指數的成分證券。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) ADR. By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤台積電 (TSM) ADR 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of products and services for the animal veterinary, livestock and poultry, dairy, and water testing industries. It operates through the following segments: Companion Animal Group (CAG), Water Quality Products (Water), Livestock, Poultry, and Dairy (LPD), and Other. The CAG segment provides diagnostic and information management-based products and services for the companion animal veterinary industry, including in-clinic diagnostic solutions, outside reference laboratory services, and veterinary software and services. The Water segment offers innovative testing solutions for easy, rapid, and accurate detection and quantification of various microbiological parameters in water. The LPD segment develops diagnostic tests, services, and related instrumentation that are used to manage the health status of livestock and poultry, to improve producer efficiency, and to ensure the quality and safety of milk and food. The Other segment is composed of products for the human point-of-care medical diagnostics market with its out-licensing arrangements. The company was founded by David Evans Shaw on December 19, 1983 and is headquartered in Westbrook, ME.
info.description_zh: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. 從事動物獸醫、畜禽、乳製品和水質檢測行業產品和服務的開發、製造和分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：伴侶動物部門（CAG）、水質產品部門（水）、畜牧業、家禽和乳製品部門（LPD）以及其他部門。 CAG部門為伴侶動物獸醫行業提供基於診斷和資訊管理的產品和服務，包括診所診斷解決方案、外部參考實驗室服務以及獸醫軟體和服務。水部門提供創新的測試解決方案，可輕鬆、快速、準確地檢測和量化水中的各種微生物參數。 LPD部門開發診斷測試、服務和相關儀器，用於管理牲畜和家禽的健康狀況，提高生產效率，並確保牛奶和食品的品質和安全。其他部門則由用於人體護理點醫療診斷市場的產品及其外包許可安排組成。該公司由 David Evans Shaw 於 1983 年 12 月 19 日創立，總部位於緬因州威斯布魯克。

info.description: State Street My2028 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a target maturity strategy, primarily investing in high-yield corporate bonds scheduled to mature in 2028. The fund utilizes a bottom-up security selection process to overweight attractive sectors and issuers while seeking to maximize current income and preserve capital as it approaches its planned liquidation date on or about December 15, 2028.
info.description_zh: State Street My2028 高收益公司債 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，採用目標到期日策略，主要投資於計劃於 2028 年到期的高收益公司債。該基金利用自下而上的證券選擇流程來增持有吸引力的行業和發行人，同時尋求在接近 2028 年 12 月 15 日左右的計劃清算日期時實現當前收入最大化並保留資本。

info.description: AB Conservative Buffer ETF seeks a conservative level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 Index, which measures the performance of the large-capitalization sector of the U.S. equity market, as determined by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB 保守緩衝 ETF 尋求保守的資本增值水平，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其幾乎所有資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust）是一款旨在追蹤 S&P 500 指數投資結果的 ETF，該指數由 S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC 確定，衡量美國股市大盤股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Qorvo, Inc. provides semiconductor solutions for RF and power. The firm combines product and technology leadership, systems-level expertise, and global manufacturing scale to quickly solve its customers' most complex technical challenges. Qorvo serves diverse high-growth segments of large global markets, including consumer electronics, smart home/IoT, automotive, EVs, battery-powered appliances, network infrastructure, healthcare, and aerospace/defense. It operates through the following segments: High Performance Analog (HPA), Connectivity and Sensors Group (CSG), and Advanced Cellular Group (ACG). The HPA segment supplies RF and power management solutions for infrastructure, defense and aerospace, automotive power, and other markets. The CSG segment supplies connectivity and sensor components and systems featuring multiple technologies such as UWB, Matter, Bluetooth Low Energy, Zigbee, Thread, Wi-Fi, cellular IoT and MEMS-/BAW-based sensors. The ACG segment supplies cellular RF solutions for smartphones, wearables, laptops, tablets, and various other devices. The company was formed following the merger of RF Micro Devices, founded in 2015, and TriQuint Semiconductor, incorporated in 1981. It is headquartered in Greensboro, NC.
info.description_zh: Qorvo, Inc. 提供射頻和電源半導體解決方案。該公司將產品和技術領先地位、系統級專業知識和全球製造規模相結合，能夠快速解決客戶最複雜的技術挑戰。 Qorvo 為全球大型市場的不同高成長細分市場提供服務，包括消費性電子產品、智慧家庭/物聯網、汽車、電動車、電池供電設備、網路基礎設施、醫療保健和航空航天/國防。該公司透過以下部門營運：高性能類比部門 (HPA)、連接和感測器部門 (CSG) 以及高級蜂窩部門 (ACG)。 HPA 部門為基礎設施、國防和航空航太、汽車電源和其他市場提供射頻和電源管理解決方案。 CSG 部門提供採用多種技術的連接和感測器組件和系統，例如 UWB、Matter、低功耗藍牙、Zigbee、Thread、Wi-Fi、蜂窩物聯網和基於 MEMS/BAW 的感測器。 ACG 部門為智慧型手機、穿戴式裝置、筆記型電腦、平板電腦和各種其他裝置提供蜂巢式射頻解決方案。該公司由成立於 2015 年的 RF Micro Devices 和成立於 1981 年的 TriQuint Semiconductor 合併而成。總部位於北卡羅來納州格林斯伯勒。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 20Y+ Treasuries ETF seeks to generate an enhanced, high-frequency income stream by executing an options-based strategy focused primarily on selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track three times the daily performance of its long-term Treasury benchmark. The fund targets three times the premium income generated from standard option writing on its underlying index, pairing an optimized distribution yield with secondary, capped interest rate participation and a discretionary downside protection layer.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 20Y+國債ETF旨在透過執行基於選擇權的策略來產生增強的高頻收入流，該策略主要側重於出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追踪其長期國債基準日表現的三倍。該基金的目標是為其標的指數發行標準選擇權所產生的溢價收入的三倍，將優化的分配收益率與二級、有上限的利率參與和可自由支配的下行保護層相結合。

info.description: iShares MSCI Global Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI Select Gold Miners Investable Market Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index has been developed by MSCI Inc. (the "index provider" or "MSCI") to target a minimum of 30 companies in developed and emerging markets that are involved in the business of gold mining. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 全球黃金礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI ACWI 選擇黃金礦業可投資市場指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數由 MSCI Inc.（「指數提供者」或「MSCI」）開發，目標是已開發市場和新興市場中至少 30 家從事金礦開採業務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: OSI Systems, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of specialized electronic systems and components for critical applications. It operates through the following segments: Security, Optoelectronics and Manufacturing, Healthcare, and Corporate and Eliminations. The Security segment includes security and inspection systems, and turnkey security screening solutions. The Optoelectronics and Manufacturing segment refers to electronic components and electronic manufacturing services. The Healthcare segment focuses on the provision of patient monitoring, cardiology and remote monitoring, connected care systems, and associated accessories. The Corporate and Eliminations segment represents the executive compensation and certain other general and administrative expenses. The company was founded by Deepak Chopra in May 1987 and is headquartered in Hawthorne, CA.
info.description_zh: OSI Systems, Inc. 從事關鍵應用專用電子系統和組件的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：安全部門、光電子和製造部門、醫療保健部門以及企業和消除部門。安全部門包括安全和檢查系統以及統包安全檢查解決方案。光電子和製造部門是指電子元件和電子製造服務。醫療保健部門專注於提供病患監護、心臟病學和遠距監護、連網護理系統以及相關配件。公司和沖銷部分代表高階主管薪酬和某些其他一般和管理費用。該公司由 Deepak Chopra 於 1987 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州霍桑。

info.description: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 24, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月24日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Carnival Corp. Ltd. engages in the operation of cruise ships. It operates through the following business segments: North America Cruise Operations, Europe Cruise Operations, Cruise Support, and Tour and Others. The North America Cruise Operations segment includes the Carnival Cruise Line, Holland America Line, Princess Cruises, and Seabourn. The Europe Cruise Operations segment consists of AIDA, Costa, Cunard, and P&O Cruises (UK). The Cruise Support segment represents port destinations and private islands for the benefit of its cruise brands. The Tour and Other segment operates hotel and transportation operations of Holland America Princess Alaska Tours. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Carnival Corp. Ltd. 從事遊輪營運。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：北美遊輪營運部門、歐洲遊輪營運部門、遊輪支援部門以及旅遊及其他部門。北美郵輪營運部門包括嘉年華郵輪公司、荷美郵輪公司、公主郵輪公司和世邦郵輪公司。歐洲郵輪營運部門包括 AIDA、Costa、Cunard 和 P&O Cruises（英國）。郵輪支援部門代表港口目的地和私人島嶼，以維護其郵輪品牌的利益。旅遊及其他部門經營荷美阿拉斯加公主旅行社的飯店和運輸業務。該公司成立於 1972 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Elemental Royalty Corp. engages in the acquisition and management of royalty interests in mineral properties. Its portfolio includes Karlawinda, Laverton, Leeville, Timok, Bonikro, Korali-Sud, Gediktepe, Viscaria, Diablillos, Dugbe, Cactus & Parks/Salye, Mactung, and Pickle Crow. The company was founded on March 11, 2004 and is headquartered in Littleton, CO.
info.description_zh: Elemental Royal Corp. 從事礦產特許權使用費權益的收購和管理。其產品組合包括 Karlawinda、Laverton、Leeville、Timok、Bonikro、Korali-Sud、Gediktepe、Viscaria、Diablillos、Dugbe、Cactus & Parks/Salye、Mactung 和 Pickle Crow。該公司成立於2004年3月11日，總部位於科羅拉多州利特爾頓。

info.description: Invesco Global Water ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq OMX Global Water IndexSM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index, as well as ADRs and GDRs that are based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of securities of global exchange-listed companies located in the United States, as well as developed and emerging markets throughout the world, that create products designed to conserve and purify water for homes, businesses and industries. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Global Water ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 OMX 全球水指數 SM（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券，以及基於基礎指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。基礎指數由位於美國以及世界各地已開發和新興市場的全球交易所上市公司的證券組成，這些公司生產旨在為家庭、企業和工業節約和淨化水的產品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily AMZN Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of AMZN. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in AMZN that is equal, on a daily basis, to 150% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 AMZN 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 AMZN 每日業績的 150%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 AMZN 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報相當於該基金淨資產價值的 150%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Unity Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the ownership and supervision of Unity Bank. The firm accepts personal and business checking accounts, time deposits, money market accounts, regular savings accounts, and demand and savings deposits. Its loan portfolio comprises credit cards, mortgage, home equity, and personal loans. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Clinton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Unity Bancorp, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，擁有Unity Bank並對其進行監管。該公司接受個人和企業支票帳戶、定期存款、貨幣市場帳戶、定期儲蓄帳戶以及活期存款和儲蓄存款。其貸款組合包括信用卡、抵押貸款、房屋淨值和個人貸款。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於新澤西州克林頓。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2029 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2029 (collectively, "2029 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2029 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）的投資組合（統稱為「2029 年債券」）的表現。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2029 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and provision of analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products and solutions for applications including aerospace, automotive, broadband, cellular infrastructure, connected home, defense, entertainment and gaming, industrial, medical, smartphone, tablet, and wearables. Its products include amplifiers, attenuators, circulators, demodulators, detectors, diodes, directional couplers, front-end modules, hybrids, isolators, lighting and display solutions, mixers, modulators, optocouplers, opt isolators, phase shifters, synthesizers, power dividers and combiners, receivers, switches, and technical ceramics. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. 從事開發、製造和提供模擬和混合信號半導體產品及解決方案，適用於航空航天、汽車、寬頻、蜂窩基礎設施、互聯家庭、國防、娛樂和遊戲、工業、醫療、智慧型手機、平板電腦和穿戴式裝置等應用。其產品包括放大器、衰減器、循環器、解調器、檢測器、二極管、定向耦合器、前端模組、混合器、隔離器、照明和顯示解決方案、混頻器、調製器、光耦合器、光隔離器、移相器、合成器、功率分配器和組合器、接收器、開關和技術陶瓷。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Shenandoah Telecommunications Co. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of regulated and unregulated telecommunication services to end-user customers and other telecommunications providers. The Tower segment leases space on 225 owned cell towers. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Edinburg, VA.
info.description_zh: Shenandoah Te communications Co. 是一家控股公司，致力於向最終用戶客戶和其他電信供應商提供受監管和不受監管的電信服務。塔楼部门租赁 225 个自有蜂窝塔的空间。该公司成立于 1902 年，总部位于弗吉尼亚州爱丁堡。

info.description: Coherent Corp. engages in the development, refinement, manufacturing, and marketing of engineered materials, opto-electronic components and devices, and lasers for use in the industrial, communications, electronics, and instrumentation markets. It operates through the following segments: Networking, Materials, and Lasers. The Networking segment leverages compound semiconductor technology platforms and deep knowledge of end-user applications. The Materials segment markets engineered materials and optoelectronic devices. The Lasers segment serves industrial customers in semiconductor capital equipment, display capital equipment, precision manufacturing, and aerospace and defense, as well as instrumentation customers in life sciences and scientific research. The company was founded by Carl J. Johnson in 1971 and is headquartered in Saxonburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Coherent Corp. 從事工業、通訊、電子和儀器儀表市場使用的工程材料、光電元件和設備以及雷射的開發、精煉、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：網路、材料和雷射。網路部門利用複合半導體技術平台和對最終用戶應用的深入了解。材料部門銷售工程材料和光電設備。雷射部門為半導體資本設備、顯示資本設備、精密製造、航空航太和國防領域的工業客戶以及生命科學和科學研究領域的儀器客戶提供服務。該公司由 Carl J. Johnson 於 1971 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州薩克森堡。

info.description: Globe Life, Inc. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of individual life and supplemental health insurance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Life Insurance, Health Insurance, and Investments Insurance. The Life Insurance segment offers products marketed by Globe Life include traditional whole life and term life insurance. The Health Insurance segment is involved in the renewable and includes Medicare Supplement, cancer, critical illness, accident, and other limited-benefit supplemental hospital and surgical products. The Investments Insurance segment refers to the management of capital resources, including investments, and the management of liquidity. The company was founded on November 19, 1979, and is headquartered in McKinney, TX.
info.description_zh: Globe Life, Inc.是一家保險控股公司，從事提供個人人壽和補充健康保險產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：人壽保險、健康保險和投資保險。人壽保險部門提供 Globe Life 行銷的產品，包括傳統的終身人壽保險和定期人壽保險。健康保險部門涉及再生保險，包括醫療保險補充、癌症、重大疾病、事故和其他有限福利補充醫院和手術產品。投資保險部門是指資本資源的管理，包括投資和流動性的管理。該公司成立於1979年11月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州麥金尼。

info.description: Jabil, Inc. engages in the provision of manufacturing services and solutions. It operates through the Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) and Diversified Manufacturing Services (DMS) segments. The EMS segment focuses on leveraging information technology, supply chain design and engineering, technologies largely centered on core electronics, utilizing a large-scale manufacturing infrastructure, and the ability to serve a broad range of end markets. The DMS segment offers engineering solutions with an emphasis on material sciences, machining, tooling, and molding of engineered plastic and metal parts. The company was founded by William E. Morean and James Golden in 1966 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Jabil, Inc. 從事提供製造服務和解決方案。它透過電子製造服務（EMS）和多元化製造服務（DMS）部門運作。 EMS部門專注於利用資訊技術、供應鏈設計和工程、主要集中於核心電子產品的技術、利用大規模製造基礎設施以及服務廣泛終端市場的能力。 DMS 部門提供工程解決方案，重點關注工程塑膠和金屬零件的材料科學、加工、模具和成型。該公司由 William E. Morean 和 James Golden 於 1966 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: Paramount Skydance Corp. is a next-generation global media and entertainment company that engages in providing content creation and distribution services. It operates through the following business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Its portfolio unites brands including Paramount Pictures, Paramount Television, CBS, CBS News, Nickelodeon, MTV, BET, Comedy Central, Showtime, Paramount Plus, Pluto TV, and Skydance's Animation, Film, Television, Interactive/Games, and Sports divisions. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Paramount Skydance Corp. 是一家下一代全球媒體和娛樂公司，致力於提供內容創作和發行服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：工作室、直接面向消費者和電視媒體。其旗下品牌包括派拉蒙影業、派拉蒙電視、CBS、CBS News、Nickelodeon、MTV、BET、Comedy Central、Showtime、Paramount Plus、Pluto TV 以及 Skydance 的動畫、電影、電視、互動/遊戲和體育部門。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: ADMA Biologics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in manufacturing, marketing, and developing specialty plasma-derived biologics. The firm operates through the following business segments: ADMA BioManufacturing and Plasma Collection Center. The ADMA BioManufacturing segment consists of immune globulin manufacturing and development operations. The Plasma Collection Center consists of source plasma collection facilities. The company was founded by Adam S. Grossman and Jerrold B. Grossman on June 24, 2004 and is headquartered in Ramsey, NJ.
info.description_zh: ADMA Biologics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事製造、行銷和開發特種血漿衍生生物製劑。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：ADMA 生物製造和血漿採集中心。 ADMA 生物製造部門包括免疫球蛋白製造和開發業務。血漿採集中心由源頭血漿採集設施組成。該公司由 Adam S. Grossman 和 Jerrold B. Grossman 於 2004 年 6 月 24 日創立，總部位於新澤西州拉姆齊。

info.description: Allient, Inc. is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that engages in the designing, manufacturing and sale of precision and specialty-controlled motion components and systems used in a broad range of industries, including industrial, vehicle, medical, and aerospace and defense. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Allient, Inc. 是一家全球性工程和製造企業，從事設計、製造和銷售精密和專業控制運動部件和系統，這些部件和系統廣泛應用於工業、車輛、醫療、航空航太和國防等行業。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Amplitude, Inc. provides a digital analytics platform that helps companies analyze their customer behavior within digital products. It delivers its application over the Internet as a subscription service using a software as a service (SaaS) model. The company was founded by Spenser Skates, Jeffrey Wang, and Curtis Liu in November 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Amplitude, Inc. 提供數位分析平台，幫助公司分析數位產品中的客戶行為。它使用軟體即服務 (SaaS) 模型透過互聯網將其應用程式作為訂閱服務提供。該公司由 Spenser Skates、Jeffrey Wang 和 Curtis Liu 於 2011 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Atlanticus Holdings Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial technology and related services. It operates through the Credit as a Service (CaaS) and Auto Finance segments. The CaaS segment includes private label credit and general purpose credit cards originated by lenders through multiple channels, including retail and healthcare, direct mail solicitation, digital marketing and partnerships with third parties. The Auto Finance segment services loans secured by independent automotive dealers and automotive finance companies in the buy-here, pay-here used car business. The company was founded by David G. Hanna in August 1996 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Atlanticus Holdings Corp.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融科技及相關服務。它透過信貸即服務（CaaS）和汽車金融部門運作。 CaaS 部分包括貸款人透過多種管道發起的自有品牌信用卡和通用信用卡，包括零售和醫療保健、直郵招攬、數位行銷以及與第三方的合作。汽車金融部門為獨立汽車經銷商和汽車金融公司在「在這裡購買、在這裡付款」的二手車業務中提供擔保的貸款服務。該公司由 David G. Hanna 於 1996 年 8 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AVGO Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AVGO. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AVGO 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 AVGO 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 AVGO 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long AVGO Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Broadcom Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long AVGO Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Broadcom Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVGO ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Broadcom Inc. (Nasdaq: AVGO) (the "Underlying Security" or "AVGO"). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by entering into swap agreements on the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVGO ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Broadcom Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：AVGO）（「基礎證券」或「AVGO」）股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過簽訂基礎證券掉期協議來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of AVGO and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 AVGO 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 AVGO 證券和掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 AVGO 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Caris Life Sciences, Inc. provides diagnostics and anatomic pathology services. It develops an unbiased profiling platform for novel target identification, drug development and delivery, diagnostic and disease monitoring, and precision medicine enabling aspects. It offers services throughout the U.S., Europe, Australia and other international markets. The company was founded by David D. Halbert in 2008 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Caris Life Sciences, Inc. 提供診斷和解剖病理學服務。它為新標靶識別、藥物開發和交付、診斷和疾病監測以及精準醫療支援方面開發了一個公正的分析平台。它在美國、歐洲、澳洲和其他國際市場提供服務。該公司由 David D. Halbert 於 2008 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Blackrock Short-Term California Muni Bond ETF seeks to maximize tax-free current income by investing in short-term municipal bonds issued in the State of California. Under normal circumstances, the fund will primarily invest in U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade short-term fixed- and floating-rate municipal securities issued by California with remaining maturities of five years or less, such as municipal bonds, municipal notes and variable rate demand obligations, as well as money market instruments and registered investment companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德短期加州市政債券 ETF 尋求透過投資加州發行的短期市政債券來最大化免稅當期收入。一般情況下，該基金將主要投資於加州發行的、剩餘期限為五年或以下的以美元計價的投資等級短期固定和浮動利率市政證券，例如市政債券、市政票據和浮動利率即期債券，以及貨幣市場工具和註冊投資公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of a class of RNA-targeting therapeutics for upregulating gene expression and restoration of healthy protein levels to treat a broad range of genetic diseases. Its lead product candidate is CMP-002. The company was founded by Richard A. Young and Leonard Zon in 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發一類 RNA 標靶療法，用於上調基因表現和恢復健康蛋白質水平，以治療多種遺傳疾病。其主要候選產品為 CMP-002。該公司由 Richard A. Young 和 Leonard Zon 於 2015 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: CBAK Energy Technology Ltd. engages in the manufacture of new energy high power lithium and sodium batteries. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Dalian, China.
info.description_zh: 中比能源科技有限公司從事新能源高功率鋰、鈉電池的製造。公司成立於2001年，總部位於中國大連。

info.description: Cognition Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery and development of innovative, small molecule therapeutics targeting age-related degenerative diseases and disorders of the central nervous system, or CNS, and retina. It offers the CT1812 which aims to restore the damaged cellular processes that drive diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, dry age-related macular degeneration, geographic atrophy and other conditions. The company was founded by Franz F. Hefti, Gilbert M. Rishton, and Susan M. Catalano on August 21, 2007 and is headquartered in Purchase, NY.
info.description_zh: Cognition Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發與年齡相關的退化性疾病以及中樞神經系統（CNS）和視網膜疾病的創新小分子療法。它提供的 CT1812 旨在恢復導致阿茲海默症、乾性老年黃斑部病變、地圖樣萎縮和其他疾病等疾病的受損細胞過程。該公司由 Franz F. Hefti、Gilbert M. Rishton 和 Susan M. Catalano 於 2007 年 8 月 21 日創立，總部位於紐約州普切斯。

info.description: CVRx, Inc. engages in developing, manufacturing, and commercializing neuromodulation solutions for patients with cardiovascular diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other Countries. The company was founded by Robert S. Kieval and Tyler P. Lipschultz in August 2001 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: CVRx, Inc. 致力於為心血管疾病患者開發、製造和商業化神經調節解決方案。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他國家。該公司由 Robert S. Kieval 和 Tyler P. Lipschultz 於 2001 年 8 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Delcath Systems, Inc. is an oncology company, which engages in the treatment of primary and metastatic liver cancers. Its products include CHEMOSAT and HEPZATO. The company was founded on August 5, 1988 and is headquartered in Queensbury, NY.
info.description_zh: Delcath Systems, Inc.是一家腫瘤學公司，從事原發性和轉移性肝癌的治療。其產品包括CHEMOSAT和HEPZATO。該公司成立於1988年8月5日，總部位於紐約州昆斯伯里。

info.description: Diodes Inc. engages in the manufacturing and supply of application-specific standard products within the broad discrete, logic, analog, and mixed-signal semiconductor markets. The firm offers diodes, rectifiers, transistors, MOSFETs, protection devices, functional specific arrays, single gate, dual gate and standard logic, amplifiers and comparators, Hall-effect, and temperature sensors. It operates through the following geographical segments: Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company was founded on June 15, 1959 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Diodes Inc. 致力於在廣泛的分立、邏輯、類比和混合訊號半導體市場中製造和供應特定應用的標準產品。該公司提供二極體、整流器、電晶體、MOSFET、保護元件、功能特定陣列、單閘極、雙閘極和標準邏輯、放大器和比較器、霍爾效應和溫度感測器。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：亞洲、美洲和歐洲。該公司成立於 1959 年 6 月 15 日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Insight Digital Partners II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 11, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Insight Digital Partners II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月11日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: First Advantage Corp. is a provider of employment background screening, identity, and verification solutions. It operates through the following segments: First Advantage Americas, First Advantage International, and Sterling. The First Advantage Americas segment performs a variety of background check and compliance services across all phases of the workforce lifecycle, from pre-onboarding to post-onboarding and ongoing monitoring, covering employees, contractors, contingent workers, tenants, and drivers. The First Advantage International segment involves regions such as Europe, India, and Asia Pacific. The Sterling segment refers to Sterling Check Corp., which provides services globally. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: First Advantage Corp. 是一家就業背景篩選、身分和驗證解決方案提供者。它透過以下部門運作：First Advantage Americas、First Advantage International 和 Sterling。 First Advantage Americas 部門在勞動力生命週期的各個階段提供各種背景調查和合規服務，從入職前到入職後以及持續監控，涵蓋員工、承包商、臨時工、租戶和司機。第一優諮詢國際部門涉及歐洲、印度和亞太地區等地區。 Sterling 部門是指在全球範圍內提供服務的 Sterling Check Corp.。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Frontdoor, Inc. engages in the provision of home service plans. Its home service plans cover the repair or replacement of major home's systems and appliances. The firm's service focuses on water heaters, garbage disposals, doorbells, smoke detectors, ceiling fans, central vacuums, refrigerators, dishwashers and trash compactors. Its brands include American Home Shield, HSA, OneGuard and Landmark. The company was founded on January 2, 2018, and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: Frontdoor, Inc. 從事提供居家服務計畫。其家庭服務計劃涵蓋主要家庭系統和電器的維修或更換。該公司的服務重點是熱水器、垃圾處理器、門鈴、煙霧偵測器、吊扇、中央吸塵器、冰箱、洗碗機和垃圾壓實機。其品牌包括American Home Shield、HSA、OneGuard和Landmark。該公司成立於2018年1月2日，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Great Elm Capital Corp., a publicly traded business development company located in the United States, which operates through the broad range of sectors. The company was founded on April 01, 2016, and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Capital Corp. 是一家位於美國的上市業務開發公司，業務涉及廣泛的行業。該公司成立於2016年4月1日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: High Tide, Inc. is a retail-focused cannabis company, which engages in the manufacturing and distribution of consumption accessories. It operates through the following segments: Bricks-and-Mortar, E-Commerce, and Medical Cannabis Distribution. The Bricks-and-Mortar segment refers to Canadian warehouse which supports the distribution of accessories. The E-Commerce segment includes U.S and international subsidiaries. The company was founded by Harkirat Grover in 2009 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.description_zh: High Tide, Inc. 是一家專注於零售的大麻公司，從事消費配件的製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：實體部門、電子商務部門和醫用大麻分銷部門。實體部分是指支援配件分銷的加拿大倉庫。電子商務部門包括美國和國際子公司。該公司由 Harkirat Grover 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: Insmed, Inc. is a global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for patients with rare diseases. Its focuses on Brensocatib, and Treprostinil Palmitil Inhalation Powder (TPIP) pipeline. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.description_zh: Insmed, Inc.是一家全球生物製藥公司，致力於罕見疾病患者療法的開發和商業化。其重點關注 Brensocatib 和曲前列素棕櫚油吸入粉劑 (TPIP) 管道。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of cell therapies as novel cancer immunotherapy products. Its lead product candidate, LN-144 for metastatic melanoma, is an autologous adoptive cell therapy utilizing tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL), which are T cells derived from patients' tumors. The company was founded by Robert T. Brooke on September 17, 2007 and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.
info.description_zh: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於細胞療法作為新型癌症免疫療法產品的開發和商業化。其主要候選產品 LN-144 用於治療轉移性黑色素瘤，是一種利用腫瘤浸潤淋巴細胞 (TIL) 的自體過繼細胞療法，TIL 是源自患者腫瘤的 T 細胞。該公司由 Robert T. Brooke 於 2007 年 9 月 17 日創立，總部位於加州聖卡洛斯。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LULU Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LULU. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LULU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LULU 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LULU 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LULU 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: McGrath RentCorp engages in the provision of business-to-business rental services. It operates through the following segments: Mobile Modular, Portable Storage, TRS-RenTelco, and Enviroplex. The Mobile Modular segment focuses on modular building and portable storage. The Portable Storage segment includes rental inventory consisting of steel containers used to provide a temporary storage solution that is delivered to the customer's location and addresses the need for secure, temporary storage with immediate access to the unit. The TRS-RenTelco segment includes operations for its electronic test equipment. The Enviroplex segment is involved in the classroom manufacturing business selling modular buildings used primarily as classrooms in California. The company was founded by Robert P. McGrath in 1979 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: McGrath RentCorp 從事提供企業對企業租賃服務。它透過以下部門運作：行動模組化、便攜式儲存、TRS-RenTelco 和 Enviroplex。行動模組化部門專注於模組化建築和便攜式儲存。便攜式儲存部門包括由鋼製容器組成的租賃庫存，用於提供臨時儲存解決方案，將其交付到客戶所在地，並滿足安全、臨時儲存和立即存取設備的需求。 TRS-RenTelco 部門包括其電子測試設備業務。 Enviroplex 部門從事教室製造業務，銷售主要用作加州教室的模組化建築。該公司由 Robert P. McGrath 於 1979 年創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: Mobilicom Ltd. is an end-to-end provider of cyber security and smart solutions for drones, robotics and autonomous platforms. It designs, develops and delivers solutions targeting global drone, robotics and autonomous system manufacturers. The firm holds patented technology and know-how for Mobile Mesh networking. Its customers include corporates, governments and military departments. The company was founded by Oren Elkayam and Yossi Segal in 2006 and is headquartered in Shoham, Israel.
info.description_zh: Mobilicom Ltd. 是一家為無人機、機器人和自主平台提供網路安全和智慧解決方案的端到端供應商。它為全球無人機、機器人和自主系統製造商設計、開發和提供解決方案。該公司擁有行動網狀網路的專利技術和專有技術。其客戶包括企業、政府和軍事部門。該公司由 Oren Elkayam 和 Yossi Segal 於 2006 年創立，總部位於以色列 Shoham。

info.description: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of engineered products and services that facilitate the optimization of oil and natural gas well completions and field development strategies. It offers fracturing systems, repeat precision, tracer diagnostics, and well construction. The company was founded by Robert Nipper and Marty Stromquist in 2006 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. 從事提供工程產品和服務，以促進石油和天然氣完井和油田開發策略的最佳化。它提供壓裂系統、重複精度、示踪劑診斷和建井。該公司由 Robert Nipper 和 Marty Stromquist 於 2006 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Universal Display Corp. engages in the business of researching, developing, and commercializing organic light emitting diode technologies and materials for use in display and solid-state lighting applications. The company was founded by Sherwin I. Seligsohn on April 24, 1985 and is headquartered in Ewing, NJ.
info.description_zh: Universal Display Corp. 從事用於顯示器和固態照明應用的有機發光二極體技術和材料的研究、開發和商業化業務。該公司由 Sherwin I. Seligsohn 於 1985 年 4 月 24 日創立，總部位於新澤西州尤因。

info.description: PepGen Inc. develops oligonucleotide therapies. It is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing the next generation of oligonucleotide therapeutics with the goal of transforming the treatment of severe neuromuscular and neurologic diseases. The company was founded on November 9, 2020 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: PepGen Inc. 開發寡核苷酸療法。它是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於推進下一代寡核苷酸療法，目標是改變嚴重神經肌肉和神經系統疾病的治療方法。該公司成立於2020年11月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Pono Capital Four, Inc. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 2, 2026 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, KY.
info.description_zh: Pono Capital Four, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。該公司成立於2026年1月2日，總部位於肯塔基州大開曼島。

info.description: uniQure NV engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative gene therapies. Its discoveries intend to treat hemophilia, Huntington's disease, glybera, and cardiovascular problems. The company was founded by Sander J. van Deventer in 1998 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
info.description_zh: uniQure NV 致力於創新基因療法的發現、開發和商業化。其發現旨在治療血友病、亨廷頓舞蹈症、甘油和心血管問題。該公司由 Sander J. van Deventer 於 1998 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Remitly Global, Inc. engages in the provision of digital financial services for immigrants and their families. The company was founded by Matthew B. Oppenheimer and Joshua Hug on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

info.description: Runway Growth Finance Corp. is a closed-end investment company, which engages in the provision of senior secured loans to high growth-potential companies in technology, life sciences, healthcare information and services, business services, select consumer services and products, and other high-growth industries. The company was founded on August 31, 2015 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Runway Growth Finance Corp.是一家封閉式投資公司，致力於向科技、生命科學、醫療保健資訊和服務、商業服務、精選消費服務和產品以及其他高成長產業的高成長潛力公司提供優先擔保貸款。該公司成立於2015年8月31日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Schrodinger, Inc. engages in the provision of chemical simulation software solutions to pharmaceutical industry. It operates through the Software and Drug Discovery business segments. The Software segment sells software to transform drug discovery across the life sciences industry and to customers in materials science industries. The Drug Discovery segment offers diverse portfolio of preclinical and clinical programs, internally and through collaborations, that have advanced to various stages of discovery and development. The company was founded by Richard A. Friesner, William A. Goddard, III and Murco Ringnalda in 1990 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Schrodinger, Inc. 致力於為製藥業提供化學模擬軟體解決方案。它透過軟體和藥物發現業務部門運作。軟體部門向整個生命科學產業以及材料科學產業的客戶銷售用於改變藥物發現的軟體。藥物發現部門透過內部和合作提供多樣化的臨床前和臨床項目組合，這些項目已進入發現和開發的各個階段。該公司由 Richard A. Friesner、William A. Goddard, III 和 Murco Ringnalda 於 1990 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Global Self Storage, Inc. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the ownership, operation, management, acquisition, and re-development of self-storage properties. It offers personal, outdoor parking, climate controlled, wine, and business storage facilities. The company was founded on September 1, 1983 and is headquartered in Millbrook, NY.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Global Self Storage, Inc.是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事自助倉儲物業的所有權、營運、管理、收購和再開發業務。飯店提供個人室外停車場、氣候控制、葡萄酒和商務儲存設施。該公司成立於1983年9月1日，總部位於紐約州米爾布魯克。

info.description: Sight Sciences, Inc. is an ophthalmic medical device company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of surgical and nonsurgical technologies for the treatment of prevalent eye diseases. It operates through the Surgical Glaucoma and Dry Eye segments. The Surgical Glaucoma segment includes OMNI Surgical System for use in minimally invasive glaucoma procedures. The Dry Eye segment offers TearCare System and related components. The company was founded by Paul Badawi and David Y. Badawi in 2011 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Sight Sciences, Inc. 是一家眼科醫療器材公司，專注於用於治療常見眼疾的手術和非手術技術的開發和商業化。它透過手術青光眼和乾眼症部門進行運作。青光眼手術部分包括用於微創青光眼手術的 OMNI 手術系統。乾眼部門提供淚液護理系統和相關組件。該公司由 Paul Badawi 和 David Y. Badawi 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: SiTime Corp.is a micro-electromechanical system-based silicon timing solution. The company is transforming the timing industry with configurable solutions that replace legacy quartz devices and enable customers to differentiate their products with performance, smaller size, lower power, and reliability. The company was founded by Markus Lutz and Aaron Partridge on December 3, 2003 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: SiTime Corp.是一家基於微機電系統的矽計時解決方案。該公司正在透過可配置的解決方案來改變計時行業，這些解決方案取代了傳統的石英裝置，並使客戶能夠憑藉性能、更小的尺寸、更低的功耗和可靠性來區分他們的產品。該公司由 Markus Lutz 和 Aaron Partridge 於 2003 年 12 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Trupanion, Inc. engages in the provision of medical insurance for cats and dogs. It operates through the Subscription Business and Other Business segments. The Subscription Business segment is involved in the monthly subscriptions of pet medical insurance. The Others Business segment includes companies or organizations that choose to provide medical insurance for cats and dogs as a benefit to their employees or members. The company was founded by Darryl Rawlings in 2000 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Trupanion, Inc. 從事為貓和狗提供醫療保險的業務。它透過訂閱業務和其他業務部門運作。訂閱業務部門從事寵物醫療保險的每月訂閱業務。其他業務部門包括選擇為貓和狗提供醫療保險作為員工或會員福利的公司或組織。該公司由 Darryl Rawlings 於 2000 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: United Fire Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the business of writing property, casualty insurance, life insurance, and selling annuities through a network of independent agencies. The firm operates through the following segments: Property and Casualty Insurance and Life Insurance. The Property and Casualty Insurance segment includes commercial lines insurance, personal lines insurance, and assumed reinsurance. The Life Insurance segment includes deferred and immediate annuities, universal life products and traditional life insurance products. The company was founded in January 1946 and is headquartered in Cedar Rapids, IA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: United Fire Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過獨立機構網路從事財產保險、傷亡保險、人壽保險和年金銷售業務。該公司透過以下部門運作：財產和意外保險以及人壽保險。財產和意外保險部門包括商業保險、個人保險和假定再保險。人壽保險部門包括遞延年金和即期年金、萬能壽險產品和傳統人壽保險產品。該公司成立於 1946 年 1 月，總部位於愛荷華州錫達拉皮茲。

info.description: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It develops precision therapies for genetically-defined cancer patients with mTOR pathway driver alterations such as alterations in TSC1 or TSC2 genes. The company was founded by Neil Desai in November 2007 and is headquartered in Morristown, NJ.
info.description_zh: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它為具有 mTOR 路徑驅動改變（例如 TSC1 或 TSC2 基因改變）的基因定義癌症患者開發精準療法。該公司由 Neil Desai 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於新澤西州莫里斯敦。

info.description: WW International, Inc. engages in the provision of weight management services. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other. The company was founded by Jean Nidetch in 1963 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: WW International, Inc. 從事提供體重管理服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他地區。該公司由 Jean Nidetch 於 1963 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Xos, Inc. is a provider of energy storage and fleet electrification solutions. It develops battery-electric commercial vehicles and mobile power systems designed for rapid deployment charging and lower total cost of ownership compared to internal combustion engine vehicles. The company was founded by Dakota Semler and Giordano Sordoni on July 29, 2020 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Xos, Inc. 是一家能源儲存和車隊電氣化解決方案提供商。該公司開發電池電動商用車和行動電源系統，旨在實現快速部署充電並比內燃機車降低總擁有成本。該公司由 Dakota Semler 和 Giordano Sordoni 於 2020 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: T.Rowe Price Short Municipal Income ETF seeks high current income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 短期市政收入 ETF 尋求免除聯邦所得稅的高額當前收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: Eaton Vance Short Duration Income ETF seeks above-average total return over a market cycle of three to five years. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed income securities of varying maturities consistent with ordinarily seeking to maintain an average duration of approximately three years or less. The fund invests primarily in U.S. government securities, corporate bonds and mortgage- and asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯短期收益 ETF 尋求在三到五年的市場週期內高於平均的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過主要投資於不同期限的以美元計價的固定收益證券的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，並通常尋求保持約三年或更短的平均久期。該基金主要投資於美國政府證券、公司債以及抵押貸款和資產支持證券。

info.description: Western Asset Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return consistent with prudent investment management and liquidity needs. The fund invests in a portfolio comprised of debt instruments and fixed income securities of various maturities. The fund may also invest in credit-linked securities.
info.description_zh: 西部資產債券ETF尋求在符合審慎投資管理和流動性需求的情況下實現總回報最大化。該基金投資於由債務工具和不同期限的固定收益證券所組成的投資組合。該基金也可以投資於信用掛鉤證券。

info.description: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. owns and operates retail outlets in the United States. It engages in the distribution and retailing of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories in the U.S., serving both professional installers and do-it-yourself customers. It provides new and remanufactured automotive hard parts, including alternators, starters, fuel pumps, water pumps, brake system components, batteries, belts, hoses, temperature controls, chassis parts and engine parts, maintenance items consisting of oil, antifreeze products, fluids, filters, lighting products, engine additives, and appearance products, and accessories, such as floor mats, seat covers, and truck accessories. Its stores offer auto body paint and related materials, automotive tools, and professional service provider service equipment. The firm stores also offer enhanced services and programs consisting of used oil, oil filter and battery recycling, battery, wiper, and bulb replacement, battery diagnostic testing, electrical and module testing, check engine light code extraction, a loaner tool program, drum and rotor resurfacing, custom hydraulic hoses, professional paint shop mixing and related materials, and machine shops. O'Reilly Automotive stores provide do-it-yourself and professional service provider customers a selection of brand name, house brands, and private label products for domestic and imported automobiles, vans, and trucks. The company was founded by Charles F. O'Reilly and Charles H. O'Reilly in November 1957 and is headquartered in Springfield, MO.
info.description_zh: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. 在美國擁有並經營零售店。該公司在美國從事汽車售後零件、工具、用品、設備和配件的分銷和零售，為專業安裝人員和自助客戶提供服務。它提供全新和再製造的汽車硬零件，包括交流發電機、起動機、燃油泵、水泵、煞車系統組件、電池、皮帶、軟管、溫控器、底盤零件和引擎零件，維護項目包括機油、防凍產品、液體、過濾器、照明產品、引擎添加劑和外觀產品，以及配件，例如腳踏墊、座椅套和卡車配件。其商店提供車身油漆及相關材料、汽車工具以及專業服務提供者的服務設備。公司商店還提供增強的服務和計劃，包括廢油、機油濾清器和電池回收、電池、雨刮器和燈泡更換、電池診斷測試、電氣和模組測試、檢查發動機燈代碼提取、借用工具計劃、鼓和轉子表面重修、定制液壓軟管、專業噴漆車間混合和相關材料以及機械車間。 O'Reilly Automotive 商店為自助和專業服務供應商客戶提供一系列國產和進口汽車、貨車和卡車的品牌、自有品牌和自有品牌產品。該公司由 Charles F. O'Reilly 和 Charles H. O'Reilly 於 1957 年 11 月創立，總部位於密蘇裡州斯普林菲爾德。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2029 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2029. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2029 and December 15, 2029, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2029 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2029 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2029 年 1 月 1 日至 2029 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc. is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the provision of development and commercialization of therapies for the treatment of neurological disorders. Its product, WAKIX, is a molecule with a novel mechanism of action designed to increase histamine signaling in the brain by binding to H3 receptors. The company was founded by Jeffrey S. Aronin on July 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Plymouth Meeting, PA.
info.description_zh: Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc.是一家商業階段的製藥公司，從事神經系統疾病治療方法的開發和商業化。其產品 WAKIX 是一種具有新穎作用機制的分子，旨在透過與 H3 受體結合來增強大腦中的組織胺訊號傳導。該公司由 Jeffrey S. Aronin 於 2017 年 7 月 25 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普利茅斯米廷。

info.description: Synchrony Financial engages in the provision of consumer financial services. It focuses on digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet, and other industries. The company was founded on September 12, 2003 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Synchrony Financial 從事提供消費金融服務。專注於數位、健康與保健、零售、電信、家居、汽車、戶外、寵物等產業。該公司成立於2003年9月12日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long AMZN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times the daily percentage change of the common stock of Amazon.com, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It aims to generate 2 times the daily performance of the underlying stock for a single day. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long AMZN Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Amazon.com, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。它的目標是單日產生標的股票日表現的 2 倍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Bitcoin ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of bitcoin subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the underlying Bitcoin ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 比特幣 ETF 尋求當前收入；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的交易所進行交易，並尋求比特幣每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）的每日槓桿投資結果，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎比特幣 ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性商品合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NVIDIA Corp. engages in the design and manufacture of computer graphics processors, chipsets, and related multimedia software. It operates through the following segments: Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) and Compute & Networking. The Graphics segment includes GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, the GeForce NOW game streaming service and related infrastructure, Quadro and NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics, virtual GPU, or vGPU, software for cloud-based visual and virtual computing, automotive platforms for infotainment systems, and Omniverse Enterprise software for building and operating metaverse and 3D internet applications. The Compute & Networking segment consists of Data Center accelerated computing platforms and end-to-end networking platforms including Quantum for InfiniBand and Spectrum for Ethernet, NVIDIA DRIVE automated-driving platform and automotive development agreements, Jetson robotics and other embedded platforms, NVIDIA AI Enterprise and other software, and DGX Cloud software and services. The company was founded by Jen Hsun Huang, Chris A. Malachowsky, and Curtis R. Priem in April 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: NVIDIA Corp. 從事電腦圖形處理器、晶片組和相關多媒體軟體的設計和製造。它透過以下部分運作：圖形處理單元（GPU）和運算與網路。圖形部分包括用於遊戲和 PC 的 GeForce GPU、GeForce NOW 遊戲串流服務和相關基礎設施、用於企業工作站圖形的 Quadro 和 NVIDIA RTX GPU、虛擬 GPU 或 vGPU、用於基於雲端的視覺和虛擬計算的軟體、用於資訊娛樂系統的汽車平台以及用於構建和操作 Metaverse 和 3D 互聯網應用程式設計的公司。運算和網路部門包括資料中心加速運算平台和端對端網路平台，包括InfiniBand的Quantum和乙太網路的Spectrum、NVIDIA DRIVE自動駕駛平台和汽車開發協定、Jetson機器人和其他嵌入式平台、NVIDIA AI Enterprise和其他軟體以及DGX Cloud軟體和服務。該公司由 Jen Hsun Huang、Chris A. Malachowsky 和 ​​Curtis R. Priem 於 1993 年 4 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Treasury Bond ETF is a passively managed, non-diversified fixed-income strategy designed to track the performance of the ICE BulletShares US Treasury Bond 2029 Index by investing in U.S. dollar-denominated Treasury bonds maturing in the year 2029. The fund combines the structure of a defined-maturity investment with the liquidity of an exchange-traded vehicle, maintaining a systematic monthly rebalancing cycle and executing a mandatory cash liquidation and distribution on or about December 15, 2029
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 國債 ETF 是一種被動管理、非多元化的固定收益策略，旨在透過投資於 2029 年到期的美元計價國債來追蹤 ICE BulletShares 美國國債 2029 指數的表現。該基金將固定期限投資的結構與交易所交易工具的流動性相結合，維持系統性的每月再平衡週期並執行強制現金清算並於 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右分發

info.description: Cabana Target Drawdown 10 ETF seeks to provide long-term growth within a targeted risk parameter. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective with limited volatility and reduced correlation to the overall performance of the equity markets by allocating its assets among the following five major asset classes - equities, fixed income securities, real estate, currencies, and commodities. The Sub-Adviser's target drawdown for the fund is 10%; however, there can be no assurance, and the fund, the Adviser, and the Sub-Adviser do not represent or guarantee, that this target will be maintained.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target Drawdown 10 ETF 尋求在目標風險參數範圍內提供長期成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過將資產配置在以下五個主要資產類別（股票、固定收益證券、房地產、貨幣和大宗商品）中，以有限的波動性並降低與股票市場整體表現的相關性來實現其投資目標。副顧問對該基金的目標提款是 10%；然而，不能保證，並且基金、顧問和副顧問也不聲明或保證這一目標將會得到維持。

info.description: NEOS Enhanced Income Credit Select ETF seeks total return from income and capital appreciation while providing a tax efficient monthly income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing 80% or more of its net assets in bonds or ETFs that invest 80% or more of their assets in bonds and selling and purchasing S&P 500 Index put options to generate income to the fund beyond what is received from the underlying investments.
info.description_zh: NEOS 增強型收入信用精選 ETF 尋求收入和資本增值的總回報，同時提供節稅的月收入。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，旨在透過將 80% 或以上的淨資產投資於債券或將 80% 或以上的資產投資於債券的 ETF，以及買賣標普 500 指數看跌期權，為基金帶來超出基礎投資收益的收入，從而實現其投資目標。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2032 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2032. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2032 高收益企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益企業債券 2032 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的高收益公司債投資組合的表現，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Core 1-5 Year USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal 1-5 Year Index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high yield with remaining effective maturities between one and five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and TBA transactions that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the index.
info.description_zh: iShares Core 1-5 年期美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用 1-5 年期指數的投資結果，該指數衡量以美元計價的應稅債券的表現，這些債券被評為投資級或高收益，剩餘有效期限為 1 至 5 年。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的 TBA 交易，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於該指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。

info.description: Xtrackers Cybersecurity Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Cyber Security ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the field of cybersecurity and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Cyber​​security Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Cyber​​ Security ESG 篩選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數化投資方法，尋求與相關指數（扣除費用和開支之前）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在網路安全領域開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Solana 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Solana 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Solana Index.
