The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Solana so that the total value of the Solana to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 Solana 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P Solana 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P Solana 指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成 S&P 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於 Solana，以便該基金所涉經濟風險的 Solana 總價值約為該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: Vanguard Total International Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a benchmark index that measures the investment return of non-U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade bonds. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index (USD Hedged). This index provides a broad-based measure of the global, investment-grade, fixed-rate debt markets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total International Bond Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤衡量非美元計價投資等級債券投資回報的基準指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合不計美元浮動調整 RIC 上限指數（美元對沖）的表現。該指數提供了對全球投資等級固定利率債務市場的廣泛衡量。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Globalstar, Inc. engages in the provision of mobile satellite services. It offers voice and data communications services to the following markets: recreation and personal, government, public safety and disaster relief, oil and gas, maritime and fishing, natural resources, mining, and forestry, construction, utilities, and transportation. The company was founded in November 2003 and is headquartered in Covington, LA.
info.description_zh: Globalstar, Inc. 從事提供行動衛星服務。它為以下市場提供語音和數據通訊服務：娛樂和個人、政府、公共安全和救災、石油和天然氣、海事和漁業、自然資源、採礦和林業、建築、公用事業和運輸。該公司成立於 2003 年 11 月，總部位於路易斯安那州卡溫頓。

info.description: iShares Fallen Angels USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg US High Yield Fallen Angel 3% Capped Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade.
info.description_zh: iShares Fallen Angels 美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國高收益 Fallen Angel 3% 上限指數的投資結果，該指數由先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現。

info.description: Weatherford International plc engages in providing equipment and services to the oil and natural gas exploration and production industry. It operates through the following segments: Drilling and Evaluation (DRE), Well Construction and Completions (WCC) and Production and Intervention (PRI). The DRE segment offers managed pressure drilling, drilling services, wire line, and drilling fluids. The WCC segment includes tubular running services, cementation products, completions, liner hangers, and well services. The PRI segment covers the intervention services and drilling tools, artificial lift, production automation and software, sub-sea intervention, and pressure pumping services. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Weatherford International plc 致力於為石油和天然氣勘探和生產行業提供設備和服務。它透過以下部門運作：鑽井和評估（DRE）、建井和完井（WCC）以及生產和介入（PRI）。 DRE 部門提供控壓鑽井、鑽井服務、電纜和鑽井液。 WCC 部門包括管管輸送服務、固井產品、完井、尾管懸掛器和油井服務。 PRI 部門涵蓋幹預服務和鑽井工具、人工舉升、生產自動化和軟體、海底幹預和壓力泵送服務。該公司成立於 1941 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: iShares MSCI World Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI World Small Cap Index. The index is composed of small-capitalization developed market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 世界小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界小型股指數的投資結果。該指數由小盤發達市場股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: FlexShares Credit-Scored US Corporate Bond Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Northern Trust US Corporate Bond IndexSM. The underlying index is designed to reflect the performance of a diversified universe of intermediate maturity, U.S.-dollar denominated bonds of companies with investment grade credit quality, favorable valuations, and enhanced short-term and long-term solvency. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of its index.
info.description_zh: FlexShares 信用評分美國公司債指數基金尋求與 Northern Trust 美國公司債指數 SM 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在反映具有投資等級信用品質、良好估值以及增強的短期和長期償付能力的公司的多元化中期債券的表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少80%投資於其指數的證券。

info.description: Hesai Group engages in the development, manufacture and sale of three-dimensional light detection and ranging(lidar) solutions. The company's lidar products enable a broad spectrum of applications across passenger and commercial vehicles with advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous vehicle fleets. The company was founded by Yi Fan Li, Kai Sun, and Shao Qing Xiang in October 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 禾賽集團從事三維光探測與測距（光達）解決方案的研發、製造和銷售。該公司的雷射雷達產品可在配備先進駕駛輔助系統 (ADAS) 的乘用車和商用車以及自動駕駛車隊中實現廣泛的應用。該公司由李一帆、孫凱和邵清翔於2014年10月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Vanguard Total International Stock Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a benchmark index that measures the investment return of stocks issued by companies located in developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the FTSE Global All Cap ex US Index, a float-adjusted market-capitalization-weighted index designed to measure equity market performance of companies located in developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. The fund invests all, or substantially all, of its assets in the common stocks included in its target index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total International Stock Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤基準指數的表現，該指數衡量已開發市場和新興市場（不包括美國）公司發行的股票的投資回報。該管理公司採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤富時全球全盤指數（美國除外）的表現，該指數是一種流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場（不包括美國）公司的股票市場表現。該基金將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於其目標指數中包含的普通股。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Float Adjusted Composite Index that measures the investment return of investment-grade U.S. bonds and investment-grade non-U.S. dollar-denominated bonds. The fund is a fund of funds and employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which is a custom, USD-hedged index designed to track the market capitalized weights of the global investment-grade bond market and is comprised of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index and the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF 旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合流通量調整後綜合指數的表現，該指數衡量投資等級美國債券和投資等級非美元計價債券的投資回報。該基金是基金中的基金，採用指數化投資方法，旨在追蹤指數的表現，該指數是定制的美元對沖指數，旨在追蹤全球投資等級債券市場的市值權重，由彭博美國綜合浮動調整指數和彭博全球綜合浮動調整後 RIC 上限指數組成。

info.description: iShares Transition-Enabling Metals ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Clean Energy Transition Metals Index. The index measures the performance of a basket of exchange-traded metals futures contracts representing the underlying metals that are extensively used in a wide range of clean energy technologies, as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets, plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the same or similar metals futures contracts as the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Transition-Eabling Metals ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 清潔能源過渡金屬指數的投資結果。該指數衡量一籃子交易所交易的金屬期貨合約的表現，這些合約代表了由 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的廣泛用於各種清潔能源技術的基礎金屬。該基金將至少 80% 的資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於與標的指數相同或相似的金屬期貨合約。

info.description: SPDR MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned Index. The fund generally invests substantially all, but at least 80%, of its total assets in the securities comprising the index. The index is designed to exceed the minimum standards for a "Paris-Aligned Benchmark" under the EU BMR. A Paris-Aligned Benchmark is designed to align with a principal objective of the Paris Agreement to limit the increase in the global average temperature to well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.
info.description_zh: SPDR MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與 MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金通常將其總資產的大部分（但至少 80%）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在超過歐盟 BMR 下「巴黎一致基準」的最低標準。巴黎協調基準旨在與《巴黎協定》的主要目標保持一致，即將全球平均氣溫上升幅度限制在遠低於工業化前水準 2 攝氏度。

info.description: Sprott Energy Transition Materials ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Energy Transition Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, production, recycling, refining, or smelting of energy transition materials; (ii) investments in energy transition materials that represent all or a significant portion of their assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 能源轉型材料 ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 能源轉型材料指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 能源轉型材料的採礦、勘探、開發、生產、回收、精煉或冶煉的公司的業績； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的能源轉型材料投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2033 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2033, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2033 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2033年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the FTSE Shariah USA Index. The index is composed of common stocks of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. companies the characteristics of which meet the requirements of Shariah and are consistent with Islamic principles as interpreted by subject-matter experts. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF 旨在追蹤 FTSE Shariah USA 指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數由大中型美國公司的普通股組成，其特徵符合伊斯蘭教法的要求，並符合主題專家解釋的伊斯蘭原則。一般情況下，其總資產的至少80%會投資於該指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2032 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2032. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2032.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2032 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2032 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield, before fees and expenses, of an equity index called the Indxx Metaverse Index (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is comprised of companies that provide services and products that support the infrastructure and applications of the Metaverse. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF 尋求的結果通常與名為 Indxx Metaverse 指數（「指數」）的股票指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數由提供支援元宇宙基礎設施和應用程式的服務和產品的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on April 16, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年4月16日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NVDA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that provide leveraged exposure to NVDA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 NVDA 每日表現的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NVDA 的證券以及為 NVDA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2033. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2033.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2033 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2033 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2031 年債券」）的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Primis Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services through its subsidiary Sonabank. The firm focuses on making loans secured primarily by commercial real estate and other types of secured and unsecured commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses in a number of industries, as well as loans to individuals for a variety of purposes. It also invests in real estate related securities, including collateralized mortgage obligations and agency mortgage backed securities. The company was founded by Georgia S. Derrico and R. Roderick Porter in July 28, 2004 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Primis Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Sonabank 提供金融服務。該公司專注於向多個行業的中小型企業提供主要以商業房地產和其他類型的有擔保和無擔保商業貸款為擔保的貸款，以及為各種目的的個人提供貸款。它還投資於房地產相關證券，包括抵押貸款抵押債券和機構抵押貸款支持證券。該公司由 Georgia S. Derrico 和 R. Roderick Porter 於 2004 年 7 月 28 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of NVIDIA Corporation. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.5 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NVIDIA 公司普通股每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。基金將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Victoryshares Westend U.S. Sector ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its total assets in U.S. equity securities of companies that are classified in one or more of the following sectors published by The GICS: (1) Communication Services; (2) Consumer Discretionary; (3) Consumer Staples; (4) Energy; (5) Financials; (6) Health Care; (7) Industrials; (8) Information Technology; (9) Materials; (10) Real Estate; and (11) Utilities.
info.description_zh: Victoryshares Westend 美國板塊 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於 GICS 公佈的屬於以下一個或多個行業的公司的美國股本證券： (1) 通訊服務； (2) 非必需消費品； (3) 必需消費品；（4） 能源； (5) 財務； (6) 醫療保健； (3) 必需消費品；(4) 能源； (5) 財務； (6) 醫療保健資訊； (7) 工業材料（10）；

info.description: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI composed of large- and mid-capitalization developed and emerging market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF 旨在追蹤由大中型已開發市場和新興市場股票組成的 MSCI ACWI 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家的綜合股市表現。

info.description: AB Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return through current income and long-term capital appreciation. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in investment grade fixed-income securities of corporate issuers. Corporate issuers may include corporate or other business entities in which a sovereign or governmental agency or entity may have, indirectly or directly, an interest, including a majority or greater ownership interest.
info.description_zh: AB Corporate Bond ETF 尋求透過當前收入和長期資本增值來最大化總回報。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於企業發行人的投資等級固定收益證券來實現其目標。公司發行人可能包括主權或政府機構或實體可能間接或直接擁有權益（包括多數或更多所有權權益）的公司或其他商業實體。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ Technology Dividend Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ Technology Dividend IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is owned and was developed by Nasdaq, Inc. (the "index provider"). The index includes up to 100 technology and telecommunications companies that pay a regular or common dividend. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ Technology Dividend Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ Technology Dividend IndexTM 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數由納斯達克公司（「指數提供者」）擁有並開發。該指數包括多達 100 家支付定期或普通股息的科技和電信公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. is a diversified holding company, that seeks to build long-term shareholder value by acquiring, managing, and growing businesses with strong fundamentals and market opportunities. Its current structure consists of four divisions: Building Solutions, Business Services, Energy Services, and Investments. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Old Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Star Equity Holdings, Inc.是一家多元化控股公司，致力於透過收購、管理和發展具有強勁基本面和市場機會的業務來建立長期股東價值。其目前的結構由四個部門組成：建築解決方案、商業服務、能源服務和投資。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於康乃狄克州老格林威治。

info.description: iShares MSCI ACWI ex U.S. ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index composed of large- and mid-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI ACWI（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤由大中型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The underlying index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of U.S. companies that have favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics (as determined by the index provider), while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI USA Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。標的指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵（由指數提供者確定）的美國公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 美國指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Global X Robotics & Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global Robotics & Artificial Intelligence Thematic Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that are involved in the development of robotics and/or artificial intelligence as defined by Indxx, the provider of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 機器人和人工智慧 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 全球機器人和人工智慧主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該基礎指數旨在為已開發市場的交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司參與基礎指數供應商 Indxx 定義的機器人和/或人工智慧開發。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amphenol Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products, and specialty cable. It operates through the following segments: Harsh Environment Solutions, Communications Solutions, and Interconnect and Sensor Systems. The Harsh Environment Solutions segment manufactures and markets a broad range of ruggedized interconnect products, including connectors and interconnect systems, printed circuits and printed circuit assemblies, and other products. The Communications Solutions segment focuses on the design, manufacture, and marketing of connector and interconnect systems, including radio frequency, power, fiber optic, and other products, together with antennas. The Interconnect and Sensor Systems segment is involved in the design, manufacture, and marketing of sensors, sensor-based systems, connectors, and value-add interconnect systems. The company was founded by Schmitt J. Arthur in 1932 and is headquartered in Wallingford, CT.
info.description_zh: 安費諾公司從事電氣、電子和光纖連接器、互連繫統、天線、感測器和基於感測器的產品以及特殊電纜的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：惡劣環境解決方案、通訊解決方案以及互連和感測器系統。惡劣環境解決方案部門製造和銷售各種堅固耐用的互連產品，包括連接器和互連繫統、印刷電路和印刷電路組件以及其他產品。通訊解決方案部門專注於連接器和互連系統的設計、製造和行銷，包括射頻、電源、光纖和其他產品以及天線。互連和感測器系統部門涉及感測器、基於感測器的系統、連接器和增值互連系統的設計、製造和行銷。該公司由 Schmitt J. Arthur 於 1932 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州沃靈福德。

info.description: Pacer Emerging Markets Cash Cows 100 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Emerging Markets Cash Cows 100 Index. The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large and mid-capitalization companies in emerging markets with high free cash flow yields. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in the component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Emerging Markets Cash Cows 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Emerging Markets Cash Cows 100 指數的總回報表現（扣除費用和支出）。該指數採用客觀、以規則為基礎的方法，為新興市場中自由現金流收益率較高的大中型企業提供投資機會。一般情況下，基金總資產（不包括證券借貸抵押品）的至少80%將投資於該指數的組成證券以及與該組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares International Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the FTSE World Government Bond Index - Developed Markets Capped Select Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of fixed-rate, local currency, investment-grade, sovereign bonds from certain developed markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 國際公債 ETF 旨在追蹤富時世界政府公債指數 - 已開發市場上限精選指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。相關指數衡量某些已開發市場的固定利率、本國貨幣、投資等級、主權債券的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SGI Dynamic Tactical ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF and invests in securities of affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs and open-end mutual funds. The fund may allocate among major equity asset classes and sectors, within the underlying funds, of the U.S., foreign and emerging markets equity of any capitalization.
info.description_zh: SGI 動態戰術 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，投資於附屬和非附屬 ETF 以及開放式共同基金的證券。該基金可以在基礎基金內的美國、外國和新興市場任何資本的股票的主要股票資產類別和部門之間進行配置。

info.description: Ferroglobe PLC is a holding company, which engages in the production of silicon and specialty metals. The firm's products include silicon metal, manganese alloys, ferrosilicon, calcium silicon, and electrodes. It operates through the following segments: North America Silicon Metals, North America Silicon Alloys, Europe Manganese, Europe Silicon Metals, Europe Silicon Alloys, South Africa Silicon Metals, South Africa Silicon Alloys, and Other. The company was founded on February 5, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Ferroglobe PLC 是一家控股公司，從事矽和特種金屬的生產。該公司的產品包括金屬矽、錳合金、矽鐵、矽鈣和電極。它透過以下部門運作：北美金屬矽部門、北美矽合金部門、歐洲錳部門、歐洲金屬矽部門、歐洲矽合金部門、南非金屬矽部門、南非矽合金部門等。該公司成立於2015年2月5日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Lyft, Inc. engages in the provision and management of an online social rideshare community platform. It offers access to a network of shared bikes and scooters for shorter rides and first mile and last-mile legs of multimodal trips, information about nearby public transit routes, and Lyft Rentals to offer riders a view of transportation options when planning any trip. The company was founded by Marcus Cohn, John Zimmer, Rajat Suri, Matt van Horn, and Logan D. Green on March 5, 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Lyft, Inc. 從事線上社交乘車共享社群平台的提供和管理。它提供共享自行車和踏板車網路的存取權限，以實現短途騎行以及多式聯運的第一英里和最後一英里行程、附近公共交通路線的資訊以及Lyft Rentals，以便乘客在計劃任何旅行時了解交通選擇。該公司由 Marcus Cohn、John Zimmer、Rajat Suri、Matt van Horn 和 Logan D. Green 於 2007 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: The Boeing Co. is an aerospace company, which engages in the manufacture of commercial jetliners and defense, space, and security systems. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Airplanes (BCA), Defense, Space and Security (BDS), and Global Services (BGS). The Commercial Airplanes segment includes the development, production, and market of commercial jet aircraft and provides fleet support services, principally to the commercial airline industry worldwide. The Defense, Space and Security segment refers to the research, development, production and modification of manned and unmanned military aircraft and weapons systems for global strike, including fighter and combat rotorcraft aircraft and missile systems, global mobility, including tanker, rotorcraft and tilt-rotor aircraft, and airborne surveillance and reconnaissance, including command and control, battle management and airborne anti-submarine aircraft. The Global Services segment provides services to commercial and defense customers. The company was founded by William Edward Boeing on July 15, 1916, and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: 波音公司是一家航空航太公司，從事商用噴射客機以及國防、太空和安全系統的製造。該公司透過以下部門運作：商用飛機部門 (BCA)、國防、太空與安全部門 (BDS) 以及全球服務部門 (BGS)。商用飛機部門包括商用噴射機的開發、生產和銷售，並主要向全球商業航空業提供機隊支援服務。國防、太空和安全部門是指用於全球打擊的有人和無人駕駛軍用飛機和武器系統的研究、開發、生產和改裝，包括戰鬥機和戰鬥旋翼機和飛彈系統，全球機動性，包括加油機、旋翼機和傾轉旋翼機，以及機載監視和偵察，包括指揮和控制、戰鬥管理和機翼反潛飛機。全球服務部門為商業和國防客戶提供服務。該公司由威廉愛德華波音於 1916 年 7 月 15 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Asure Software, Inc. delivers human capital management solutions through the lens of entrepreneurs and executives with an owner's mentality. It helps small and mid-sized businesses to develop their human capital and allocate their time, money and technology toward growth. Its solutions include Asure Payroll & Tax, Asure HR, and Asure Time & Attendance. The firm's Asure HRServices offer ranges from online compliance tools to a fully outsourced HR department. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Asure Software, Inc. 透過具有所有者心態的企業家和高階主管的觀點提供人力資本管理解決方案。它幫助中小型企業發展人力資本，並分配時間、金錢和技術以實現成長。其解決方案包括 Asure 薪資和稅務、Asure HR 以及 Asure 考勤。該公司的 Asure HRServices 提供從線上合規工具到完全外包的人力資源部門的服務。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Japan Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 日本指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克日本指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: iShares MSCI Qatar ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All Qatar Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the equity market in Qatar. The underlying index uses a capping methodology that limits the weight of any single "group entity" to a maximum of 25% of the underlying index weight. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 卡達 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 全卡達上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整市值加權指數，旨在衡量卡達股市。標的指數使用上限方法，將任何單一「集團實體」的權重限制為標的指數權重的最大 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Preferred and Income Securities ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Exchange-Listed Preferred & Hybrid Securities Index, which measures the performance of a select group of exchange-listed, U.S. dollar-denominated preferred securities, hybrid securities and convertible preferred securities listed on the NYSE or NASDAQ. The fund may invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares 優先和收入證券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 交易所上市優先和混合證券指數的投資結果，該指數衡量一組精選的交易所上市、以美元計價的優先證券、混合證券以及在紐約證券交易所或納斯達克上市的可轉換優先證券的表現。該基金可以將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: GE Aerospace is an American aircraft company, which engages in the provision of jet and turboprop engines, as well as integrated systems for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft. The firm's portfolio of brands includes Avio Aero, Unison, GE Additive, and Dowty Propellers. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Engines and Services, Defense and Propulsion Technologies, and Corporate and Other. The Commercial Engines and Services segment is involved in the design, development, manufacturing, and servicing of jet engines for commercial airframes, as well as business aviation and aeroderivative applications. The Defense and Propulsion Technologies segment offers defense engines and critical aircraft systems. The Corporate and Other segment relates to corporate functions and operations costs. The company was founded by Thomas Alva Edison in 1878 and is headquartered in Evendale, OH.
info.description_zh: GE航空航太公司是一家美國飛機公司，主要為商用、軍用、公務和通用航空飛機提供噴射和渦輪螺旋槳發動機以及整合系統。該公司的品牌組合包括 Avio Aero、Unison、GE Additive 和 Dowty Propellers。它透過以下部門運作：商用引擎和服務部門、國防和推進技術部門以及企業和其他部門。商用發動機和服務部門涉及商用機身噴射發動機的設計、開發、製造和維修，以及公務航空和航改應用。國防和推進技術部門提供國防發動機和關鍵飛機系統。公司及其他部門涉及公司職能和營運成本。該公司由托馬斯·阿爾瓦·愛迪生於 1878 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州埃文代爾。

info.description: AXS Change Finance ESG ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Change Finance Diversified Impact U.S. Large Cap Fossil Fuel Free Index. The index measures the performance of an equal-weighted portfolio of approximately 100 large-, mid-capitalization equity securities of U.S.-listed companies. The fund adviser attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The adviser expects that, over time, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index will be 95% or better.
info.description_zh: AXS Change Finance ESG ETF 旨在追蹤 Change Finance 多元化影響美國大盤無化石燃料指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數衡量約 100 隻美國上市公司大中型股票證券的等權重投資組合的表現。基金顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。

info.description: Sprott Silver Miners & Physical Silver ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, that track the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Silver Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of the value of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, production, development, or exploration of silver; and publicly traded closed-end trusts that invest 50% or more of their assets in physical silver. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Silver Miners & Physical Silver ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，追蹤納斯達克 Sprott Silver Miners Index 的總回報表現。在正常情況下，基金將至少將其總資產價值的80%投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自白銀開採、生產、開發或勘探的公司的表現；以及將 50% 或更多資產投資於實體白銀的公開交易封閉式信託。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: Qualys, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud security and compliance solutions. Its products enable organizations to identify security risks to information technology infrastructures, help protect information technology systems and applications from cyber attacks, and achieve compliance with internal policies and external regulations. The firm also offers solutions through a software-as-a-service model, primarily with renewable annual subscriptions. The company was founded on December 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Qualys, Inc. 致力於提供雲端安全性和合規性解決方案。其產品使組織能夠識別資訊技術基礎設施的安全風險，幫助保護資訊科技系統和應用程式免受網路攻擊，並實現內部政策和外部法規的合規性。該公司還透過軟體即服務模式提供解決方案，主要採用可更新的年度訂閱。該公司成立於1999年12月30日，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: Spot exchange-traded fund from VanEck designed to reflect the performance of the price of BNB tokens, holding BNB and valuing its shares daily based on the MarketVector BNB Benchmark Rate.
info.description_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.

info.description: TSPY Lift ETF tracks the daily performance of the TappAlpha SPY Growth & Daily Income ETF (TSPY) with a 1.3x leverage factor. The strategy is designed to provide amplified exposure to a core portfolio that combines long S&P 500 equity participation with a systematic, fintech-powered daily (0DTE) covered call overlay for income generation.
info.description_zh: TSPY Lift ETF 追蹤 TappAlpha SPY 成長和每日收入 ETF (TSPY) 的每日表現，槓桿係數為 1.3 倍。該策略旨在擴大對核心投資組合的曝險，該投資組合將長期標普 500 指數股票參與與系統性、金融科技驅動的每日 (0DTE) 覆蓋看漲期權疊加相結合，以產生收入。

info.description: Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. engages in the manufacture and development of security screening products. It also provides artificial intelligence-based security screening solutions for industries including casinos, industrial workplaces, schools, and ticketed venues. The company was founded by Anil R. Chitkara and Michael Philip Ellenbogen in July 2013 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. 從事安全檢查產品的製造和開發。它還為賭場、工業工作場所、學校和售票場所等行業提供基於人工智慧的安全檢查解決方案。該公司由 Anil R. Chitkara 和 Michael Philip Ellenbogen 於 2013 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Global X Internet of Things ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global Internet of Things Thematic Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that facilitate the Internet of Things industry, including companies involved in wearable technology, home automation, connected automotive technology, sensors, networking infrastructure/software, smart metering and energy control devices. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 物聯網 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 全球物聯網主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該指數旨在為已開發市場的交易所上市公司提供投資機會，促進物聯網產業的發展，包括涉及穿戴式技術、家庭自動化、連網汽車技術、感測器、網路基礎設施/軟體、智慧計量和能源控制設備的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Emerging Markets Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Emerging Markets Infrastructure IndexTM, which is designed to track the performance of 30 of the largest publicly listed companies in the infrastructure industry in emerging markets. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 新興市場基礎設施​​ ETF 旨在追蹤標普新興市場基礎設施​​指數™的投資結果，該指數旨在追蹤新興市場基礎設施​​產業 30 家最大的上市公司的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物以及未納入指數的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Technology Opportunities ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity investments in technology companies. It seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, in companies that are considered by the Investment Adviser to benefit from the proliferation of technology. The fund may invest up to 25% of its total assets measured at the time of purchase ("Total Assets") in foreign securities.
info.description_zh: 高盛科技機會ETF尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於科技公司的股權投資。在正常情況下，它尋求透過投資投資顧問認為可從技術擴散中受益的公司來實現其投資目標。該基金最多可將其購買時總資產（「總資產」）的 25% 投資於外國證券。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NVDA. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to NVDA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求 NVDA 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index ("Broad Markets Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index（「Broad Markets Index」或「Index」）的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 2000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Growth Index that measures the investment return of small-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Growth Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of small-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 2000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤Russell 2000 Growth Index的表現，該指數衡量美國小型成長股的投資回報。該基金顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 2000 成長指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國小型成長股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: Russell Inv U.S. Small Cap Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in small capitalization equity securities economically tied to the U.S. It invests principally in common stocks of small capitalization U.S. companies, some of which are also considered micro capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv 美國小型股主動型 ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與美國經濟相關的小市值股票證券。它主要投資於小市值美國公司的普通股，其中一些也被視為微型美國公司。

info.description: Donegal Group, Inc. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of property and casualty insurance to businesses and individuals. It operates through the following segments: Investment Function, Personal Lines of Insurance, and Commercial Lines of Insurance. The Investment Function segment covers investment activities. The Personal Lines of Insurance segment consists of homeowners and private passenger automobile policies. The Commercial Lines of Insurance segment includes commercial automobile, commercial multi-peril, and workers compensation policies. The company was founded on August 26, 1986 and is headquartered in Marietta, PA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Donegal Group, Inc.是一家保險控股公司，致力於向企業和個人提供財產和傷亡保險。它透過以下部門運作：投資職能部門、個人保險業務部門和商業保險業務部門。投資功能部分涵蓋投資活動。個人保險部分包括房屋所有權人和私人乘用車保單。商業保險業務部門包括商業汽車、商業多重險和工人賠償保單。該公司成立於1986年8月26日，總部位於賓州瑪麗埃塔。

info.description: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S. listed common stock. The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital.在正常藉錢The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.

info.description: Latham Group, Inc. operates as a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of in-ground residential swimming pools in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. It offers a portfolio of pools and related products, including in-ground swimming pools, pool liners, and pool covers. The company was founded on December 6, 2018 and is headquartered in Latham, NY.
info.description_zh: Latham Group, Inc. 在北美、澳洲和紐西蘭從事地下住宅游泳池的設計、製造和行銷。它提供一系列泳池及相關產品，包括地下游泳池、泳池襯墊和泳池蓋。該公司成立於2018年12月6日，總部位於紐約州萊瑟姆。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Tail Risk ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies a protective put strategy (i.e. long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 尾部風險 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票並對納斯達克 100 指數應用保護性看跌策略（即多頭（購買）看跌期權）的風險管理策略的績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600. The index, as designed, has two components: (i) a Nasdaq-100 component and (ii) a dividend component consisting of long positions in annual futures contracts that provide exposure to ordinary dividends paid on the common stocks of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Advisor attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF 旨在追蹤 Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600 的總回報表現（未扣除費用和開支）。按照設計，該指數有兩個組成部分：(i) Nasdaq-100 成分和 (ii) 股息成分，由年度期貨合約的多頭頭寸組成，這些合約提供對包括以下公司的普通股支付的普通股股息的敞口被納入納斯達克 100 指數。顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NetEase, Inc. is an internet technology company, which engages in the provision of premium online services centered around content, community, communication and commerce. It develops and operates some of the most popular PC-client and mobile games in China. The firm also operates some of the most popular international online games in China by partnering with Blizzard Entertainment, Mojang AB (a Microsoft subsidiary) and other global game developers. NetEase also offers other services, including the intelligent learning services of its majority-controlled subsidiary, Youdao, its music streaming platform, NetEase Cloud Music, and its private label e-commerce platform, Yanxuan. The company operates through the following business segments: Online Game Services, Youdao, Cloud Music, and Innovative Businesses and Others. The Online Game Services segment produces online PC-client games. The Youdao segment is an online education service provider in China. The Cloud Music segment represents revenue from online music services through the sales of membership subscriptions in various content and service packages. The Innovative Businesses and Others segment offers other services, which includes live video streaming and its private label e-commerce platform, Yanxuan. The company was founded by Lei Ding in June 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 網易公司是一家網路科技公司，提供以內容、社群、通訊和商業為核心的優質線上服務。它開發並經營一些中國最受歡迎的電腦客戶端和手機遊戲。該公司還與暴雪娛樂、Mojang AB（微軟子公司）和其他全球遊戲開發商合作，在中國經營一些最受歡迎的國際網路遊戲。網易也提供其他服務，包括其控股子公司有道的智慧學習服務、音樂串流平台網易雲音樂以及自有品牌電子商務平台嚴選。該公司透過以下業務板塊運作：網路遊戲服務、有道、雲端音樂、創新業務及其他。線上遊戲服務部門生產線上電腦用戶端遊戲。有道部門是中國的線上教育服務提供者。雲端音樂部門代表透過銷售各種內容和服務包的會員訂閱來獲得線上音樂服務的收入。創新業務及其他部門提供其他服務，其中包括視訊直播及其自有品牌電子商務平台嚴選。該公司由丁磊於1997年6月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in U.S.-listed equity securities of companies that, in the Sub-Adviser's opinion, are primarily focused on building solutions to address climate change. It may invest in international companies, including those in emerging markets, through U.S. exchange-tradedADRs, however, they will not be considered U.S. equity securities for purposes of the fund's 80% policy.
info.description_zh: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過主要投資於美國上市公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，副顧問認為這些公司主要致力於建立應對氣候變遷的解決方案。它可以透過美國交易所交易的美國存託憑證投資於國際公司，包括新興市場的公司，但是，就該基金的 80% 政策而言，它們不會被視為美國股票證券。

info.description: SGI Enhanced Nasdaq-100 ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. Under normal market circumstances, seeks to achieve its objective by (1) investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity investments of companies that, at the time of investment, are included in the NASDAQ-100 Index and/or options, ETFs or options on ETFs that seek to replicate the returns of the Index, and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型納斯達克 100 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場情況下，尋求透過以下方式實現其目標：(1) 將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於在投資時納入 NASDAQ-100 指數和/或尋求複製指數回報的期權、ETF 或 ETF 期權的公司的股權投資，以及 (2) 投資於尋求產生當前收入的期權策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: REX Drone ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the VettaFi Drone IndexSM (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities that comprise the index. The index tracks the performance of a portfolio of global equity securities of companies that are engaged in drone and/or unmanned aerial vehicles ("UAV") manufacturing and enabling technologies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX 無人機 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 VettaFi Drone IndexSM（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數追蹤從事無人機和/或無人駕駛飛行器（“UAV”）製造和支援技術的公司的全球股票證券投資組合的表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Telesat Corp. engages in the provision of satellite communications and consulting services. It operates through Geostationary (GEO) and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) segments. It is a global satellite operator, providing mission-critical communications solutions to support the requirements of sophisticated satellite users throughout the world and consists of 14 geostationary satellites and the Canadian payload on Viasat-1. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
info.description_zh: Telesat Corp. 從事提供衛星通訊和諮詢服務。它透過對地靜止軌道 (GEO) 和低地球軌道 (LEO) 部分運作。它是一家全球衛星營運商，提供關鍵任務通訊解決方案，以滿足世界各地複雜衛星用戶的需求，由 14 顆地球靜止衛星和 Viasat-1 上的加拿大有效載荷組成。該公司成立於1969年，總部位於加拿大渥太華。

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Direxion Daily AAPL Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AAPL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to AAPL equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AAPL Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 AAPL 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具組合起來為 AAPL 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿風險敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的至少 80%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily BA Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of BA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of BA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to BA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily BA Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 BA 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 BA 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 BA 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The firm focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare muscle disorders for which there is significant unmet medical need. Its platform utilizes custom-built throughput and translatable systems that measure integrated muscle function in whole organ extracts to identify small molecule precision medicines regulating key proteins in muscle tissue, initially focused on addressing rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Badreddin Edris, Alan Russel and Peter A. Thompson in 2017 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。該公司專注於針對嚴重、罕見肌肉疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化，這些疾病的醫療需求尚未得到滿足。其平台利用定制的通量和可翻譯系統來測量整個器官提取物中的綜合肌肉功能，以識別調節肌肉組織中關鍵蛋白質的小分子精準藥物，最初專注於解決罕見的神經肌肉和心臟病。該公司由 Badreddin Edris、Alan Russel 和 Peter A. Thompson 於 2017 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd. provides intelligent robotics and supply chain solutions to enterprises. It offers smart automation systems for industrial processes, logistics and retail stores. The firm operates through the following segments: Intelligent Robotics, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), and Supply Chain Solutions. The company was founded by Israel Gal in 1990 and is headquartered in Rishon LeZion, Israel.
info.description_zh: BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd. 為企業提供智慧機器人和供應鏈解決方案。它為工業流程、物流和零售商店提供智慧自動化系統。該公司透過以下部門運作：智慧機器人、無線射頻識別 (RFID) 和供應鏈解決方案。該公司由 Israel Gal 於 1990 年創立，總部位於以色列裡雄萊錫安。

info.description: Lumentum Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of optical and photonic products. It operates through the Cloud and Networking, and Industrial Tech segments. The Cloud and Networking segment refers to a portfolio of optical and photonic components, modules, and subsystems. The Industrial Tech segment includes solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, ultrafast lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Lumentum Holdings, Inc. 從事提供光學和光子產品。它透過雲端和網路以及工業技術部門運作。雲和網路部分是指光學和光子組件、模組和子系統的組合。工業技術領域包括固態雷射、千瓦級光纖雷射、超快雷射、二極體雷射和氣體雷射。該公司成立於 1979 年，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Seer, Inc. engages in the development of proprietary engineered nanoparticles to provide access across the proteome. Its Proteograph product suite consists of automation instruments and software, which provide a workflow to make proteomic profiling. The company was founded by Philip Ma, Robert S. Langer Jr. and Omid C. Farokhzad on March 16, 2017 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Seer, Inc. 致力於開發專有的工程奈米粒子，以提供跨蛋白質組的存取。其 Proteograph 產品套件由自動化儀器和軟體組成，提供了進行蛋白質體分析的工作流程。該公司由 Philip Ma、Robert S. Langer Jr. 和 Omid C. Farokhzad 於 2017 年 3 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Astronics Corp. engages in the provision of electrical power generation and distribution systems. The firm includes motion systems, lighting and safety systems, avionics products, aircraft structures, systems certification, and automated test systems. It operates through the Aerospace and Test Systems segments. The Aerospace segment designs and manufactures products for the global aerospace industry. The Test Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and maintains communications and weapons test systems and training and simulation devices for military applications. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in East Aurora, NY.
info.description_zh: Astronics Corp. 從事提供發電和配電系統。該公司包括運動系統、照明和安全系統、航空電子產品、飛機結構、系統認證和自動化測試系統。它透過航空航天和測試系統部門運作。航空航天部門為全球航空航天工業設計和製造產品。測試系統部門設計、開發、製造和維護通訊和武器測試系統以及軍事應用的訓練和模擬設備。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於紐約州東奧羅拉。

info.description: 908 Devices, Inc. engages in the development of measurement devices for chemical and biochemical analysis. It offers products using mass spectrometry technology, an analytical technique for measuring the mass of charged molecules that is used in chemical analysis laboratories for applications, such as safety and security, food science, biotechnology, clinical diagnostics, and controlling industrial processes. Its products include desktops and handhelds. The company was founded by Kevin J. Knopp, Miller Scott, Steve Araiza, Andrew Bartfay, Michael Jobin, Christopher D. Brown, and Christopher J. Petty in 2012 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: 908 Devices, Inc. 從事化學和生化分析測量設備的開發。它提供使用質譜技術的產品，質譜技術是一種用於測量帶電分子質量的分析技術，用於化學分析實驗室的應用，例如安全和安保、食品科學、生物技術、臨床診斷和控制工業過程。其產品包括桌上型電腦和手持機。該公司由 Kevin J. Knopp、Miller Scott、Steve Araiza、Andrew Bartfay、Michael Jobin、Christopher D. Brown 和 Christopher J. Petty 於 2012 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Technology ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive technology companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性技術 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性科技公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VinFast Auto Ltd. engages in designing and manufacturing electric vehicles. It offers electric scooters (e-scooters) and electric buses (e-buses). It provides e-mobility ecosystem built around customers, community and connectivity alongside new vehicle roll-out. The company was founded by Pham Nhat Vuong in June 2017 and is headquartered in Hai Phong City, Vietnam.
info.description_zh: VinFast Auto Ltd. 從事電動車的設計和製造。它提供電動滑板車（e-scooters）和電動巴士（e-buses）。它提供圍繞客戶、社區和連接性以及新車推出而構建的電動車生態系統。該公司由Pham Nhat Vuong於2017年6月創立，總部位於越南海防市。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: RadNet, Inc. engages in the provision of outpatient diagnostic imaging services in the United States. It operates through the following segments: Imaging Centers and Digital Health. The Imaging Centers segment provides physicians with imaging capabilities to facilitate the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and disorders. The Digital Health segment develops and deploys clinical applications to enhance interpretation of medical images and improve patient outcomes with an emphasis on brain, breast, prostate, and pulmonary diagnostics. The company was founded by Howard G. Berger in 1980 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: RadNet, Inc. 在美國提供門診診斷影像服務。它透過以下部門運作：影像中心和數位健康。影像中心部門為醫生提供影像能力，以促進疾病和病症的診斷和治療。數位健康部門開發和部署臨床應用程序，以增強醫學影像的解釋並改善患者的治療結果，重點是大腦、乳房、前列腺和肺部診斷。該公司由 Howard G. Berger 於 1980 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. engages in the provision of global logistics services. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Other North America, Latin America, North Asia, South Asia, Europe, and Middle East, Africa, and India. It offers air freight, ocean freight and ocean and customs brokerage and other services. It also provides customer solutions such as order management, time-definite transportation, warehousing and distribution, temperature-controlled transit, cargo insurance and customized logistics solutions. The company was founded by John M. Kaiser, Peter Rose, Wang Li Kou, Kevin Walsh, Hank Wong, George Ho, Robert Chiarito, and Glenn Alger in 1979 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. 從事提供全球物流服務。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、北美其他地區、拉丁美洲、北亞、南亞、歐洲、中東、非洲和印度。它提供空運、海運以及海運和報關等服務。它還為客戶提供訂單管理、限時運輸、倉儲配送、溫控運輸、貨物保險和客製化物流解決方案等解決方案。該公司由 John M. Kaiser、Peter Rose、Wang Li Kou、Kevin Walsh、Hank Wong、George Ho、Robert Chiarito 和 Glenn Alger 於 1979 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Direxion NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Shares seeks investment results before fees and expenses that track the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its assets in the securities that comprise the index or investments with economic characteristics similar to the securities included in the index. The index is the equal weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes approximately 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion NASDAQ-100 等權重指數股票尋求追蹤 NASDAQ-100 等權重指數的未計費用和開支的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於指數所包含的證券或與指數所包含的證券具有相似經濟特徵的投資。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克股票市場上市的約 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TransMedics Group, Inc. operates as a commercial stage medical technology company. The firm engages in the development and commercialization of organ care system platform. It focuses on the preservation of human organs for transplant in a near-physiologic condition to address the limitations of cold storage organ preservation. The company was founded by Waleed H. Hassanein in August 1998 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.
info.description_zh: TransMedics Group, Inc. 是一家商業階段的醫療技術公司。該公司從事器官護理系統平台的開發和商業化。它專注於在接近生理狀態下保存用於移植的人體器官，以解決冷藏器官保存的限制。該公司由 Waleed H. Hassanein 於 1998 年 8 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州安多佛。

info.description: iShares MSCI UAE ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All UAE Capped Index composed of UAE equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is designed to measure the equity market in the United Arab Emirates ("UAE"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI UAE ETF 旨在追蹤由阿聯酋股票組成的 MSCI All UAE Capped Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量阿拉伯聯合大公國（「UAE」）的股票市場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares S&P Small-Cap 600 Growth ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P SmallCap 600 Growth IndexTM composed of small-capitalization U.S. equities that exhibit growth characteristics. The index measures the performance of the small-capitalization growth sector of the U.S. equity market. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: iShares S&P Small-Cap 600 Growth ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Growth IndexTM 的投資結果，該指數由具有成長特徵的小型美國股票組成。該指數衡量美國股市小型成長型板塊的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。

info.description: ARS Focused Opportunities Strategy ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"), sub-advised by ARS Investment Partners, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund invests either directly in the equity securities of companies the Sub-Adviser deems to be high-quality, defined by strong balance sheets, reasonable earnings growth, and above-average dividend yields with the prospect for dividend growth, or indirectly through one or more underlying ETFs, that have exposure to the same companies. The fund manager intends to invest across a variety of sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 聚焦機會策略 ETF 尋求實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 ARS Investment Partners, LLC（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金直接投資於副顧問認為高品質的公司的股本證券，這些公司的資產負債表強勁、盈利增長合理、股息收益率高於平均水平且有股息增長的前景，或者通過一隻或多只投資於同一公司的基礎 ETF 間接投資。基金經理人打算投資多個產業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is the equal-weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes 100 of the largest U.S. and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100 等加權指數基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ-100 等加權 TM 指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克上市的 100 家最大的美國和國際非金融公司。

info.description: Touchstone Sands Capital US Select Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in common stocks of U.S. companies that have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth. The manager emphasizes investments in large and mid capitalization growth companies. The fund will invest, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in common stocks of U.S. companies that Sands Capital believes have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth.
info.description_zh: Touchstone Sands Capital US Select Growth ETF 寻求长期资本增值。该基金主要投资于收入或盈利增长潜力高于平均水平的美国公司的普通股。该经理强调对大中型资本成长型公司的投资。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於金沙資本認為具有高於平均水平的收入或獲利成長潛力的美國公司的普通股。

info.description: Kornit Digital Ltd. is engaged in the development, designing, manufacture, and marketing of industrial and commercial printing solutions for the garment, apparel, and textile industries. It offers printing solutions for apparel, polyester, sportswear, beachwear, accessories, paradigm shirt, textiles, curtains, cushions and couches. The company was founded by Ofer Ben-Zur on January 16, 2002 and is headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel.
info.description_zh: 康麗數位有限公司致力於為服裝、服裝和紡織業開發、設計、製造和行銷工業和商業印刷解決方案。它為服裝、聚酯纖維、運動服、沙灘裝、配件、範式襯衫、紡織品、窗簾、靠墊和沙發提供印刷解決方案。該公司由Ofer Ben-Zur於2002年1月16日創立，總部位於以色列羅什艾因。

info.description: Pony.ai, Inc. develops artificial intelligence-based robot designed for autonomous driving. The firm's software algorithms and infrastructure enables a vehicle to perceive its surroundings, predict what others will do, and maneuver itself accordingly. The company was founded by Jun Peng and Tian Cheng Lou in November 4, 2016 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Pony.ai, Inc. 開發專為自動駕駛而設計的人工智慧機器人。該公司的軟體演算法和基礎設施使車輛能夠感知周圍環境，預測其他人會做什麼，並相應地進行自我操縱。該公司由彭軍和樓天成於2016年11月4日創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Rand Capital Corp. is a business development company which engages in investment activities. Its investment objective is to maximize total return to its shareholders with current income and capital appreciation by focusing its debt and related equity investments in privately held lower middle market companies with committed and experienced managements in a broad variety of industries. The company was founded by George F. Rand and Donald A. Ross on February 24, 1969 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Rand Capital Corp. 是一家從事投資活動的業務開發公司。其投資目標是透過將其債務和相關股權投資重點投資於在各行業擁有忠誠且經驗豐富的管理層的中低端市場私人持有公司，透過當前收入和資本增值，最大限度地提高股東的總回報。該公司由 George F. Rand 和 Donald A. Ross 於 1969 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: i3 Verticals, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solutions to public sector solutions. It delivers end-to-end digital transformation, streamlining complex government operations, and citizen engagement. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: i3 Verticals, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於為公共部門解決方案提供企業軟體解決方案。它提供端到端的數位轉型，簡化複雜的政府運作和公民參與。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: Malibu Boats, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of recreational powerboats. The firm offers performance sport boats, sterndrive, and outboard boats under the Malibu, Axis, Pursuit, Maverick, Cobia, Pathfinder, Hewes, and Cobalt brands. It operates through the following segments: Malibu, Saltwater Fishing, and Cobalt. The Malibu segment is involved in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of Malibu and Axis performance sports boats. The Saltwater Fishing segment includes manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of Pursuit boats and the Maverick Boat Group boats. The Cobalt segment participates in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of Cobalt boats. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Loudon, TN.
info.description_zh: Malibu Boats, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事休閒動力艇的設計、製造和行銷。該公司提供 Malibu、Axis、Pursuit、Maverick、Cobia、Pathfinder、Hewes 和 Cobalt 品牌的高性能運動船、尾機驅動船和舷外船。該公司透過以下部門運作：Malibu、鹹水捕魚和Cobalt。 Malibu 部門從事 Malibu 和 Axis 高性能運動艇的製造、分銷、行銷和銷售。鹹水釣魚部門包括 Pursuit 船和 Maverick Boat Group 船的製造、分銷、行銷和銷售。鈷部門參與鈷船的製造、分銷、行銷和銷售。該公司成立於 1982 年，總部位於田納西州勞登。

info.description: Expand Energy Corp. engages in the production and development of natural gas, oil, and natural gas liquids. Its operations include Haynesville, Northeast Appalachia, and Southwest Appalachia. The company was founded in 2024 and is headquartered in Spring, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Expand Energy Corp. 從事天然氣、石油和液化天然氣的生產和開發。其業務包括海恩斯維爾、東北阿巴拉契亞和西南阿巴拉契亞。該公司成立於 2024 年，總部位於德克薩斯州斯普林。

info.description: Dogwood Therapeutics, Inc. is a development-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing therapeutics for pain and fatigue illness. Its product includes Halneuron. It focuses on antiviral therapies IMC-1 and IMC-2 to treat diseases associated with a viral triggered abnormal immune response such as Long-COVID and fibromyalgia. The company was founded on February 28, 2012 is headquartered in Alpharetta, GA.
info.description_zh: Dogwood Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家處於開發階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發疼痛和疲勞疾病的治療方法。其產品包括Halneuron。它專注於抗病毒療法 IMC-1 和 IMC-2，以治療與病毒引發的異常免疫反應相關的疾病，例如長新冠病毒和纖維肌痛。該公司成立於2012年2月28日，總部位於喬治亞州阿爾法利塔。

info.description: DuPont de Nemours, Inc. engages in the development and manufacture of specialty materials and technology-based products. It operates through the Healthcare & Water Technologies and Diversified Industrials segments. The Healthcare & Water Technologies segment includes packaging, parts, and components for medical device and biopharma markets and water filtration and purification technologies primarily for industrial wastewater and energy, municipal drinking water and desalination, and life sciences and specialty markets. The Diversified Industrials segment builds technologies, with a portfolio serving new-build, repair, and remodel applications across non-residential and residential construction markets, and industrial technologies, which include a portfolio of adhesive, wear and friction, and packaging solutions serving aerospace, automotive, printing, and packaging markets. The company was founded in 1802 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: 杜邦德內穆爾公司從事特殊材料和技術產品的開發和製造。它透過醫療保健和水技術以及多元化工業部門運作。醫療保健和水技術部門包括用於醫療器材和生物製藥市場的包裝、零件和組件，以及主要用於工業廢水和能源、市政飲用水和海水淡化以及生命科學和專業市場的水過濾和淨化技術。多元化工業部門建構技術，提供服務於非住宅和住宅建築市場的新建、維修和改造應用的產品組合，以及工業技術，其中包括服務於航空航太、汽車、印刷和包裝市場的黏合劑、磨損和摩擦以及包裝解決方案的產品組合。該公司成立於 1802 年，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Republic Airways Holdings, Inc. is a holding company that engages in the provision of passenger airline services. The airlines provide fixed-fee flights operated under their codeshare partners brands: American Eagle, Delta Connection, and United Express. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Carmel, IN.
info.description_zh: 共和航空控股公司是一家提供客運航空服務的控股公司。這些航空公司提供以其代碼共享合作夥伴品牌營運的固定費用航班：American Eagle、Delta Connection 和 United Express。該公司成立於 1974 年，總部位於印第安納州卡梅爾。

info.description: Pathward Financial, Inc. is a financial holding company, which provides savings and loan services. The firm operates through the following business segments: Consumer, Commercial, and Corporate Services/Other. The Consumer segment collaborates with partners to navigate payment and lending needs. The Commercial segment refers to the commercial finance business line, which helps businesses access funds they need to launch, operate, and grow. The Corporate Services/Other segment consists of certain shared services, treasury, retained community bank portfolio, and student loan lending.
