The company was founded on June 14, 1993 and is headquartered in Sioux Falls, SD.
info.description_zh: Pathward Financial, Inc.是一家提供儲蓄和貸款服務的金融控股公司。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：消費者、商業和企業服務/其他。消費者部門與合作夥伴合作以滿足支付和貸款需求。商業部門是指商業金融業務線，幫助企業獲得啟動、營運和發展所需的資金。企業服務/其他部門包括某些共享服務、財務、保留的社區銀行投資組合和學生貸款。該公司成立於 1993 年 6 月 14 日，總部位於南達科他州蘇福爾斯。

info.description: NioCorp Developments Ltd. engages in the evaluation, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral deposits. It focuses on a super alloy materials project in Nebraska for producing niobium, scandium, and titanium. The company was founded on February 27, 1987, and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: NioCorp Developments Ltd. 從事礦藏的評估、收購、勘探和開發。它專注於內布拉斯加州的一個生產鈮、鈧和鈦的超級合金材料項目。該公司成立於1987年2月27日，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bluestar 5G Communications Index (the index). The fund uses a passive management approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a tiered, modified market capitalization-weighted portfolio of the U.S.-listed equity securities, including depositary receipts, of companies whose products or services are predominantly tied to the development of 5G networking and communication technologies.
info.description_zh: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF 旨在追蹤藍星 5G 通訊指數（簡稱「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用被動管理方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由在美國上市的股票證券（包括其產品或服務主要與 5G 網路和通訊技術的發展相關的公司的存託憑證）的分級、修改後的市值加權投資組合組成。

info.description: Ambarella, Inc. engages in the development of low-power system-on-a-chip (SoC), semiconductors, and software for edge artificial intelligence (AI) applications and intelligent automation. The firm's products include video security, advanced driver assistance (ADAS), electronic mirror, drive recorder, driver or cabin monitoring, autonomous driving, and other robotics applications. It operates through the following geographical segments: Taiwan, Asia Pacific, Europe, North America, and United States. The company was founded by Feng Ming Wang and Leslie D. Kohn on January 15, 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Ambarella, Inc. 致力於開發用於邊緣人工智慧 (AI) 應用和智慧自動化的低功耗系統單晶片 (SoC)、半導體和軟體。該公司的產品包括視訊安全、高級駕駛輔助 (ADAS)、電子鏡、行車記錄器、駕駛員或駕駛室監控、自動駕駛和其他機器人應用。它透過以下地理區域運作：台灣、亞太地區、歐洲、北美和美國。該公司由 Feng Ming Wang 和 Leslie D. Kohn 於 2004 年 1 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Kimball Electronics, Inc. engages in the provision of contract manufacturing services including engineering and supply chain support for the production of electronic assemblies and other products including medical devices, medical disposables, precision molded plastics, and automation, test, and inspection equipment primarily in automotive, medical, and industrial applications. It operates through the following business units: the United States, China, Mexico, Poland, Romania, Thailand, and GES. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Jasper, IN.
info.description_zh: Kimball Electronics, Inc. 從事提供合約製造服務，包括為電子組件和其他產品（包括主要用於汽車、醫療和工業應用的醫療設備、醫療一次性用品、精密模製塑膠以及自動化、測試和檢查設備）的生產提供工程和供應鏈支援。它透過以下業務部門運作：美國、中國、墨西哥、波蘭、羅馬尼亞、泰國和 GES。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於印第安納州賈斯珀。

info.description: Hycroft Mining Holding Corp. engages in the exploration, mining, and development of gold and silver properties. The company was founded on August 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Winnemucca, NV.
info.description_zh: Hycroft Mining Holding Corp. 從事金銀礦產的勘探、開採和開發。該公司成立於2017年8月28日，總部位於內華達州溫尼馬卡。

info.description: MakeMyTrip Ltd. engages in the provision of travel services. It offers air ticketing, hotels and packages, rail tickets, bus tickets, car hire, experiences and ancillary travel requirements such as foreign currency exchange services, visa processing, facilitating access to travel, and other insurance products. The company was founded by Deep Kalra and Rajesh Magow on April 28, 2000 and is headquartered in Gurgaon, India.
info.description_zh: MakeMyTrip Ltd. 從事提供旅遊服務。它提供機票、飯店和套餐、火車票、汽車票、汽車租賃、體驗和輔助旅行需求，如外幣兌換服務、簽證辦理、便利旅行和其他保險產品。該公司由 Deep Kalra 和 Rajesh Magow 於 2000 年 4 月 28 日創立，總部位於印度古爾岡。

info.description: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. engages in the acquisition, ownership, and lease of parking facilities and related infrastructure, including parking lots, parking garages, and other parking structures. The company was founded on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. 從事停車設施及相關基礎設施的收購、所有權和租賃業務，包括停車場、停車庫和其他停車設施。該公司成立於2015年5月4日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Utilities & Communication Services ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Utilities & Communication Services Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the utilities and communication services sectors, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap 公用事業和通訊服務 ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped 公用事業和通訊服務指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的公用事業和通信服務行業小型美國公司的證券表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The index uses a rules-based methodology that seeks to provide exposure to large-capitalization U.S. companies with above average free cash flow margins. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of large-capitalization companies ("large cap") that are principally traded in the United States. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在為自由現金流利潤率高於平均水平的大型美國公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於主要在美國交易的大型公司（「大盤股」）的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Golden Sun Technology Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of tutorial services. It focuses on the development of each of students' strengths and potential, and the promotion of life-long skills and interests in learning. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 金太陽科技集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供輔導服務。它著重發展每個學生的優勢和潛力，並促進終身技能和學習興趣。公司成立於1997年，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ORCL ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ORCL ETF 尋求甲骨文公司（NYSE：ORCL）每日股價變動百分比兩倍（200%）的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily ORCL Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of ORCL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of ORCL and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to ORCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ORCL Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ORCL 每日業績的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 ORCL 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些組合起來為 ORCL 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Perella Weinberg Partners operates as an advisory firm, which engages in the provision of strategic and financial advisory services. It serves the large public multinational corporations, mid-sized public and private companies, individual entrepreneurs, private and institutional investors, creditor committees, and government institutions. The company was founded in June 2006 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Perella Weinberg Partners 作為一家顧問公司經營，提供策略和財務諮詢服務。它為大型上市跨國公司、中型上市和私人公司、個人企業家、私人和機構投資者、債權人委員會和政府機構提供服務。該公司成立於2006年6月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: First Capital, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and business banking services. Its loan portfolio includes residential real estate, land, construction, commercial real estate and business, home equity and second mortgage, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on September 11, 1998 and is headquartered in Corydon, IN.
info.description_zh: First Capital, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業和商業銀行服務。其貸款組合包括住宅房地產、土地、建築、商業房地產和企業、房屋淨值和第二抵押貸款以及其他消費貸款。該公司成立於1998年9月11日，總部位於印第安納州科里登。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cybersecurity seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity IndexSM. The index is a modified liquidity weighted index comprised of companies classified as "cybersecurity" companies by CTA. The Advisor expects that its cash balances maintained in connection with the use of financial instruments will typically be held in money market instruments. It invests in common stock issued by public companies. The fund invests in derivatives, which are financial instruments whose value is derived from the value of an underlying asset or assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cyber​​security 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於納斯達克 CTA 網路安全指數 SM 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該指數是修改後的流動性加權指數，由 CTA 歸類為「網路安全」公司的公司組成。顧問預計其與使用金融工具相關的現金餘額通常以貨幣市場工具持有。它投資於上市公司發行的普通股。該基金投資於衍生性商品，這些衍生性商品是其價值源自標的資產或資產的價值的金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Red Violet, Inc. engages in the provision of software and proprietary technology services. It specializes in data and analysis sector, which provides cloud-based, mission-critical information solutions to enterprises in a variety of industries. Its brands include IDI and Forewarn. The company was founded in August 2017 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Red Violet, Inc. 從事提供軟體和專有技術服務。它專注於數據和分析領域，為各行業的企業提供基於雲端的關鍵任務資訊解決方案。其品牌包括IDI和Forewarn。該公司成立於 2017 年 8 月，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Global X Social Media ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Social Media Total Return Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts and Global Depositary Receipts based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index tracks the equity performance of the largest and most liquid companies involved in the social media industry, including companies that provide social networking, file sharing, and other web-based media applications. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 社群媒體 ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 社群媒體總回報指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證和全球存託憑證。該指數追蹤社交媒體行業規模最大、流動性最強的公司的股票表現，包括提供社交網路、文件共享和其他基於網路的媒體應用程式的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Franklin Resources, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of investment management and related services. The firm offers services and products under various distinct brand names, including, but not limited to, Franklin, Templeton, Legg Mason, Benefit Street Partners, Brandywine Global Investment Management, Clarion Partners, ClearBridge Investments, Fiduciary Trust Company International, Franklin Mutual Series, K2 Advisors, Lexington Partners, Putnam Investments, Alcentra, Royce Investment Partners and Western Asset Management Company. It provides investment management and related services to retail, institutional and high-net-worth investors in jurisdictions worldwide. The company was founded by Rupert H. Johnson, Sr. in 1947 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.
info.description_zh: Franklin Resources, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供投資管理及相關服務。該公司提供各種不同品牌的服務和產品，包括但不限於 Franklin、Templeton、Legg Mason、Benefit Street Partners、Brandywine Global Investment Management、Clarion Partners、ClearBridge Investments、Fiduciary Trust Company International、Franklin Mutual Series、K2 Advisors、Lexington Partners、Putnam Investments Management、Alcentra、Royce Partners 和 Western Company。它為全球司法管轄區的零售、機構和高淨值投資者提供投資管理及相關服務。該公司由 Rupert H. Johnson, Sr. 於 1947 年創立，總部位於加州聖馬刁。

info.description: Tevogen, Inc. is a clinical-stage specialty immunotherapy company, which engages in the provision of off-the-shelf therapies for the treatment of infectious diseases, cancers, and neurological disorders. It focuses on its product, ExacTcell, a technology that treats acute viral infections, long-term consequences of viral infections, and viral and non-viral induced cancers. The company was founded in April 2021 and is headquartered in Warren, NJ.
info.description_zh: Tevogen, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的專業免疫治療公司，致力於提供用於治療傳染病、癌症和神經系統疾病的現成療法。它專注於其產品 ExacTcell，這是一種治療急性病毒感染、病毒感染的長期後果以及病毒和非病毒誘發的癌症的技術。該公司成立於 2021 年 4 月，總部位於新澤西州沃倫。

info.description: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of Gastrointestinal (GI) products. It operates through the Human Therapeutics segment. The company was founded on January 5, 1998 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物技術公司，從事胃腸道 (GI) 產品的開發和商業化。它透過人類治療部門運作。該公司成立於1998年1月5日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long CRWD Daily ETF seeks daily inverse investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: CRWD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2x (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long CRWD Daily ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果為 CrowdStrike Holdings Inc（納斯達克股票代碼：CRWD）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, franchising, licensing, and operation of quick-service restaurants under the name El Pollo Loco. It specializes in fire-grilling fresh citrus-marinated chicken with a variety of offerings including Chicken Avocado Burrito, Pollo Fit entrees, chicken tostada salads, and Pollo Bowls. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. 從事 El Pollo Loco 名稱下快餐店的開發、特許經營、許可和營運業務。它專門提供火烤新鮮柑橘醃製雞肉，提供各種菜餚，包括雞肉酪梨捲餅、Pollo Fit 主菜、雞肉托斯塔達沙拉和 Pollo Bowls。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: Geron Corp. operates as a biotechnology company. It develops a telomerase inhibitor, Imetelstat, in hematologic myeloid malignancies. The firm develops therapeutic products for oncology. The company was founded by Michael D. West on November 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Geron Corp. 作为一家生物技术公司运营。它開發了一種用於治療血液骨髓惡性腫瘤的端粒酶抑制劑 Imetelstat。該公司開發腫瘤治療產品。該公司由 Michael D. West 於 1990 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特市。

info.description: AirSculpt Technologies, Inc. is a fat removal treatment under its brand, Elite Body Sculpture.. It provides custom body contouring using proprietary AirSculpt method that removes unwanted fat in a minimally invasive procedure, producing dramatic results. The company was founded by Aaron J. Rollins in 2012 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: AirSculpt Technologies, Inc. 是其品牌 Elite Body Sculpture 下的脂肪去除療程。它使用專有的 AirSculpt 方法提供客製化身體輪廓，透過微創手術去除不需要的脂肪，產生顯著的效果。該公司由 Aaron J. Rollins 於 2012 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts ("Crypto Asset Futures ETFs"), (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts ("crypto asset futures"), and (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset ("Spot Crypto Asset ETPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 數位資產生態系統 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈產業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約（「加密資產期貨ETF」）的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨交易（iv幣貨幣參考資產（「現貨加密資產 ETP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Apollo Global Management, Inc. provides asset management services. It offers its clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade to private equity with a focus on three business strategies: yield, hybrid, and equity. It operates through following segments: Asset Management, Retirement Services and Principal Investing. The Asset Management segment focuses on credit and equity investing strategies. The Retirement Services and Principal Investing segment consists of realized performance fee income, realized investment income from balance sheet investments, and certain allocable expenses related to corporate functions supporting the entire company. The company was founded by Marc Rowan in 1990 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Apollo Global Management, Inc. 提供資產管理服務。它為客戶提供從投資等級到私募股權的風險回報範圍內每個點的超額回報，重點關註三種業務策略：收益、混合和股權。它透過以下部門運作：資產管理部門、退休服務部門和本金投資部門。資產管理部門專注於信貸和股權投資策略。退休服務和本金投資部門包括已實現的績效費收入、資產負債表投資的已實現投資收入以及與支持整個公司的公司職能相關的某些可分配費用。該公司由 Marc Rowan 於 1990 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Xtrackers US Green Infrastructure Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive United States Green Infrastructure ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business exposure in the production, generation, or distribution of green energy or are engaged in the establishment of a sustainable infrastructure to enable the use of renewable energy and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers 美國綠色基礎設施精選股票 ETF 尋求與 Solactive 美國綠色基礎設施 ESG 篩選指數 (未計費用和開支) 的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數化投資方法，尋求與相關指數（扣除費用和開支前的表現）大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在綠色能源的生產、發電或分銷領域有業務的公司或從事建立可持續基礎設施以實現可再生能源使用並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long VALE Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Vale S.A. (VALE). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying global leader in iron ore and nickel production.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long VALE Daily ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，目標為 Vale S.A. (VALE) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是成熟交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大每日對鐵礦石和鎳生產的全球領導者的曝險。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the information technology sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的信息技術領域美國小型公司的證券表現。

info.description: Alphabet, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in software, health care, transportation, and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets. The Google Services segment includes products and services, such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. The Google Cloud segment refers to infrastructure and platform services, collaboration tools, and other services for enterprise customers. The Other Bets segment relates to the sale of healthcare-related services and internet services. The company was founded by Lawrence E. Page and Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin on October 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Alphabet, Inc. 是一家控股公司，業務涉及軟體、醫療保健、運輸和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：Google服務、Google雲端和其他賭注。 Google 服務部分包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Google 地圖、Google Play、搜尋和 YouTube 等產品和服務。 Google Cloud 部門是指為企業客戶提供基礎設施和平台服務、協作工具以及其他服務。其他投注部門涉及醫療保健相關服務和網路服務的銷售。該公司由 Lawrence E. Page 和 Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin 於 2015 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: FormFactor, Inc. engages in the provision of test and measurement solutions. It operates through the Probe Cards and Systems segments. The Probe Cards segment consists of technologies and product architectures, including micro-electromechanical systems technologies. The Systems segment consists of analytical probe solutions for on-wafer probing, board tests, and package tests. The company was founded by Igor Khandros on April 15, 1993 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: FormFactor, Inc. 致力於提供測試和測量解決方案。它透過探針卡和系統部門運作。探針卡部分由技術和產品架構組成，包括微機電系統技術。系統部門包括用於晶圓探測、電路板測試和封裝測試的分析探針解決方案。該公司由 Igor Khandros 於 1993 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: Alphabet, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in software, health care, transportation, and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets. The Google Services segment includes products and services, such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. The Google Cloud segment refers to infrastructure and platform services, collaboration tools, and other services for enterprise customers. The Other Bets segment relates to the sale of healthcare-related services and internet services. The company was founded by Lawrence E. Page and Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin on October 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Alphabet, Inc. 是一家控股公司，業務涉及軟體、醫療保健、運輸和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：Google服務、Google雲端和其他賭注。 Google 服務部分包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Google 地圖、Google Play、搜尋和 YouTube 等產品和服務。 Google Cloud 部門是指為企業客戶提供基礎設施和平台服務、協作工具以及其他服務。其他投注部門涉及醫療保健相關服務和網路服務的銷售。該公司由 Lawrence E. Page 和 Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin 於 2015 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Pro-Dex, Inc. engages in the design, development and manufacture of rotary drive surgical and dental instruments. The firm specializes in medical devices and services, industrial and scientific, dental and component, repairs and other. Its products include finished medical devices, micro air-motors, dental products, plastic injection molding and torque wrenches. The company was founded on January 26, 1994 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Pro-Dex, Inc. 從事旋轉驅動手術和牙科器械的設計、開發和製造。該公司專注於醫療設備和服務、工業和科學、牙科和零件、維修等。其產品包括成品醫療器材、微型氣動馬達、牙科產品、塑膠射出成型和扭力扳手。該公司成立於1994年1月26日，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Defiance Retail Kings ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in U.S.-listed companies demonstrating high retail investor sentiment and digital engagement. The fund utilizes a proprietary model to identify "Retail Kings"-companies that are favorites or trending leaders in online investor communities-while further vetting them for fundamental resilience and competitive moats.
info.description_zh: Defiance Retail Kings ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資表現出高散戶投資者情緒和數位參與度的美國上市公司來實現長期資本增值。該基金利用專有模型來識別「零售之王」——線上投資者社群中最受歡迎或趨勢領先的公司——同時進一步審查它們的基本彈性和競爭護城河。

info.description: Strata Critical Medical, Inc. is a time-critical logistics and medical services provider to the United States healthcare industry. It operates through the following segments: Logistics and Clinical. The Logistics segment includes Organ Placement, Air, and Ground Logistics. The Clinical segment focuses on Organ Recovery, Normothermic Regional Perfusion, Preservation, and Cardiac Care. The company was founded by Robert S. Wiesenthal and Steven Martocci on December 22, 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Strata Critical Medical, Inc. 是美國醫療保健產業時間緊迫的物流和醫療服務提供者。它透過以下部門運作：物流和臨床。物流部門包括器官放置、空中和地面物流。臨床部分重點在於器官恢復、常溫區域灌注、保存和心臟護理。該公司由 Robert S. Wiesenthal 和 Steven Martocci 於 2014 年 12 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Lightwave Logic, Inc. is a development stage company which engages in the commercialization of electro-optic photonic devices. The firm offers the P2ICTM technology platform which uses in-house proprietary organic polymers. Its products include electro-optical modulation devices and proprietary polymer photonic integrated circuits. The company was founded on June 24, 1997 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Lightwave Logic, Inc.是一家處於開發階段的公司，致力於電光光子元件的商業化。該公司提供 P2ICTM 技術平台，該平台使用內部專有的有機聚合物。其產品包括電光調製元件和專有的聚合物光子積體電路。該公司成立於1997年6月24日，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: Ouster, Inc. engages in the provision of high resolution digital lidar sensors that offer advanced 3D vision to machinery, vehicles, robots, and fixed infrastructure assets. The company was founded by Angus Pacala and Mark Frichtl on June 30, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Ouster, Inc. 致力於提供高解析度數位光達感測器，為機械、車輛、機器人和固定基礎設施資產提供先進的 3D 視覺。該公司由 Angus Pacala 和 Mark Frichtl 於 2015 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Fox Factory Holding Corp. engages in designing, engineering, manufacturing and marketing performance ride dynamics products. The firm offers bicycles, side-by-sides and on-road vehicles with off-road capabilities, off-road vehicles and trucks, all - terrain vehicles, snowmobiles, specialty vehicles and applications and motorcycles. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Asia, Europe and Rest of the World. The company was founded on December 28, 2007 and is headquartered in Duluth, GA.
info.description_zh: Fox Factory Holding Corp. 從事設計、工程、製造和行銷高性能駕駛動力產品。該公司提供自行車、並排式和具有越野功能的公路車、越野車和卡車、全地形車、雪地車、特殊車輛和應用以及摩托車。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、亞洲、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司成立於2007年12月28日，總部位於喬治亞州德盧斯。

info.description: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel therapies for cancer. It also offers cancer treatments with surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy. The company was founded by Anatoly Dritschilo, Mira Jung, and Milton Brown on December 18, 2012 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於開發癌症新療法。它還提供手術、放射治療、化療和免疫治療等癌症治療方法。該公司由 Anatoly Dritschilo、Mira Jung 和 Milton Brown 於 2012 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: Zillow Group, Inc. engages in the provision of real estate and home-related information marketplaces on mobile and the web. The company was founded by Richard N. Barton and Lloyd D. Frink in December 2004 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Zillow Group, Inc. 致力於在行動和網路上提供房地產和家居相關資訊市場。該公司由 Richard N. Barton 和 Lloyd D. Frink 於 2004 年 12 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: ViaSat, Inc. engages in providing communications technologies and services. It operates through the Communication Services and Defense and Advanced Technologies business segments. The Communication Services business segment provides a wide range of broadband and narrowband communications solutions across government and commercial mobility markets. The Defense and Advanced Technologies business segment develops and offers a diverse array of resilient, vertically integrated solutions to government and commercial customers, leveraging the company's technical competencies in encryption, cyber security, tactical gateways, modems, and waveforms. The company was founded by Mark D. Dankberg and Mark J. Miller on May 1, 1986 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: ViaSat, Inc. 從事提供通訊技術和服務。它透過通訊服務以及國防和先進技術業務部門運作。通訊服務業務部門為政府和商業行動市場提供廣泛的寬頻和窄頻通訊解決方案。國防和先進技術業務部門利用公司在加密、網路安全、戰術網關、數據機和波形方面的技術能力，為政府和商業客戶開發並提供各種彈性、垂直整合的解決方案。該公司由 Mark D. Dankberg 和 Mark J. Miller 於 1986 年 5 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Crocs, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, worldwide marketing, sale, and distribution of lifestyle footwear and accessories. It operates through the Crocs Brand and HEYDUDE Brand segments. The Crocs Brand segment refers to the United States, South Korea, China, Japan, Singapore, Canada, Germany, Great Britain, France, Malaysia, Australia, Puerto Rico, the Netherlands, Australia, India, and Ireland. The HEYDUDE Brand segment focuses on the United States. The company was founded by Scott Seamans, George B. Boedecker, Jr., and Lyndon V. Hanson III in 2002 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Crocs, Inc. 從事時尚鞋類和配件的設計、開發、製造、全球行銷、銷售和分銷。它透過 Crocs 品牌和 HEYDUDE 品牌部門運作。 Crocs 品牌細分市場涉及美國、韓國、中國、日本、新加坡、加拿大、德國、英國、法國、馬來西亞、澳洲、波多黎各、荷蘭、澳洲、印度和愛爾蘭。 HEYDUDE 品牌細分市場專注於美國。該公司由 Scott Seamans、George B. Boedecker, Jr. 和 Lyndon V. Hanson III 於 2002 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. engages in the provision of power electronics conversion products. Its products include AC-DC power supply units, DC-DC conversion, high voltage amplifiers and power supplies, plasma power, controllers, sense, and measurement. The company was founded by Douglas S. Schatz in 1981 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. 從事提供電力電子轉換產品。其產品包括AC-DC電源裝置、DC-DC轉換、高壓放大器和電源、等離子電源、控制器、感測和測量。該公司由 Douglas S. Schatz 於 1981 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: XPEL, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of automotive products. It offers paint protection, automotive, flat glass window films, and plotters. The company was founded on October 14, 2003 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: XPEL, Inc. 從事汽車產品的製造和分銷。它提供油漆保護、汽車、平板玻璃窗膜和繪圖儀。該公司成立於2003年10月14日，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: Happen, Inc. is a U.S. digital marketplace bank focused on the Motivated Middle high FICO, high-income borrowers actively managing their financial lives. The firm's success is fueled by advanced credit underwriting, a proprietary technology platform, and a marketplace bank model that generates compelling revenue through loan sales, net interest income, and fee-based services. It operates through the LendingClub Bank and LendingClub Corporation (Parent Only) segments. The LendingClub Bank segment is involved in the provision of a full complement of financial products and solutions, loans, leases, and deposits. The LendingClub Corporation (Parent Only) segment includes the holding company legal entity. The company was founded by Renaud Laplanche and Soulaiman Htite on October 2, 2006 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Happen, Inc. 是一家美國數位市場銀行，專注於積極管理其財務生活的中高 FICO、高收入借款人。該公司的成功得益於先進的信貸承銷、專有技術平台和市場銀行模式，該模式透過貸款銷售、淨利息收入和收費服務產生可觀的收入。它透過 LendingClub Bank 和 LendingClub Corporation（僅限家長）部門運作。 LendingClub Bank 部門提供全套金融產品和解決方案、貸款、租賃和存款。 LendingClub Corporation（限家長）部門包含控股公司法人實體。該公司由 Renaud Laplanche 和 Soulaiman Htite 於 2006 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of optical communications products. Its products include optical devices, such as laser diodes, photodiodes, related modules and circuitry, and equipment for applications in fiber-to-the-home, cable television, point to point communications, and wireless. The company was founded by Chih Hsiang Lin on February 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Sugar Land, TX.
info.description_zh: Applied Opto electronics, Inc.從事光通訊產品的設計與製造。其產品包括光學元件，如雷射二極體、光電二極體、相關模組和電路，以及光纖到府、有線電視、點對點通訊和無線應用的設備。該公司由 Chih Hsiang Lin 於 1997 年 2 月 28 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州 Sugar Land。

info.description: Zillow Group, Inc. engages in the provision of real estate and home-related information marketplaces on mobile and the web. The company was founded by Richard N. Barton and Lloyd D. Frink in December 2004 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Zillow Group, Inc. 致力於在行動和網路上提供房地產和家居相關資訊市場。該公司由 Richard N. Barton 和 Lloyd D. Frink 於 2004 年 12 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Aurora Innovation, Inc. engages in the design and development of automobile hardware, software, and provision of data services. It offers the Aurora Driver which allows a vehicle to drive itself. The company was founded by Christopher Urmson, Sterling Anderson and James Andrew Bagnell in 2017 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Aurora Innovation, Inc.從事汽車硬體、軟體的設計和開發以及提供數據服務。它提供了 Aurora Driver，允許車輛自動駕駛。該公司由 Christopher Urmson、Sterling Anderson 和 James Andrew Bagnell 於 2017 年創立，總部位於賓州匹茲堡。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable MARA ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks current income by investing at least 80% of its net assets in derivative contracts utilizing autocallable instruments that reference the common stock of MARA Holdings, Inc. The strategy aims to deliver monthly distributions while managing cash balances through U.S. government securities, money market funds, short-term bond ETFs, investment-grade corporate debt, repurchase agreements, or national exchange-listed U.S. large-cap equities.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable MARA ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於利用可自動贖回工具（參考 MARA Holdings, Inc. 普通股）的衍生性商品合約來尋求當期收入。該策略旨在透過美國政府證券、貨幣市場基金、短期債券 ETF、投資等級公司債務、回購協議或在國家交易所上市的美國大盤股管理現金餘額，同時提供每月分配股票。

info.description: KraneShares 2x Long BIDU Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the ADR of Baidu Inc. (NASDAQ: BIDU). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Stock and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide investment exposure to 2 times (200%) the performance of the Underlying Stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 金瑞股份 2 倍多頭 BIDU 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為百度公司（納斯達克股票代碼：BIDU）每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的股票和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些金融工具組合起來提供的投資風險是標的股票表現的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AAL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AAL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AAL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AAL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 AAL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 AAL 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dorman Products, Inc. engages in the supply of automotive replacement and upgrade parts for the motor vehicle aftermarket industry. Its products include automotive body, steering and suspension, undercar, underhood, hardware and accessories, and heavy-duty components. The company was founded by Steven L. Berman and Richard N. Berman on October 16, 1978 and is headquartered in Colmar, PA.
info.description_zh: Dorman Products, Inc. 致力於為機動車輛售後市場產業供應汽車更換和升級零件。其產品包括汽車車身、轉向和懸吊、車底、引擎蓋、硬體和配件以及重型零件。該公司由 Steven L. Berman 和 Richard N. Berman 於 1978 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州科爾馬。

info.description: Prelude Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in the development of novel precision cancer medicines. It also focuses on the design and development of small molecule agents for cancer medicines. The company was founded by Krishna Vaddi in 2016 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Prelude Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段腫瘤公司，致力於開發新型精準癌症藥物。它還專注於癌症藥物小分子藥物的設計和開發。該公司由 Krishna Vaddi 於 2016 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and provision of products and services for the renewable energy, residential, and infrastructure markets. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Infrastructure, and Agtech. The Residential segment includes roof and foundation ventilation products, rain dispersion products and roofing accessories, centralized mail systems, and electronic package solutions. The Infrastructure segment provides engineered solutions for bridges, highways, and airfields including structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, and bridge cable protection systems. The Agtech segment offers growing and processing solutions including designing, engineering, manufacturing, full scope construction, and maintenance and support of greenhouses, indoor growing operations, and botanical extraction systems. The company was founded on September 1, 1972 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. 從事為再生能源、住宅和基礎設施市場製造和提供產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、基礎設施部門和農業科技部門。住宅部門包括屋頂和地基通風產品、雨水分散產品和屋頂配件、集中式郵件系統和電子成套解決方案。基礎設施部門為橋樑、高速公路和機場提供工程解決方案，包括結構軸承、伸縮縫、路面密封、彈性混凝土和橋樑電纜保護系統。農業科技部門提供種植和加工解決方案，包括溫室、室內種植作業和植物提取系統的設計、工程、製造、全方位建設以及維護和支援。該公司成立於1972年9月1日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: People, Inc. engages in the media and Internet business. It operates through the following segments: Dotdash Meredith, Angi Inc, Search, and Emerging and Other. The Dotdash Meredith segment provides digital and print publishing services from mobile to magazines. The ANGI Homeservices segment offers repairing, remodeling, cleaning, and landscaping through category-transforming products under HomeAdvisor, Angie's List, Handy, and Fixd Repair brands. The Search segment consists of Ask Media Group, which provides general search services and information. The Emerging and Other segment includes platforms Care.com, Bluecrew, NurseFly Mosaic Group, Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, IAC Films, and Newco. The company was founded on August 24, 1995, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: People, Inc. 從事媒體和網路業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：Dotdash Meredith、Angi Inc、Search、Emerging and Other。 Dotdash Meredith 部門提供從手機到雜誌的數位和印刷出版服務。 ANGI Homeservices 部門透過 HomeAdvisor、Angie's List、Handy 和 Fixd Repair 品牌下的類別轉型產品提供維修、改造、清潔和景觀美化服務。搜尋部門由 Ask Media Group 組成，該集團提供一般搜尋服務和資訊。新興和其他部門包括 Care.com、Bluecrew、NurseFly Mosaic Group、Vivian Health、The Daily Beast、IAC Films 和 Newco 等平台。該公司成立於1995年8月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Jiayin Group, Inc. engages in the operation of an online individual finance marketplace in China, which connects individual investors and individual borrowers. The company was founded by Dinggui Yan in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 嘉銀集團在中國從事線上個人金融市場的運營，該市場連接個人投資者和個人借款人。該公司由嚴鼎貴於2011年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Alvotech is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and manufacture of biosimilar medicines. The firm is focusing on the development of its product candidates. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, North America, Asia, and Other. The company was founded by Robert Vilhelm Wessman in 2013 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Alvotech是一家生技公司，從事生物相似藥的開發和製造。該公司正專注於候選產品的開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：歐洲、北美、亞洲和其他地區。該公司由 Robert Vilhelm Wessman 於 2013 年創立，總部位於盧森堡。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long GOOGL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Alphabet Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: GOOGL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. At the end of each trading day, the notional exposure against the Underlying Stock obtained through the combination of these instruments will be approximately 200% of the fund's net asset value.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long GOOGL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Alphabet Inc. A 類普通股（納斯達克股票代碼：GOOGL）每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過基礎股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。在每個交易日結束時，透過這些工具組合獲得的標的股票的名義曝險將約為基金資產淨值的200%。

info.description: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of GOOGL. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to 150% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 GOOGL 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 GOOGL 每日業績的 150%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報相當於該基金淨資產價值的 150%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Tucows, Inc. is an Internet services company. The firm engages in the provision of domain names, email, and other internet services. It operates through the following segments: Ting, Wavelo, and Tucows Domains. The Ting segment its wholly owned subsidiaries, Cedar and Simply Bits includes the provision of high-speed Internet access services to select towns throughout the United States, with further expansion underway to both new and existing markets. The Wavelo segment includes the provision of full-service platforms and professional services providing a variety of solutions that support Communication Services providers (CSPs), including subscription and billing management, network orchestration and provisioning, and individual developer tools. The Tucows Domains segment includes wholesale and retail domain name registration services, as well as value added services derived through OpenSRS, eNom, Ascio, EPAG and Hover brands. The company was founded in November 1992 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Tucows, Inc. 是一家網路服務公司。該公司從事提供網域名稱、電子郵件和其他網路服務。它透過以下部門運作：Ting、Wavelo 和 Tucows Domains。 Ting 部門的全資子公司 Cedar 和 Simply Bits 包括向美國部分城鎮提供高速網路存取服務，並進一步向新市場和現有市場擴張。 Wavelo 部門包括提供全方位服務平台和專業服務，提供支援通訊服務供應商 (CSP) 的各種解決方案，包括訂閱和計費管理、網路編排和配置以及個人開發人員工具。 Tucows Domains 部門包括批發和零售網域註冊服務，以及透過 OpenSRS、eNom、Ascio、EPAG 和 Hover 品牌衍生的加值服務。該公司成立於1992年11月，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Adeia, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the invention, development, and licensing of innovations and technologies for entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Asia, Canada, Europe and Middle East, and Other. The company was founded on October 1, 2022 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.industry_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
info.description_zh: Adeia, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於娛樂、媒體、消費性電子和半導體產業的創新和技術的發明、開發和授權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和中東等。該公司成立於2022年10月1日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Accuray, Inc. is a radiation therapy company, which engages in manufacturing medical equipment. It develops, manufactures, sells, and supports medical solutions. The company was founded by John R. Adler in 1990 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.description_zh: Accuray, Inc.是一家放射治療公司，從事醫療設備製造。它開發、製造、銷售和支援醫療解決方案。該公司由 John R. Adler 於 1990 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: Shengfeng Development Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of contract logistics services. It also focuses on B2B freight transportation, cloud storage, and value-added services. The company was founded by Yong Xu Liu in 2001 and is headquartered in Fuzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 盛豐發展有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供合約物流服務。它還專注於B2B貨運、雲端儲存和增值服務。該公司由劉永旭於2001年創立，總部位於中國福州。

info.description: D-Wave Quantum, Inc. engages in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It provides customers with access to the company's quantum computing systems via the cloud in the form of quantum computing as a service. It offers professional services such as customer assistance in identifying and implementing quantum-computing applications. The company was founded on January 25, 2022 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: D-Wave Quantum, Inc. 從事量子計算系統、軟體和服務的開發和交付。它以量子運算即服務的形式為客戶提供透過雲端存取公司量子運算系統的能力。它提供專業服務，例如幫助客戶識別和實施量子運算應用程式。該公司成立於2022年1月25日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Scienjoy Holding Corp. provides mobile entertainment live streaming platforms in China. The firm operates its platforms on both PC and mobile apps, through which users can enjoy immersive and interactive entertainment live streaming. Its different platforms include broadcaster policy, events, promotion and games. The firm also provides technological infrastructure to enable broadcasters, online users, and viewers to interact with each other during live streaming. The company was founded by Xiao Wu He, Pei Lu & Bo Wan in October 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Scienjoy Holding Corp. 在中國提供行動娛樂直播平台。該公司在PC和行動應用程式上經營其平台，用戶可以透過這些平台享受身臨其境的互動娛樂直播。其不同平台包括廣播公司政策、活動、促銷和遊戲。該公司還提供技術基礎設施，使廣播公司、線上用戶和觀眾能夠在直播過程中相互互動。該公司由何曉武、盧培和萬博於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Reborn Coffee, Inc. engages in the franchise of retail locations and kiosks of coffee, water, and other beverages. The company was founded by Jay Kim on July 31, 2015 and is headquartered in Brea, CA.
info.description_zh: Reborn Coffee, Inc. 從事咖啡、水和其他飲料零售店和售貨亭的特許經營業務。該公司由 Jay Kim 於 2015 年 7 月 31 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州布雷亞。

info.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. engages in the business of developing and operating restaurants that serve a relevant menu of burritos, burrito bowls, quesadillas, tacos, and salads made using fresh, high-quality ingredients. The company was founded by Steve Ells in 1993 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. 從事開發和經營餐廳業務，這些餐廳提供墨西哥捲餅、墨西哥捲餅碗、墨西哥玉米餅、炸玉米餅和沙拉等相關菜單，均採用新鮮優質原料製成。該公司由 Steve Ells 於 1993 年創立，總部位於加州紐波特海灘。

info.description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of conducted electrical weapons for personal defense. It operates through the TASER segment and Software and Sensors segment. The TASER segment sells conducted electrical weapons, accessories, and other related products and services. The Software and Sensors segment includes devices, wearables, applications, cloud, and mobile products. The company was founded by Patrick W. Smith and Thomas P. Smith on September 7, 1993 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Axon Enterprise, Inc. 從事個人防禦傳導電子武器的開發、製造和銷售。它透過 TASER 部門以及軟體和感測器部門運作。泰瑟槍部門銷售傳導電子武器、配件以及其他相關產品和服務。軟體和感測器部分包括設備、穿戴式裝置、應用程式、雲端和行動產品。該公司由 Patrick W. Smith 和 Thomas P. Smith 於 1993 年 9 月 7 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRWV Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of CRWV. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRWV, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRWV 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CRWV 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 CRWV 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Symbotic, Inc. is an automation technology company, which engages in a robotics and automation-based product movement technology platform. It focuses on developing, commercializing, and deploying innovative, end-to-end technology solutions for supply chain operations. It operates through the United States and Canada geographical segments. The company was founded by Richard B. Cohen on December 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Symbotic, Inc.是一家自動化技術公司，從事機器人和基於自動化的產品移動技術平台。它專注於為供應鏈營運開發、商業化和部署創新的端到端技術解決方案。它透過美國和加拿大的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Richard B. Cohen 於 2020 年 12 月 11 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: FST Corp. engages in the manufactures and sells golf club shafts, along with other golf-related items, to golf equipment brands, OEMs, distributors, and consumers via the KBS Golf Experience retail outlets. The firm equipment, marketed under the KBS brand, is utilized by golfers at all levels, including many professional players participating in the PGA and other major golf associations. Its product portfolio, retail presence, and golf-related services are part of a vertically integrated business model that has established the KBS brand on a global scale and created significant competitive advantages over peer brands. The growth strategies currently position it for expansion into under-tapped golf shaft markets. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Chiayi, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: FST Corp. 致力於製造高爾夫球桿桿身以及其他高爾夫相關產品，並透過 KBS Golf Experience 零售店向高爾夫裝備品牌、原始設備製造商、分銷商和消費者銷售。該公司的設備以 KBS 品牌銷售，供各個級別的高爾夫球手使用，其中包括許多參加 PGA 和其他主要高爾夫協會的職業球員。其產品組合、零售業務和高爾夫相關服務是垂直整合業務模式的一部分，該模式在全球範圍內建立了 KBS 品牌，並與同行品牌相比具有顯著的競爭優勢。目前的成長策略使其能夠擴展到尚未開發的高爾夫球桿市場。公司成立於1989年，總部位於台灣嘉義。

info.description: Vivid Seats, Inc. operates as an online ticket marketplace, which engages in the provision of different selections of events and tickets in North America. It operates through the following segments: Marketplace and Resale. The Marketplace segment acts as an intermediary between event ticket buyers and ticket sellers. The Resale segment acquires tickets to resell on secondary ticket marketplaces, including its own. Its partners include Caesars Entertainment, RollingStone, Marriott Bonvoy, Capital One, American Airlines and others. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Vivid Seats, Inc. 是一家線上門票市場，致力於在北美提供不同的活動和門票選擇。它透過以下部門運作：市場和轉售。市場部分充當活動門票買家和門票賣家之間的中介。轉售部門購買門票並在二級門票市場（包括自己的市場）上轉售。其合作夥伴包括凱撒娛樂、滾石、萬豪旅享家、第一資本、美國航空等。該公司成立於 2001 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: Tigo Energy, Inc. engages in the manufacturing and development of module level power electronics. Its solutions include TS4-X, EI Residential, Energy Intelligence, TS4-A, and EI Predict. The company was founded on February 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Tigo Energy, Inc.從事模組級電力電子產品的製造和開發。其解決方案包括 TS4-X、EI Residential、Energy Intelligence、TS4-A 和 EI Predict。該公司成立於2019年2月13日，總部位於加州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: Adial Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development of therapeutics for the treatment or prevention of addiction and related disorders. It offers the AD04, a selective serotonin-3 antagonist. The company was founded by Bankole A. Johnson and William B. Stilley, III in November 2010 and is headquartered in Glen Allen, VA.
info.description_zh: Adial Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 從事治療或預防成癮及相關疾病的療法的開發。它提供 AD04，一種選擇性 5-羥色胺-3 拮抗劑。該公司由 Bankole A. Johnson 和 William B. Stilley, III 於 2010 年 11 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州格倫艾倫。

info.description: Ensysce Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of solutions for severe pain relief while reducing the fear of and the potential for misuse and overdose. The firm's Trypsin Activated Abuse Protection and Multi-Pill Abuse Resistance platforms are in the process of developing a new class of powerful, tamper-proof opioids that prevent both drug abuse and overdoses. The company was founded in April 2003 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: Ensysce Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發緩解嚴重疼痛的解決方案，同時減少誤用和過量的恐懼和可能性。該公司的胰蛋白酶活化濫用保護和多藥丸濫用抵抗平台正在開發一種新型強效、防篡改鴉片類藥物，可防止藥物濫用和過量服用。該公司成立於 2003 年 4 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Pulmonx Corp. is a medical technology company, which engages in the provision of interventional pulmonology, planning tools and treatments for obstructive lung diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and Other International. The company was founded by Rodney Perkins on December 26, 1995 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Pulmonx Corp. 是一家醫療科技公司，致力於為阻塞性肺病提供介入性肺病學、規劃工具和治療。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、中東、非洲、亞太地區和其他國際市場。該公司由 Rodney Perkins 於 1995 年 12 月 26 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: MindForge, Inc. is a holding company, which focuses on providing value-added services using artificial intelligence-driven technology to businesses within the insurance industry, including insurance carriers, and brokers. The company was founded by Jian Chen and Ming Fei Liu in 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: MindForge, Inc. 是一家控股公司，專注於利用人工智慧驅動的技術向保險業內的企業（包括保險公司和經紀人）提供增值服務。該公司由陳健和劉明飛於2018年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Check-Cap Ltd. is a clinical stage medical diagnostics company, which engages in the development of ingestible imaging capsule systems for colorectal cancer screening. Its patented technology, C-Scan, is a patient-friendly preparation-free test designed to detect polyps before they may transform into cancer. The company was founded by Yoav Kimchy in 2005 and is headquartered in Isfiya, Israel.
info.description_zh: Check-Cap Ltd.是一家臨床階段醫療診斷公司，致力於開發用於結直腸癌篩檢的可攝入成像膠囊系統。其專利技術 C-Scan 是一種患者友好的免準備測試，旨在在息肉轉變為癌症之前檢測出息肉。該公司由 Yoav Kimchy 於 2005 年創立，總部位於以色列伊斯菲亞。

info.description: Autolus Therapeutics Plc is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of gene therapies. It uses proprietary and modular T cell programming technologies that are designed to recognize cancer cells, break down their defense mechanisms, and attack and kill these cells. The company was founded by Martin Pule in September 2014 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Autolus Therapeutics Plc 是一家生物製藥公司，從事基因療法的開發和商業化。它使用專有的模組化 T 細胞編程技術，旨在識別癌細胞、打破其防禦機制並攻擊和殺死這些細胞。該公司由Martin Pule於2014年9月創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of light emitting diode lighting systems, wireless Internet of Things enabled control, commercial and industrial electric vehicle charging infrastructure solutions, and lighting and electrical maintenance services. It operates through the following segments: Lighting, Maintenance, Electric Vehicle Charging (EV), and Corporate and Other. The Lighting segment is involved in the development and sale of lighting products and provides construction and engineering services for commercial lighting and energy management systems. The Maintenance segment focuses on retailers, distributors, and other businesses with maintenance, repair, and replacement services for lighting and related electrical components. The EV segment offers electric vehicle charging expertise and provides EV turnkey installation solutions with ongoing support to all commercial verticals. The Corporate and Other segment includes operating expenses. The company was founded by Neal R. Verfuerth and Patrick J. Trotter in April 1996 and is headquartered in Manitowoc, WI.
info.description_zh: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. 從事提供發光二極管照明系統、無線物聯網控制、商業和工業電動車充電基礎設施解決方案以及照明和電氣維護服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：照明部門、維修部門、電動車充電部門（EV）以及企業及其他部門。照明部門從事照明產品的開發和銷售，並為商業照明和能源管理系統提供建築和工程服務。維修部門專注於為照明及相關電氣元件提供維護、維修和更換服務的零售商、經銷商和其他企業。電動車部門提供電動車充電專業知識，並提供電動車交鑰匙安裝解決方案，並為所有商業垂直領域提供持續支援。公司及其他部門包括營運費用。該公司由 Neal R. Verfuerth 和 Patrick J. Trotter 於 1996 年 4 月創立，總部位於威斯康辛州馬尼托瓦克。

info.description: X-Energy, Inc. operates as an energy company The firm focuses on modular nuclear reactors and fuel technology for clean energy generation. The company was founded by Kam Ghaffarian and Eben Mulder on 2009 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: X-Energy, Inc. 作為一家能源公司運營，該公司專注於用於清潔能源發電的模組化核反應器和燃料技術。該公司由 Kam Ghaffarian 和 Eben Mulder 於 2009 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Digital Turbine, Inc. is a mobile growth platform that offers solutions for advertisers, publishers, carriers, and device original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). The firm operates through the On Device Solutions (ODS) and App Growth Platform (AGP) segments. The ODS segment generates revenue from the delivery of mobile application media or content to end users with solutions for all participants in the mobile application ecosystem that want to connect with end users and consumers who hold the device. This includes mobile carriers and device OEMs that participate in the app economy, app publishers and developers, and brands and advertising agencies. The AGP segment provides platforms that allow mobile app publishers and developers to monetize their monthly active users via display, native, and video advertising. The company was founded on November 6, 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Digital Turbine, Inc. 是一個行動成長平台，為廣告主、出版商、營運商和裝置原始裝置製造商 (OEM) 提供解決方案。該公司透過設備上解決方案（ODS）和應用程式成長平台（AGP）部門進行營運。 ODS 部門透過向最終用戶交付行動應用程式媒體或內容來產生收入，並為行動應用程式生態系統中希望與最終用戶和持有設備的消費者建立聯繫的所有參與者提供解決方案。這包括參與應用經濟的行動營運商和設備 OEM、應用程式發行商和開發人員以及品牌和廣告代理商。 AGP 部門提供的平台允許行動應用程式發行商和開發人員透過展示廣告、原生廣告和影片廣告從其每月活躍用戶中獲利。該公司成立於1998年11月6日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Top QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Mega Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the Daily Target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the largest companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index by targeting the performance of approximately the top 45% cumulative weight of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Top QQQ 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）相當於 Nasdaq-100 Mega Index 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在透過納斯達克 100 指數中約前 45% 累積權重的表現來衡量納斯達克 100 指數中最大的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SCYNEXIS, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of novel oral and intravenous triterpenoid antifungal for the treatment of several fungal infections, including vulvovaginal candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, invasive candidiasis, and refractory invasive fungal infections. The company was founded by Scot Kevin Huber, Terry Eugene Marquardt, Pierre Bernard Jacques Monnet, Russell J. Outcalt, and Yves Joseph Ribeill on November 4, 1999 and is headquartered in Jersey City, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: SCYNEXIS, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於開發新型口服和靜脈注射三萜類抗真菌藥，用於治療多種真菌感染，包括外陰陰道念珠菌病、侵襲性曲霉病、侵襲性念珠菌病和難治性侵襲性真菌感染。該公司由 Scot Kevin Huber、Terry Eugene Marquardt、Pierre Bernard Jacques Monnet、Russell J. Outcalt 和 Yves Joseph Ribeill 於 1999 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州澤西市。

info.description: Evogene Ltd. engages in the development and commercialization of a computer-biological platform for improving the development processes of products in the field of life sciences. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture, Industrial Applications, and Human Health. The Agriculture segment develops seed traits, agrochemical products, and agro biological products to improve plant performance. The Industrial Applications focuses on the development and commercialization of improved castor bean seeds for industrial uses. The Human Health segment involves discovery and development of human microbiome-based therapeutics. The company was founded by Amir Barzilay and Hagai Karchi on October 10, 1999 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Evogene Ltd. 從事電腦生物平台的開發和商業化，以改善生命科學領域產品的開發流程。它透過以下部門運作：農業、工業應用和人類健康。農業部門開發種子性狀、農化產品和農業生物產品，以提高植物性能。工業應用重點在於工業用途改良蓖麻子種子的開發和商業化。人類健康部分涉及基於人類微生物組的療法的發現和開發。該公司由 Amir Barzilay 和 Hagai Karchi 於 1999 年 10 月 10 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: American Resources Corp. engages in the extraction, processing, transportation, and distribution of metallurgical coal to the steel industry. It focuses on the operation of coal mining complexes located primarily within Pike, Knott, and Letcher Counties, Kentucky, and Wyoming County, West Virginia. The company was founded in 2006 and in headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: 美國資源公司從事冶金煤的開採、加工、運輸和分配給鋼鐵業。該公司專注於主要位於肯塔基州派克縣、諾特縣和萊徹縣以及西維吉尼亞州懷俄明縣的煤礦綜合體的運作。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: Mako Mining Corp. engages in the development and exploration of gold. It also focuses on San Albino gold project located in Nueva Segovia, Nicaragua. The company was founded on April 1, 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Mako Mining Corp. 從事黃金的開發和勘探。它還專注於位於尼加拉瓜新塞哥維亞的San Albino金礦計畫。該公司成立於2004年4月1日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Innospec, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, blend, marketing, and supply of fuel additives, oilfield chemicals, personal care, and other specialty chemicals. It operates through the following segments: Fuel Specialties, Performance Chemicals, and Oilfield Services. The Fuel Specialties segment develops, manufactures, blends, markets, and supplies a range of specialty chemical products used as additives to a range of fuels. The Performance Chemicals segment provides technology-based solutions for customers processes or products focused on the personal care, home care, agrochemical, and mining industries. The Oilfield Services segment refers to the development and marketing of chemical solutions for fracturing, drilling, stimulation, completion operations, products for oil and gas production, and transport. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Innospec, Inc. 從事燃料添加劑、油田化學品、個人護理品和其他特殊化學品的開發、製造、混合、行銷和供應。它透過以下部門運作：特種燃料部門、高性能化學品部門和油田服務部門。特種燃料部門開發、製造、混合、行銷和供應一系列特殊化學產品，用作一系列燃料的添加劑。高性能化學品部門為專注於個人護理、家庭護理、農業化學品和採礦行業的客戶流程或產品提供基於技術的解決方案。油田服務部門是指用於壓裂、鑽井、增產、完井作業、石油和天然氣生產和運輸產品的化學解決方案的開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1938 年，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: The9 Ltd. is engaged in the operation of online games. It operates through Cryptocurrency Mining, and Corporate and Others segments. The company was founded by Jun Zhu on December 22, 1999, and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 九城有限公司從事網路遊戲營運。它透過加密貨幣挖礦、企業及其他部門運作。該公司由朱駿於1999年12月22日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the retail of closeouts, excess inventory, and salvage merchandise. The firm offers overstocks, discontinued merchandise, package changes, cancelled orders, buybacks from retailers, and major manufacturers. Its products include housewares, bed and bath, food, floor coverings, health and beauty aids, books and stationery, toys and electronics. The company was founded by Mark Butler, Mort Bernstein, Oliver Rosenberg and Harry Coverman on July 29, 1982, and is headquartered in Harrisburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事清倉、過剩庫存和回收商品的零售業務。該公司提供庫存過剩、停產商品、包裝變更、取消訂單、零售商和主要製造商的回購服務。其產品包括家庭用品、床具和浴室、食品、地板覆蓋、健康和美容用品、書籍和文具、玩具和電子產品。該公司由 Mark Butler、Mort Bernstein、Oliver Rosenberg 和 Harry Coverman 於 1982 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於賓州哈里斯堡。

info.description: Tapestry, Inc. engages in the provision of luxury accessories and lifestyle brands. It operates through the following segments: Coach, Kate Spade, and Stuart Weitzman. The Coach segment consists of global sales of Coach brand products to customers through Coach operated stores, including the internet and concession shop-in-shops, and sales to wholesale customers, and through independent third-party distributors. The Kate Spade segment focuses on Kate Spade New York brand products to customers through Kate Spade operated stores, including the Internet, sales to wholesale customers, through concession shop-in-shops and through independent third-party distributors. The Stuart Weitzman segment includes Stuart Weitzman brand products primarily through Stuart Weitzman operated stores. The company was founded by Dawn Hughes in 1941 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Tapestry, Inc. 從事提供奢華配件和生活風格品牌。它透過以下部門運作：Coach、Kate Spade 和 Stuart Weitzman。 Coach 部門包括透過 Coach 經營的商店（包括網路和特許店中店）向全球客戶銷售 Coach 品牌產品，以及透過獨立第三方經銷商向批發客戶銷售。 Kate Spade 部門專注於透過 Kate Spade 經營的商店（包括網路）向顧客銷售 Kate Spade New York 品牌產品，透過特許經營店中店和獨立第三方經銷商向批發客戶銷售。 Stuart Weitzman 部門主要透過 Stuart Weitzman 經營的商店提供 Stuart Weitzman 品牌產品。該公司由 Dawn Hughes 於 1941 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: BlackRock Large Cap Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in large cap equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, large cap equity securities are equity securities that at the time of purchase have a market capitalization within the range of companies included in the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德大盤成長 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少80%的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於大盤股證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。就基金的 80% 政策而言，大盤股證券是指購買時市值處於 Russell 1000 Growth Index 所包含公司範圍內的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio will be technology companies or companies that rely heavily on technological advances. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券將是科技公司或嚴重依賴技術進步的公司。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pfizer Inc. is a research-based global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sales and distribution of biopharmaceutical products worldwide. The firm works across developed and emerging markets to advance wellness, prevention, treatments and cures that challenge the most feared diseases. The company was founded by Charles Pfizer Sr. and Charles Erhart in 1849 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 輝瑞公司是一家以研究為基礎的全球生物製藥公司，在全球範圍內從事生物製藥產品的發現、開發、製造、行銷、銷售和分銷。該公司在已開發和新興市場開展工作，推動健康、預防、治療和治療，以應對最可怕的疾病。該公司由 Charles Pfizer Sr. 和 Charles Erhart 於 1849 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Tractor Supply Co. engages in the retail sale of farm and ranch products. It operates retail farm and ranch stores and focuses on supplying the lifestyle needs of recreational farmers and ranchers, as well as tradesmen and small businesses. The firm operates the retail stores under the names: Tractor Supply Company, Orscheln Farm & Home, and Petsense. Its product categories include equine, livestock, pet, and small animal, hardware, truck, towing, and tool, heating, lawn and garden items, power equipment, gifts, and toys, recreational clothing and footwear, and maintenance products for agricultural and rural use. The company was founded by Charles E. Schmidt, Sr. in 1938 and is headquartered in Brentwood, TN.
info.description_zh: Tractor Supply Co. 從事農場和牧場產品的零售。它經營零售農場和牧場商店，專注於滿足休閒農民和牧場主以及商人和小型企業的生活方式需求。該公司以以下名稱經營零售店：Tractor Supply Company、Orscheln Farm & Home 和 Petsense。其產品類別包括馬、牲畜、寵物和小動物、五金、卡車、拖車和工具、暖氣、草坪和花園用品、電力設備、禮品和玩具、休閒服裝和鞋類以及農業和農村使用的維護產品。該公司由 Charles E. Schmidt, Sr. 於 1938 年創立，總部位於田納西州布倫特伍德。

info.description: Youxin Technogy Ltd. operates as an investment holding company. It is a software as a service and platform as a service provider. The firm develops, uses and controls business applications without the need to purchase complex information technology infrastructure. The company was founded by Sun Jin Hou and Lin Shao Zhang on October 21, 2022 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 友信科技有限公司以投資控股公司運作。它是一個軟體即服務和平台即服務提供者。該公司無需購買複雜的資訊技術基礎設施即可開發、使用和控制業務應用程式。該公司由孫金侯和林少章於2022年10月21日創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long SPY Quarterly ETF seeks calendar quarter investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar quarter performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long SPY 季度 ETF 尋求日曆季度投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信託日曆季度業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信託的日曆季度業績提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dakota Active Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly through other ETFs, in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. companies or underlying ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Dakota Active Equity ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過直接或透過其他 ETF 間接投資於美國股本證券投資組合來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國公司的股本證券或提供美國公司股本證券敞口的基礎ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Scharf Global Opportunity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund primarily invests in U.S. and non-U.S. equity securities that the Adviser believes have significantly more appreciation potential than downside risk over the long term. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include, but are not limited to, common and preferred stock of companies of all size market capitalizations, rights and warrants. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its total assets in non-U.S. securities. During unusual market conditions, the fund will invest at least 30% of its total assets in non-U.S. securities.
info.description_zh: Scharf Global Opportunity ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於顧問認為長期來看升值潛力明顯大於下行風險的美國和非美國股票證券。本基金可投資的股本證券包括但不限於各種市值公司的普通股和優先股、權利和認股權證。一般情況下，該基金將至少40%的總資產投資於非美國證券。在異常市場條件下，該基金將至少將其總資產的 30% 投資於非美國證券。

info.description: Exagen, Inc. is a commercial-stage diagnostics company, which engages in transforming the care continuum for patients suffering from debilitating and chronic autoimmune diseases by enabling timely differential diagnosis and optimizing therapeutic intervention. It operates under the Avise brand. The company was founded by Waneta C. Tuttle and Cole Harris in 2002 and is headquartered in Vista, CA.
info.description_zh: Exagen, Inc. 是一家商業階段的診斷公司，致力於透過及時鑑別診斷和優化治療介入來改變患有衰弱性和慢性自體免疫疾病的患者的護理連續性。它以 Avise 品牌運作。該公司由 Waneta C. Tuttle 和 Cole Harris 於 2002 年創立，總部位於加州維斯塔。

info.description: MKAM ETF seeks to capture the majority of equity market returns, while exposing investors to less volatility and downside risk than other equity investments. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in U.S. equity securities that generally mimic the performance of the S&P 500 Index while attempting to reduce volatility and mitigate drawdowns. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: MKAM ETF 旨在獲取大部分股票市場回報，同時使投資者面臨比其他股票投資更少的波動性和下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資通常模仿標準普爾 500 指數表現的美國股票證券來實現其投資目標，同時試圖減少波動性和減少回撤。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree U.S. Quality Dividend Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a fundamentally weighted index that consists of dividend-paying U.S. common stocks with growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 美國品質股息成長基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 美國品質股息成長指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金總資產（不包括證券借貸抵押品）的至少80%將投資於該指數的組成證券以及與該組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的投資。該指數是一個基本面加權指數，由具有成長特徵的派息美國普通股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Paris-Aligned Climate MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Climate Paris Aligned Benchmark Extended Select Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization stocks that are selected and weighted so that, in the aggregate, the portfolio is compatible with the objectives of the Paris Agreement by following a decarbonization trajectory. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 巴黎協調氣候 MSCI 美國 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 美國氣候巴黎協調基準擴展精選指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。基礎指數由美國大中型股票組成，這些股票經過精心挑選和加權，總體而言，該投資組合遵循脫碳軌跡，與《巴黎協定》的目標一致。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of critical care products, with a focus on oncology, anti-infectives in adjunct cancer care, prescription products, and stem cell therapy. Its products include I/ONTAK, Mino-Lok, Halo-Lido, Mino-Wrap, and Novecite. The company was founded by Ralph Montrone, Leonard Mazur, Myron Holubiak on January 23, 2007 and is headquartered in Cranford, NJ.
info.description_zh: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事重症監護產品的開發和商業化，重點關注腫瘤學、輔助癌症護理中的抗感染藥物、處方產品和幹細胞治療。其產品包括 I/ONTAK、Mino-Lok、Halo-Lido、Mino-Wrap 和 Novecite。該公司由 Ralph Montrone、Leonard Mazur、Myron Holubiak 於 2007 年 1 月 23 日創立，總部位於新澤西州克蘭福德。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The Sub-Adviser defines U.S. companies as companies whose securities are traded principally in the United States or that have their principal place of business in the United States. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。副顧問將美國公司定義為證券主要在美國交易或主要營業地點在美國的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sapient Quality Select ETF is an actively managed fund that targets U.S. equities by identifying companies exhibiting a convergence of high-quality financial characteristics and robust growth potential. The investment process utilizes a proprietary framework to screen for businesses with above-average profitability, strong management profiles, and attractive valuations, specifically focusing on entities positioned to benefit from long-term economic catalysts or transformative market themes.
info.description_zh: Sapient Quality Select ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過識別具有高品質財務特徵和強勁成長潛力的公司來瞄準美國股票。投資流程利用專有框架來篩選獲利能力高於平均水平、管理能力強且估值有吸引力的企業，特別關注那些能夠從長期經濟催化劑或變革性市場主題中受益的實體。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 3000 Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 3000 Index that measures the investment return of the broad U.S. stock market. The advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 3000 Index, which represents approximately 98% of the U.S. equity market and comprises the 3,000 largest companies in the United States. The Advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 3000 Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤衡量美國股市整體投資報酬率的 Russell 3000 指數的表現。該顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 3000 指數的表現，該指數約占美國股市的 98%，由美國最大的 3,000 家公司組成。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: Ferguson Enterprises, Inc. engages in the distribution of plumbing, heating, ventilation and air conditioning, appliances, lighting, pipes, valves and fittings, and water and wastewater products to professional contractors and customers in the repair, maintenance, improvement, and new construction markets through its subsidiaries. It operates through the United States and Canada geographical segments. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Newport News, VA.
info.description_zh: Ferguson Enterprises, Inc. 透過其子公司向維修、維護、改善和新建市場的專業承包商和客戶分銷管道、暖氣、通風和空調、電器、照明、管道、閥門和配件以及水和廢水產品。它透過美國和加拿大的地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於 1953 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州紐波特紐斯。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Value Opportunities ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in a portfolio of equity securities. Although it will invest primarily in publicly traded U.S. securities, it may invest up to 20% of its Net Assets in foreign securities, including securities of issuers in countries with emerging markets or economies ("emerging countries") and securities quoted in foreign currencies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛價值機會ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於股本證券投資組合。儘管將主要投資於公開交易的美國證券，但最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外國證券，包括新興市場或經濟體國家（「新興國家」）發行人的證券以及以外幣報價的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ishares Paris-Aligned Climate MSCI World Ex USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of MSCI World ex USA Climate Paris Aligned Benchmark Extended Select Index.
