The index is composed of large- and mid-cap developed market equities, excluding the U.S., that are selected and weighted so that, in the aggregate, the portfolio is compatible with the objectives of the Paris Agreement by following a decarbonization trajectory, reducing exposure to climate-related transition and physical risks and increasing exposure to companies favorably positioned for the transition to a low-carbon economy. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index.
info.description_zh: isshares 巴黎調整氣候 MSCI 世界（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界（美國除外）氣候巴黎調整基準擴展精選指數的投資結果。該指數由大中型已開發市場股票（不包括美國）組成，其選擇和加權的目的是使該投資組合總體上符合《巴黎協定》的目標，遵循脫碳軌跡，減少與氣候相關的轉型和實體風險的敞口，並增加對向低碳經濟轉型處於有利地位的公司的敞口。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的成分證券。

info.description: Thrivent International Large Cap ETF provides exposure to a well-diversified portfolio of large-capitalization equity securities issued by companies in non-U.S. developed markets across growth, value, and core investment styles. The Fund combines fundamental research and quantitative risk management to capture total return from international developed markets relative to its benchmark, the MSCI World ex-USA Index.
info.description_zh: Thrivent International Large Cap ETF 提供由非美國已開發市場公司發行的多元化大盤股證券投資組合，涵蓋成長型、價值型和核心投資風格。該基金結合了基礎研究和定量風險管理，以獲得國際已開發市場相對於其基準 MSCI 世界（美國除外）指數的總回報。

info.description: Ned Davis Research 360 Dynamic Allocation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that primarily invests in passively managed ETFs, including affiliated ETFs that use the sub-adviser's models or indices. The underlying ETFs principally invest in equity securities,bonds (both long- and short-term),commodities and money markets.
info.description_zh: Ned Davis Research 360 動態配置 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於被動管理的 ETF，包括使用副顧問模型或指數的附屬 ETF。基礎ETF主要投資於股本證券、債券（長期和短期）、大宗商品和貨幣市場。

info.description: ETF advised by VanEck providing targeted exposure to U.S. industrials sector companies using the TruSector methodology.
info.description_zh: VanEck 為 ETF 提供諮詢，使用 TruSector 方法為美國工業部門公司提供有針對性的投資。

info.description: U.S. Small Cap Growth Portfolio ETF Class Shares is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to capture long-term capital appreciation by investing in small-capitalization companies listed within the United States. The strategy utilizes a proprietary quantitative approach that targets small-cap companies with low relative prices and high profitability while minimizing transaction costs through structured, institutional execution.
info.description_zh: 美國小型股成長投資組合 ETF 類別股票是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過投資在美國上市的小型股公司來獲取長期資本增值。此策略採用專有的定量方法，針對相對價格較低、獲利能力較高的小型股公司，同時透過結構化、機構執行最大限度地降低交易成本。

info.description: Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by Sprott Asset Management, LP. The fund is co-managed by Sprott Asset Management USA Inc. It invests in the public equity markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in value stocks of companies across all market capitalizations. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Russell 3000 Index. It was formerly known as Royce Focus Trust, Inc. Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. was formed on March 2, 1988 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. 是由 Sprott Asset Management, LP 發起和管理的封閉式股票共同基金。該基金由 Sprott Asset Management USA Inc. 共同管理，投資於美國公共股票市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業的公司股票。它主要投資於所有市值公司的價值股票。該基金將其投資組合的表現與羅素 3000 指數進行比較。它的前身為 Royce Focus Trust, Inc.。 Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. 成立於 1988 年 3 月 2 日，註冊地在美國。

info.description: iShares MSCI Global Sustainable Development Goals ETF seeks to track the performance of the MSCI ACWI Sustainable Impact Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is composed of companies that derive a majority of their revenue from products and services that address at least one of the world's major social and environmental challenges as identified by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 全球永續發展目標 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI ACWI 永續影響指數的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數由大部分收入來自產品和服務的公司組成，這些產品和服務至少解決了聯合國永續發展目標確定的世界主要社會和環境挑戰之一。

info.description: AB Moderate Buffer ETF seeks a moderate level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB 適度緩衝 ETF 尋求適度的資本增值，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護的潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其大部分資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust）是一款旨在追蹤 S&P 500 指數投資結果的 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and XRP 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P XRP 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P XRP Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in XRP so that the total value of the XRP to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 XRP 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在費用和支出之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P XRP 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P XRP 指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成標準普爾 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資 XRP，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的 XRP 總價值約佔該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: Defiance Autism Impact ETF is a passively managed thematic fund tracking an equal-weighted index of publicly traded global companies within developed markets that provide products, services, or research supporting the autism ecosystem and broader neurodivergent community. The fund targets the expanding healthcare, specialized education, assistive technology, and behavioral diagnostics sectors while incorporating a unique philanthropic commitment to donate net advisory profits to autism care and research organizations.
info.description_zh: Defiance Autism Impact ETF 是一支被動管理的主題基金，追蹤已開發市場內全球上市公司的等權重指數，這些公司提供支持自閉症生態系統和更廣泛的神經分歧社群的產品、服務或研究。該基金的目標是擴大醫療保健、專業教育、輔助技術和行為診斷領域，同時納入獨特的慈善承諾，將淨諮詢利潤捐贈給自閉症護理和研究組織。

info.description: Themes Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Pure Gold Miners Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are active in the gold mining industry and is denominated in U.S. dollars. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Gold Miners ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Global Pure Gold Miners Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為活躍於黃金開採行業的公司提供風險敞口，並以美元計價。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Growth Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets of growth companies.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前與 Victory International Growth 自由現金流指數的表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場成長型公司股票證券的投資。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright ADR ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation above international benchmarks such as the MSCI EAFE Index. The fund seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by selecting primarily a portfolio of U.S.-traded securities of non-U.S. organizations, most often American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). It will invest at least 80% of its total assets in ADRs and in securities that have economic characteristics similar to ADRs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright ADR ETF 尋求高於 MSCI EAFE 指數等國際基準的長期資本增值。該基金旨在透過主要選擇非美國組織在美國交易的證券投資組合（最常見的是美國存託憑證（「ADR」））來實現基金的投資目標。它將把至少80%的總資產投資於ADR以及具有與ADR類似經濟特徵的證券。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Ethereum 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Ether Futures 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Ether Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Ether futures contracts so that the total value of the Ether to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和以太坊 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P 以太期貨 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數權重為 75%，標普以太期貨指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於以太坊期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的以太幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: F/m High Yield 100 ETF seeks investment results, that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the Bloomberg U.S. High Yield Top 100 Quality Select Equal Weighted Index. The index a subset of the Bloomberg U.S. Corporate High Yield Bond Index, which is designed to measure the performance of select below-investment grade bonds issued by the 100 largest issuers based on market capitalization. Under normal market conditions, the Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's assets in the securities of issuers comprising the underlying index.
info.description_zh: F/m High Yield 100 ETF 尋求投資結果，該結果通常與彭博美國高收益 100 強優質精選等加權指數的價格和收益表現相對應（未計費用和開支）。該指數是彭博美國企業高收益債券指數的子集，旨在衡量 100 家最大發行人根據市值發行的精選低於投資等級債券的表現。在正常市場條件下，顧問力求透過將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於構成基礎指數的發行人的證券來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Man Active Trend Enhanced ETF seeks to provide capital growth. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in two complementary investment strategies: an active, trend-following strategy (the "Trend-Following Strategy") and an equity strategy (the "Equity Strategy"). AHL Partners LLP, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), employs a quantitative model to identify investment opportunities across a wide range of global markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Trend 增強型 ETF 旨在提供資本成長。該基金尋求透過投資兩種互補的投資策略來實現其投資目標：積極的趨勢追蹤策略（「趨勢追蹤策略」）和股票策略（「股票策略」）。該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）AHL Partners LLP 採用定量模型來識別全球廣泛市場的投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco High Yield Bond Factor ETF seeks total return. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high-yield, below-investment grade, fixed-income securities, and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. It may invest up to 20% of its net assets in U.S. Treasury and agency securities. The fund may also invest up to 10% of its net assets in certain collateralized debt obligations.
info.description_zh: 景順高收益債券因子 ETF 尋求總回報。該基金是一種主動管理的ETF，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額）投資於高收益、低於投資級別的固定收益證券以及具有與此類證券類似經濟特徵的衍生品和其他工具來實現其投資目標。它最多可以將其淨資產的 20% 投資於美國國債和機構證券。該基金還可以將其淨資產最多 10% 投資於某些債務抵押債券。

info.description: Macquarie Focused International Core ETF seeks to provide capital growth and appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the ETF will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity companies. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks of non-U.S. companies located or operating in both developed markets and emerging markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理聚焦國際核心 ETF 致力於提供資本成長和增值。在正常情況下，ETF將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於股權公司。該基金將主要投資於位於已開發市場和新興市場或在新興市場運營的非美國公司的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: OTG Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on June 12, 2025 and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: OTG Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 12 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Principal U.S. Mega-Cap ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. companies with very large ("mega") market capitalizations at the time of purchase. For this fund, companies with mega capitalizations are those with market capitalizations in the top 50th percentile of the S&P 500 Index at the time of purchase.
info.description_zh: 主要美國巨型股 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於購買時市值非常大（「巨型」）的美國公司的股本證券。對於該基金來說，巨額資本公司是指購買時市值位於標準普爾 500 指數前 50% 的公司。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2026 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2026, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2026 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2026 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 17, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年10月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Aeva Technologies, Inc. develops sensing paradigm for autonomous vehicles and robotics. The firm offers drones, robotics, vehicle technology, and virtual and augmented reality products. The company was founded by Soroush Salehian Dardashti and Mina Rezk in 2017 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Aeva Technologies, Inc. 為自動駕駛車輛和機器人開發感測範例。該公司提供無人機、機器人、車輛技術以及虛擬和擴增實境產品。該公司由 Soroush Salehian Dardashti 和 Mina Rezk 於 2017 年創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the purpose of acquiring and integrating various companies engaged in the aerospace and defense industry. It operates through the following segments: Avionics and Electronics, Electric Air Mobility, Drones, and Training. The Avionics and Electronics segment refers to its brand, Aspen Avionics, which designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication, and display components and integrated systems. The Electric Air Mobility segment transforms urban transportation with its development of an electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. The Drones perform crucial missions such as ISR and target tracking, mapping, surveying, inspection, and localization, enhancing military, and commercial operational efficiency worldwide. The Training segment relates to its brand, Coastal Defense, delivers specialized professional training services to the military and commercial aviation communities. The company was founded by Chirinjeev Kathuria on August, 30, 2021 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. 致力於收購和整合從事航空航天和國防工業的多家公司。該公司透過以下部門運作：航空電子和電子部門、電動空中交通部門、無人機部門和培訓部門。航空電子設備和電子部門是指其品牌 Aspen Avionics，該公司設計、認證和製造關鍵的導航、通訊和顯示組件以及整合系統。電動空中交通部門透過開發電動垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飛機改變了城市交通。無人機執行ISR和目標追蹤、測繪、測量、檢查和定位等關鍵任務，提高全球軍事和商業營運效率。培訓部門與其品牌海岸防禦有關，為軍事和商業航空界提供專門的專業培訓服務。該公司由 Chirinjeev Kathuria 於 2021 年 8 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Alkami Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of digital banking software solutions to credit unions, banks, credit union service organizations, and service bureaus. It offers content management and an online and mobile banking suite that brings together a snapshot view of accounts with recent and upcoming activities. The company was founded by Louis A. Iannaccone, Scott Klososky, Steve Meston, Gary L. Nelson, Gruenewald Bobby, Jay Lackey, Stephen Bohanon, and Kim Stroh in 2007 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Alkami Technology, Inc. 致力於向信用社、銀行、信用社服務組織和服務局提供數位銀行軟體解決方案。它提供內容管理以及線上和行動銀行套件，將帳戶快照視圖與最近和即將進行的活動結合在一起。該公司由 Louis A. Iannaccone、Scott Klososky、Steve Meston、Gary L. Nelson、Gruenewald Bobby、Jay Lackey、Stephen Bohanon 和 Kim Stroh 於 2007 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of land-based aquaculture services. It includes farming of aquatic organisms such as fish, shellfish, crustaceans, and aquatic plants. The firm focuses on a salmon product, a bioengineered Atlantic salmon that can grow to market size faster than conventional farmed Atlantic salmon. The company was founded by Elliot Z. Entis and Garth L. Fletcher on December 17, 1991 and is headquartered in Harvard, MA.
info.description_zh: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. 從事提供陸基水產養殖服務。它包括魚類、貝類、甲殼類和水生植物等水生生物的養殖。該公司專注於鮭魚產品，這是一種生物工程大西洋鮭魚，它可以比傳統養殖的大西洋鮭魚更快長到上市尺寸。該公司由 Elliot Z. Entis 和 Garth L. Fletcher 於 1991 年 12 月 17 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州哈佛大學。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: ATN International, Inc. engages in the provision of digital infrastructure and communications services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Telecom and International Telecom. The U.S. Telecom segment offers fixed, carrier, and managed services to customers in Alaska and the western U.S. The International Telecom segment focuses on fixed, carrier, mobility and managed services to customers in Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Guyana, and US Virgin Islands. The company was founded by Cornelius B. Prior Jr. in June 1987 and is headquartered in Beverly, MA.
info.description_zh: ATN International, Inc. 從事提供數位基礎設施和通訊服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國電信部門和國際電信部門。美國電信部門為阿拉斯加和美國西部的客戶提供固定、營運商和管理服務。國際電信部門專注於為百慕達、開曼群島、圭亞那和美屬維京群島的客戶提供固定、營運商、行動和管理服務。該公司由 Cornelius B. Prior Jr. 於 1987 年 6 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州貝弗利。

info.description: BHAV Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Piscataway, NJ.
info.description_zh: BHAV Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，致力於與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於新澤西州皮斯卡塔韋。

info.description: BeLive Holdings engages in the development of software and programming activities and provides consultancy services. The company offers technology solutions for live commerce and shoppable short videos. It offers services through BeLive White Label solution and a cloud-based BeLive software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution. The company was founded on June 18, 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: BeLive Holdings 從事軟體開發和程式設計活動並提供諮詢服務。該公司為直播商務和可購物短視頻提供技術解決方案。它透過 BeLive 白標解決方案和基於雲端的 BeLive 軟體即服務 (SaaS) 解決方案提供服務。該公司成立於2014年6月18日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc. is a commercial stage biotechnology company which focuses on regenerative therapies in the fields of immunotherapy, endocrinology, urology, neurology and orthopedics. Its products include CaverStem, FemCelz, StemSpine and ImmCelz. The company was founded by Timothy Warbington on December 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物技術公司，專注於免疫療法、內分泌學、泌尿學、神經學和骨科領域的再生療法。其產品包括CaverStem、FemCelz、StemSpine 和ImmCelz。該公司由 Timothy Warbington 於 1998 年 12 月 3 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: ClearOne, Inc. engages in the design, development, and marketing of professional audio conferencing, microphone, and video collaboration solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: ClearOne, Inc. 從事專業音訊會議、麥克風和視訊協作解決方案的設計、開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Cronos Group, Inc. engages in the production and distribution of cannabis. I It operates through the Canada and Israel segments. The company was founded on August 21, 2012 and is headquartered in Stayner, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Cronos Group, Inc. 從事大麻的生產和分銷。 I 它透過加拿大和以色列部門運作。該公司成立於2012年8月21日，總部位於加拿大斯塔納。

info.description: DXP Enterprises, Inc. engages in the business of distributing maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to customers serving a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Service Centers (SC), Supply Chain Services (SCS), Innovative Pumping Solutions (IPS), and Corporate. The SC segment provides MRO products, equipment, and services including technical expertise and logistics capabilities to customers serving varied end markets with the ability to provide same day delivery. The SCS segment focuses on managing customers' supply chains including procurement and inventory management. The IPS segment includes integrated, custom pump skid packages, pump remanufacturing, and manufactures branded private label pumps to meet the capital equipment needs of the global customer base. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: DXP Enterprises, Inc. 從事向服務各種終端市場的客戶分銷維護、維修和營運 (MRO) 產品和服務的業務。它透過以下部門運作：服務中心 (SC)、供應鏈服務 (SCS)、創新泵送解決方案 (IPS) 和企業部門。 SC 部門向服務不同終端市場的客戶提供 MRO 產品、設備和服務，包括技術專業知識和物流能力，並能夠提供當日交付。 SCS部門專注於管理客戶的供應鏈，包括採購和庫存管理。 IPS 部門包括整合、客製化泵橇套件、泵浦再製造以及製造品牌自有品牌泵，以滿足全球客戶群的資本設備需求。該公司成立於 1908 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Evolus, Inc. is a medical aesthetics company, which engages in the provision of medical aesthetic treatments and procedures. It offers products under the brand of Jeuveau. The company was founded by Scott Cannizzaro in November 2012 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Evolus, Inc. 是一家醫學美容公司，提供醫學美容治療和手術。它提供 Jeuveau 品牌的產品。該公司由 Scott Cannizzaro 於 2012 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州紐波特海灘。

info.description: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc. is an exploration stage company, which engages in the provision of boron and lithium properties in Australia and the United States. It focuses on supplying boron specialty materials, complemented by lithium co-product production. The company was founded on September 23, 2021 and is headquartered in Hesperia, CA.
info.description_zh: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc.是一家處於勘探階段的公司，主要在澳洲和美國提供硼和鋰資源。它專注於供應硼特種材料，並輔以鋰副產品生產。該公司成立於2021年9月23日，總部位於加州希斯皮里亞。

info.description: FIGX Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on February 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Tiburon, CA.

info.description: Future Money Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of entering into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Future Money Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Gauzy Ltd. is a light and vision control company, which engages in the development, manufacturing, and wholesale of liquid control glass. It operates through the following segments: Architecture, Automotive, Safety Tech, and Aeronautics. The Architecture segment segment focuses on sales for both interior and exterior applications for commercial, retail, residential, healthcare and hospitality customers. The Automotive segment focuses on sales that enable OEMs to incorporate company's technology into glass rooftops, side windows and windshields to replace conventional mechanical sun visors and shades. The Safety Tech segment focuses on sales of advanced driver assistance systems for buses, coaches, recreational vehicles and specific vehicles, such as camera and motion sensor systems, smart mirrors, and safety doors. The Aeronautics segment is involved in the sale of shading and cabin management systems in private and commercial aircraft, and helicopters. The company was founded by Adrian Lofer, Dimitry Dobrenko and Eyal Peso on October 26, 2009 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
info.description_zh: Gauzy Ltd.是一家光與視覺控制公司，從事液控玻璃的開發、製造和批發。它透過以下部門運作：建築、汽車、安全技術和航空。建築部門專注於商業、零售、住宅、醫療保健和酒店客戶的內部和外部應用的銷售。汽車部門的重點是銷售，使原始設備製造商能夠將公司的技術融入玻璃屋頂、側窗和擋風玻璃中，以取代傳統的機械遮陽板和遮陽帽。安全技術部門專注於巴士、客車、休閒車和特定車輛的先進駕駛輔助系統的銷售，例如攝影機和運動感測器系統、智慧後視鏡和安全門。航空部門從事私人和商用飛機以及直升機遮陽和機艙管理系統的銷售。該公司由 Adrian Lofer、Dimitry Dobrenko 和 Eyal Peso 於 2009 年 10 月 26 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫-雅法。

info.description: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. The company was founded by Edward King and Dan Fetters on July 2, 2024 and is headquartered in Manhattan Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。該公司由 Edward King 和 Dan Fetters 於 2024 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州曼哈頓海灘。

info.description: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它從事與一個或多個企業的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月20日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Lightbridge Corp. engages in the development and commercialization of next generation nuclear fuel technology. It offers Lightbridge Fuel, a proprietary next generation of nuclear fuel technology for current and future reactors. The company was founded on January 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: Lightbridge Corp. 從事下一代核燃料技術的開發和商業化。它提供 Lightbridge Fuel，這是一種適用於當前和未來反應器的下一代專有核燃料技術。該公司成立於1992年1月8日，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Medalist Diversified, Inc. engages in the acquisition, reposition, renovation, lease, and management of income-producing properties. It focuses on commercial properties, including flex-industrial and retail properties, multi-family residential properties, and limited-service hotel properties. It operates through the following segments: Retail Center Properties, Flex Center Property and STNL Properties. The Retail Center Properties segment consists of the Shops at Franklin Square, the Ashley Plaza Shopping Center, the Lancer Center, and the Salisbury Marketplace Shopping Center. The Flex Center Property segment consists of Brookfield Center, the Greenbrier Business Center, and the Parkway property. The STNL Properties segment consists of the Citibank property, an outparcel at its Salisbury Marketplace property, and the Hanover Square outparcel. The company was founded on September 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.
info.description_zh: Medalist Diversified, Inc. 從事創收財產的收購、重新定位、翻新、租賃和管理。它專注於商業房地產，包括靈活工業和零售房地產、多戶住宅房地產和有限服務酒店房地產。該公司透過以下部門營運：Retail Center Properties、Flex Center Property 和 STNL Properties。零售中心地產部門包括富蘭克林廣場商店、阿什利廣場購物中心、蘭瑟中心和索爾茲伯里市場購物中心。 Flex Center 物業部分包括 Brookfield Center、Greenbrier Business Center 和 Parkway 物業。 STNL 地產部門包括花旗銀行地產、索爾茲伯里市場地產和漢諾威廣場地產。該公司成立於2015年9月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州里士滿。

info.description: Mckinley Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Needham, MA.
info.description_zh: Mckinley Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月27日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州尼達姆。

info.description: Park Dental Partners, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive business support services including clinical team members, administrative personnel, facilities and equipment. The company was founded by Gregory T. Swenson and Brian Murn in 1972 and is headquartered in Roseville, MN.
info.description_zh: Park Dental Partners, Inc. 從事提供全面的業務支援服務，包括臨床團隊成員、行政人員、設施和設備。該公司由 Gregory T. Swenson 和 Brian Murn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州羅斯維爾。

info.description: TDH Holdings, Inc. is a real estate management company, that focuses on owning, operating and managing commercial real estate properties. It provides office services for small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was founded by Rong Feng Cui on April 22, 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: TDH Holdings, Inc. 是一家房地產管理公司，專注於擁有、經營和管理商業房地產。為中小企業提供辦公服務。該公司由崔榮峰於2002年4月22日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. III 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月15日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 28, 2026 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2026 年 2 月 28 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: SurgePays, Inc. operates as a technology-driven company, which focuses on building a supply chain software platform as an alternative to traditional wholesale supply chain distribution models. It offers goods and services direct to convenience stores, bodegas, minimarts, tiendas and other corner stores, providing goods and services primarily to the underbanked community. The company was founded on August 18, 2006 and is headquartered in Bartlett, TN.
info.description_zh: SurgePays, Inc. 是一家技術驅動型公司，專注於建立供應鏈軟體平台，作為傳統批發供應鏈分銷模式的替代方案。它直接向便利商店、酒窖、迷你超市、tiendas 和其他街角商店提供商品和服務，主要向銀行服務不足的社區提供商品和服務。該公司成立於2006年8月18日，總部位於田納西州巴特利特。

info.description: Twelve Seas Investment Co. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: 十二海投資有限公司 III 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月14日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: VEON Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of connectivity and digital services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Pakistan, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Bangladesh. Additionally, the company reports its operations under Other, which includes activities in Kyrgyzstan, and HQ and eliminations, which covers management-related transactions. The company was founded by Dmitriy Borisovich Zimin and Augie K. Fabela II in 1992 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: VEON Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供連接和數位服務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：巴基斯坦、烏克蘭、哈薩克、烏茲別克和孟加拉。此外，該公司在「其他」項下報告其業務，其中包括在吉爾吉斯斯坦的活動，以及總部和抵銷，其中包括與管理相關的交易。該公司由 Dmitriy Borisovich Zimin 和 Augie K. Fabela II 於 1992 年創立，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜。

info.description: VSE Corp. is focused on significantly enhancing the productivity and longevity of its customers' high-value, business-critical assets. It operates through the Aviation segment. The Aviation segment is a provider of aftermarket parts distribution and MRO services for components and engine accessories supporting commercial, business and general aviation operators. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: VSE Corp. 致力於大幅提升客戶高價值、業務關鍵型資產的生產力與壽命。它透過航空部門運作。航空部門是為商業、公務和通用航空業者提供零件和引擎配件的售後零件分銷和 MRO 服務提供者。該公司成立於 1959 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。

info.description: W.F Holding Ltd. engages in the manufacture of fiberglass reinforced plastic and FRP products. It sells a range of FRP products, including filament wound and molded tanks, thermoplastic tanks, lining products, ducting and fitting products, air pollution control equipment, and custom-made products. The firm also offer delivery, installation and repair, maintenance services, and on-site consultation services. The company was founded on March 7, 2023 and is headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: W.F Holding Ltd. 從事玻璃纖維增強塑膠和玻璃鋼製品的製造。該公司銷售一系列玻璃鋼產品，包括纖維纏繞和模壓儲罐、熱塑性儲罐、襯裡產品、管道和配件產品、空氣污染控制設備和客製化產品。該公司還提供送貨、安裝和維修、維護服務以及現場諮詢服務。該公司成立於2023年3月7日，總部位於馬來西亞莎阿南。

info.description: WF International Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of supply, installation, fitting-out, and maintenance services for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, floor heating systems, and water purification systems. The company was founded by Ke Chen in June 2009 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.description_zh: WF International Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事暖氣、通風和空調 (HVAC) 系統、地暖系統和水淨化系統的供應、安裝、裝修和維護服務。該公司由陳柯於2009年6月創立，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd. is a holding company. It engages in the business of processing, selling, and distributing cured meat products including cured pork sausages, cured pork meat, and other cured meat products such as cured chicken, cured duck, and cured fish; snack products including ready-to-eat sausages, jerky, duck necks, duck feet, and clay pot rice; and frozen meat products including frozen sausages, frozen beef patties, and frozen chicken breast fillets. The company was founded on April 24, 2015 and is headquartered in Zhongshan, China.
info.description_zh: 永業食品控股集團有限公司是一家控股公司。從事醃製肉製品的加工、銷售和分銷業務，包括醃製豬肉香腸、醃製豬肉以及醃製雞、醃鴨、醃魚等其他醃製肉製品；即食香腸、肉乾、鴨脖、鴨腳、煲仔飯等休閒食品；以及冷凍肉類製品，包括冷凍香腸、冷凍牛肉餅和冷凍雞胸肉片。公司成立於2015年4月24日，總部位於中國中山。

info.description: TEN Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of event planning, production, and broadcasting services. The firm produces virtual, hybrid, and physical events such as live streaming and video recording. It also offers the Xyvid Pro Platform, which supports virtual and hybrid event planning, as well as production, broadcasting, and continuing education services. The company was founded on December 5, 2011 and is headquartered in Langhorne, PA.
info.description_zh: TEN Holdings, Inc. 從事提供活動規劃、製作和廣播服務。該公司製作虛擬、混合和實體活動，例如直播和錄影。它還提供 Xyvid Pro 平台，支援虛擬和混合活動策劃以及製作、廣播和繼續教育服務。該公司成立於2011年12月5日，總部位於賓州蘭霍恩。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2028, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2028 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SPY ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of the Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X Shares (NYSE ARCA: SPXL) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for an indirect exposure to the share price of the Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X Shares, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the price of the underlying ETF's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SPY ETF 尋求當前收入；該基金的次要投資目標是接觸 Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X 股票（NYSE ARCA：SPXL）的表現，但潛在投資收益受到限制。該基金是主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X 股票價格的機會，但受到標的 ETF 股票價格上漲的潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index (the "index"). The index uses a rules-based methodology that seeks to provide exposure to small-capitalization U.S. companies with above average free cash flow margins. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of small-capitalization companies ("small cap") that are principally traded in the United States. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在為自由現金流利潤率高於平均水平的美國小市值公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於主要在美國交易的小型公司（「小型股」）的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Republic Digital Acquisition Co. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 23, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Republic Digital Acquisition Co. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年1月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Northern Trust Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE All Maturity Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust免稅債券ETF尋求與ICE全到期市政債券指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的結果。基礎指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares Corporate Bond ETF seeks maximum current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in corporate bonds, and in related derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to corporate bonds. The fund will invest primarily in investment-grade securities, but may invest up to 10% of its net assets in below-investment-grade corporate credit securities, which are sometimes referred to as high-yield or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 公司債 ETF 尋求最大當前收入，而不會對本金帶來不當風險。一般情況下，基金至少80%的淨資產投資於公司債，以及相關衍生性商品和其他具有與公司債類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金將主要投資於投資等級證券，但最多可將其淨資產的 10% 投資於低於投資等級的企業信貸證券，這些證券有時被稱為高收益或「垃圾」債券。

info.description: Aura Minerals, Inc. engages in the development and operation of gold, copper, and base metal projects in the Americas. It operates through the following segments: Minosa Mine, Apoena Mine, the Aranzazu Mine, Almas Mine, and Borborema Project. The company was founded on July 12, 1946 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aura Minerals, Inc. 在美洲從事金、銅和賤金屬專案的開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：Minosa 礦、Apoena 礦、Aranzazu 礦、Almas 礦和 Borborema 計畫。该公司成立于 1946 年 7 月 12 日，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: Avantis Credit ETF seeks to maximize total return. The fund invests primarily in investment grade quality debt obligations from a diverse group of U.S. and non-U.S. issuers. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in fixed income securities. Fixed income securities in which the fund may invest as part of its principal strategy are corporate bonds and notes issued by U.S. and foreign corporations, securities issued by governments and their agencies, instrumentalities, or sponsored corporations-including supranational organizations.
info.description_zh: Avantis Credit ETF 尋求最大化總回報。該基金主要投資於來自不同美國和非美國發行人的投資等級優質債務。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於固定收益證券。作為其主要策略的一部分，該基金可投資的固定收益證券包括美國和外國公司發行的公司債券和票據、政府及其機構、機構或贊助公司（包括超國家組織）發行的證券。

info.description: iShares Emerging Markets Bond Active ETF seeks to maximize total return from a combination of income and capital growth. The fund will invest primarily in a portfolio of bonds of sovereigns and public sector and private sector companies located in, or tied economically to, emerging market countries that are predominantly denominated in U.S. Dollars, Euros, Sterling and other hard currencies. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in the bonds of issuers domiciled or exercising the predominant part of their economic activity in, emerging market countries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Emerging Markets Bond Active ETF 寻求最大化收入和资本增长相结合的总回报。該基金將主要投資於位於新興市場國家或與新興市場國家有經濟聯繫的主權國家以及公共部門和私營部門公司的債券投資組合，這些債券主要以美元、歐元、英鎊和其他硬通貨計價。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於在新興市場國家註冊或進行主要經濟活動的發行人的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nordson Corp. engages in the engineering, manufacture and market of products and systems used for adhesives, coatings, sealants, biomaterials and other materials. It operates through the following segments: Industrial Precision Solutions, Medical and Fluid Solutions and Advanced Technology Solution. The Industrial Precision Solutions segment enhances the technology synergies between adhesive dispensing systems and industrial coating systems to deliver proprietary dispensing and processing technology to diverse end markets. The Medical and Fluid Solutions segment includes components and device solutions for medical, life science, high-tech industrial and other diverse end markets. The Advanced Technology Solution segment integrates proprietary product technologies found in progressive stages of a customer's production processes, such as surface treatment, precisely controlled dispensing of material and post-dispense test and inspection to ensure quality. The company was founded by Eric T. Nord, Evan W. Nord and Walter G. Nord in 1954 and is headquartered in Westlake, OH.
info.description_zh: Nordson Corp. 從事用於黏合劑、塗料、密封劑、生物材料和其他材料的產品和系統的工程、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：工業精密解決方案、醫療和流體解決方案以及先進技術解決方案。工業精密解決方案部門增強了黏合劑點膠系統和工業塗層系統之間的技術協同作用，為不同的終端市場提供專有的點膠和加工技術。醫療和流體解決方案部門包括用於醫療、生命科學、高科技工業和其他多元化終端市場的組件和設備解決方案。先進技術解決方案部門整合了客戶生產流程各個階段的專有產品技術，例如表面處理、精確控制的材料分配以及分配後測試和檢查，以確保品質。該公司由 Eric T. Nord、Evan W. Nord 和 Walter G. Nord 於 1954 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州韋斯特萊克。

info.description: Touchstone Dynamic International ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include common stocks, preferred stocks, depositary receipts such as American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") and European Depositary Receipts ("EDRs"), Real Estate Investment Trusts ("REITs"), and interests in other investment companies, including other exchange-traded funds that invest in equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone Dynamic International ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於非美國公司的股本證券。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證（「GDR」）和歐洲存託憑證（「EDR」）等存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）以及其他投資公司的權益，包括其他投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金。

info.description: Even Herd Long Short ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund, an actively-managed ETF, seeks to achieve its investment objective by taking both long and short positions in equity securities. Even Herd, LLC, the fund's sub-adviser, employs its proprietary algorithm to manage the fund's portfolio, seeking to maintain a consistent 100% long exposure to equity securities. In addition, the fund's short exposure will vary between 10% to 60%.
info.description_zh: 即使是 Herd Long Short ETF 也尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過持有股票證券的多頭和空頭部位來實現其投資目標。甚至該基金的副顧問 Herd, LLC 也採用其專有演算法來管理該基金的投資組合，力求保持一致的 100% 股票證券多頭敞口。此外，該基金的空頭部位將在10%至60%之間變化。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2030. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index (the "underlying index"). It may also invest in short-term paper, cash and cash equivalents, including shares of money market funds advised by BFA or its affiliates. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2030 and December 15, 2030, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2030 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數（「基礎指數」）標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。它還可以投資短期票據、現金和現金等價物，包括 BFA 或其附屬機構建議的貨幣市場基金股票。標的指數由計劃於 2030 年 1 月 1 日至 2030 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: NEOS Boosted S&P 500 High Income ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 Index while generating high monthly income and enhanced market participation. The fund invests approximately 100% of its assets in the common stocks of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and utilizes a synthetic options strategy to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure, alongside a data-driven call option overlay designed to convert upside potential into distributable cash flow.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted S&P 500 High Income ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 指數的總回報，同時產生高月收入並增強市場參與度。該基金將約 100% 的資產投資於構成標準普爾 500 指數的美國大型公司的普通股，並利用合成選擇權策略創建約 150% 的名義投資組合敞口，以及數據驅動的看漲期權疊加，旨在將上漲潛力轉化為可分配現金流。

info.description: WisdomTree Voya Yield Enchanced USD Universal Bond Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Universal Enhanced Yield Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in the component securities of the index. The index is comprised of USD-denominated bonds. The index deconstructs the USD-denominated bond market, as represented by USD-denominated, taxable bonds that are rated either investment grade or high yield, into one of the five categories of debt. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Voya 收益率增強型美元通用債券基金旨在追蹤彭博美國通用增強型收益率指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，將投資於指數的組成證券。該指數由以美元計價的債券組成。該指數將以美元計價的債券市場（以投資等級或高收益評級的美元計價應稅債券為代表）分解為五類債務之一。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2031. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2031 and December 15, 2031, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2031 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由計劃於 2031 年 1 月 1 日至 2031 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI composed of large-, mid- and small-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF 旨在追蹤由大、中、小型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: Themes Cybersecurity ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Cyber Security Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the cybersecurity industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Cyber​​security ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Cyber​​ Security Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在網路安全產業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司，其註冊目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: CoinShares Plc provides entertainment and business software development & web portals services. The company was founded on August 29, 2025 and is headquartered in St. Helier, the United Kingdom.

info.description: IDX Alternative FIAT ETF provides exposure to precious metals (gold, silver) and major digital assets (Bitcoin, Ethereum) via futures, crypto ETPs and metal ETPs with a stated risk-managed, inflation/currency-hedge objective and judicious use of leverage up to 1.25x.
info.description_zh: IDX 另類法定 ETF 透過期貨、加密貨幣 ETP 和金屬 ETP 提供貴金屬（黃金、白銀）和主要數位資產（比特幣、以太幣）的投資，並具有明確的風險管理、通膨/貨幣對沖目標，並明智地使用高達 1.25 倍的槓桿。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2033 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2033 (collectively, "2033 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 高收益公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益公司債 2033 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合的表現，這些債券在 2033 年到期，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」（統稱為「2033 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 23, 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營，其創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2020年11月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: GDEV, Inc. operates as a gaming and entertainment holding company, which oversees a diverse portfolio of studios focused on developing and publishing live-service games across multiple platforms and genres. Its portfolio includes studios specializing in mobile, browser, and PC games, as well as captivating intellectual properties spanning various genres. The company's franchises include hero wars, island hoppers, pixel gun 3D, and others. The company was founded by Andrey Fadeev and Boris Gertsovsky in 2010 and is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
info.description_zh: GDEV, Inc. 是一家遊戲和娛樂控股公司，負責監管多元化的工作室組合，專注於跨多個平台和類型開發和發布即時服務遊戲。其產品組合包括專門從事行動、瀏覽器和電腦遊戲的工作室，以及涵蓋各種類型的迷人智慧財產權。該公司的特許經營遊戲包括《英雄戰爭》、《島嶼跳躍者》、《像素槍 3D》等。該公司由 Andrey Fadeev 和 Boris Gertsovsky 於 2010 年創立，總部位於塞浦路斯利馬索爾。

info.description: Polar Power, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of direct current (DC) power systems. Its products include DC generators, Back-up DC generators, hybrid power systems, Li-Ion battery system, and Marine DC generators. The company was founded by Arthur D. Sams in 1979 and is headquartered in Gardena, CA.
info.description_zh: Polar Power, Inc. 從事直流 (DC) 電源系統的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括直流發電機、備用直流發電機、混合動力系統、鋰離子電池系統和船用直流發電機。該公司由 Arthur D. Sams 於 1979 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州加迪納。

info.description: SPDR S&P Emerging Markets ex-China ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the S&P Emerging ex-China BMI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities comprising the index. The index is a float-adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to define and measure the investable universe of publicly traded companies domiciled in emerging markets, excluding China. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR 標普新興市場（中國除外）ETF 尋求提供在扣除費用和支出之前大致與標普新興市場（中國除外）BMI 相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於構成指數的證券。該指數是一個浮動調整市值加權指數，旨在定義和衡量新興市場（不包括中國）上市公司的可投資範圍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Symmetry Panoramic Sector Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its assets primarily among (i) shares of ETFs that each focus on common stocks of companies included in an individual sector of the U.S. large capitalization universe, as such sectors are determined by the Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) and/or (ii) common stocks of companies included in the Equity Sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Symmetry Panoramic Sector Momentum ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過將其資產主要配置在 (i) ETF 份額中來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 份額均專注於美國大型資本領域中單個部門所包含的公司的普通股，因為這些部門由全球行業分類標準 (GICS) 確定，和/或 (ii) 股票部門所包含的公司的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Abits Group, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet media marketing services in China and bitcoin mining and related services in the United States. It is the operator of the Games Channel of the Xinhua App, an application developed and operated by Xinhua New China News Agency. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Abits Group, Inc.在中國提供網路媒體行銷服務，在美國提供比特幣挖礦及相關服務。它是新華社開發和運營的應用程式“新華社”遊戲頻道的運營商。公司成立於2013年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Horizon NASDAQ-100 Defined Risk ETF seeks capital appreciation and capital preservation. Horizon Investments, LLC ("Horizon" or the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing primarily in Flexible Exchange Options ("FLEX Options") that provide exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and implementing an options-based strategy that seeks to generate income, manage volatility and reduce downside risk.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n NASDAQ-100 定義風險 ETF 尋求資本增值和資本保值。 Horizo​​n Investments, LLC（「Horizo​​n」或「顧問」）尋求透過主要投資於提供納斯達克 100 指數曝險的靈活交易選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）並實施旨在產生收入、管理波動性和降低下行風險的基於選擇權的策略來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: First Internet Bancorp engages in the provision of online commercial and retail banking products and services. It offers first-lien residential mortgage loans, consumer loans and credit cards & CRE loans in Indiana and other parts of the midwest in the form of office, retail, industrial, and multifamily loans, with credit tenant lease financing. The company was founded on September 15, 2005 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: First Internet Bancorp 從事提供線上商業和零售銀行產品及服務。該公司在印第安納州和中西部其他地區以辦公室、零售、工業和多戶住宅貸款的形式提供第一留置權住宅抵押貸款、消費貸款、信用卡和商業房地產貸款，並提供信用租戶租賃融資。該公司成立於2005年9月15日，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: TNL Mediagene engages in digital advertising, integrated marketing, marketing survey, artificial intelligence technology, data analysis, content service platform, and production of audio-visual programs. It operates media, technology, and digital studio businesses primarily in Japan and Taiwan. The company was founded on May 25, 2023 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: TNL Mediagene 從事數位廣告、整合行銷、行銷調查、人工智慧技術、數據分析、內容服務平台和視聽節目製作。該公司主要在日本和台灣經營媒體、科技和數位工作室業務。該公司成立於2023年5月25日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Verde Clean Fuels, Inc. engages in the provision of renewable gasoline, which is derived from diverse feedstocks including biomass, municipal solid waste, and mixed plastics. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Verde Clean Fuels, Inc. 從事提供可再生汽油，這些汽油源自多種原料，包括生物質、都市固體廢物和混合塑膠。該公司成立於 2004 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd. engages in the gaming entertainment business. It operates through the Gaming and iGaming business divisions. The Gaming business division develops and publishes social casinos and casual games. The iGaming business division refers to development and operation of license-based online casinos. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd.從事遊戲娛樂業務。它透過遊戲和網路遊戲業務部門運作。遊戲業務部門開發和發布社交賭場和休閒遊戲。 iGaming業務部門是指基於許可的線上賭場的開發和營運。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: New Century Logistics (BVI) Ltd. is a holding company, which is doing business through its subsidiaries, providing air and ocean export and import freight forwarding & logistics services. It offers cargo space, cargo pick up, off-airport air cargo security screening, palletization, preparation of shipping documentation, arrangement of customs clearance to cargo handling at ports and other related services. The company was founded on April 24, 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: New Century Logistics (BVI) Ltd.是一家控股公司，透過其子公司開展業務，提供空運和海運出口和進口貨運代理及物流服務。提供艙位、取貨、機場外空運貨物安檢、打托盤、準備運輸文件、安排清關到港口貨物裝卸等相關服務。公司成立於2019年4月24日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. engages in the development of ocean robots that are controlled through an AI-driven cloud software platform, which enables a sliding scale spectrum of autonomous operations. It offers an aquanaut, hydronaut, argonaut, ToolKITT, and olympic arms. The company was founded by Nicolaus Adam Radford and Reginald Bruce Berka on March 27, 2014 and is headquartered in Webster, TX.
info.description_zh: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. 從事海洋機器人的開發，這些機器人透過人工智慧驅動的雲端軟體平台進行控制，從而實現了自主操作的滑動範圍。它提供了 Aquanaut、Hydronaut、Argonaut、ToolKITT 和 Olympic Arms。該公司由 Nicolaus Adam Radford 和 Reginald Bruce Berka 於 2014 年 3 月 27 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州韋伯斯特。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PhenixFIN Corp. is an internally-managed non-diversified closed-end management investment company. Its investment objective is to generate current income and capital appreciation. The company was founded on April 23, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: PhenixFIN Corp. 是一家內部管理的非多元化封閉式管理投資公司。其投資目標是產生當期收入和資本增值。該公司成立於2010年4月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of approximately 70 securities of domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的約 70 種國內和國際非金融公司證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的組成證券。

info.description: Burney U.S. Equity Select ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that provides core U.S. equity exposure through a systematic stock selection process refined over five decades. The strategy utilizes a proprietary quantitative model to evaluate securities across a multi-factor framework, Growth, Valuation, Profitability, Quality, and Momentum, while incorporating forward-looking machine learning signals to identify companies with revenue potential overlooked by traditional metrics.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Equity Select ETF 是一檔主動式管理的非多元化基金，透過五年來完善的系統選股流程提供核心美國股票投資。此策略利用專有的定量模型來跨多因素框架（成長、估值、獲利能力、品質和動量）評估證券，同時結合前瞻性機器學習訊號來識別具有被傳統指標忽視的收入潛力的公司。

info.description: WEBs Materials XLB Defined Volatility ETF is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the U.S. large-cap materials sector while employing a systematic, rules-based strategy to target a specific annual volatility rate. The fund dynamically adjusts its market exposure between 0% and 200% based on recent realized volatility, increasing exposure through derivatives when market fluctuations are low and reducing exposure to cash when volatility exceeds the target.
info.description_zh: WEBs Materials XLB 定義波動率 ETF 是一款被動管理基金，提供對美國大盤材料行業的投資，同時採用系統化的、基於規則的策略來瞄準特定的年度波動率。該基金根據近期實現的波動率在0%至200%之間動態調整其市場敞口，當市場波動較低時透過衍生性商品增加敞口，當波動率超過目標時減少現金敞口。

info.description: Texxon Holding Ltd. provides supply chain management services in East China. Its services include the sale of plastic, chemical raw materials, and other plastic raw materials. Its products are used in fabrics, coastings, resins, beverage packing, other downstream products, pipelines and pipes used in infrastructure, daily or food grade packing and agriculture membranes. The company was founded on January 20, 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 德盛控股有限公司在華東地區提供供應鏈管理服務。其服務包括銷售塑膠、化學原料及其他塑膠原料。其產品用於織物、海岸線、樹脂、飲料包裝、其他下游產品、基礎設施、日用或食品級包裝和農業膜中使用的管道和管道。公司成立於2022年1月20日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Equal Weight ETF is a non-diversified, index-based strategy that provides exposure to the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market using an equal-weighted methodology. The fund offers a balanced path to the Nasdaq-100 universe by assigning an initial 1% weight to each constituent, effectively mitigating the single-stock and mega-cap concentration risk inherent in market-capitalization-weighted strategies
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 等權重 ETF 是一種非多元化、基於指數的策略，採用等權重方法提供對納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大非金融公司的投資。該基金為每個成分股分配初始 1% 的權重，為進入納斯達克 100 指數提供了一條平衡的路徑，有效降低了市值加權策略中固有的單股和大型股集中風險

info.description: Global X Thematic Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Thematic Growth Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to provide broad exposure to thematic growth strategies using a portfolio of exchange-traded funds (each, an "underlying ETF"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 主題成長 ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 主題成長指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在利用交易所交易基金（每隻「基礎 ETF」）投資組合提供對主題成長策略的廣泛投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Massimo Group engages in the manufacture and distribution of powersports vehicles and recreational watercraft. It offers farm and ranch tested utility terrain vehicles, recreational all-terrain vehicles, and Americana style mini-bikes, and pontoon boats. The company was founded by David Shan and Rod N. Santomassimo on October 10, 2022 and is headquartered in Garland, TX.
info.description_zh: Massimo 集團從事動力運動車輛和休閒船隻的製造和分銷。它提供經過農場和牧場測試的多功能越野車、休閒全地形車、美式迷你自行車和浮橋船。該公司由 David Shan 和 Rod N. Santomassimo 於 2022 年 10 月 10 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州加蘭。

info.description: JATT II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 13, 2026, and is headquartered in Westfield, NJ.
info.description_zh: JATT II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，致力於與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2026年1月13日，總部位於新澤西州韋斯特菲爾德。

info.description: Drilling Tools International Corp. engages in the rental of directional drilling tools, wellbore optimization tools and other drilling products. It operates through the following geographical segments: Western Hemisphere and Eastern Hemisphere. The Western Hemisphere segment focuses on providing a comprehensive range of downhole drilling tools and services primarily for onshore and offshore operations across North America and Latin America. The Eastern Hemisphere segment represents the company's strategic expansion into Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, focusing on delivering advanced drilling solutions for both land and offshore markets. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Drilling Tools International Corp. 從事定向鑽井工具、井眼優化工具和其他鑽井產品的租賃。它透過以下地理區域運作：西半球和東半球。西半球部門專注於提供全面的井下鑽井工具和服務，主要用於北美和拉丁美洲的陸上和海上作業。東半球部門代表了該公司向歐洲、中東和亞太地區的策略性擴張，專注於為陸地和海上市場提供先進的鑽井解決方案。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Transportation ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Transportation IndexTM. The fund invests at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the transportation sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克交通 ETF 尋求與納斯達克美國智慧交通指數TM 的價格和收益率（未計基金費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括運輸業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Horizon Digital Frontier ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in equity securities of U.S. and foreign (non-U.S.) companies that offer exposure to emerging technologies that are in various phases of development. The fund's investments may include common stocks, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and securities of other ETFs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Digital Frontier ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於美國和外國（非美國）公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些公司提供處於不同發展階段的新興技術的投資。該基金的投資可能包括普通股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和其他 ETF 的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF seeks calendar month investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund will enter into one or more swaps with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF 尋求不計費用和開支的日曆月投資結果，相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆月業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆月表現提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金將與全球主要金融機構進行一項或多項掉期，其中該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在 Invesco QQQ Trust 上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Axogen, Inc. engages in the development and marketing of surgical solutions for peripheral nerve regeneration and repair. It provides products and educational resources to improve surgical treatment algorithms for peripheral nerve damage or discontinuity. Its products include Avance Nerve Graft, Axoguard Nerve Connector, Axoguard Nerve Protector, Avive Soft Tissue Membrane, AcroVal Neurosensory and Motor Testing System, and AxoTouch Two-Point Discriminator. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Alachua, FL.
