info.description: Workhorse Group, Inc. engages in the provision of sustainable solutions to the commercial transportation sector. It operates as an original equipment manufacturer, which designs and builds battery-electric vehicles including trucks and aircraft. The company was founded by Stephen S. Burns on February 20, 2007 and is headquartered in Wixom, MI.
info.description_zh: Workhorse Group, Inc. 致力於為商業運輸領域提供永續解決方案。它是一家原始設備製造商，設計和製造電池電動車，包括卡車和飛機。該公司由 Stephen S. Burns 於 2007 年 2 月 20 日創立，總部位於密西根州威克瑟姆。

info.description: Newell Brands, Inc. is a global consumer goods company, which engages in the business of manufacturing, marketing, and selling consumer and commercial products. It operates through the following segments: Home and Commercial Solutions, Learning and Development, Outdoor and Recreation, and Corporate. The Home and Commercial Solutions segment includes designing, manufacturing, sourcing, marketing, and distributing a diverse line of household products including kitchen appliances, food and home storage, fresh preserving, vacuum sealing, gourmet cookware, bakeware, cutlery, and home fragrance products, as well as commercial cleaning and maintenance solutions products, closet and garage organization products, hygiene systems, and material handling solutions. The Learning and Development segment focuses on writing instruments including markers, highlighters, pens, and pencils, art products, activity-based products, labeling solutions, baby gear, and infant care products. The Outdoor and Recreation segment offers global consumer active lifestyle products for outdoor and outdoor-related activities including technical apparel and on-the-go beverageware. The Corporate segment provides general corporate services. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Newell Brands, Inc. 是一家全球消費品公司，從事製造、行銷和銷售消費品和商業產品的業務。它透過以下部門運作：家庭和商業解決方案部門、學習和發展部門、戶外和休閒部門以及企業部門。家庭和商業解決方案部門包括設計、製造、採購、行銷和分銷各種家用產品，包括廚房電器、食品和家庭儲存、保鮮、真空密封、美食炊具、烘焙用具、餐具和家用香薰產品，以及商業清潔和維護解決方案產品、壁櫥和車庫組織產品、衛生系統和材料處理解決方案。學習和發展部門專注於書寫工具，包括記號筆、螢光筆、鋼筆和鉛筆、藝術產品、基於活動的產品、標籤解決方案、嬰兒用品和嬰兒護理產品。戶外和休閒部門為全球消費者提供用於戶外和戶外相關活動的積極生活方式產品，包括技術服裝和隨身飲料。企業部門提供一般企業服務。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Great Elm Group, Inc. engages in providing investment management and real estate management services. It focuses on the business of growing a portfolio of long-duration and permanent capital vehicles across credit, real estate, specialty finance, and other alternative strategies. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Group, Inc. 從事提供投資管理和房地產管理服務。它專注於發展信貸、房地產、專業金融和其他另類策略的長期和永久資本工具投資組合的業務。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ANET ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE: ANET). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund manager is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of fund's assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 ANET ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Arista Networks, Inc.（NYSE：ANET）每日股價變動百分比的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。基金經理人預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的基金資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. engages in the provision of pet health and wellness services. It operates across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, including a growing network, store veterinary hospitals, and offer a complete online resource for pet health and wellness. The firm offers grooming, as well as in-store and online training. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. 从事提供宠物健康和保健服务。該公司的業務遍及美國、墨西哥和波多黎各，包括不斷發展的網路、商店獸醫醫院，並提供完整的寵物健康線上資源。该公司提供美容服务以及店内和在线培训。该公司成立于 1965 年，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。

info.description: Xerox Holdings Corp. is a workplace technology company, which builds and integrates software and hardware for enterprises. It operates through the Print and Other, and Financing (FITTLE) segments. The company was founded on March 11, 2019, and is headquartered in Norwalk, CT.
info.description_zh: 施樂控股公司是一家工作場所技術公司，為企業建立和整合軟體和硬體。它透過印刷和其他以及融資 (FITTLE) 部門運作。該公司成立於2019年3月11日，總部位於康乃狄克州諾沃克。

info.description: Enveric Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company which engages in the development of neuroplastogenic small-molecule therapeutics for the treatment of depression, anxiety, addiction, and other psychiatric disorders. The company was founded on February 28, 1994 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Enveric Biosciences, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於開發神經質體小分子療法，用於治療憂鬱、焦慮、成癮和其他精神疾病。該公司成立於1994年2月28日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Terra Innovatum Global NV operates as a holding company that offers micro-reactor solutions. It engages in the development of nuclear micro modular solutions focused on clean energy. The firm's nuclear technology, the SOLO features a thermally-moderated, gas-cooled nuclear reactor core that operates with standard enrichment U235 and conventional Zircaloy-cladded UO2 fuel pellets. The company was founded on April 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Lucca, Italy.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Terra Innovatum Global NV 作為一家提供微反應器解決方案的控股公司運作。它致力於開發專注於清潔能源的核子微型模組化解決方案。該公司的核子技術 SOLO 採用熱慢化氣冷核反應器堆芯，採用標準濃縮 U235 和傳統鋯合金包層 UO2 燃料芯塊運作。該公司成立於2025年4月29日，總部位於義大利盧卡。

info.description: FatPipe, Inc. engages in the development of software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) solutions for organizations, including enterprises, communication service providers, security service providers, government organizations, and other middle-market companies. Its products include WARP, MPVPN, SD-WAN, Fatpipe Orchestrator, Next Gen Firewall, 5G and LTE, FatPipe Total Security 360, SASE, SIEM, EnterpriseView, and Cloud Connect. The company was founded by Ragula Bhaskar and Sanchaita Datta on October 14, 2010 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: FatPipe, Inc. 致力於為企業、通訊服務供應商、安全服務供應商、政府組織和其他中間市場公司等組織開發軟體定義的廣域網路 (SD-WAN) 解決方案。其產品包括 WARP、MPVPN、SD-WAN、Fatpipe Orchestrator、新一代防火牆、5G 和 LTE、FatPipe Total Security 360、SASE、SIEM、EnterpriseView 和 Cloud Connect。該公司由 Ragula Bhaskar 和 Sanchaita Datta 於 2010 年 10 月 14 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Adagio Medical Holdings, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the development ablation technologies for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. It treats atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, and ventricular tachycardia. The company was founded on August 24, 2020 and is headquartered in Laguna Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Adagio Medical Holdings, Inc.是一家醫療器材公司，致力於開發治療心律不整的消融技術。它可以治療心房顫動、心房撲動和心室心搏過速。該公司成立於2020年8月24日，總部位於加州拉古納山。

info.description: Niki Biosolutions, Inc. is a nonprofit organization company, focused on cancer prevention, HIV/AIDS awareness and treatment support. The company is headquartered in Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Niki Biosolutions, Inc. 是一家非營利組織公司，專注於癌症預防、愛滋病毒/愛滋病意識和治療支持。該公司總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. is multi-platform media company, which engages in the operation of radio stations in the United States. The firm offers marketing solutions across event platforms. It operates through the following business segments: Audio, Digital, and Other. The company was founded by George G. Beasley in 1961 and is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc.是一家多媒體平台公司，在美國從事廣播電台的營運。該公司提供跨活動平台的營銷解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：音訊、數位和其他。該公司由 George G. Beasley 於 1961 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long Futu Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of FUTU. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of FUTU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund manager will pay the premium for each call option contract bought and receive the premium for each put option sold. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股份2倍長富途每日ETF尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未扣除費用和開支）為FUTU普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具組合起來可提供 FUTU 價格 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。基金經理人將為買入的每份看漲期權合約支付權利金，並為賣出的每份看跌期權合約收取權利金。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Byrna Technologies, Inc. is a less-lethal self-defense technology company, which engages in the business of developing, manufacturing, and selling innovative less-lethal personal security solutions. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, South Africa, Europe, South America, and Asia, and Canada. The company was founded on March 1, 2005 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.
info.description_zh: Byrna Technologies, Inc. 是一家低致命性自衛技術公司，從事開發、製造和銷售創新的低致命性個人安全解決方案業務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、南非、歐洲、南美洲、亞洲和加拿大。該公司成立於2005年3月1日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州安多佛。

info.description: Giftify, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of its subsidiary, Restaurant.com. It operates through the following divisions: Business to Customer (B2C), Business to Business (B2B), and other business. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Schaumburg, IL.
info.description_zh: Giftify, Inc. 擁有並經營其子公司 Restaurant.com。它透過以下部門運作：企業對客戶 (B2C)、企業對企業 (B2B) 和其他業務。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州紹姆堡。

info.description: Hydrofarm Holdings Group, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of controlled environment agriculture equipment and supplies. It offers lighting, atmospheric control, hydroponics, nutrients and additives, growing media, plant care and pest and disease control, seed starting and cloning, garden accessories, and food storage products. The firm operates through the U.S. and Canada geographical segments. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Shoemakersville, PA.
info.description_zh: Hydrofarm Holdings Group, Inc. 從事受控環境農業設備和用品的製造和分銷。它提供照明、大氣控制、水耕、營養物質和添加劑、生長介質、植物護理和病蟲害控制、種子起始和克隆、花園配件以及食品儲存產品。該公司透過美國和加拿大地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於 1977 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州舒梅克斯維爾。

info.description: SenesTech, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of proprietary technology for the management of animal pest populations. The firm focuses on rat populations through fertility control. It offers its ContraPest product to residential and commercial sectors such as animal, structural, and food markets. The company was founded by Loretta P. Mayer and Cheryl A. Dyer on July 27, 2004 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: SenesTech, Inc. 從事動物害蟲族群管理專有技術的開發和商業化。該公司專注於透過生育控制來控制老鼠數量。該公司向住宅和商業領域（例如動物、結構和食品市場）提供 ContraPest 產品。該公司由 Loretta P. Mayer 和 Cheryl A. Dyer 於 2004 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Kustom Entertainment, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of digital audio, video recording, and speed detection devices. It operates through the following segments: Video Solutions, Revenue Cycle Management, and Entertainment. The Video Solutions segment includes video recording products and services for law enforcement and commercial customers and the sale of Shield disinfectant and personal protective products. The Revenue Cycle Management Segment consists of medical billing subsidiaries. The Entertainment segment focuses on ticketing services provided through TicketSmarter and its online platform, TicketSmarter.com. The company was founded on December 13, 2000 and is headquartered in Overland Park, KS.
info.description_zh: Kustom Entertainment, Inc. 從事數位音訊、錄影和速度檢測設備的設計、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：視訊解決方案部門、收入週期管理部門和娛樂部門。視訊解決方案部門包括為執法和商業客戶提供錄影產品和服務，以及銷售 Shield 消毒劑和個人防護產品。收入周期管理部門由醫療計費子公司組成。娛樂部門專注於透過 TicketSmarter 及其線上平台 TicketSmarter.com 提供的票務服務。該公司成立於2000年12月13日，總部位於堪薩斯州歐弗蘭帕克。

info.description: Megan Holdings Ltd. engages in the development, construction, and maintenance of aquaculture farms and related works. It offers upgrading and maintenance of aquaculture and agriculture farms, design and development of new aquaculture and agriculture farms, and the sourcing of industrial supplies and rental of machinery for agriculture and aquaculture purposes. The company was founded in September 2020 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Megan Holdings Ltd.從事水產養殖場及相關工程的開發、建設及維護。它提供水產養殖和農業農場的升級和維護、新水產養殖和農業農場的設計和開發，以及工業用品的採購和農業和水產養殖機械的租賃。該公司成立於2020年9月，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: The Growhub Ltd. engages in the provision of product traceability and authenticity solutions through the GrowHub Platform. It also provides product trading facilitation services. The company was founded by Choon Yew Chan in January 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Growhub Ltd. 透過 GrowHub 平台提供產品可追溯性和真實性解決方案。它還提供產品交易便利服務。該公司由 Choon Yew Chan 於 2020 年 1 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Focus Universal, Inc. engages in the development and manufacture of universal smart devices. Its technology features a Universal Smart Instrumentation Platform (USIP), a hardware and software integration platform that provides solutions for embedded design, industrial control and monitoring. It also offers Ubiquitor, universal smart controller, and sensors. The company was founded by Desheng Wang on December 4, 2012 and is headquartered in West Covina, CA.
info.description_zh: Focus Universal, Inc.從事通用智慧型裝置的開發與製造。其技術以通用智慧儀表平台（USIP）為特色，這是一個硬體和軟體整合平台，為嵌入式設計、工業控制和監控提供解決方案。它還提供 Ubiquitor、通用智慧控制器和感測器。該公司由王德勝於2012年12月4日創立，總部位於加州西科維納。

info.description: Fusemachines, Inc. engages as a global provider of enterprise AI products and services. The firm leverages its proprietary AI studio and AI engines to offer enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that enable organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. It serves industries including healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, and government. The company was founded by Sameer Maskey on November 16, 2012 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Fusemachines, Inc. 是一家全球企業人工智慧產品和服務供應商。該公司利用其專有的人工智慧工作室和人工智慧引擎提供企業人工智慧產品和專業服務，使任何規模的組織都能夠實施和擴展人工智慧。它服務的行業包括醫療保健、金融、零售、製造和政府。該公司由 Sameer Maskey 於 2012 年 11 月 16 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: GlucoTrack, Inc. designs, develops, and commercializes non-invasive glucose monitoring devices for use by persons suffering from diabetes. The company offers the GlucoTrack model DF-F glucose monitoring device, which utilizes a patented combination of ultrasound, electromagnetic and thermal technologies to obtain glucose measurements. The company was founded by Avner Gal and David Malka in September 2001 and is headquartered in Rutherford, NJ.
info.description_zh: GlucoTrack, Inc. 設計、開發和商業化供糖尿病患者使用的非侵入性血糖監測設備。該公司提供 GlucoTrack 型號 DF-F 血糖監測設備，該設備利用超音波、電磁和熱技術的專利組合來獲得血糖測量結果。該公司由 Avner Gal 和 David Malka 於 2001 年 9 月創立，總部位於新澤西州盧瑟福。

info.description: Kandal M Venture Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture of leather goods through its subsidiary. The firm's products include handbags, shoulder bags, crossbody bags, tote bags, backpacks, satchels, and wallets. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States of America, Europe, Canada, Japan, and Others. The company was founded on January 16, 2024 and is headquartered in Takhmao, Cambodia.
info.description_zh: Kandal M Venture Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事皮革製品製造。該公司的產品包括手提包、單肩包、斜背包、手提包、背包、斜背包和皮夾。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、歐洲、加拿大、日本和其他地區。該公司成立於2024年1月16日，總部位於柬埔寨大金奧。

info.description: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd. engages in asset management services to logistics property investors including funds, family offices, property owners, and high-net-worth individuals. It operates through Construction Management and Engineering Design Services and Asset Management and Professional Consultancy Services segments. The company was founded by Hau Lim Chung and Chun Yip Yiu in 2015 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd. 為物流房地產投資者（包括基金、家族辦公室、業主和高淨值人士）提供資產管理服務。它透過施工管理和工程設計服務以及資產管理和專業諮詢服務部門運作。該公司由 Hau Lim Chung 和 Chun Yip Yao 於 2015 年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Cycurion, Inc. engages in custom solutions to organizations for information technology (IT) and cybersecurity needs. It offers consulting and advisory, managed IT, and managed security services. The company was founded by Alvin McCoy and Emmit McHenry in 2017 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Cycurion, Inc. 致力於為組織提供滿足資訊技術 (IT) 和網路安全需求的客製化解決方案。它提供諮詢和諮詢、託管 IT 和託管安全服務。該公司由 Alvin McCoy 和 Emmit McHenry 於 2017 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Nuwellis, Inc. operates as a medical device company. It engages in the provision of products for the treatment of fluid overload. The firm's products include Aquadex FlexFlow System, which provides an ultrafiltration for the removal of salt and water in patients with hypervolemia, or fluid overload. It operates through Cardiac and Coronary Disease Products segment. The company was founded by Crispin Marsh and William S. Peters in November 1999 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.
info.description_zh: Nuwellis, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司。它從事提供治療液體超負荷的產品。該公司的產品包括 Aquadex FlexFlow 系統，​​該系統提供超濾功能，用於去除血液體積過多或液體超負荷患者的鹽和水。它透過心臟和冠心病產品部門運作。該公司由 Crispin Marsh 和 William S. Peters 於 1999 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊甸園草原。

info.description: YXT.COM Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of digital learning platforms. It integrates software and content through its SaaS model to assist customers in corporate learning. The company was founded by Xiao Yan Lu, Teng Zu and Jie Ding in November 2011 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: YXT.COM Group Holding Ltd.從事提供數位學習平台業務。它透過SaaS模式整合軟體和內容，協助客戶進行企業學習。該公司由陸曉燕、騰祖和丁傑於2011年11月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: Preformed Line Products Co. engages in the provision of products and systems employed in the construction and maintenance of overhead and underground networks for the energy, telecommunication, cable operators, information, and other similar industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: PLP-USA, Americas, Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA), and Asia-Pacific. The PLP-USA segment is involved in manufacturing traditional products primarily supporting domestic energy, telecommunications, and solar products. The Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific segments focuses on supporting energy, telecommunications, data communication, and solar products in each respective geographical region. The company was founded by Thomas F. Peterson in 1947 and is headquartered in Mayfield Village, OH.
info.description_zh: Preformed Line Products Co. 致力於為能源、電信、電纜運營商、資訊和其他類似行業提供用於架空和地下網路建設和維護的產品和系統。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：PLP-美國、美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA) 以及亞太地區。 PLP-USA 部門從事製造主要支持國內能源、電信和太陽能產品的傳統產品。美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區則專注於支援各個地理區域的能源、電信、數據通訊和太陽能產品。該公司由 Thomas F. Peterson 於 1947 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州梅菲爾德村。

info.description: T Stamp, Inc. engages in development of proprietary artificial intelligence-powered solutions. It also focuses on researching and leveraging machine learning artificial intelligence, including computer vision, cryptography, and data mining, to process and protect data for identification against fraud. The company was founded by Gareth Genner, Andrew Gowasack, Catherine Lambert and Mike Lindenau on November 9, 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: T Stamp, Inc. 致力於開發專有的人工智慧驅動解決方案。它還專注於研究和利用機器學習人工智慧，包括電腦視覺、密碼學和資料探勘，來處理和保護資料以防止詐欺。該公司由 Gareth Genner、Andrew Gowasack、Catherine Lambert 和 Mike Lindenau 於 2015 年 11 月 9 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Magnite, Inc. provides a technology solution to automate the purchase and sale of digital advertising inventory for buyers and sellers. It features applications and services for digital advertising sellers including websites, mobile applications, and other digital media properties. The company was founded by Frank Addante, Duc Chau, Craig Roah, Julie Mattern and Brian D. Baumgart on April 20, 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Magnite, Inc. 提供了一種技術解決方案，可為買家和賣家自動購買和銷售數位廣告庫存。它為數位廣告銷售商提供應用程式和服務，包括網站、行動應用程式和其他數位媒體資產。該公司由 Frank Addante、Duc Chau、Craig Roah、Julie Mattern 和 Brian D. Baumgart 於 2007 年 4 月 20 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Backblaze, Inc. operates as a cloud provider for businesses and consumers to store, use, and protect their data. The firm provides a foundation for businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals to store, backup, and archive data, host content, manage media, and build their applications. It also offers B2 Cloud Storage and Computer Backup services. The company was founded by Timothy Nufire, Gleb Budman, Charles Jones, Kwok Hang Ng, Brian Wilson, Nilay Patel and Damon Uyeda in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Backblaze, Inc. 是一家雲端供應商，為企業和消費者儲存、使用和保護其資料。該公司為企業、開發人員、IT 專業人員和個人提供儲存、備份和歸檔資料、託管內容、管理媒體和建立應用程式的基礎。它還提供 B2 雲端儲存和電腦備份服務。該公司由 Timothy Nufire、Gleb Budman、Charles Jones、Kwok Hang Ng、Brian Wilson、Nilay Patel 和 Damon Uyeda 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: DMC Global, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of technical products and services in the energy, industrial, and infrastructure markets. It operates through the following business segments: Arcadia Products, NobelClad and DynaEnergetics. The Arcadia Products segment designs, engineers, fabricates, and finishes aluminum framing systems, windows, curtain walls, storefronts, entrance systems, and interior partitions to the commercial construction market. The NobelClad segment produces explosion-welded clad metal plates for the construction of corrosion resistant industrial processing equipment and specialized transition joints. The DynaEnergetics segment designs, manufactures, and distributes products utilized by the global oil and gas industry principally for the perforation of oil and gas wells. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: DMC Global, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於在能源、工業和基礎設施市場提供技術產品和服務。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：Arcadia Products、NobelClad 和 DynaEnergetics。 Arcadia Products 部門為商業建築市場設計、建造、製造和裝飾鋁框架系統、窗戶、帷幕牆、店面、入口系統和內部隔間。 NobelClad 部門生產爆炸焊接複合金屬板，用於建造耐腐蝕工業加工設備和專用過渡接頭。 DynaEnergetics 部門設計、製造和分銷全球石油和天然氣產業主要用於石油和天然氣井射孔的產品。該公司成立於 1965 年，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: AirJoule Technologies Corp. operates as a thermal energy and water harvesting technology company. It provides efficient and sustainable air conditioning and pure water from air through its transformational AirJoule technology. The company was founded on March 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Ronan, MT.
info.description_zh: AirJoule Technologies Corp. 是一家熱能和水收集技術公司。它透過其變革性的 AirJoule 技術提供高效、可持續的空調和空氣中的純淨水。該公司成立於 2024 年 3 月 14 日，總部位於蒙大拿州羅南。

info.description: DoorDash, Inc. engages in the design, development, and operation of a food delivery and logistics platform. It serves consumers in the United States, Canada, and Australia. The company was founded by Andy Fang, Tony Xu, Stanley Tang, and Evan Moore on January 12, 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: DoorDash, Inc. 從事食品配送和物流平台的設計、開發和營運。它為美國、加拿大和澳洲的消費者提供服務。該公司由 Andy Fang、Tony Xu、Stanley Tang 和 Evan Moore 於 2013 年 1 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: First Trust Cloud Computing ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an equity index called the ISE CTA Cloud Computing Index TM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies involved in the cloud computing industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust 雲端運算 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 ISE CTA 雲端運算指數 TM 的股票指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤雲端運算產業公司的業績。

info.description: Electra Battery Materials Corp. engages in the refining, acquisition, and exploration of resource properties. Its project portfolio includes Iron Creek, Becancour, Ontario Refinery and North American Nickel. The company was founded on July 13, 2011 and is headquartered Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Electra Battery Materials Corp. 從事資源資產的精煉、收購和勘探。其項目組合包括 Iron Creek、Becancour、Ontario Refinery 和 North American Nickel。該公司成立於2011年7月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLK ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLK Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the technology sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLK ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLK 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場科技業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity and equity-related securities (namely, common and preferred stock, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts, warrants, rights and participatory notes) of or related to Next Gen Technologies Companies located throughout the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於位於世界各地的下一代技術公司或與其相關的股票和股票相關證券（即普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證、認股權證、權利和參與票據）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Developed Markets ex-US Small Cap AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Developed Markets Ex-US Small Cap Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Developed Markets Ex-US Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 已開發市場（美國除外）小型股 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 已開發市場（美國除外）小型股指數的股票指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克發達市場（美國除外）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Themes Generative Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Generative Artificial Intelligence Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in AI related industries. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Generative Artificial Intelligence ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Generative Artificial Intelligence Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在人工智慧相關行業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Supply Chain ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity, ADR securities, and non-U.S. developed and emerging market-listed securities, which over time may vary as market and investment opportunities change. The fund may also enter into currency-related spot transactions when it transacts in equities denominated in foreign currencies or invest in certain derivative instruments, such as currency futures or forwards that will help the adviser manage risk associated with foreign currency exposure, if any, or futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎變革供應鏈ETF尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於美國上市股票、ADR 證券以及非美國已開發和新興市場上市證券，隨著時間的推移，這些證券可能會隨著市場和投資機會的變化而變化。當基金進行以外幣計價的股票交易或投資某些衍生性商品（例如貨幣期貨或遠期合約）時，也可能會進行與貨幣相關的現貨交易，這將有助於顧問管理與外幣風險（如有）或期貨合約相關的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard Equity Megatrends ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The portfolio will seek to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in an actively managed portfolio of established, well managed companies located around the world, including emerging markets. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity and equity-related securities (including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), and Global Depositary Receipts). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Equity Megatrends ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該投資組合將透過主要投資於由位於世界各地（包括新興市場）的成熟、管理良好的公司組成的積極管理的投資組合來尋求實現其投資目標。正常情況下，投資組合至少80%的淨資產投資於股票和股票相關證券（包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Littelfuse, Inc. is an industrial technology manufacturing company, which engages in the business of designing, manufacturing, and selling electronic components, modules, and subassemblies to empower the long-term secular growth themes of sustainability, connectivity, and safety. It operates through the following segments: Electronics, Transportation, and Industrial. The Electronics segment includes a broad range of end markets including industrial motor drives, power conversion, automotive electronics, electric vehicle and related charging infrastructure, aerospace, power supplies, data centers and telecommunications, medical devices, alternative energy and energy storage, building and home automation, appliances, and mobile electronics. The Transportation segment focuses on circuit protection, power control, and sensing technologies for global original equipment manufacturers, tier-one suppliers and parts, and aftermarket distributors in passenger vehicle, heavy-duty truck and bus, off-road and recreational vehicles, material handling equipment, agricultural machinery, construction equipment, and other commercial vehicle end markets. The Industrial segment offers industrial circuit protection, industrial controls, and temperature sensors for use in various applications such as renewable energy and energy storage systems, industrial safety, factory automation, electric vehicle infrastructure, HVAC systems, non-residential construction, MRO, and mining. The company was founded by Edward V. Sundt in 1927 and is headquartered in Rosemont, IL.
info.description_zh: Littelfuse, Inc. 是一家工業技術製造公司，從事設計、製造和銷售電子元件、模組和組件的業務，以實現永續發展、連接性和安全性等長期成長主題。它透過以下部門運作：電子、運輸和工業。電子部門包括廣泛的終端市場，包括工業馬達驅動、電源轉換、汽車電子、電動車和相關充電基礎設施、航空航太、電源、資料中心和電信、醫療設備、替代能源和能源儲存、樓宇和家庭自動化、家用電器和行動電子產品。運輸部門專注於為乘用車、重型卡車和公共汽車、越野和休閒車、物料搬運設備、農業機械、建築設備和其他商用車終端市場的全球原始設備製造商、一級供應商和零件以及售後分銷商提供電路保護、電源控制和感測技術。工業部門提供工業電路保護、工業控制和溫度感測器，用於各種應用，例如再生能源和儲能係統、工業安全、工廠自動化、電動汽車基礎設施、HVAC 系統、非住宅建築、MRO 和採礦。該公司由 Edward V. Sundt 於 1927 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州羅斯蒙特。

info.description: IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of its underlying index, the IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index seeks to provide exposure to innovative companies by investing in the equities of companies that have high research and development ("R&D") spending around the world. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the investments included in its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IQ 全球股票研發領袖 ETF 尋求與其標的指數 IQ 全球股票研發領袖指數（「標的指數」）的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的結果。該指數旨在透過投資全球研發（「R＆D」）支出較高的公司的股票來提供對創新公司的投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於其基礎指數中包含的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM US Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic large capitalization equity securities. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. investments.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM US Core ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資主要投資於國內大市值股票證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於美國。

info.description: Thornburg International Growth ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund adviser expects to invest primarily in equity securities or depositary receipts of non-U.S. developed market issuers selected for their growth potential. Thornburg, the fund's investment adviser, intends to invest in companies that it believes have growth characteristics, such as growing revenues and earnings or the prospect for such growth in revenues or earnings. The fund can invest in companies of any size, from larger, well-established companies to smaller, emerging growth companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg International Growth ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金顧問預計將主要投資於根據成長潛力而選擇的非美國已開發市場發行人的股本證券或存託憑證。該基金的投資顧問桑伯格打算投資於它認為具有成長特徵的公司，例如收入和收益不斷增長或收入或收益有成長前景的公司。該基金可以投資任何規模的公司，從大型、成熟的公司到小型、新興的成長型公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization companies based on their positioning, relative to their sector peers, with respect to the transition to a low-carbon economy, as determined by the index provider, based primarily on current emissions intensity, emissions reduction targets, green business revenue, and/or climate risk management. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤由美國大中型企業組成的 MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index 的投資結果，該指數由指數提供商根據當前排放強度、減排目標、綠色業務收入和/或氣候風險管理確定的相對於行業同行的定位，確定向低碳經濟轉型。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Walt Disney Co. engages in the business of international family entertainment and media enterprise. It owns and operates television and radio production, distribution and broadcasting stations, direct-to-consumer services, amusement parks, and hotels. It operates through the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Parks, Experiences, and Products. The company was founded by Walter Elias Disney on October 16, 1923 and is headquartered in Burbank, CA.
info.description_zh: 華特迪士尼公司從事國際家庭娛樂和媒體業務。它擁有並經營電視和廣播製作、發行和廣播電台、直接面向消費者的服務、遊樂園和酒店。它透過以下業務部門運作：迪士尼娛樂、ESPN 以及迪士尼樂園、體驗和產品。該公司由沃爾特·埃利亞斯·迪士尼 (Walter Elias Disney) 於 1923 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州伯班克。

info.description: JPMorgan Managed Futures Plus ETF combines a strategic, long-term large-capitalization U.S. equity exposure with a systematic, model-driven managed futures strategy that takes long and short positions globally across equities, fixed income, currencies, and commodities. The fund implements its multi-asset framework via direct stock investments and substantial derivative exposures, while managing a portion of its commodity risk through a wholly owned Cayman Islands subsidiary.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通管理期貨Plus ETF將戰略性長期大盤美國股票敞口與系統化、模型驅動的管理期貨策略相結合，該策略在全球範圍內持有股票、固定收益、貨幣和大宗商品的多頭和空頭頭寸。該基金透過直接股票投資和大量衍生性商品曝險實施其多元資產框架，同時透過全資擁有的開曼群島子公司管理部分商品風險。

info.description: IQ U.S. Large Cap R&D Leaders ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of its underlying index, the IQ U.S. Large Cap R&D Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index seeks to provide exposure to innovative companies by investing in the equities of U.S. large cap companies that have high research and development ("R&D") spending. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the investments included in its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IQ U.S. Large Cap R&D Leaders ETF 尋求與其標的指數 IQ U.S. Large Cap R&D Leaders Index（「標的指數」）的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的結果。該指數旨在透過投資研發（「R＆D」）支出較高的美國大型公司的股票來提供對創新公司的投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於其基礎指數中包含的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bridges Capital Tactical ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed, diversified exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a blend of passively managed U.S. equity index ETFs, large-capitalization equity securities and cash or cash equivalents. It is expected that the fund will generally hold 5 to 20 investments selected from a universe that includes large-capitalization U.S. equity securities and passively managed index ETFs tracking U.S. small-, mid- and large-capitalization equity indexes (the "Indexes").
info.description_zh: Bridges Capital Tactical ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的多元化交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於被動管理的美國股指ETF、大盤股本證券和現金或現金等價物的組合來實現其投資目標。預計該基金通常將持有 5 至 20 項投資，這些投資選自大盤股美國股票證券和追蹤美國小型股、中盤股和大盤股指數（「指數」）的被動管理指數 ETF。

info.description: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the total return performance of Hartford US Quality Growth Index that tracks the performance of exchange traded U.S. large cap equity securities and is designed to consist of U.S. equities with favorable growth characteristics while maintaining what is considered to be enhanced exposure to quality while also providing reasonable exposure to value and momentum. The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in securities of the Index and in depositary receipts representing securities of the index.
info.description_zh: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF 力求提供與 Hartford US Quality Growth Index 的總回報表現相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支），該指數跟踪交易所交易的美國大盤股證券的表現，旨在由具有良好增長特徵的美國股票組成，同時保持被認為增強的質量敞口，同時提供合理的價值和動量。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數證券和代表指數證券的存託憑證。

info.description: Ishares Copper And Metals Mining ETF seeks to track the investment results of the STOXX Global Copper and Metals Mining Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. equities of companies primarily engaged in copper and metal ore mining. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 銅和金屬礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球銅和金屬礦業指數的投資結果，該指數由主要從事銅和金屬礦石開採的公司的美國和非美國股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF is a non-diversified exchange-traded fund that provides targeted, "pure-play" exposure to the global rare earths industry while specifically excluding companies domiciled in or primarily operating within China. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the mining, separation, refining, and production of rare earth elements (REEs), catering to investors seeking to capitalize on the geopolitical realignment of critical material supply chains.
info.description_zh: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF 是一款非多元化交易所交易基金，提供針對全球稀土行業的有針對性的「純粹」投資，同時明確排除在中國註冊或主要在中國運營的公司。該基金追蹤參與稀土元素 (REE) 開採、分離、精煉和生產的公司指數，迎合尋求利用關鍵材料供應鏈地緣政治重組的投資者。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Hedged Advantage ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities that is intended to substantially replicate the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Index and utilizing an option overlay strategy designed to partially hedge the fund's downside exposure when equity markets decline. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 對沖優勢 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該管理人尋求透過主要投資於美國股票證券投資組合來實現其投資目標，該投資組合旨在大幅複製納斯達克 100 指數的表現，並利用旨在部分對沖股市下跌時基金下行風險的期權疊加策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Hedged Equity Laddered Overlay ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The manager seeks to provide capital appreciation through participation in the broad equity markets while hedging overall market exposure relative to traditional long-only equity strategies. The manager seeks to provide capital appreciation through participation in the broad equity markets while hedging overall market exposure relative to traditional long-only equity strategies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克對沖股票階梯疊加 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。管理人尋求透過參與廣泛的股票市場來提供資本增值，同時對沖相對於傳統多頭股票策略的整體市場風險。管理人尋求透過參與廣泛的股票市場來提供資本增值，同時對沖相對於傳統多頭股票策略的整體市場風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility QQQ ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility Triple Q's Index. The manager implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 22%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility QQQ ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility Triple Q 指數表現相對應的投資結果。管理人透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 Invesco QQQ TrustSM 系列 1 的表現，基礎 ETF 的投資曝險根據 22% 的目標年度波動率進行調整。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust RiverFront Dynamic Emerging Markets ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in a portfolio of equity securities of emerging market companies, including through investments in common stock, depositary receipts, and common and preferred shares of real estate investment trusts, and forward foreign currency exchange contracts and currency spot transactions used to hedge the fund's exposure to the currencies in which the equity securities of such emerging market companies are denominated. The fund may invest in small, mid and large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust RiverFront Dynamic Emerging Markets ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於新興市場公司的股本證券投資組合，包括投資於普通股、存託憑證、房地產投資信託的普通股和優先股，以及用於對沖基金對此類新興市場公司股本證券計價貨幣的風險的遠期外匯兌換合約和貨幣即期交易。該基金可投資於小型、中型和大型資本公司。

info.description: iShares Core S&P U.S. Growth ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 900 Growth Index composed of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. equities that exhibit growth characteristics. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: iShares Core S&P U.S. Growth ETF 旨在追蹤由具有成長特徵的大中型美國股票組成的 S&P 900 成長指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。

info.description: Xtrackers Nifty 500 India ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nifty 500 Index. The underlying index measures the equity performance of the top 500 companies traded on the NSE based on full market capitalization that meet certain eligibility requirements. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Nifty 500 India ETF 尋求與 Nifty 500 指數未計費用和開支的表現大致相符的投資結果。基礎指數根據滿足特定資格要求的總市值衡量 NSE 交易的前 500 家公司的股票表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies identified as global leaders in disruptive innovation. The strategy integrates a top-down evaluation of secular growth trends with a fundamental bottom-up analysis to select 150 to 250 high-quality companies distinguished by advanced technologies, superior business models, and significant research and development expenditures.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於被認定為全球顛覆性創新領導者的公司的多元化投資組合，實現長期資本成長。該策略將長期成長趨勢自上而下的評估與自下而上的基本分析相結合，選出150至250家以先進技術、卓越商業模式和大量研發支出為特色的優質公司。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the common stock of Freeport-McMoRan Inc. The fund employs a leveraged strategy to amplify the daily performance of its underlying security through the use of financial derivative instruments and direct investment.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF 是一款交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Freeport-McMoRan Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金採用槓桿策略，透過使用金融衍生工具和直接投資來放大其基礎證券的每日表現。

info.description: Global X Disruptive Materials ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Disruptive Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that produce metals and other raw or composite materials that have been identified as being essential to disruptive technologies such as lithium batteries, solar panels, wind turbines, fuel cells, robotics, and 3D printers. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 顛覆性材料 ETF 尋求與 Solactive 顛覆性材料指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於該指數的證券以及基於該指數的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該指數旨在為那些生產金屬和其他原材料或複合材料的公司提供投資機會，這些材料被認為對鋰電池、太陽能電池板、風力渦輪機、燃料電池、機器人和 3D 列印機等顛覆性技術至關重要。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Copper Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Copper Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Argent Focused Small Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of small-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Focused Small Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資小型公司的股權證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - October seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM. The fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - 10 月旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ TrustSM 價格回報相匹配的回報。該基金將其大部分資產投資於 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Growth Opportunities ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities. Although it invests primarily in publicly traded U.S. securities, it may invest up to 20% of its Net Assets in foreign securities, including securities of issuers in countries with emerging markets or economies ("emerging countries") and securities quoted in foreign currencies. The fund may invest in companies of any market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛成長機會 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於股本證券。儘管其主要投資於公開交易的美國證券，但最多可將其淨資產的 20% 投資於外國證券，包括新興市場或經濟體國家（「新興國家」）發行人的證券以及以外幣報價的證券。該基金可以投資於任何市值的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies based in countries classified as emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由新興市場國家的大型資本公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: Cambria Global EW 2 ETF is an actively managed fund that provides broad global equity exposure by investing directly in publicly traded common stocks, preferred stocks, depositary receipts, and real estate investment trusts, or indirectly through other exchange-traded funds. The strategy focuses predominantly on global large-capitalization companies-with a significant weight allocated to the 500 largest publicly traded companies worldwide-while maintaining the flexibility to include mid- and small-capitalization companies across developed, developing, and emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Cambria Global EW 2 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過直接投資於公開交易的普通股、優先股、存託憑證和房地產投資信託，或透過其他交易所交易基金間接投資，提供廣泛的全球股票部位。該策略主要關注全球大型資本公司（其中全球最大的 500 家上市公司的權重很大），同時保持包括已開發市場、發展中市場和新興市場的中小型資本公司的靈活性。

info.description: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. is a traded business development company, which engages in investing in middle market companies located in the United States. The fund focuses on companies operating across a broad range of sectors. It provides financing in the form of secured debt including first lien, second lien debt, unsecured debt, mezzanine subordinated debt, and equity securities for buyout transactions. The firm acquires controlling interest. The company was founded on February 5, 2015 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. 是一家交易業務開發公司，致力於投資位於美國的中間市場公司。該基金專注於跨多個行業運營的公司。它以擔保債務的形式提供融資，包括第一留置權債務、第二留置權債務、無擔保債務、夾層級債務和用於收購交易的股本證券。該公司獲得控股權。該公司成立於2015年2月5日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Thrivent International Small Cap ETF provides exposure to a well-diversified portfolio of small-capitalization equity securities issued by companies in non-U.S. developed markets across growth, value, and core investment styles. The Fund utilizes an active strategy combining quantitative analysis and fundamental research to seek long-term capital appreciation from international developed small-cap equities relative to its benchmark, the MSCI EAFE Small Cap Index.
info.description_zh: Thrivent International Small Cap ETF 提供非美國已開發市場公司發行的多元化小型股證券投資組合，涵蓋成長型、價值型和核心投資風格。該基金採用定量分析和基本面研究相結合的積極策略，從國際發達小型股中尋求相對於其基準 MSCI EAFE 小型股指數的長期資本增值。

info.description: Blackrock U.S. Industry Rotation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S.-listed equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德美國產業輪動ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於在美國上市的股本證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors, styles (e.g., value or growth), and industry groups or ETFs that provide similar exposure to U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域、風格（例如價值或成長）的美國公司，以及為美國公司提供類似曝險的產業集團或 ETF。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cambria Tax Aware ETF seeks to provide a tax-efficient investment return consisting of capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchanged-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity securities that have a market capitalization of greater than $5 billion. Utilizing its own quantitative model, the fund's investment sub-adviser, Cambria Investment Management, L.P. ("Cambria" or the "Sub-Adviser") selects value stocks with lower dividend distributions, which are generally taxed as ordinary income.
info.description_zh: Cambria Tax Aware ETF 旨在提供包括資本增值在內的節稅投資回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於市值超過 50 億美元的美國上市股票證券。該基金的投資副顧問 Cambria Investment Management, L.P.（「Cambria」或「副顧問」）利用自己的量化模型，選擇股息分配較低的價值股票，這些股票通常作為普通收入徵稅。

info.description: Russell Inv Global Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities. The fund invests principally in equity securities, including common stocks and preferred stocks, of companies economically tied to a number of countries around the world, including the US, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies, in a globally diversified manner.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Global Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值加上用於投資目的的借款的至少80%投資於股本證券。該基金主要以全球多元化的方式投資於與包括美國在內的世界許多國家有經濟聯繫的公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表這些公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index (the "underlying index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of U.S. equity securities included in the S&P 500 Index that maintain alignment with a broad understanding of the moral and biblical teachings of Christians. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於相關指數的證券。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤標準普爾 500 指數中包含的美國股票證券的表現，該指數與對基督徒道德和聖經教義的廣泛理解保持一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: RACWI US ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the RACWI U.S. Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to seek to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is comprised of U.S. listed companies selected based on a proprietary methodology developed and maintained by RAFI Indices, LLC. The index was created to provide exposure to U.S. listed companies based on a fundamental value factor instead of market capitalization alone. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: RACWI US ETF 旨在追蹤 RACWI 美國指數（未計費用和開支）的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由根據 RAFI Indices, LLC 開發和維護的專有方法選擇的美國上市公司組成。該指數的創建是為了根據基本價值因素而不是僅根據市值來提供對美國上市公司的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. Adaptive Moving Average Fund utilizes a systematic trend-following overlay to dynamically allocate between U.S. large-cap equities and U.S. Treasury bills based on prevailing market momentum. The strategy is designed to provide full equity participation during uptrends while proactively reducing net exposure and shifting to cash equivalents during periods of high volatility or downward price trends to mitigate significant drawdowns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree美國自適應移動平均基金利用系統性趨勢追蹤疊加，根據當前市場勢頭在美國大盤股和美國國債之間進行動態配置。該策略旨在在上漲趨勢期間提供全面的股權參與，同時在高波動或價格下跌趨勢期間主動減少淨敞口並轉向現金等價物，以減輕大幅回撤。

info.description: Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF is an actively managed, unconstrained portfolio that invests in growth equities across developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. Utilizing a research-driven, bottom-up fundamental selection process with a typical investment horizon of at least five years, the fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by targeting companies with strong structural advantages and distinct growth potential outside its primary benchmark, the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index.
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF 是一種主動管理、不受約束的投資組合，投資於已開發市場和新興市場（美國除外）的成長型股票。該基金採用研究驅動、自下而上的基本面選擇流程，典型投資期限至少為五年，透過瞄準在其主要基準 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數之外具有強大結構優勢和明顯增長潛力的公司來尋求長期資本增值。

info.description: Janus Henderson Mid Cap Growth Alpha ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of mid-capitalization ("mid cap") companies selected for their growth potential. The advisor uses an active, systematic strategy designed to select mid-sized capitalization growth stocks using a proprietary quantitative methodology.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Mid Cap Growth Alpha ETF 尋求長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於因其成長潛力而選擇的中等市值（「中盤」）公司的股本證券。該顧問採用主動、系統化的策略，旨在使用專有的定量方法選擇中等市值的成長型股票。

info.description: VanEck Consumer Disc TruSector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in equity securities of consumer discretionary-related companies or instruments that provide exposure to consumer discretionary-related companies as determined by the adviser. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Consumer Disc TruSector ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場情況下將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於非必需消費品相關公司的股本證券或顧問確定的向非必需消費品相關公司提供投資的工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. engages in the mining of copper, gold, and molybdenum. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Copper Mines, South America Operations, Indonesia Operations, Molybdenum Mines, U.S. Rod and Refining, Atlantic Copper, and Corporate and Other. The U.S. Copper Mines segment operates open-pit copper mines in Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami in Arizona and Chino, and Tyrone in New Mexico. The South America Operations segment includes Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The Indonesia Operations segment handles the operations of the Grasberg minerals district that produce copper concentrate containing significant quantities of gold and silver. The Molybdenum Mines segment includes the Henderson underground mine and Climax open pit mine, both in Colorado. The U.S. Rod and Refining segment consists of copper conversion facilities located in North America and includes refinery and rod mills. The Atlantic Copper segment smelts and refines copper concentrate and markets refined copper and precious metals in slimes. The Corporate and Other segment offers other mining and eliminations, oil and gas operations, and other corporate and elimination items. The company was founded by James R. Moffett on November 10, 1987, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. 從事銅、金和鉬的開採。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國銅礦部門、南美業務部門、印尼業務部門、鉬礦部門、美國棒材和精煉部門、大西洋銅業部門以及企業及其他部門。美國銅礦部門在亞利桑那州的莫倫西、巴格達、薩福德、謝里塔、邁阿密和新墨西哥州的奇諾和蒂龍經營露天銅礦。南美洲業務部門包括秘魯的Cerro Verde 和智利的El Abra。印尼業務部門負責格拉斯伯格礦區的業務，該礦區生產含有大量金和銀的銅精礦。鉬礦部門包括位於科羅拉多州的亨德森地下礦和 Climax 露天礦場。美國棒材和精煉部門由位於北美的銅轉化設施組成，包括精煉廠和棒材軋鋼機。大西洋銅業部門冶煉和精煉銅精礦，並銷售精煉銅和礦泥中的貴金屬。公司及其他部門提供其他採礦和消除、石油和天然氣業務以及其他公司和消除項目。該公司由 James R. Moffett 於 1987 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Technology ETF is an income-oriented investment strategy designed to maximize weekly distributions primarily through an options-based strategy of selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track three times the daily performance of its underlying sector benchmark. The fund aims to capture three times the premium income generated from standard option writing on the sector index, pairing high yield potential with secondary, capped capital appreciation and a discretionary downside protection element.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Technology ETF 是一種以收入為導向的投資策略，旨在主要透過基於期權的策略來最大化每週分配，即出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追踪其基礎行業基準日表現的三倍。該基金的目標是獲取行業指數標準選擇權寫作所產生的三倍溢價收入，將高收益潛力與二級資本增值上限和可自由支配的下行保護要素相結合。

info.description: The Fund's investment objective is to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the Target Outcome Period. In seeking to achieve this investment objective, the Fund's upside cap over the period January 1, 2025 through June 30, 2025. Under normal market conditions, the Fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in investments that provide exposure to securities included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The Fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF").
info.description_zh: 該基金的投資目標是為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 在目標結果期內的前 12%（未計費用和開支）損失提供下行緩衝。為了實現這一投資目標，該基金在2025年1月1日至2025年6月30日期間的上漲上限。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於提供納斯達克100指數所含證券曝險的投資。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金將其大部分資產投資於景順 QQQ 信託系列 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。

info.description: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the basic materials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家基礎材料產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Data Enhanced International Equity ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities issued by non-U.S. issuers across developed and emerging markets. The investment strategy employs a quantitative, bottom-up stock selection process to build a broadly diversified portfolio of large- and mid-capitalization international companies across major global sectors.
info.description_zh: 高盛數據增強型國際股票 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於已開發市場和新興市場的非美國發行人發行的股票證券，實現長期資本增值。此投資策略採用定量、由下而上的選股流程，建立廣泛多元化的投資組合，涵蓋全球主要產業的大中型資本國際公司。

info.description: Warren Street Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in equity securities selected by Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") that provide exposure to companies of all sizes located around the world. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Warren Street 全球股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資 Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC（「副顧問」）選擇的股票證券來實現其投資目標，這些股票向世界各地各種規模的公司提供投資。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於股本證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly inhibit tumors to treat specific types of cancer and other diseases. Its pipeline includes Varlilumab, CDX-1140, and CDX-301, and CDX-3379. The company was founded by Anthony S. Marucci and Tibor Keler in 1983 and is headquartered in Hampton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in speccess have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in species soo diseases.其管道包括 Varlilumab、CDX-1140、CDX-301 和 CDX-3379。该公司由 Anthony S. Marucci 和 Tibor Keler 于 1983 年创立，总部位于新泽西州汉普顿。

info.description: Jpmorgan Equity Focus ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities. "Assets" means net assets, plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes. In implementing its main strategies, the fund invests primarily in common stocks and real estate investment trusts (REITs), but it may also invest up to 20% of its total assets in common stocks of foreign companies, including depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通股票焦點 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。一般情況下，基金至少80%的資產投資於股本證券。 「資產」指淨資產加上用於投資目的的借款金額。在實施其主要策略時，該基金主要投資於普通股和房地產投資信託基金（REIT），但也可能將其總資產的最多20%投資於外國公司的普通股，包括存託憑證。

info.description: BlackRock Long-Term U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital growth. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. issuers and derivatives with similar economic characteristics. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in equity securities of foreign issuers, including ADRs and GDRs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德長期美國股票 ETF 致力於實現長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於美國發行人的股本證券和具有類似經濟特徵的衍生性商品。它可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於外國發行人的股本證券，包括 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Yoke Core ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a dynamic, tactical asset allocation portfolio across domestic and international equity markets. It invests in domestic and international equity securities (including common stock, other ETFs, real estate investment trusts ("REITs"), American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs")).
info.description_zh: Yoke Core ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於國內和國際股票市場的動態、戰術性資產配置組合來實現其投資目標。它投資於國內和國際股票證券（包括普通股、其他ETF、房地產投資信託（「REIT」）、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」））。

info.description: eGain Corp. engages in the development, licensing, implementation, and support of customer service infrastructure software solutions. Its solutions include financial services, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, ecommerce, helpdesks, and marketing. The company was founded by Ashutosh Roy and Gunjan K. Sinha on September 10, 1997 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: eGain Corp. 從事客戶服務基礎設施軟體解決方案的開發、授權、實施和支援。其解決方案包括金融服務、保險、零售、旅遊和酒店、電子商務、服務台和行銷。該公司由 Ashutosh Roy 和 Gunjan K. Sinha 於 1997 年 9 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Newmont Corp. engages in the exploration and acquisition of gold properties, containing copper, silver, lead, zinc or other metals. It operates through the following geographical segments: Canada, Mexico, Suriname, Argentina, Peru, Australia, Papua New Guinea, Ghana, and U.S. The company was founded by William Boyce Thompson on May 2, 1921 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: 紐蒙特公司從事黃金礦產的勘探和收購，其中含有銅、銀、鉛、鋅或其他金屬。該公司在以下地理區域開展業務：加拿大、墨西哥、蘇利南、阿根廷、秘魯、澳洲、巴布亞紐幾內亞、迦納和美國。該公司由 William Boyce Thompson 於 1921 年 5 月 2 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy that leverages artificial intelligence ("AI") and natural language processing to derive a proprietary News Media Sentiment Signal (the "Sentiment Signal"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large, mid and small capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過利用人工智慧（「AI」）和自然語言處理來得出專有的新聞媒體情緒訊號（「情緒訊號」）的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市的大、中、小型資本公司的證券。

info.description: lululemon athletica, Inc. engages in the business of designing, distributing, and retailing technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories. It operates through the following segments: Company-Operated Stores, Direct to Consumer, and Other. The company was founded by Dennis James Wilson in 1998 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: lululemon sportsa, Inc. 從事設計、分銷和零售技術運動服裝、鞋類和配件的業務。它透過以下部門運作：公司自營商店部門、直接面向消費者部門和其他部門。該公司由 Dennis James Wilson 於 1998 年創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - January seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the one-year Target Outcome Period. The fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - 1 月旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上行上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1 在一年目標結果期內的前 12% 損失提供下行緩衝。該基金將其大部分資產投資於 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Transcat, Inc. engages in the provision of calibration and laboratory instrument services. It operates through the following business segments: Service and Distribution. The Service segment offers calibration, repair, inspection, analytical qualifications, preventive maintenance, consulting, and other related services. The Distribution segment distributes professional grade tests, measurement, and control instrumentation. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Rochester, NY.
info.description_zh: Transcat, Inc. 從事提供校準和實驗室儀器服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務和分銷。服務部門提供校準、維修、檢查、分析鑑定、預防性維護、諮詢和其他相關服務。分銷部門分銷專業級測試、測量和控制儀器。該公司成立於 1964 年，總部位於紐約州羅徹斯特。

info.description: WisdomTree International Adaptive Moving Average Fund seeks to track a rules-based index that provides exposure to developed international large-cap equities while dynamically adjusting to U.S. Treasury bills based on market trend signals. The strategy utilizes a systematic framework incorporating a 200-day simple moving average (SMA) signal and a breadth-based overlay-measuring the percentage of constituents above their own moving averages-to manage equity exposure and mitigate downside risk during prolonged market downturns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 國際自適應移動平均基金尋求追蹤一個基於規則的指數，該指數提供對已開發國際大盤股的投資，同時根據市場趨勢訊號動態調整美國國債。該策略利用一個系統框架，其中包含 200 天簡單移動平均線 (SMA) 訊號和基於廣度的疊加（衡量成分股高於其移動平均線的百分比），以管理股票風險並減輕長期市場低迷期間的下行風險。

info.description: Vox Royalty Corp. operates as a return-focused mining royalty and streaming company. It holds a portfolio of royalties and streaming assets. The company was founded by Kyle Floyd on January 22, 2014 and is headquartered in Westminster, CO.
