info.description_zh: Vox Royal Corp. 是一家注重回報的礦業特許權使用費和串流媒體公司。它持有特許權使用費和串流媒體資產的投資組合。該公司由凱爾·弗洛伊德 (Kyle Floyd) 於 2014 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州威斯敏斯特。

info.description: Themes Robotics & Automation ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Industrial Robotics & Automation Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies whose products and services are focused on robotics and automation solutions in an industrial context. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Robotics & Automation ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive 工業機器人與自動化指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為那些產品和服務專注於工業環境中的機器人和自動化解決方案的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Brands Consumption Leaders ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek to preserve capital during adverse market conditions. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in stocks of companies that, in the view of the fund's investment sub-adviser, Accuvest Global Advisors Inc. (the "Sub-Adviser"), are leading and/or attractive brands serving consumption focused industries as identified by the Sub-Adviser.
info.description_zh: Alpha Brands Consumer Leaders ETF尋求長期資本增值；該基金的次要投資目標是在不利的市場條件下尋求保留資本。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於該基金的投資副顧問 Accuvest Global Advisors Inc.（「副顧問」）認為是服務於以消費為重點的行業的領先和/或有吸引力的品牌的公司股票來實現其投資目標。

info.description: EMCOR Group, Inc. engages in the provision of electrical and mechanical construction, and facilities services. It operates through the following segments: United States Electrical Construction and Facilities Services, United States Mechanical Construction and Facilities Services, United States Building Services, and United States Industrial Services. The United States Electrical Construction and Facilities Services segment offers systems for electrical power transmission and distribution. The United States Mechanical Construction and Facilities Services segment is involved in systems for heating, ventilation, air conditioning, refrigeration, and clean-room process ventilation. The United States Building Services segment is composed of operations which provide a portfolio of services needed to support the operation and maintenance of customers' facilities. The United States Industrial Services segment covers operations which provide industrial maintenance and services. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Norwalk, CT.
info.description_zh: EMCOR Group, Inc. 從事提供電氣和機械建築以及設施服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國電氣建築和設施服務部門、美國機械建築和設施服務部門、美國建築服務部門和美國工業服務部門。美國電氣建設和設施服務部門提供電力傳輸和分配系統。美國機械製造和設施服務部門涉及暖氣、通風、空調、冷氣和無塵室工藝通風系統。美國建築服務部門由提供支援客戶設施營運和維護所需的一系列服務的業務組成。美國工業服務部門涵蓋提供工業維護和服務的業務。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於康乃狄克州諾沃克。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% Issuer Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of emerging market companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵的新興市場公司的股票表現。

info.description: TimesSquare Quality Mid Cap Growth ETF is an actively managed fund that utilizes a research-intensive, bottom-up approach to identify a high-conviction portfolio of 30-40 mid-capitalization U.S. companies. The strategy, described as "Growth with a Conscience," prioritizes high-quality businesses with sustainable competitive advantages and proven management teams, while strictly adhering to valuation discipline to ensure entry prices are anchored in fundamental stability.
info.description_zh: TimesSquare Quality Mid Cap Growth ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，採用研究密集、自下而上的方法來確定由 30-40 家中等市值美國公司組成的高可信度投資組合。該策略被稱為“良心成長”，優先考慮具有可持續競爭優勢和成熟管理團隊的優質企業，同時嚴格遵守估值紀律，以確保進入價格穩定在基本面。

info.description: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its objective by investing primarily in equity securities of small non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include, but are not limited to, common stock, preferred stock and depositary receipts. As a non-fundamental policy, under normal market conditions, it will invest at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of non-U.S. small companies.
info.description_zh: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金尋求透過主要投資於小型非美國公司的股本證券來實現其目標。股本證券包括但不限於普通股、優先股及存託憑證。作為一項非基本面政策，在正常市場條件下，它將把至少80%的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款，投資於非美國小公司的股本證券。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600  Capped Materials Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. These companies are principally engaged in the business of producing raw materials, including producing and manufacturing chemical products; manufacturing construction materials, containers, and packaging; mining metals and the production of related products; and manufacturing paper and forest products. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Materials Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該等公司主要從事原料生產業務，包括生產及製造化學產品；製造建築材料、容器及包裝；開採金屬及相關產品的生產；以及造紙及林產品製造。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 1stdibs.com, Inc. operates as an online marketplace for home decorations, fashion, and interior design. Its business units include 1stdibs and Design Manager. It offers vintage, antique, and contemporary furniture, home decor, jewelry, watches, art, and fashion. The company was founded by Michael Bruno and Laurence Forcione in 2000 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 1stdibs.com, Inc. 是一家家居裝飾、時尚和室內設計線上市場。其業務部門包括 1stdibs 和 Design Manager。它提供復古、古董和現代家具、家居裝飾、珠寶、手錶、藝術品和時尚。該公司由 Michael Bruno 和 Laurence Forcione 於 2000 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Parametric Equity Plus ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The investment objective of the fund is to seek to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities.
info.description_zh: 參數股票加ETF旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的投資目標是尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。

info.description: Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF delivers an actively managed, research-driven framework targeting 60 to 100 high-conviction growth companies across emerging and frontier markets. Capitalizing on structural themes like artificial intelligence infrastructure, supply chain electrification, digital finance, and rising local consumption, the approach employs bottom-up fundamental selection to capture substantial long-term capital appreciation unconstrained by benchmark positioning relative to the MSCI Emerging Markets Index.
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF 提供了一個積極管理、研究驅動的框架，針對新興市場和前沿市場的 60 至 100 家高可信度成長型公司。此方法利用人工智慧基礎設施、供應鏈電氣化、數位金融和不斷增長的本地消費等結構性主題，採用自下而上的基本面選擇來捕捉長期資本增值，不受相對於 MSCI 新興市場指數的基準定位的限制。

info.description: Serve Robotics, Inc. engages in providing self-driving delivery. It designs, develops, and operates zero-emissions robots that serve people in public spaces, starting with food delivery. The company was founded by Ali Kashani, Dmitry Demeshchuk and MJ Burk Chun in 2017 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Serve Robotics, Inc. 致力於提供自動駕駛送貨服務。它設計、開發和運作零排放機器人，為公共場所的人們提供服務，從送餐開始。該公司由 Ali Kashani、Dmitry Demeshchuk 和 MJ Burk Chun 於 2017 年創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Innovative Transaction & Process ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Indxx Blockchain Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that are either actively using, investing in, developing, or have products that are poised to benefit from blockchain technology and/or the potential for increased efficiency that it provides to various business processes.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx Innovative Transaction & Process ETF 尋求與名為 Indxx 區塊鏈指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤那些正在積極使用、投資、開發或擁有有望受益於區塊鏈技術和/或它為各種業務流程提供的效率提高潛力的產品的公司的表現。

info.description: Actively managed ETF seeking capital appreciation through exposure to SpaceX and companies participating in the broader space economy.
info.description_zh: 積極管理的 ETF 透過投資 SpaceX 和參與更廣泛的太空經濟的公司尋求資本增值。

info.description: First Trust Eurozone AlphaDEX ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Eurozone Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Eurozone Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional passive-style indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Eurozone AlphaDEX ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 AlphaDEX 歐元區指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克歐元區指數中選擇相對於傳統被動型指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: State Street My2030 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a target maturity strategy, primarily investing in high-yield corporate bonds scheduled to mature in 2030. The fund utilizes a bottom-up security selection process to overweight attractive sectors and issuers while seeking to maximize current income and preserve capital as it approaches its planned liquidation date on or about December 15, 2030.
info.description_zh: State Street My2030 高收益公司債 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，採用目標到期日策略，主要投資於計劃於 2030 年到期的高收益公司債。該基金利用自下而上的證券選擇流程來增持有吸引力的行業和發行人，同時在接近 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右的計劃清算日期時尋求最大化當前收入並保留資本。

info.description: BUUU Group Ltd. is a holding company, which operates through its subsidiaries, BU Creation and BU Workshop. Its subsidiaries engage in design, planning and production of face-to-face events, immersive environments and brand-based experiences for clients and venues, including event organizers, consumer brand marketers and retail shopping centers. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: BUUU Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 BU Creation 和 BU Workshop 營運。其子公司為客戶和場所（包括活動組織者、消費品牌行銷商和零售購物中心）設計、規劃和製作面對面活動、沉浸式環境和基於品牌的體驗。該公司成立於2017年，總部位於香港。

info.description: State Street My2029 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a target maturity strategy, primarily investing in high-yield corporate bonds scheduled to mature in 2029. The fund utilizes a bottom-up security selection process to overweight attractive sectors and issuers while seeking to maximize current income and preserve capital as it approaches its planned liquidation date on or about December 15, 2029.
info.description_zh: State Street My2029 高收益公司債 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，採用目標到期日策略，主要投資於計劃於 2029 年到期的高收益公司債。該基金利用自下而上的證券選擇流程來增持有吸引力的行業和發行人，同時在接近 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右的計劃清算日期時尋求最大化當前收入並保留資本。

info.description: REX AI Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities comprising the BITA AI Leaders Select Index. It seeks to employ its investment strategy regardless of whether there are periods of adverse market, economic, or other conditions and will not seek to take temporary defensive positions during such periods. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX AI 股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於包含 BITA AI Leaders Select Index 的證券。無論是否存在不利的市場、經濟或其他條件，它都力求採用其投資策略，並且不會尋求在此期間採取臨時防禦立場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amazon.com, Inc. is a multinational technology company, which engages in the provision of online retail shopping services. It operates through the following segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The North America segment offers retail sale of consumer products, including from sellers, advertising, and subscriptions services through North America-focused online and physical stores. The International segment focuses on retail sale of consumer products, including sellers, advertising, and subscription services through internationally focused online stores. The AWS segment is composed of global sales of computers, storage, databases, and other services for start-ups, enterprises, government agencies, and academic institutions. The company was founded by Jeffrey P. Bezos in July 1994 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Amazon.com, Inc.是一家跨國科技公司，提供線上零售購物服務。它透過以下部門運作：北美部門、國際部門和亞馬遜網路服務部門 (AWS)。北美部門提供消費品零售，包括透過專注於北美的線上和實體商店提供的賣家、廣告和訂閱服務。國際部門專注於消費品零售，包括透過國際線上商店提供的賣家、廣告和訂閱服務。 AWS部門由新創公司、企業、政府機構和學術機構的電腦、儲存、資料庫和其他服務的全球銷售組成。該公司由 Jeffrey P. Bezos 於 1994 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Principal Financial Group, Inc. engages in the investment management offering business. It offers financial products and services to businesses, individuals, and institutional clients. It operates its business through the following segments: Retirement and Income Solutions, Principal Asset Management, and Benefits and Protection. The Retirement and Income Solutions Segment offers a comprehensive portfolio of products and services for retirement savings along with select products for retirement income. The Principal Asset Management segment provides global investment solutions to institutional, retirement, retail and high net worth investors in the U.S. and select emerging markets. The Benefits and Protection segment includes selling individual life insurance products. The company was founded by Edward A. Temple in 1879 and is headquartered in Des Moines, IA.
info.description_zh: 主要金融集團, Inc. 從事投資管理服務業務。它為企業、個人和機構客戶提供金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門經營業務：退休和收入解決方案部門、主要資產管理部門以及福利和保護部門。退休和收入解決方案部門提供全面的退休儲蓄產品和服務組合以及精選的退休收入產品。主要資產管理部門為美國和特定新興市場的機構、退休、零售和高淨值投資者提供全球投資解決方案。福利和保護部門包括銷售個人人壽保險產品。該公司由 Edward A. Temple 於 1879 年創立，總部位於愛荷華州得梅因。

info.description: Alpha Architect International Quantitative Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Adviser employs a multi-step, quantitative, rules-based methodology to identify a portfolio of approximately 50 to 100 non-U.S. equity securities with the highest relative momentum. A "momentum" style of investing emphasizes investing in securities that have had higher recent total return performance compared to other securities. The Adviser then employs proprietary screens to eliminate companies with issues that may negatively impact their momentum. The fund may also invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents, other investment companies, as well as securities and other instruments.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect International Quantitative Momentum ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該顧問採用多步驟、定量、基於規則的方法來確定由大約 50 至 100 種相對動量最高的非美國股票證券組成的投資組合。 「動量」投資風格強調投資於近期總回報表現高於其他證券的證券。然後，顧問採用專有篩選來消除存在可能對其發展勢頭產生負面影響的問題的公司。該基金還可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於現金和現金等價物、其他投資公司以及證券和其他工具。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, the Adviser invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2031, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund may also invest in municipal bonds with maturity dates within six months prior to or after the fund's target maturity year. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，顧問將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅的投資。該基金主要投資於 2031 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金還可以投資於到期日在基金目標到期年份之前或之後六個月內的市政債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Flexible Equity Active ETF is a dynamically managed fund that takes both long and short positions primarily in global equity securities across any market capitalization, utilizing derivatives to gain exposure, hedge risk, or implement opportunistic asset and currency strategies. The portfolio incorporates a flexible combination of common stock, preferred stock, REITs, convertible securities, and up to 25% exposure to commodity markets via a wholly owned Cayman Subsidiary and commodity-linked exchange-traded products.

info.description: iShares 1-3 Year International Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the FTSE World Government Bond Index - Developed Markets 1-3 Years Capped Select Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The index is the performance of fixed-rate, local currency, investment-grade, sovereign bonds from certain developed markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 1-3 年期國際公債 ETF 旨在追蹤富時世界政府公債指數 - 已開發市場 1-3 年上限精選指數的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。此指數是來自某些已開發市場的固定利率、本國貨幣、投資等級主權債券的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Mosaic Co. engages in the production and marketing of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients. It operates through the following segments: Phosphates, Potash, and Mosaic Fertilizantes. The Phosphates segment is involved in the ownership and operation of mines and production facilities which produce concentrated phosphate crop nutrients and phosphate-based animal feed ingredients, and processing plants which produce concentrated phosphate crop nutrients. The Potash segment includes mining, processing, and selling potash. The Mosaic Fertilizantes segment focuses on mines, chemical plants, crop nutrient blending and bagging facilities, port terminals, and warehouses. The company was founded on March 25, 2004 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: 馬賽克公司從事濃縮磷酸鹽和鉀肥作物營養素的生產和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：磷酸鹽、鉀鹽和馬賽克肥料。磷酸鹽部門參與生產濃縮磷酸鹽作物營養素和磷酸鹽動物飼料成分的礦山和生產設施以及生產濃縮磷酸鹽作物營養素的加工廠的所有權和運營。鉀肥部門包括開採、加工和銷售鉀肥。馬賽克肥料部門專注於礦山、化工廠、作物養分混合和裝袋設施、港口碼頭和倉庫。該公司成立於2004年3月25日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Multi-Sector Income ETF seeks to provide high income and some capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in fixed income securities. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 多部門收入 ETF 旨在提供高收入和一定的資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: First Trust Europe AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Europe Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Europe AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 歐洲指數（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。该基金通常将至少 90% 的净资产（包括投资借款）投资于构成该指数的证券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克歐洲指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2030 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2030 高收益公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares 美元高收益公司債 2030 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合在 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）的表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: AB International Buffer ETF seeks a moderate level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the iShares MSCI EAFE ETF) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EAFE Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB International Buffer ETF 尋求適度的資本增值，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其幾乎所有資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 iShares MSCI EAFE ETF）是一款旨在追蹤 MSCI EAFE 指數投資結果的 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: F/m Compoundr High Yield Bond ETF seeks investment results, that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the Nasdaq Compoundr High-Yield Corporate Bond Index. The index is designed to offer exposure consistent with the total return of high-yield corporate bonds, without receiving and reinvesting dividend income, by investing in ETFs. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in underlying funds that invest primarily in high-yield bonds.
info.description_zh: F/mcompoundr 高收益債券 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克compoundr高收益公司債指數相對應（未扣除費用和開支）。該指數旨在透過投資 ETF 提供與高收益公司債總回報一致的風險敞口，而無需接收股息收入並進行再投資。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於主要投資於高收益債券的基礎基金來實現基金的目標。

info.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. is a global edge-to-cloud company, which engages in the provision of information technology, technology and enterprise products, solutions, and services. It operates through the following segments: Server, Hybrid Cloud, Intelligent Edge, Financial Services, and Corporate Investments and Other. The Server segment consists of general-purpose servers for multi-workload computing and workload-optimized servers to deliver the performance and value for demanding applications, and integrated systems comprised of software and hardware designed to address high-performance computing and supercomputing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and transaction processing workloads for government and commercial customers globally. The Hybrid Cloud segment is involved in a variety of cloud-native and hybrid solutions across storage, private cloud, and the infrastructure software-as-a-service space. The Intelligent Edge segment offers wired and wireless local area networks, campus, branch, and data center switching, software-defined wide-area-networks, private and public cellular network software, network security, and associated services that enable secure connectivity for businesses of any size. The Financial Services segment provides investment solutions, such as leasing, financing, IT consumption, utility programs, and asset management services for customers that facilitate technology deployment models and the acquisition of complete IT solutions, including hardware, software, and services from Hewlett Packard Enterprise and others. The Corporate Investments and Other segment includes the Advisory and Professional Services business, which primarily offers consultative-led services, HPE and partner technology expertise and advice, implementation services, as well as complex solution engagement capabilities, the Communications and Media Solutions business, which primarily offers software and related services to the telecommunications industry, and Hewlett Packard Labs, which is responsible for research and development. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard on July 2, 1939 and is headquartered in Spring, TX.
info.description_zh: 惠普企業有限公司是一家全球邊緣到雲端公司，從事提供資訊科技、技術和企業產品、解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：伺服器部門、混合雲部門、智慧邊緣部門、金融服務部門以及企業投資及其他部門。伺服器部門包括用於多工作負載運算的通用伺服器和工作負載優化伺服器，為要求苛刻的應用程式提供效能和價值，以及由軟體和硬體組成的整合系統，旨在為全球政府和商業客戶解決高效能運算和超級運算、人工智慧、數據分析和事務處理工作負載。混合雲部門涉及跨儲存、私有雲和基礎設施軟體即服務領域的各種雲端原生和混合解決方案。智慧邊緣部門提供有線和無線區域網路、園區、分公司和資料中心交換、軟體定義的廣域網路、專用和公共蜂窩網路軟體、網路安全以及相關服務，為任何規模的企業提供安全連線。金融服務部門為客戶提供投資解決方案，例如租賃、融資、IT消費、公用事業計劃和資產管理服務，以促進技術部署模型和從慧與等公司購買完整的IT解決方案，包括硬體、軟體和服務。企業投資和其他部門包括諮詢和專業服務業務（主要提供諮詢主導的服務、慧與和合作夥伴技術專業知識和建議、實施服務以及複雜的解決方案參與能力）、通訊和媒體解決方案業務（主要向電信行業提供軟體和相關服務）以及惠普實驗室（負責研發）。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1939 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯普林。

info.description: Keen Vision Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on June 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Keen Vision Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2021年6月18日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Quanta Services, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive infrastructure solutions to the electric power, oil and gas, communication, pipeline, and energy industries. It operates through the following segments: Electric Power, Renewable Energy, and Underground and Infrastructure. The Electric Power segment provides services for the electric power and communications markets. The Renewable Energy segment is involved in providing infrastructure solutions to customers involved in the renewable energy industry. The Underground and Infrastructure segment offers infrastructure solutions to customers involved in the transportation, distribution, storage, development, and processing of natural gas, oil, and other products. The company was founded by Kevin D. Miller, Steven P. Colmar, William G. Parkhouse, and John R. Colson on August 19, 1997 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Quanta Services, Inc. 致力於為電力、石油和天然氣、通訊、管道和能源產業提供全面的基礎設施解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：電力、再生能源、地下和基礎設施部門。電力部門為電力和通訊市場提供服務。再生能源部門為再生能源產業的客戶提供基礎設施解決方案。地下和基礎設施部門為涉及天然氣、石油和其他產品的運輸、分銷、儲存、開發和加工的客戶提供基礎設施解決方案。該公司由 Kevin D. Miller、Steven P. Colmar、William G. Parkhouse 和 John R. Colson 於 1997 年 8 月 19 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Northern Trust Short-Term Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE Short Term Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market with maturities of less than five years as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust 短期免稅債券 ETF 尋求與 ICE 短期重點市政債券指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的期限少於五年的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2030 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nuveen Preferred And Income ETF seeks to provide a high level of current income and total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pursue its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of the sum of its net assets and the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in preferred securities and other income producing securities.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Preferred And Income ETF 力求提供高水準的當前收入和總回報。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常市場條件下將其淨資產總和以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額的至少 80% 投資於優先證券和其他創收證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds structured to capture institutional total returns from short-duration fixed-income instruments while completely eliminating recurring taxable distribution payouts to its shareholders. The strategy dynamically shifts capital among underlying registered exchange-traded funds holding U.S. government obligations with maturities under one year, deploying a disciplined tactical rotation out of underlying positions prior to their dividend record dates to allow asset growth to compound directly within the fund's net asset value.
info.description_zh: F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund 是一種主動管理的基金中的基金，其結構旨在獲取短期固定收益工具的機構總回報，同時完全消除向股東支付的經常性應稅分配支出。該策略在持有期限在一年以下的美國政府債券的基礎註冊交易所交易基金之間動態轉移資本，在股息記錄日期之前從基礎頭寸中部署嚴格的戰術輪換，以使資產增長直接在基金的資產淨值內實現複合增長。

info.description: F/M 3-Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the [ICE BofA 3-Year Target Maturity Index]. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the F/m 3-Year Bond ETF's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the F/m 3-Year Bond ETF's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The [ICE BofA 3-Year Target Maturity Index] is an index comprised of U.S. investment-grade corporate bonds.
info.description_zh: F/M 3 年期投資等級公司債 ETF 尋求大體上與 [ICE BofA 3 年期目標到期指數] 的價格和收益率表現相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將 F/m 3 年期債券 ETF 淨資產的至少 80%（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於基礎指數的成分證券，來實現 F/m 3 年期債券 ETF 的投資目標。 [ICE BofA 3 年目標到期指數] 是由美國投資等級公司債所組成的指數。

info.description: Vaneck Technology Trusector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in equity securities of information technology-related companies or instruments that provide exposure to information technology-related companies as determined by the adviser. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Technology Trusector ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場情況下將其總資產的至少80%投資於資訊科技相關公司的股本證券或顧問確定的為資訊科技相關公司提供投資的工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fox Corp. engages in providing television production and broadcasting services. It also provides news under the brands FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment and FOX Television Stations, and Tubi Media Group. It operates through the following segments: Cable Network Programming, Television, and Other and Corporate. The Cable Network Programming segment refers to the production and licensing of news and sports content distributed primarily through traditional cable television systems, direct broadcast satellite operators, and telecommunication companies and online multi-channel video programming distributors. The Television segment focuses on the acquisition, marketing, and distribution of broadcast network programming. The Other and Corporate segment relates to the FOX Studio Lot, Credible Labs Inc, corporate overhead costs, and intracompany eliminations. The company was founded by Keith Rupert Murdoch on May 3, 2018, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 福斯公司從事提供電視製作和廣播服務。它還以福克斯新聞媒體、福克斯體育、福克斯娛樂、福克斯電視台以及 Tubi Media Group 品牌提供新聞。它透過以下部門運作：有線電視節目部門、電視部門、其他部門和企業部門。有線電視網絡節目部門是指主要透過傳統有線電視系統、直播衛星營運商、電信公司和線上多頻道視訊節目發行商分發的新聞和體育內容的製作和許可。電視部門專注於廣播網路節目的收購、行銷和發行。其他和公司部門涉及 FOX Studio Lot、Credible Labs Inc、公司管理費用和公司內部抵銷。該公司由基斯·魯珀特·默多克於2018年5月3日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Aperture AC is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September10, 2025 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Aperture AC 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現與一個或多個企業的合併、聯合、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月10日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on June 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。其成立的目的是与一个或多个企业进行合并、合并、股份交换、资产收购、股份购买、重组或类似的业务合并，在本招股说明书中将其称为初始业务合并。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 9 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description_zh: Lionheart Holdings 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market Small Cap ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by small-capitalization companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The strategy combines quantitative screening via a proprietary alpha model ranking approximately 4,500 small-cap stocks with bottom-up fundamental analysis to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market Small Cap ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的小型資本公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型對約 4,500 隻小型股進行排名的定量篩選與自下而上的基本面分析結合起來，建立一個多元化的投資組合，目標是那些定位於可持續盈利增長和以有吸引力的估值進行積極盈利修正的公司。

info.description: Fingermotion Inc. is a mobile data specialist company, which engages in the provision of payment and recharge service, data plans, subscription plans, mobile phones, loyalty points redemption, and other product bundles. It operates through the following segments: Telecommunications and Product Services, Value Added Products and Services, Short Message Services and Multimedia Messaging Services, Rich Communication Services Platform, and Big Data Insights. The company was founded on January 23, 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Fingermotion Inc.是一家行動數據專業公司，提供支付和儲值服務、數據計劃、訂閱計劃、手機、忠誠積分兌換和其他產品捆綁。它透過以下部門運作：電信和產品服務、增值產品和服務、簡訊服務和多媒體訊息服務、豐富的通訊服務平台和大數據洞察。該公司成立於2014年1月23日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Idea Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. info.description_zh: Idea Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月18日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月27日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Melar Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on March 11, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Melar Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年3月11日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: M3-Brigade Acquisition VI Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, consolidation, capital stock exchange, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 5, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: M3-Brigade Acquisition VI Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股本交換、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。该公司成立于2025年6月5日，总部位于纽约州纽约。

info.description: QDRO Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 28, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: QDRO Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月28日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Zai Lab Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the developing and commercializing therapies that address medical conditions with unmet needs in oncology, autoimmune disorders, infectious diseases, and neuroscience. Its products include Zejula, Optune, Qinlock, and Nuzyra. The company was founded by Samantha Ying Du and Marietta Wu in April 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 再鼎醫藥 (Zai Lab Ltd.) 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化療法，解決腫瘤學、自體免疫疾病、傳染病和神經科學領域未滿足需求的醫療狀況。其產品包括 Zejula、Optune、Qinlock 和 Nuzyra。該公司由杜英和吳瑪麗於2014年4月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage rare disease company that combines science, data and patient needs to create therapies for diseases with limited or no treatment options. The firm focuses on the treatment of rare neurological and sleep conditions such as certain Urea Cycle Disorders, Niemann Pick Disease Type C and Idiopathic Hypersomnia. The company receives royalties for AZSTARYS from its commercial partner Corium. The company was founded by Christal M. M. Mickle and Travis C. Mickle on October 30, 2006 and is headquartered in Celebration, FL.
info.description_zh: Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的罕見疾病公司，它將科學、數據和患者需求結合起來，為治療選擇有限或沒有治療選擇的疾病創造療法。該公司專注於治療罕見的神經系統和睡眠疾病，例如某些尿素循環障礙、C 型尼曼匹克病和特發性嗜睡症。該公司從其商業合作夥伴 Corium 處獲得 AZSTARYS 的特許權使用費。該公司由 Christal M. M. Mickle 和 Travis C. Mickle 於 2006 年 10 月 30 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州 Celebration。

info.description: F/m Opportunistic Income ETF seeks is to maximize total return, including both income and appreciation, by identifying undervalued and opportunistic sectors and securities in the U.S. fixed income markets. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") managed by F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC (the "adviser") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in fixed-income securities.
info.description_zh: F/m 機會主義收入 ETF 尋求透過識別美國固定收益市場中被低估和機會主義的行業和證券來最大化總回報，包括收入和升值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC（「顧問」）管理，旨在透過投資固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: American Airlines Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a network carrier through its principal wholly owned mainline operating subsidiary, American. The firm offers air transportation for passengers and cargo. It operates through the following geographical segments: Domestic, Latin America, Atlantic, and Pacific. The company was founded on December 9, 2013, and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.
info.description_zh: 美國航空集團公司是一家控股公司，透過其主要全資擁有的幹線運營子公司美國航空從事網路承運商的營運。該公司為乘客和貨物提供航空運輸。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：國內、拉丁美洲、大西洋和太平洋。該公司成立於2013年12月9日，總部位於德州沃思堡。

info.description: iShares 0-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Markit iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade 0-5 Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds with remaining maturities of less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade corporate debt.
info.description_zh: iShares 0-5 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Markit iBoxx 美元流動投資等級 0-5 指數的投資結果，該指數由以美元計價、剩餘期限少於五年的投資等級公司債組成。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映以美元計價的投資等級公司債務的表現。

info.description: VanEck Fallen Angel High Yield Bond ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of ICE US Fallen Angel High Yield 10% Constrained Index (the "Fallen Angel Index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index is comprised of below investment grade corporate bonds denominated in U.S. dollars that were rated investment grade at the time of issuance.
info.description_zh: VanEck Fallen Angel 高收益債券 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前盡可能接近複製 ICE 美國 Fallen Angel 高收益 10% 約束指數（「Fallen Angel 指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數由以美元計價的低於投資等級的公司債券組成，這些債券在發行時被評為投資等級。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Risk Managed Income ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk managed income strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 風險管理收益 ETF 力求提供與 Nasdaq-100 月淨信用領 95-100 指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於 Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量風險管理收益策略的表現，該策略持有納斯達克 100 指數的標的股票，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2034 (collectively, "2034 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 高收益企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益企業債券 2034 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合的表現，這些債券在 2034 年到期，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」（統稱為「2034 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2029. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2029.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: iShares ESG 1-5 Year USD Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI US Corporate 1-5 Year ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index has been developed by Bloomberg Finance L.P. and its affiliates with environmental, social and governance ("ESG") rating inputs from MSCI ESG Research LLC pursuant to an agreement between MSCI ESG Research and Bloomberg Index Services Limited, a subsidiary of Bloomberg.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG 1-5 年期美元公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美國企業 1-5 年期 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數由 Bloomberg Finance L.P. 及其附屬公司根據 MSCI ESG Research 與 Bloomberg 子公司 Bloomberg Index Services Limited 的協議，可利用 MSCI ESG Research LLC 提供的環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）評級資訊開發。

info.description: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. The company was founded on May 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。該公司成立於2025年5月29日，總部位於康乃狄克州格林威治。

info.description: US Treasury 3 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index (GA03). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 3-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 3 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 3 年期美國國債指數 (GA03) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美銀美林目前 3 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 3 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Baillie Gifford International Concentrated Growth ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified portfolio that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in a select number of high-growth international businesses outside the United States. Utilizing a high-conviction, bottom-up fundamental research process with a typical holding horizon of around five years, the strategy targets exceptional companies with massive market opportunities, durable competitive advantages, and visionary management, completely unconstrained by benchmark matching
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford International Concentration Growth ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化投資組合，透過投資於美國以外的精選數量的高成長國際企業來尋求長期資本增值。該策略採用高說服力、自下而上的基礎研究流程，典型的持有期限為五年左右，目標是擁有巨大市場機會、持久競爭優勢和富有遠見的管理的傑出公司，完全不受基準匹配的限制

info.description: IDX Dynamic Fixed Income ETF seeks high current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that is a "fund of funds," meaning that it normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in other ETFs that invest in various sectors of the debt markets, including corporate bonds, U.S. government and agency securities, private debt, foreign bonds (including emerging markets), foreign sovereign bonds, convertible securities, Treasury Inflation Protected Securities (TIPS), bank loans, asset-backed securities, mortgage-backed securities, and cash equivalent instruments. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IDX 動態固定收益 ETF 追求高當期報酬。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”），屬於“基金中的基金”，這意味著它通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資於債務市場各個領域的其他 ETF，包括公司債券、美國政府和機構證券、私人債務、外國債券（包括新興市場）、外國主權債券、可轉換證券(TIPS)、銀行貸款、資產支持證券證券、抵押貸款支持證券和現金等價工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Bitcoin 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Bitcoin futures contracts so that the total value of the Bitcoin to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和比特幣 75/25 策略 ETF 旨在複製 S&P 500 和 S&P CME 比特幣期貨指數 75/25 混合指數的總回報（扣除費用和開支）。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數佔 75% 的權重，標普 CME 比特幣期貨指數佔 25% 的權重。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於比特幣期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險的比特幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2029年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BlackRock High Yield ETF seeks to maximize total return, consistent with income generation and prudent investment management. The fund invests primarily in non-investment grade bonds with maturities of ten years or less. It normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in high yield investments and other financial instruments with economic characteristics similar to such investments. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德高收益 ETF 尋求最大化總回報，與創收和審慎的投資管理保持一致。該基金主要投資於期限為十年或更短的非投資等級債券。它通常將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於高收益投資和具有與此類投資類似的經濟特徵的其他金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Developed Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Developed Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies classified as developed markets, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA 已開發市場動量 ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright 已開發市場技術領先指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由歸類為已開發市場（美國除外）的大型市值公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: PMorgan Equity Premium Yield ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that seeks to provide a high level of current income and total return by combining a defensive U.S. large-cap equity portfolio with an proprietary options overlay. The strategy utilizes a data science-driven investment process to select a diversified basket of equities with attractive risk-return characteristics while systematically selling call option spreads on the S&P 500 Index to harvest premiums and mitigate volatility.
info.description_zh: PMorgan Equity Premium Yield ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，旨在透過將防禦性美國大盤股投資組合與專有選擇權疊加相結合，提供高水準的當前收入和總回報。該策略利用數據科學驅動的投資流程來選擇具有有吸引力的風險回報特徵的多元化一籃子股票，同時系統地出售標準普爾 500 指數的看漲期權價差，以獲取溢價並減輕波動性。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2030. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2030.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: WisdomTree Asia Defense Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Asia Defense Index (the "Index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in constituents of the index and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such constituents. The index has between 20 and 100 constituents with a maximum weight of 7.5% for "Exposure Score 3" constituents and 4% for "Exposure Score 2" and "Exposure Score 1" constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 亞洲防務基金致力於追蹤 WisdomTree 亞洲防務指數（「指數」）未計費用和開支的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於指數成分股和/或具有與此類成分股經濟特徵基本相似的經濟特徵的投資。該指數有 20 至 100 隻成分股，其中「暴露評分 3」成分股的最大權重為 7.5%，「暴露評分 2」和「暴露評分 1」成分股的最大權重為 4%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM Index. Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index has been designed based upon the principle that the asset class exhibiting the highest levels of "relative strength," based on current prices, will be the asset class with the best performance over the near term.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM 指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常情況下，基金將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數的設計原則是，根據當前價格，表現出最高水準「相對強度」的資產類別將是近期表現最好的資產類別。

info.description: REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for exposure to the share price (i.e., the price returns) of the securities of the companies comprising the Solactive FANG Innovation Index. The fund advisor seeks to employ the fund's investment strategy regardless of whether there are periods of adverse market, economic, or other conditions and will not seek to take temporary defensive positions during such periods.
info.description_zh: REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，同時保持接觸 Solactive FANG 創新指數公司證券的股價（即價格回報）的機會。無論是否存在不利的市場、經濟或其他條件，基金顧問都會尋求採用基金的投資策略，並且不會尋求在此期間採取臨時防禦立場。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2030年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PGIM Laddered Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF seeks to provide investors with capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by providing investors with exposure to the stocks included in the Nasdaq-100 Index while attempting to limit downside risk by investing in a "laddered portfolio" of four PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETFs (the "Underlying ETFs").
info.description_zh: PGIM Laddered Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF 旨在為投資者提供資本增值。該基金力求透過向投資者提供納斯達克 100 指數中包含的股票敞口來實現其投資目標，同時嘗試透過投資由四隻 PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF（「基礎 ETF」）組成的「階梯投資組合」來限制下行風險。

info.description: Hartford Dynamic Bond ETF seeks to provide long-term total return. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in fixed-income securities. The fund normally invests in both investment grade fixed income securities and non-investment grade fixed income securities (also known as "junk bonds").
info.description_zh: Hartford Dynamic Bond ETF 尋求提供長期總回報。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券。本基金通常投資於投資等級固定收益證券和非投資等級固定收益證券（也稱為「垃圾債券」）。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Treasury Bond ETF is a passively managed, non-diversified fixed-income strategy designed to track the performance of the ICE BulletShares US Treasury Bond 2030 Index by investing in U.S. dollar-denominated Treasury bonds maturing in the year 2030. The fund combines the structure of a defined-maturity investment with the liquidity of an exchange-traded vehicle, maintaining a systematic monthly rebalancing cycle and executing a mandatory cash liquidation and distribution on or about December 15, 2030
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 公債 ETF 是一種被動管理、非多元化的固定收益策略，旨在透過投資於 2030 年到期的美元計價國債來追蹤 ICE BulletShares 美國國債 2030 指數的表現。該基金將固定期限投資的結構與交易所交易工具的流動性相結合，維持系統性的每月再平衡週期並執行強制現金清算並於 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右分發

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2031 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2031. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2031.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2031 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Compass Pathways Plc is a biotechnology company, which provides mental health care services. It focuses on improving the lives of those who are suffering with mental health challenges and who are not helped by current treatments. The company was founded by Goldsmith George Jay and Malievskaia Ekaterina in 2016 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Compass Pathways Plc 是一家生技公司，提供心理健康護理服務。它的重點是改善那些遭受心理健康挑戰且當前治療無濟於事的人的生活。該公司由 Goldsmith George Jay 和 Malievskaia Ekaterina 於 2016 年創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Franklin Multisector Income ETF seeks to provide a high level of current income; capital appreciation over the long term is a secondary goal. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests in a diversified portfolio of U.S. and foreign debt securities across multiple fixed income sectors. Debt securities include all varieties of fixed, variable and floating rate income securities, including bonds, U.S. and foreign government and agency securities, corporate loans (and loan participations) and mortgage-backed securities and other asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 富蘭克林多部門收入 ETF 力求提供高水準的當期收入；長期資本增值是次要目標。在正常市場條件下，該基金投資於多個固定收益領域的美國和外債證券的多元化投資組合。債務證券包括各種固定、可變和浮動利率收入證券，包括債券、美國和外國政府和機構證券、公司貸款（和貸款參與）以及抵押貸款支持證券和其他資產支持證券。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2031 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2031, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2031 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2031年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2035 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, the adviser invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2035, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund may also invest in corporate bonds with maturity dates within six months prior to or after the fund's target maturity year. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2035 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，顧問將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2035年到期的公司債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金還可以投資於到期日在基金目標到期年份之前或之後六個月內的公司債。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Summit State Bank engages in providing an array of financial services to small and medium-sized businesses, their owners and employees, entrepreneurs, high net worth families, foundations, estates, and individual consumers. It specializes in business services, personal accounts, nonprofit programs, and mobile banking ranging from lending, checking, merchant, eBanking, automated teller machines, equity loans, and others. The company was founded on December 20, 1982 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: Summit State Bank 致力於為中小型企業、其所有者和員工、企業家、高淨值家庭、基金會、遺產和個人消費者提供一系列金融服務。它專門從事商業服務、個人帳戶、非營利計劃和行動銀行業務，範圍包括貸款、支票、商業、電子銀行、自動櫃員機、股權貸款等。該公司成立於1982年12月20日，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Alpha Architect Value Momentum Trend ETF seeks long term capital appreciation while attempting to minimize market drawdowns. The fund is a "fund of funds," meaning that it primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs, rather than in securities of individual companies. Its portfolio will be composed primarily of the other ETFs advised by the Adviser. Currently, there are four Alpha Architect ETFs, which invest in either domestic or international equity securities, and employ either a "momentum" or a "value" investment strategy.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 價值動量趨勢 ETF 尋求長期資本增值，同時試圖盡量減少市場回檔。該基金是“基金中的基金”，這意味著它主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票，而不是個別公司的證券。其投資組合將主要由顧問建議的其他 ETF 組成。目前，Alpha Architect 有四種 ETF，投資於國內或國際股票證券，並採用「動量」或「價值」投資策略。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Treasury Bond ETF is a passively managed, non-diversified fixed-income strategy designed to track the performance of the ICE BulletShares US Treasury Bond 2031 Index by investing in U.S. dollar-denominated Treasury bonds maturing in the year 2031. The fund combines the structure of a defined-maturity investment with the liquidity of an exchange-traded vehicle, maintaining a systematic monthly rebalancing cycle and executing a mandatory cash liquidation and distribution on or about December 15, 2031
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 公債 ETF 是一種被動管理、非多元化的固定收益策略，旨在透過投資於 2031 年到期的美元計價國債來追蹤 ICE BulletShares 美國國債 2031 指數的表現。該基金將固定期限投資的結構與交易所交易工具的流動性相結合，維持系統性的每月再平衡週期並執行強制現金清算並於 2031 年 12 月 15 日左右分發

info.description: Range Capital Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on May 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Cold Spring Harbor, NY.
info.description_zh: Range Capital Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年5月22日，總部位於紐約州冷泉港。

info.description: Ocean Park High Income ETF seeks to provide total return and to limit exposure to downside risk. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund's assets between unaffiliated higher yielding ETFs ("High Income ETFs"), long-term Treasury ETFs ("Treasury ETFs") and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in high income ETFs.
info.description_zh: 海洋公園高收入 ETF 旨在提供總回報並限制下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過戰術性地在獨立的高收益 ETF（「高收入 ETF」）、長期國債 ETF（「國債 ETF」）和現金等價物之間分配基金資產來實現其投資目標。在正常市場條件下，顧問預計將其大部分資產投資於高收益 ETF。

info.description: Alexis Practical Tactical ETF seeks total return primarily through long-term capital appreciation, with income and capital preservation as secondary objectives. In seeking to achieve its investment objective, the fund has the flexibility to allocate its assets among different markets around the world and various asset classes (e.g., equity, fixed income, commodities (including precious metals), and real estate (including real estate investment trusts ("REITs"))) and strategies, including alternative strategies (e.g., merger arbitrage, convertible bond and options-based strategies).
info.description_zh: Alexis Practical Tactical ETF 主要透過長期資本增值來尋求總回報，收入和資本保值是次要目標。為了實現其投資目標，該基金可以靈活地在全球不同市場和各種資產類別（例如股票、固定收益、大宗商品（包括貴金屬）和房地產（包括房地產投資信託基金（「REITs」）））和策略（包括另類策略（例如合併套利、可轉換債券和基於選擇權的策略））之間配置其資產。

info.description: iShares Dynamic Equity Active ETF seeks to provide total return. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. It seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in both equity and fixed-income securities, including money market securities and other short-term securities or instruments, of issuers located around the world. Equity securities include common stock, preferred stock, ADRs, or securities or other instruments whose price is linked to the value of common stock.
info.description_zh: iShares Dynamic Equity Active ETF 力求提供總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。它尋求透過投資世界各地發行人的股票和固定收益證券（包括貨幣市場證券和其他短期證券或工具）來實現其投資目標。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、美國存託憑證或價格與普通股價值掛鉤的證券或其他工具。

info.description: US Treasury 7 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 7-Year US Treasury Index (GA07). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 7-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 7-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 7 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 7 年期美國國債指數 (GA07) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美銀美林目前 7 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 7 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Robotics and 3D Printing Index (the "Index"). The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Robotics and 3D Printing Companies, as determined by the index provider. The fund adviser will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 機器人和 3D 列印指數（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由指數提供者確定的至少 50% 收入來自機器人和 3D 列印公司的全球上市股票和存託憑證組成。基金顧問通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2034 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2034. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2034.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2034 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2034 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. provides global alternative asset management solutions. The firm invests on behalf of clients who seek allocations to alternative investments, such as private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. It specializes in developing customized portfolios for clients who want an active role in the development of their alternatives programs and also offers multi-client portfolios for investors who desire a turn-key solution for accessing alternative investments. The company's offerings include multi-manager portfolios as well as portfolios of direct investments and co-investments. GCM Grosvenor has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Tokyo, Hong Kong, and Seoul. GCM Grosvenor was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. 提供全球另類資產管理解決方案。該公司代表尋求另類投資配置的客戶進行投資，例如私募股權、基礎設施、房地產、信貸和絕對回報策略。它專門為希望在另類投資項目開發中發揮積極作用的客戶開發客製化投資組合，並為希望獲得另類投資交鑰匙解決方案的投資者提供多客戶投資組合。該公司的產品包括多管理人投資組合以及直接投資和共同投資組合。 GCM Grosvenor 在紐約、洛杉磯、倫敦、東京、香港和首爾設有辦事處。 GCM Grosvenor 成立於 1971 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2034 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2034, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2034 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2034年到期的公司債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Choice ESG Screened Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Choice ESG 篩選指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（“ESG”）評級的大中型美國公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2035. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2035.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2035 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2035 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Wisdomtree 7-10 Year Laddered Treasury Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Treasury 7-10 Year Laddered Treasury Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. Treasuries that have a remaining maturity of seven to ten years and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such Treasuries. The index is composed of fixed-rate coupon U.S. Treasury securities maturing in 7 to 10 years or with remaining maturities between 7 to 10 years.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 7-10 年階梯式國債基金 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國財政部 7-10 年階梯式國債指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於剩餘期限為7至10年的美國國債以及與此類國債經濟特徵基本相似的投資。該指數由 7 至 10 年到期或剩餘期限為 7 至 10 年的固定利率美國公債組成。

info.description: The KraneShares InspereX Nasdaq Dynamic Buffered High Income Index ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the price and yield performance of a specific equity and derivative securities index. The Fund's current index is the Nasdaq InspereX Dynamic Buffered High Income Index. The Underlying Index is designed to track the performance of a systematic enhanced collar strategy that seeks to limit losses while providing option income. The Underlying Index models a strategy that includes these components: 1.total return exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index; 2.short call options (i.e., selling call options) on the Nasdaq-100 Index, which involve the selling of a series of short-dated call options (i.e., five days or less) to generate option income, with new call options being sold each day; and 3. short futures positions (i.e., selling futures) on the Nasdaq-100 Futures Excess Return Index, which is dynamically adjusted on a daily basis as it seeks to replicate the effect of rolling monthly put options on the Nasdaq-100 Index and provide downside protection against losses. The Fund may invest directly in any component of the Nasdaq-100 Index or may invest in an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to track the Nasdaq-100 Index.
info.description_zh: KraneShares InspereX 納斯達克動態緩衝高收入指數 ETF 旨在提供未計費用和支出的投資結果，該結果通常與特定股票和衍生證券指數的價格和收益率表現相對應。該基金目前的指數是納斯達克InspereX動態緩衝高收入指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤系統性增強型領子策略的表現，該策略旨在限制損失，同時提供選擇權收入。基礎指數模型包含以下組成部分的策略： 1. 納斯達克 100 指數的總回報敞口； 2.納斯達克 100指數的空頭買權（即賣出買權），涉及賣出一系列短期（即五天或以下）買權以產生選擇權收入，每天都會賣出新的買權；期貨超額回報指數的空頭期貨部位（即賣出期貨），該指數每天動態調整，旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數每月滾動看跌期權的效果，並提供針對損失的下行保護。該基金可以直接投資於 Nasdaq-100 指數的任何組成部分，也可以投資於追蹤 Nasdaq-100 指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2036 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2036. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2036.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2036 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2036 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2036 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve this objective by (1) creating an actively managed portfolio of equity securities comprised significantly of those included in the fund's primary benchmark, the Nasdaq-100 Index (the Benchmark), and (2) through equity-linked notes (ELNs), selling call options with exposure to the Benchmark. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。該基金力求透過以下方式實現這一目標：(1) 創建一個積極管理的股本證券投資組合，其中主要包括基金主要基準納斯達克 100 指數（基準）中包含的證券，以及 (2) 透過股票掛鉤票據 (ELN) 出售與基準敞口相關的看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的一檔交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities ETF 註冊地在美國。

info.description: F/M 10-Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the [ICE BofA 10-Year Target Maturity Index]. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC seeks to achieve the F/m 10-Year Bond ETF's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the F/m 10-Year Bond ETF's net assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The [ICE BofA 10-Year Target Maurity Index] is an index comprised of U.S. investment-grade corporate bonds.
info.description_zh: F/M 10 年期投資等級公司債 ETF 尋求整體上與 [ICE BofA 10 年期目標到期指數] 的價格和收益率表現相對應的結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC 尋求透過將 F/m 10 年期債券 ETF 淨資產的至少 80% 投資於基礎指數的組成證券來實現 F/m 10 年期債券 ETF 的投資目標。 [ICE BofA 10 年目標毛利率指數] 是由美國投資等級公司債組成的指數。

info.description: Goldman Sachs MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker Index (Net, USD, Unhedged). The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in securities included in its underlying index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The index seeks to approximate the returns of private equity investments by replicating region, sector and style exposures through publicly listed equities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤 ETF 力求提供在費用和開支之前與 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤指數（淨值、美元、未對沖）表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於其標的指數中包含的證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該指數旨在透過公開上市股票複製地區、行業和風格的風險敞口來估算私募股權投資的回報率。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF seeks long-term growth through capital appreciation. Under normal conditions, the fund typically invests in equity securities of U.S. and foreign companies, including common stocks, preferred stocks, and securities convertible into common or preferred stocks. It can invest in companies from a wide range of industries and of various sizes. The fund will invest primarily in mid and small-size companies.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF 透過資本增值尋求長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金通常投資於美國和外國公司的股本證券，包括普通股、優先股以及可轉換為普通股或優先股的證券。它可以投資各個行業和各種規模的公司。該基金將主要投資於中小型企業。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 1000 Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 1000  Index that measures the investment return of large-capitalization stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 1000 Index.
