The index is designed to measure the performance of large-capitalization stocks in the United States. The Advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 1000 Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤衡量美國大盤股投資回報的Russell 1000指數的表現。基金顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 1000 指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國大盤股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2036 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2036 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2036. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2036 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2036 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2036 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Innovator Nasdaq-100 10 Buffer ETF - Quarterly seeks capital appreciation with a measure of downside protection by providing investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in FLexible EXchange Options that reference the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 創新者 Nasdaq-100 10 Buffer ETF - 每季度透過為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ TrustSM，系列 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，尋求資本增值和一定程度的下行保護。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於參考 Invesco QQQ TrustSM，系列 1 的彈性交易選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares WestEnd Global Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, has a policy to invest at least 80% of its assets in the shares of exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that invest in equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its net assets in ETFs that invest primarily in securities of issuers outside of the United States.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares WestEnd 全球股票 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金的政策是將至少80%的資產投資於投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）的份額。在正常情況下，該基金將至少40%的淨資產投資於主要投資於美國境外發行人的證券的ETF。

info.description: Cabana Target Leading Sector Moderate ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by allocating its assets among ETFs that invest in securities of companies in the various sectors of the U.S. market: communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, health care, industrials, information technology, materials, real estate, and utilities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target 領先產業溫和 ETF 尋求提供長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過將其資產分配給投資於美國市場各行業公司證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標：通訊服務、非必需消費品、必需消費品、能源、金融、醫療保健、工業、資訊科技、材料、房地產和公用事業。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Avantis U.S. Quality ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors and industry groups. The fund focuses on growth companies, which the portfolio managers generally define as companies that have relatively higher price-to-book ratios or that are included in the MSCI USA Growth IMI Index. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Avantis 美國優質 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域和行業群體的美國公司。該基金專注於成長型公司，投資組合經理人通常將其定義為市淨率相對較高或納入 MSCI 美國成長 IMI 指數的公司。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少80%的資產投資於美國公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ClearBridge Large Cap Growth ESG ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation through investing in large-capitalization companies with the potential for high future earnings growth. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to meet its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any, in equity securities or other instruments with similar economic characteristics of U.S. companies with large market capitalizations that meet its financial and environmental, social and governance ("ESG") criteria.
info.description_zh: ClearBridge 大盤成長 ESG ETF 透過投資未來獲利高成長潛力的大市值公司來尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於股本證券或具有與美國大市值公司類似經​​濟特徵且符合其財務和環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）標準的其他工具來實現其投資目標。

info.description: CoreWeave, Inc. engages in the powers of the creation and delivery of the intelligence that drives innovation. It offers a solution used by organizations of all sizes that require sophisticated AI computing, from the largest of enterprises to small, well-funded start-ups. The company was founded by Michael Intrator, Brian Venturo, Peter Salanki, and Brannin McBee on September 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Livingston, NJ.
info.description_zh: CoreWeave, Inc. 致力於創造和交付推動創新的智慧。它提供的解決方案可供各種規模的需要複雜人工智慧運算的組織使用，從最大的企業到資金充足的小型新創公司。該公司由 Michael Intrator、Brian Venturo、Peter Salanki 和 Brannin McBee 於 2017 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於新澤西州利文斯頓。

info.description: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar Exponential Technologies IndexSM composed of stocks of developed and emerging market companies that create or use exponential technologies. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a subset of the Morningstar Global Markets Index (the "Parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF 旨在追蹤 Morningstar Exponential Technologies IndexSM 的投資結果，該指數由創建或使用指數技術的已開發和新興市場公司的股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是晨星全球市場指數（「母指數」）的子集。

info.description: ishares Breakthrough Environmental Solutions ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar Global Emerging Green Technologies Select Index. The underlying index measures the performance of equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. companies involved in breakthrough innovations and new technologies that seek to address or combat climate change, as determined by Morningstar or its affiliates. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: isshares Breakthrough Environmental Solutions ETF 旨在追蹤晨星全球新興綠色技術精選指數的投資結果。該指數衡量由晨星或其附屬公司確定的涉及尋求解決或應對氣候變遷的突破性創新和新技術的美國和非美國公司發行的股本證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptors ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests its assets in a combination of five Fidelity funds, each of which normally invests in equity securities of companies that represent a disruptive theme. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time.
info.description_zh: Fidelity Disruptors ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將其資產投資於五個富達基金的組合，每個基金通常投資於代表顛覆性主題的公司的股本證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。

info.description: Stratasys Ltd. engages in the development of industrial grade additive solutions. It offers three-dimensional printers and parts, materials, and software. The company was founded on March 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Minnetonka, MN.
info.description_zh: Stratasys Ltd. 從事工業級添加劑解決方案的開發。它提供 3D 列印機以及零件、材料和軟體。該公司成立於1998年3月3日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼通卡。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of large-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The Advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index. The fund may become non-diversified, as defined under the Investment Company Act of 1940, solely as a result of a change in relative market capitalization or index weighting of one or more constituents of the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤 Russell 1000 Growth Index 的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國大盤成長股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。根據 1940 年《投資公司法》的定義，基金可能會變得非多元化，這僅僅是由於指數的一個或多個成分股的相對市值或指數權重變化的結果。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index TM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index includes companies that are primarily engaged and involved in electric grid, electric meters and devices, networks, energy storage and management, and enabling software used by the smart grid infrastructure sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克 Clean Edge 智慧電網基礎設施指數基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 Clean Edge 智慧電網基礎設施指數 TM 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數包括主要從事和參與電網、電錶和設備、網路、能源儲存和管理以及智慧電網基礎設施領域使用的支援軟體的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks income and capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in emerging market dividend-paying common stocks with growth characteristics. The adviser, using a disciplined model-based process focused on a long-term approach to investing, seeks to identify dividend-paying companies with strong corporate profitability and sustainable growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場優質股息成長基金尋求收入和資本增值。該基金尋求透過主要投資於具有成長特徵的新興市場派息普通股來實現其投資目標。該顧問採用基於模型的嚴格流程，專注於長期投資方法，力求識別具有強勁企業盈利能力和可持續增長特徵的派息公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Nasdaq Autocallable Income ETF seeks to generate high monthly income while providing reduced downside risk through exposure to the MerQube Nasdaq-100 Vol Advantage Autocallable Index. The fund is a non-diversified, actively managed ETF that, under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its total assets in U.S. Treasuries, cash, cash equivalents, "box spreads" and unfunded total return swaps that provide exposure to the index. The fund will not attempt to replicate or track the index but will instead use financial instruments such as total return swaps to gain exposure to the level of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Calamos Nasdaq Autocallable Income ETF 尋求產生高月收入，同時透過投資 MerQube Nasdaq-100 Vol Advantage Autocallable Index 來降低下行風險。該基金是一種非多元化、主動管理的 ETF，在正常市場條件下，尋求將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於美國國債、現金、現金等價物、「箱式利差」和提供指數敞口的無融資總回報掉期。該基金不會嘗試複製或追蹤該指數，而是會使用總回報掉期等金融工具來獲得指數水準的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of any capitalization, including in emerging markets. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資 ETF 來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 主要投資於任何資本的國內外股票證券，包括新興市場。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。

info.description: City Different Investments Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. The managers define "equity securities" to mean common stock, depositary receipts (e.g., American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs")), equity interests in real estate investment trusts ("REITs") and master limited partnerships ("MLPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: City Different Investments 全球股票 ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於股本證券來實現其投資目標。管理者將「股本證券」定義為普通股、存託憑證（例如美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」））、房地產投資信託（「REIT」）股權和主有限合夥（「MLP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. engages in the retail sale of home improvement products. The firm offers products for maintenance, repair, remodeling, home decorating, and property maintenance. It also provides home improvement products in the following categories: appliances, seasonal & outdoor living, lumber, lawn & garden, kitchens & bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and decor. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Mooresville, NC.
info.description_zh: Lowe's Companies, Inc. 從事家居裝修產品的零售業務。該公司提供用於維護、修理、改造、家居裝飾和物業維護的產品。它還提供以下類別的家居裝修產品：電器、季節性和戶外生活、木材、草坪和花園、廚房和浴室、五金、建築材料、木製品、油漆、粗糙管道、工具、電氣、地板和裝飾。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州穆爾斯維爾。

info.description: PeakShares RMR Prime Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation and income generation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that may engage in active and frequent trading. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities that include common stocks of companies and equity ETFs providing exposure to such companies, and have economic characteristics similar to such securities.
info.description_zh: PeakShares RMR Prime 股票 ETF 旨在提供資本增值和創收。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），可以進行活躍且頻繁的交易。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券，其中包括公司的普通股和向此類公司提供敞口的股本ETF，並且具有與此類證券類似的經濟特徵。

info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 德國 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 德國指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克德國指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: NEOS NASDAQ-100(R) High Income ETF seeks to generate high monthly income in a tax efficient manner with the potential for equity appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a portfolio of stocks that make up the Nasdaq-100 Index and a call options strategy, that consists of written (sold) call options on the Nasdaq-100 Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in securities, or derivative instruments linked to securities, of companies that are included in the reference index.
info.description_zh: NEOS NASDAQ-100(R) 高收入 ETF 力求以節稅的方式產生高額月收入，並具有股票升值的潛力。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資構成 Nasdaq-100 指數的股票組合和看漲期權策略（包括 Nasdaq-100 指數的書面（出售）看漲期權）來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資目的借款，將投資於參考指數所包含公司的證券或與證券掛鉤的衍生性商品。

info.description: Johnson Outdoors, Inc. engages in the manufacturing and marketing of seasonal, outdoor recreation products. It operates through the following segments: Fishing, Camping, Watercraft Recreation, Diving, and Other. The Fishing segment includes the brands Minn Kota electric motors for quiet trolling or primary propulsion, marine battery chargers, and shallow water anchors, Humminbird sonar and GPS equipment for fishfinding, navigation and marine cartography, and Cannon downriggers for controlled-depth fishing. The Camping segment consists of Eureka! Consumer, commercial and military tents and accessories, sleeping bags, camping furniture and stoves and other recreational camping products, and Jetboil portable outdoor cooking systems. The Watercraft Recreation segment designs and markets canoes and kayaks, including pedal-driven and Minn Kota motor-driven kayaks, under the Ocean Kayaks and Old Town brand names for family recreation, touring, angling, and tripping. The Diving segment sells and distributes the SCUBAPRO brand. The company was founded by Samuel Curtis Johnson II in 1987 and is headquartered in Racine, WI.
info.description_zh: Johnson Outdoors, Inc. 從事季節性戶外休閒產品的製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：釣魚、露營、船隻娛樂、潛水和其他。釣魚部門包括用於安靜拖釣或主推進的 Minn Kota 品牌電動馬達、船用電池充電器和淺水錨、用於探魚、導航和海洋製圖的 Humminbird 聲納和 GPS 設備，以及用於控制深度釣魚的 Cannon 下降裝置。露營部分包括尤里卡！消費、商業和軍用帳篷及配件、睡袋、露營家具和爐灶及其他休閒露營產品，以及 Jetboil 便攜式戶外烹飪系統。 Watercraft Recreation 部門以 Ocean Kayaks 和 Old Town 品牌設計和銷售獨木舟和皮划艇，包括踏板驅動和 Minn Kota 電機驅動皮划艇，用於家庭休閒、旅遊、釣魚和旅行。潛水部門銷售和分銷 SCUBAPRO 品牌。該公司由 Samuel Curtis Johnson II 於 1987 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州拉辛。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF seeks total return through current income and long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by: (1) investing in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities designed to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the NASDAQ-100 Index or U.S.-listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that seek to track the performance of the index, or both, and (2) utilizing an options-based income strategy implemented through equity-linked notes (ELNs) with exposure to either the index or ETFs tracking the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF 透過當前收入和資本的長期成長尋求總回報。該基金力求透過以下方式實現其投資目標：(1) 投資於旨在追蹤 NASDAQ-100 指數或旨在追蹤該指數表現的美國上市交易所交易基金 (ETF) 或兩者的表現（未計費用和開支）的美國股票證券投資組合，以及 (2) 利用透過股票掛鉤的票據 (ELN) 實施的基於期權的基於期權的貨幣策略，並投資於該指數或該指數 (ELN) 實施的基於期權的期權或該指數 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth & Income ETF seeks long-term growth of capital and current income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index, (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF 戰術成長和收入 ETF 尋求資本和當前收入的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF，(ii) 直接投資於或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益分配」），以及 (iii) 短期美國國庫、貨幣市場基金和現金和現金和現金等價物（現金等價物或現金等價物（現金等價物或現金等價物）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Hilton Small-Midcap Opportunity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser uses its proprietary Small & Mid Cap Opportunities investment process ("SMCO Process") to seek risk-adjusted returns by investing in U.S. equity securities within the small- and mid-cap asset classes. The fund's portfolio will typically consist of between 50-75 stocks. The fund's portfolio will consistently consist of stocks that the Sub-Adviser deems fundamentally attractive and reasonably valued. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in equity securities of small- and mid-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: 希爾頓中小型股機會 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。副顧問使用其專有的中小型股機會投資流程（「SMCO 流程」），透過投資中小型資產類別內的美國股票證券來尋求風險調整後的回報。該基金的投資組合通常由 50-75 隻股票組成。該基金的投資組合將始終由副顧問認為具有基本吸引力且估值合理的股票組成。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資用途的借款，將投資於中小型公司的股本證券。

info.description: First Trust IndXX NextG ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Indxx 5G & NextG Thematic Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that have devoted, or have committed to devote, material resources to the research, development and application of fifth generation ("5G") and next generation digital cellular technologies as they emerge.
info.description_zh: First Trust IndXX NextG ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Indxx 5G 和 NextG 主題指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤那些已投入或已承諾投入物質資源用於第五代（「5G」）和下一代數位蜂窩技術的研究、開發和應用的公司的表現。

info.description: Kurv Technology Titans Select ETF seeks maximum total return, consistent with prudent investment management. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs as well as the equity securities of, or derivative instruments (e.g. options) relating to, individual companies in the technology sector ("Technology Companies"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Kurv Technology Titans Select ETF 追求最大總回報，與審慎的投資管理一致。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票以及與科技業個別公司（「科技公司」）相關的股本證券或衍生性工具（例如選擇權）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance,before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票的風險管理策略的績效，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Energy Storage & Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results of STOXX Global Energy Storage and Materials Index. The index measures the performance of equity securities of companies involved in energy storage solutions aiming to support the transition to a low carbon economy, including hydrogen, fuel cells, and batteries as determined by STOXX Ltd. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 儲能和材料 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球儲能和材料指數的投資結果。該指數衡量參與旨在支持向低碳經濟轉型的能源儲存解決方案的公司的股本證券的表現，包括由 STOXX Ltd 確定的氫、燃料電池和電池。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其基礎指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity NASDAQ Composite Index Track seeks to provide investment returns that closely correspond to the price and yield performance of the Nasdaq Composite Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in common stocks included in the index. The advisor uses statistical sampling techniques that take into account such factors as capitalization, industry exposures, dividend yield, price/earnings (P/E) ratio, price/book (P/B) ratio, and earnings growth to create a portfolio of securities listed in the Nasdaq Composite Index that have a similar investment profile to the entire index.
info.description_zh: 富達納斯達克綜合指數追蹤旨在提供與納斯達克綜合指數的價格和收益率表現密切相關的投資回報。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數所包含的普通股。顧問使用統計抽樣技術，考慮資本化、行業風險、股息收益率、本益比 (P/E)、市淨率 (P/B) 比率和盈利增長等因素，創建納斯達克綜合指數中列出的與整個指數具有相似投資狀況的證券投資組合。

info.description: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index subject to a limit on potential investment gains is the secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the value of the index, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the value of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Nasdaq 100 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；納斯達克 100 指數的表現受到潛在投資收益限制是次要考慮因素。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，同時維持間接接觸指數價值的機會，但受到指數價值上漲潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "Index Allocation"), (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF Tactical Growth ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF（「指數配置」），(ii) 直接投資或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益配置」），以及 (iii) 短期貨幣基金等價物、現金、現金、現金、現金、現金等價物或現金（現金或現金基金等現金、現金或現金基金等現金（它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF seeks to provide current income with consideration for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a targeted outcome strategy that is intended to optimize, in the opinion of Fund management, premium income generation and the potential for capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Investments in derivatives are counted toward the fund's 80% policy to the extent that they provide investment exposure to the securities included within that policy or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF 旨在提供當前收入，同時考慮資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用有針對性的結果策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在根據基金管理層的意見優化保費收入的產生和資本增值的潛力。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於納斯達克股票市場上市的股票證券。衍生性商品投資計入基金的 80% 保單，只要它們提供對該保單中包含的證券或與此類證券相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的投資曝險。

info.description: Alphadroid Defensive Sector Rotation ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-RO Defensive Sector Rotation Index ("Defensive Sector Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid 防禦性產業輪動 ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-RO 防禦性產業輪動指數（「防禦性產業指數」或「指數」）在扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Blackrock Large Cap Core ETF seeks to maximize total return. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in large cap equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. The fund primarily seeks to buy common stock and may also invest in preferred stock and convertible securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Blackrock Large Cap Core ETF 尋求最大化總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額投資於大盤股證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生性商品。該基金主要尋求購買普通股，也可能投資於優先股和可轉換證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard US Systematic Small Cap Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Portfolio invests primarily in equity securities, principally common stocks, of small capitalization U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, the Portfolio invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of small cap U.S. companies. The Portfolio may invest up to 20% of its assets in other securities which need not be equity securities of small cap U.S. companies, including investments in larger U.S. companies and in non-U.S. companies, including securities of emerging markets companies traded on a U.S. exchange.
info.description_zh: Lazard 美國系統性小型股 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該投資組合主要投資於美國小型公司的股本證券，主要是普通股。在正常情況下，該投資組合將至少80%的資產投資於美國小型企業的股本證券。投資組合最多可將其資產的 20% 投資於其他證券，這些證券不必是美國小型公司的股本證券，包括對大型美國公司和非美國公司的投資，包括在美國交易所交易的新興市場公司的證券。

info.description: Mango Growth ETF is an actively managed ETF. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in the common stock of companies that the fund manager believes have high growth characteristics. The fund manager considers a company to have high growth characteristics if it demonstrates consistently strong year-over-year growth across multiple fundamental and market-based metrics. These may include, but are not limited to, sustained increases in sales, earnings, and cash flows, as well as positive share price trends over a specified evaluation period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 芒果成長ETF是主動式管理型ETF。該基金透過主要投資於基金經理人認為具有高成長特徵的公司的普通股來尋求長期資本增值。如果一家公司在多個基本面和基於市場的指標上表現出持續強勁的同比增長，基金經理就會認為該公司具有高成長特徵。這些可能包括但不限於銷售額、收益和現金流量的持續成長，以及在特定評估期間內積極的股價趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF seeks to provide capital growth over the medium to long term. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity and equity-related securities of emerging market issuers. Equity and equity-related securities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter common and preferred stocks, warrants, options, rights, convertible securities, sponsored and unsponsored depositary receipts, trust certificates, partnership interests and shares of other investment companies (including other exchange-traded funds ("ETFs")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF 尋求在中長期內提供資本增長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於新興市場發行人的股票和股票相關證券。股票和股票相關證券包括交易所交易和場外交易的普通股和優先股、認股權證、選擇權、權利、可轉換證券、保薦和非保薦存託憑證、信託證書、合夥權益以及其他投資公司的股份（包括其他交易所交易基金（「ETF」））。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Home Depot, Inc. engages in the sale of building materials and home improvement products. Its products include building materials, home improvement products, lawn and garden products and decor products. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Canada and Mexico. It offers home improvement installation services, and tool and rental equipment. The company was founded by Bernard Marcus, Arthur M. Blank, Kenneth Gerald Langone and Pat Farrah on June 29, 1978 and is headquartered at Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: The Home Depot, Inc. 從事建築材料和家居裝修產品的銷售。其產品包括建築材料、家居裝修產品、草坪和花園產品以及裝飾產品。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、加拿大和墨西哥。它提供家居裝修安裝服務以及工具和租賃設備。該公司由 Bernard Marcus、Arthur M. Blank、Kenneth Gerald Langone 和 Pat Farrah 於 1978 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 Core Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity investments of companies that are included in the fund's benchmark. The fund will generally seek to maintain style, capitalization and industry characteristics similar to its benchmark. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 Nasdaq-100 核心溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於納入該基金基準的公司的股權投資。該基金通常會尋求保持與其基準相似的風格、資本規模和行業特徵。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Daily Covered Call Index. The index is designed to replicate the performance of an investment strategy that combines a long position in the Nasdaq-100 Index with a short position in Nasdaq-100 Index call options. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 高收入 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 每日備兌買權指數表現的投資結果。該指數旨在複製將納斯達克 100 指數多頭頭寸與納斯達克 100 指數看漲期權空頭頭寸相結合的投資策略的績效。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於指數的組成證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco ESG NASDAQ 100 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq-100 ESG Index(the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "parent index") that also meet the index provider's ESG criteria. The parent index includes securities of 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco ESG NASDAQ 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ESG 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數（「母指數」）中包含的公司的業績，這些公司也符合指數提供者的 ESG 標準。母指數包括在納斯達克股票市場有限責任公司上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司的證券（按市值計算）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Alternative Nasdaq & Bond ETF seeks attractive risk-adjusted total return through capital appreciation and current income. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80%, but up to 100%, of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any) in a portfolio of equity instruments (including options and equity ETFs) and fixed income instruments (including bonds and fixed income ETFs) intended to deliver convertible security-like exposure to companies in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Calamos 另類納斯達克和債券 ETF 透過資本增值和當前收入尋求具有吸引力的風險調整總回報。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80%、但最多 100% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款，如果有）投資於權益工具（包括期權和股票 ETF）和固定收益工具（包括債券和固定收益 ETF）投資組合來實現其目標，旨在向納斯達克 100 指數中的公司提供類似可轉換證券的風險敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco FTSE RAFI US 1500 Small-Mid ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the FTSE RAFI US Mid Small 1500 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 1,500 common stocks and is designed to track the performance of small- and medium-sized U.S. companies based on the following four fundamental measures of firm size: book value, cash flow, sales and dividends.
info.description_zh: Invesco FTSE RAFI US 1500 Small-Mid ETF 旨在追蹤 FTSE RAFI US Mid Small 1500 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數由大約 1,500 只普通股組成，旨在根據以下四項衡量公司規模的基本指標來追蹤美國中小型公司的業績：帳面價值、現金流、銷售額和股息。

info.description: Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund is a closed-ended equity indexed mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments, Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Asset Management, LLC and Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in the stocks of large-cap companies. The fund also invests through index call options. It seeks to replicate the performance of its portfolio against the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund was previously known as NASDAQ Premium Income & Growth Fund Inc. Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund was formed on January 30, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund 是由 Nuveen Investments, Inc. 推出的封閉式股票指數共同基金。該基金由 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC 和 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC 共同管理。它投資於美國的公共股票市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業的公司股票。它主要投資於大型公司的股票。該基金也透過指數買權進行投資。它試圖複製其投資組合相對於納斯達克 100 指數的表現。該基金以前稱為 NASDAQ Premium Income & Growth Fund Inc. Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund 成立於 2007 年 1 月 30 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq Top 30 Stocks ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of securities of the 30 largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq Top 30 Stocks ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的 30 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司的證券表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable TSLA ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that aims to generate current monthly income and provide limited downside protection by investing in a laddered portfolio of autocallable derivative instruments linked to the common stock of Tesla, Inc. (TSLA). The fund utilizes structured "autocallable" options that pay contingent coupons and include an automatic early redemption feature if the underlying asset's price meets or exceeds predefined barrier levels on specific observation dates.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable TSLA ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，旨在透過投資於與 Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) 普通股掛鉤的可自動贖回衍生性工具階梯投資組合，產生當前每月收入並提供有限的下行保護。該基金利用結構化的「可自動贖回」選擇權，支付或有息票，並包括如果標的資產的價格在特定觀察日期達到或超過預定障礙水平時自動提前贖回的功能。

info.description: Vaneck Robotics ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the BlueStar Robotics Index (the "index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in Robotics Companies. The index is comprised of equity securities, which may include depositary receipts of global exchange-listed companies in the robotics industry. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Robotics ETF 力求在費用和支出之前盡可能密切地追蹤 BlueStar Robotics Index（「指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於機器人公司。該指數由股本證券組成，其中可能包括機器人產業全球交易所上市公司的存託憑證。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory Free Cash Flow Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. VettaFi LLC constructs the index in accordance with a rules-based methodology that screens for positive free cash flow and selects 100 growth companies with the highest score within the VettaFi US Equity Large/Mid-Cap 1000 Index (the "Parent Index").
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 自由現金流成長 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 自由現金流成長指數的表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。 VettaFi LLC 根據基於規則的方法建立該指數，該方法篩選正的自由現金流，並選擇 VettaFi 美國股票大/中型股 1000 指數（「母指數」）中得分最高的 100 家成長型公司。

info.description: Pacer Trendpilot 100 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer NASDAQ-100 Trendpilot Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) in the component securities of the index. The index implements a systematic trend-following strategy that directs exposure (i) 100% to the NASDAQ-100 Index, (ii) 50% to the NASDAQ-100 and 50% to 3-Month U.S. Treasury bills, or (iii) 100% to 3-Month U.S. Treasury bills, depending on the relative performance of the NASDAQ-100 and its 200-business day historical simple moving average. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Trendpilot 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer NASDAQ-100 Trendpilot 指數在費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該基金將其總資產的至少 80%（不包括證券借貸所持有的抵押品）投資於該指數的成分證券。該指數實施系統性趨勢追蹤策略，將風險敞口 (i) 100% 投資於 NASDAQ-100 指數，(ii) 50% 投資於 NASDAQ-100 指數，50% 投資於 3 個月期美國國債，或 (iii) 100% 投資於 3 個月市場經濟指數 3 個月期美國國債，或 (iii) 100% 投資於 3 個月市場合理期。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Texas Equity ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Russell Texas Equity Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of equity securities of U.S. companies headquartered in the State of Texas, as defined by FTSE Russell (the "Index Provider" or "Russell"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Texas Equity ETF 旨在追蹤 Russell Texas 股票指數的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量富時羅素（「指數提供者」或「羅素」）定義的總部位於德克薩斯州的美國公司的股票表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Communication Services TruSector ETF is an actively managed fund designed to provide comprehensive, market-cap-weighted exposure to the communication services sector by overcoming traditional regulatory diversification constraints. The strategy employs a hybrid "TruSector" approach, combining direct equity investments in sector leaders with positions in other sector-specific ETFs to ensure the portfolio's weightings more accurately reflect the sector's actual market composition rather than being artificially capped.
info.description_zh: VanEck Communication Services TruSector ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，旨在透過克服傳統的監管多元化限制，為通訊服務業提供全面的、市值加權的投資。該策略採用混合「TruSector」方法，將行業領導者的直接股權投資與其他特定行業ETF的頭寸結合起來，以確保投資組合的權重更準確地反映該行業的實際市場組成，而不是人為限制。

info.description: KraneShares Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the MerQube Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in instruments in its underlying index or in instruments that have economic characteristics similar to those in the index. The index is an equal weighted index designed to measure the performance of companies involved in the advancement of humanoid and embodied intelligence technology or acting as a supply chain solution for a humanoid and embodied intelligence company. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: KraneShares 全球類人生物和具體智慧指數 ETF 力求提供在未計費用和支出之前與 MerQube 全球類人生物和具體智慧指數大致對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於其標的指數中的工具或與指數中具有相似經濟特徵的工具。該指數是一個等權重指數，旨在衡量參與人形和實體智慧技術進步或為人形和實體智慧公司提供供應鏈解決方案的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BA. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BA 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 BA 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 BA 價格每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Avantis Emerging Markets Ex-China Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of companies related to emerging market countries, excluding those domiciled in China. The fund's managers consider an emerging market country to be any country other than a developed country.
