info.description: Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ-100 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq, Inc. ("Nasdaq" or the "index provider") compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which includes securities of 100 of the largest domestic and international nonfinancial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC based on market capitalization. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 NASDAQ-100 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克公司（「納斯達克」或「指數提供者」）嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，其中包括在納斯達克股票市場有限責任公司上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司的證券（按市值計算）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Trust seeks investment results that generally correspond to the price and yield performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. To maintain the correspondence between the composition and weights of the securities in the trust (the "securities") and the stocks in the NASDAQ-100 Index, the adviser adjusts the securities from time to time to conform to periodic changes in the identity and/or relative weights of index securities. The composition and weighting of the securities portion of a portfolio deposit are also adjusted to conform to changes in the index.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ Trust 尋求通常與 NASDAQ-100 指數的價格和收益率表現相對應的投資結果。為了維持信託中的證券（「證券」）與 NASDAQ-100 指數中的股票的組成和權重之間的對應關係，顧問會不時調整證券，以符合指數證券的身份和/或相對權重的定期變化。投資組合存款的證券部分的組成和權重也會被調整，以適應指數的變化。

info.description: Infrastructure Capital Nasdaq Option Income ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that combines a long equity portfolio with dynamic options overlays to generate high monthly distribution returns while preserving capital appreciation potential. The fund utilizes a top-down macroeconomic framework to selectively buy and write short-duration put and call options alongside an actively managed, value-tilted stock portfolio that mirrors the economic risk profile of the Nasdaq Composite Index.
info.description_zh: 基礎設施資本納斯達克選擇權收益 ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，將長期股票投資組合與動態選擇權疊加相結合，產生高月度分配回報，同時保留資本增值潛力。該基金利用自上而下的宏觀經濟框架，選擇性地購買和賣出短期看跌期權和看漲期權，以及反映納斯達克綜合指數經濟風險狀況的積極管理、價值傾斜的股票投資組合。

info.description: Optimize Strategy Index ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 優化策略指數ETF旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Entegris, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of specialty materials for the microelectronics industry. It operates through the Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segments. The Materials Solutions segment provides materials-based solutions, such as chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition materials, chemical mechanical planarization ("CMP") slurries and pads, ion implantation specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials that enable customers to achieve better device performance and faster time to yield, while providing for lower total cost of ownership. The Advanced Purity Solutions segment offers filtration, purification and contamination-control solutions that improve customers' yield, device reliability and cost by ensuring the purity of critical liquid chemistries and gases and the cleanliness of wafers and other substrates used throughout semiconductor manufacturing processes, the semiconductor ecosystem and other high-technology industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Entegris, Inc. 從事微電子行業特殊材料的開發、製造和供應。它透過材料解決方案（MS）和高級純度解決方案（APS）部門運作。材料解決方案部門提供基於材料的解決方案，例如化學氣相和原子層沉積材料、化學機械平坦化（“CMP”）漿料和墊、離子注入特種氣體、配方蝕刻和清潔材料以及其他特種材料，使客戶能夠實現更好的裝置性能和更快的產量，同時降低總擁有成本。高階純度解決方案部門提供過濾、純化和污染控制解決方案，透過確保關鍵液體化學品和氣體的純度以及半導體製造流程、半導體生態系統和其他高科技產業中使用的晶圓和其他基材的清潔度，提高客戶的產量、設備可靠性和成本。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income in a tax-efficient manner with the potential for enhanced equity appreciation in rising markets. The fund utilizes a multi-part strategy including a core 100% exposure to a portfolio of stocks that make up the Nasdaq-100 Index and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure to the index, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF 尋求透過以節稅的方式產生高額月收入來提高業績，並有可能在新興市場中提高股票升值。該基金採用多部分策略，包括對構成納斯達克 100 指數的股票投資組合進行 100% 核心敞口，以及旨在創建對該指數約 150% 名義投資組合敞口的附加綜合期權策略，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ Next Generation 100 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq, Inc. compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is comprised of securities of the next generation of Nasdaq-listed non-financial companies; that is, the largest 100 Nasdaq-listed companies outside of the NASDAQ-100 Index (the "NASDAQ-100") based on market capitalization. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克下一代 100 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數由納斯達克上市的下一代非金融公司的證券組成；即 NASDAQ-100 指數（“NASDAQ-100”）之外按市值計算的最大 100 家納斯達克上市公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance NASDAQ 100 Lightningspread Income ETF seeks to seek current income; capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income and, secondarily, capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by employing a "LightningSpread" strategy, which is designed to generate daily income that the fund manager intends to distribute twice weekly. The fund's strategy also seeks to provide long exposure to the price return of the Nasdaq 100 index (the "index"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance NASDAQ 100 Lightningspread Income ETF 尋求當前收益；資本增值。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，其次是資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用「LightningSpread」策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在產生每日收入，基金經理打算每週分配兩次。該基金的策略還尋求提供納斯達克 100 指數（「指數」）價格回報的長期曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Baron Technology ETF invests in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of U.S. and non-U.S. technology companies of any market capitalization, selected for their durable growth potential from the development, advancement and use of technology, however, investments in non-U.S. securities are limited to 35% of the Fund's total assets at the time of purchase. Technology companies may be located anywhere in the world, including developing countries. A developing country is a country included in the MSCI Emerging Markets (EM) Index and other countries determined by the Adviser to be developing countries based on classifications made by the International Monetary Fund or on country characteristics similar to those of the countries in the EM Index. BAMCO seeks to invest in businesses it believes have significant opportunities for growth, sustainable competitive advantages, exceptional management, and an attractive valuation.
info.description_zh: Baron Technology ETF 投資於任何市值的美國和非美國科技公司的股本證券（包括存託憑證），因其在技術開發、進步和使用方面的持久增長潛力而被選擇，但對非美國證券的投資僅限於購買時基金總資產的 35%。科技公司可能位於世界任何地方，包括發展中國家。發展中國家是指納入 MSCI 新興市場 (EM) 指數的國家以及顧問根據國際貨幣基金組織的分類或根據與新興市場指數國家類似的國家特徵確定為發展中國家的其他國家。 BAMCO 尋求投資於它認為具有重大成長機會、可持續競爭優勢、卓越管理和有吸引力估值的企業。

info.description: Acuitas Small Cap Active ETF is an actively managed fund that utilizes a multi-manager approach to achieve long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. small-capitalization and microcap equities. The strategy seeks to exploit market inefficiencies in the lower capitalization spectrum by allocating assets among a curated group of subadvisers with disciplined, differentiated investment processes.
info.description_zh: Acuitas Small Cap Active ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，採用多管理人方式，透過投資美國小型股和微型盤股的多元化投資組合來實現長期資本增值。該策略旨在透過在一組具有紀律性、差異化投資流程的精心策劃的次級顧問之間分配資產，來利用較低資本化範圍內的市場低效率。

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. The digital asset-related activities that such issuers may be involved in include (i) mining of digital assets; (ii) holding digital assets in their corporate treasury or government treasury; and (iii) working on platforms to facilitate payment with, or the transfer of, digital assets.
info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery. Its product offers automation and customization options for astigmatism treatment planning and other steps of the refractive cataract surgery procedure. The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery.其產品為散光治療計劃和屈光性白內障手術的其他步驟提供自動化和定制選項。 The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.

info.description: Xtrackers Artificial Intelligence and Big Data ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq Global Artificial Intelligence and Big DataTM Index. The index is designed to track the performance of a selection of companies from global developed and emerging markets engaged in the following themes (Artificial Intelligence) and its sub-themes (Deep learning, Image recognition, Natural language processing, Speech recognition & chatbots). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets (but typically far more) in component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers 人工智慧和大數據 ETF 尋求與納斯達克全球人工智慧和大數據TM指數未計費用和開支之前的表現大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在追蹤來自全球已開發和新興市場的精選公司的業績，這些公司從事以下主題（人工智慧）及其子主題（深度學習、圖像識別、自然語言處理、語音識別和聊天機器人）。該基金將至少將其總資產的 80%（但通常更多）投資於基礎指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Momentum Index 的總回報表現大致相對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AOT Growth and Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that invests in U.S. listed equity securities that have high growth potential based on a low marginal cost business model. It's investment universe consists of publicly traded equity securities listed in the United States with a minimum market capitalization of $800 million. The Sub-Adviser also excludes REITs, and Business Development Companies ("BDCs").
info.description_zh: AOT 成長與創新 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（ETF），投資於基於低邊際成本商業模式的具有高成長潛力的美國上市股票證券。其投資領域包括在美國上市的公開交易股票證券，市值最低為 8 億美元。副顧問也不包括房地產投資信託基金和業務發展公司（「BDC」）。

info.description: Founder-Led ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Founder-Led Index. The index tracks the performance of the top 50 founder-led publicly traded U.S. companies, defined as companies where at least one original founder currently serves in a C-suite or equivalent key executive role. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in founder-led company equities included in the index and/or in financial instruments that collectively provide exposure to founder-led companies represented in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 創辦人主導的 ETF 旨在追蹤創辦人主導的指數在扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數追蹤美國 50 強創辦人領導的上市公司的業績，這些公司的定義是至少一名原始創辦人目前擔任最高管理層或同等關鍵管理職位的公司。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於指數中包含的創始人領導的公司股票和/或共同為指數中代表的創始人領導的公司提供風險敞口的金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Artificial Intelligence & Technology ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Artificial Intelligence & Big Data Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of companies involved in the development and utilization of artificial intelligence ("AI") and big data. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 人工智慧與科技 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 人工智慧與大數據指數（「基礎指數」）未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）和大數據開發和利用的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Procure Space ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before the fund's fees and expenses, of an equity index called the "S-Network Space Index". The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in companies of the underlying index that receive at least 50% of their revenues or profits from space-related businesses. The underlying index is designed to serve as an equity benchmark for a globally traded portfolio of companies that are engaged in space-related business, such as those utilizing satellite technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Procure Space ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「S-Network Space Index」的股票指數（扣除基金費用和支出之前）的表現相對應。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於相關指數中至少 50% 的收入或利潤來自太空相關業務的公司。該指數旨在作為從事太空相關業務（例如利用衛星技術的公司）的全球交易公司投資組合的股票基準。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Transformative Tech Accelerators ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing in equity securities of foreign and domestic Transformative Tech Accelerators. Transformative Tech Accelerators are companies that provide products or services contributing to the disruptive potential of novel technologies (e.g., blockchain and artificial intelligence ("AI")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy Transformative Tech Accelerators ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過投資國內外轉型技術加速器的股本證券來實現基金的投資目標。變革性技術加速器是提供有助於新技術（例如區塊鏈和人工智慧（“AI”））顛覆性潛力的產品或服務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X CleanTech ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global CleanTech Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes, in the securities of the index and in ADRs, GDRs based on the securities in the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from the increased adoption of technologies focused on improving the efficiency of renewable energy production and/or mitigating the adverse environmental effects of resource consumption. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X CleanTech ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx Global CleanTech 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數證券以及基於指數證券的 ADR、GDR。該指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司能夠從更多地採用專注於提高再生能源生產效率和/或減輕資源消耗對環境的不利影響的技術中受益。它是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Top 30 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the daily target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the top 30 companies from the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 Nasdaq-100 Top 30 指數每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數中排名前 30 名的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tilray Brands, Inc. engages as a consumer packaged goods company, which focuses on medical cannabis research and the cultivation, processing, and distribution of cannabis products worldwide. It operates through the followings segments: Cannabis, Distribution, Beverage, and Wellness. The Cannabis segment focuses on cultivation, production, distribution, and sale of both medical and adult-use cannabis products. The Distribution segment is involved in purchase, resale, and distribution of pharmaceutical and wellness products. The Beverage segment refers to the production, marketing, and sale of beverages. The Wellness segment represents the production, marketing, and distribution of hemp-based food and other wellness products. The company was founded on January 24, 2018 and is headquartered in Leamington, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Tilray Brands, Inc. 是一家消費品公司，專注於醫用大麻研究以及全球大麻產品的種植、加工和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：大麻、分銷、飲料和健康。大麻部門專注於醫用和成人用大麻產品的種植、生產、分銷和銷售。分銷部門從事藥品和保健產品的購買、轉售和分銷。飲料部門是指飲料的生產、行銷和銷售。健康部門代表大麻食品和其他健康產品的生產、行銷和分銷。該公司成立於2018年1月24日，總部位於加拿大利明頓。

info.description: TCW Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of businesses that the Adviser has identified, through annual reports, press releases and other public statements by an issuer, as well as the Adviser's due diligence process, as using, or as having demonstrated an intent to use, predictive or generative AI in a way that is or has the potential to deliver a material improvement in the company's financial condition. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW人工智慧ETF尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於顧問透過發行人的年度報告、新聞稿和其他公開聲明以及顧問的盡職調查流程確定的企業證券，這些企業使用或已表明有意使用預測性或生成性人工智慧，以實現或有可能對公司的財務狀況帶來實質改善。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Technology ETF seeks to provide long-term capital growth. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investments purposes) in securities of companies that the Advisor expects to generate a majority of their revenue from technology or enablement through technology. The fund's managers consider technology enabled companies as those whose competitive edge and/or market share are largely based on their technology capabilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Technology ETF 尋求提供長期資本成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於顧問預計大部分收入來自技術或透過技術實現的公司的證券。該基金的經理人認為，技術驅動型公司的競爭優勢和/或市佔率很大程度上取決於其技術能力。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 21shares Polkadot ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to DOT, the native cryptocurrency of the Polkadot network. The fund seeks to track the performance of its underlying digital asset by holding DOT in secure, institutional-grade cold storage, while uniquely incorporating a staking component to capture network rewards that may be used to offset fund expenses or contribute to the net asset value.
info.description_zh: 21shares Polkadot ETF 是一款被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支援的 DOT（Polkadot 網路的原生加密貨幣）曝險。該基金尋求透過將 DOT 保存在安全的機構級冷庫中來追蹤其基礎數位資產的表現，同時獨特地納入質押組件來獲取網路獎勵，這些獎勵可用於抵消基金費用或貢獻淨資產價值。

info.description: Flywire Corp. is a payments enablement and software company. The firm engages in providing vertical-specific software and payments technology to embed within the existing accounts receivable (AR) workflows for clients across the education, healthcare, travel vertical markets, and business-to-business (B2B) industries. It also integrates with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, such as NetSuite, which allows organizations to optimize the payment experience of customers. The company was founded by Marcaide Marchite Iker in July 2009 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Flywire Corp. 是一家支付支援和軟體公司。該公司致力於為教育、醫療保健、旅遊垂直市場和企業對企業 (B2B) 行業的客戶提供垂直特定的軟體和支付技術，嵌入現有的應收帳款 (AR) 工作流程中。它還與 NetSuite 等企業資源規劃 (ERP) 系統集成，使組織能夠優化客戶的支付體驗。該公司由 Marcaide Marchite Iker 於 2009 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Defiance Quantum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Quantum Computing and Machine Learning Index (the "index"). The fund uses a "passive management" (or indexing) approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a modified equal-weighted portfolio of the stock of companies that derive at least 50% of their annual revenue or operating activity from the development of quantum computing and machine learning technology.
info.description_zh: Defiance Quantum ETF 旨在追蹤藍星量子計算和機器學習指數（「指數」）扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」（或指數化）方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由經過修改的等權重公司股票投資組合組成，這些公司的年收入或營運活動至少有 50% 來自量子計算和機器學習技術的發展。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF seeks calendar quarter investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF 尋求日曆季度投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆季度業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆季度業績提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: KraneShares Artificial Intelligence and Technology ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, track the performance of the Solactive Etna Artificial General Intelligence Index. The underlying index is a modified, free float adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to measure the equity performance of companies in developed markets with exposure to AI businesses. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests principally in instruments in the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: KraneShares 人工智慧和技術 ETF 尋求提供在費用和支出之前追蹤 Solactive Etna 人工智慧指數表現的投資結果。基礎指數是經過修改的、自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場中從事人工智慧業務的公司的股票表現。在正常情況下，該基金主要投資於相關指數的工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is an equal-weighted index composed of the securities comprising the NASDAQ-100 Index that are classified as "technology" according to the Industry Classification Benchmark classification system.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是一個等權重指數，由納斯達克 100 指數中根據行業分類基準分類系統歸類為「科技」的證券組成。

info.description: First Trust SSI Strategic Convertible Securities ETF seeks total return. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in a portfolio of U.S. and non-U.S. convertible securities. In general, convertible securities combine the investment characteristics of bonds and common stocks and typically consist of debt securities or preferred securities that may be converted or exchanged within a specified period of time into a certain amount of common stock or other equity security of the same or a different issuer.
info.description_zh: First Trust SSI 策略可轉換證券 ETF 尋求總回報。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於美國和非美國可轉換證券的投資組合來實現其投資目標。一般來說，可轉換證券結合了債券和普通股的投資特點，通常由可以在指定期限內轉換或交換為相同或不同發行人的一定數量的普通股或其他股本證券的債務證券或優先證券組成。

info.description: OptimizeRx Corp. is digital health company, engaged in the provision of digital health messaging via electronic health records, which serve as a direct channel for pharmaceutical companies to communicate with healthcare providers. It offers electronic health record (EHR) workflow solutions which include financial messaging, patient education, and brand messaging and brand support. The company was founded by David A. Harrell in 2006 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: OptimizeRx Corp. 是一家數位健康公司，致力於透過電子健康記錄提供數位健康訊息，這是製藥公司與醫療保健提供者溝通的直接管道。它提供電子健康記錄 (EHR) 工作流程解決方案，其中包括財務訊息傳遞、患者教育以及品牌訊息傳遞和品牌支援。該公司由 David A. Harrell 於 2006 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Opus Genetics, Inc. engages in the research and development of ophthalmic biopharmaceutical products. It focuses on developing and commercializing therapies for the treatment of several eye disorders. The company was founded by Mina Patel Soouch and Alan R. Meyer in February 2018 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Opus Genetics, Inc.從事眼科生物製藥產品的研發。它專注於開發和商業化治療多種眼部疾病的療法。該公司由 Mina Patel Soouch 和 Alan R. Meyer 於 2018 年 2 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: SoFi Technologies, Inc. is a financial service platform, which engages in the provision of student loan refinancing options to the private student loan market. It operates through the following segments: Lending, Technology Platform, and Financial Services. The Lending segment offers personal loans, student loans, home loan products, and related servicing activities. The Technology Platform segment focuses on technology products and solutions revenue. The Financial Services segment includes the SoFi Money product, SoFi Invest product, SoFi Credit Card product, SoFi Relay personal finance management product, and other financial services. The company was founded in April 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: SoFi Technologies, Inc. 是一家金融服務平台，致力於向私人學生貸款市場提供學生貸款再融資選項。它透過以下部門運作：貸款、技術平台和金融服務。貸款部門提供個人貸款、學生貸款、房屋貸款產品和相關服務活動。技術平台部門專注於技術產品和解決方案收入。金融服務部門包括SoFi Money產品、SoFi Invest產品、SoFi信用卡產品、SoFi Relay個人財務管理產品和其他金融服務。該公司成立於2011年4月，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Velo3D, Inc. operates as a technology company, which engages in developing and manufacturing metal laser sintering printing machines for 3D printing. Its products include assure system, flow software, sapphire printer & sapphire XC. The company was founded by Benyamin Buller in June 2014 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Velo3D, Inc.是一家科技公司，致力於開發和製造用於3D列印的金屬雷射燒結印表機。其產品包括保固系統、流程軟體、藍寶石印表機和藍寶石XC。該公司由 Benyamin Buller 於 2014 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Spear Alpha ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest primarily in equity securities, including common stock or American depositary receipts ("ADRs") of companies that Spear Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") believes are poised to benefit from breakthrough innovation in industrial technology. The Adviser defines "innovation in industrial technology" as those technological developments that are transforming or have the potential to transform the industrial sector. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Spear Alpha ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於股票證券，包括 Spear Advisors LLC（「顧問」）認為有望從工業技術突破性創新中受益的公司的普通股或美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。顧問將「工業技術創新」定義為那些正在改變或有潛力改變工業部門的技術發展。它是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Hedged Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) ETFs that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts, (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts, (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset, and (v) covered call options and protective put options on investments held in the portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 對沖數位資產生態系統 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈行業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約的ETF，（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨合約，（iv）以比特幣或以太幣作為參考資產交易所的投資期權產品，以及（v）投資組合中持有的投資基金。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares UltraPro QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to three times (3x) the daily performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index includes 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraPro QQQ 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 NASDAQ-100 指數每日表現的三倍 (3x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數包括納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司（按市值計算）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PANW Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PANW. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PANW 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PANW 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PANW 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PANW. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PANW and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PANW 每日業績的 200% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PANW 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 PANW 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable SMCI ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks current income by investing at least 80% of its net assets in derivative contracts utilizing autocallable instruments that reference the common stock of Super Micro Computer, Inc. The strategy aims to deliver monthly distributions while managing cash balances through U.S. government securities, money market funds, short-term bond ETFs, investment-grade corporate debt, repurchase agreements, or national exchange-listed U.S. large-cap equities.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable SMCI ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於利用參考 Super Micro Computer, Inc. 普通股的可自動贖回工具的衍生性商品合約來尋求當前收入。該策略旨在透過美國政府證券、貨幣市場基金、短期債券 ETF、投資等級公司債務、回購協議或在國家交易所上市的美國大盤股管理現金餘額，同時提供每月分配股票。

info.description: Moonvest ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that targets a concentrated, high-conviction portfolio of 15 to 35 global equities identified as undervalued or "beaten-down" with significant recovery potential. The strategy utilizes a contrarian, bottom-up fundamental methodology to invest in a blend of high-growth and value companies that have experienced substantial drawdowns from 52-week highs but maintain strong structural outlooks.
info.description_zh: Moonvest ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，目標是由 15 至 35 只被認定為被低估或「遭受重挫」且具有巨大復甦潛力的全球股票組成的集中、高信念投資組合。該策略採用逆勢、自下而上的基本面方法，投資於高成長和價值公司，這些公司經歷了 52 週高點的大幅下跌，但仍保持強勁的結構性前景。

info.description: Power Solutions International, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and trade of power systems and electrical power generation equipment. The firm provides integrated turnkey solutions to global original equipment manufacturers and end-user customers within the energy, industrial, and transportation end markets. The company was founded by Gary S. Winemaster, Kenneth J. Winemaster, and William Winemaster in February 1985 and is headquartered in Wood Dale, IL.
info.description_zh: Power Solutions International, Inc. 從事電力系統和發電設備的設計、製造和貿易。該公司為能源、工業和運輸終端市場的全球原始設備製造商和最終用戶客戶提供整合的交鑰匙解決方案。該公司由 Gary S. Winemaster、Kenneth J. Winemaster 和 William Winemaster 於 1985 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州伍德戴爾。

info.description: Cognex Corp. engages in the provision of machine vision products and solutions that improve efficiency and quality in a wide range of businesses across attractive industrial end markets. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, Europe, Greater China, and Other. The company was founded by Robert J. Shillman, William Silver, and Marilyn Matz on January 7, 1981 and is headquartered in Natick, MA.
info.description_zh: 康耐視公司致力於提供機器視覺產品和解決方案，以提高有吸引力的工業終端市場中各種業務的效率和品質。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、大中華區和其他地區。該公司由 Robert J. Shillman、William Silver 和 Marilyn Matz 於 1981 年 1 月 7 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州納蒂克。

info.description: Teamshares, Inc. is a tech-enabled acquiror of SMEs, intending to be a permanent home when owners retire. The company was founded on June 28, 2019 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Teamshares, Inc. 是一家以科技為支撐的中小企業收購者，旨在成為業主退休後的永久住所。該公司成立於2019年6月28日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Direxion Daily SOFI Bull 2X ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund that targets daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common shares of SoFi Technologies, Inc. Designed as a tactical instrument for sophisticated investors, the fund utilizes financial derivative instruments to amplify short-term bullish conviction in a leading digital financial services platform, necessitating daily monitoring due to the effects of compounding and path dependency.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily SOFI Bull 2X ETF 是一款積極管理的單股槓桿交易所交易基金，其目標是 SoFi Technologies, Inc. 普通股每日價格表現 200% 的每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）。該基金被設計為成熟投資者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生工具來放大領先數位金融服務平台的短期看漲信念，由於複利和路徑依賴的影響，需要進行日常監控。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOFI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoFi Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: SOFI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 SOFI ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 SoFi Technologies, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SOFI）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Quantum Cyber NV engages in assembling an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered, quantum-accelerated system-of-systems autonomous defense platform. It integrates drone warfare, counter-UAS, autonomous naval mine countermeasures, EMP shielding, anti-drone ammunition, command-and-control, and quantum antenna applications. The company was founded on March 8, 2021 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Quantum Cyber​​ NV 致力於組裝由人工智慧 (AI) 驅動、量子加速的系統級系統自主防禦平台。它整合了無人機作戰、反無人機、自主水雷對抗、電磁脈衝屏蔽、反無人機彈藥、指揮控制和量子天線應用。該公司成立於 2021 年 3 月 8 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: Aehr Test Systems engages in the design, manufacture, market, and sale of test and burn-in equipment used in the semiconductor industry. Its products include FOX-XP, FOX-NP, and FOX-CP wafer contact parallel test and burn-in systems, the WaferPak full wafer contactor, the DiePak Carrier, the WaferPak Aligner, the DiePak Autoloader, and test fixtures. The company was founded by Rhea J. Posedel on May 25, 1977 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Aehr Test Systems 從事半導體行業使用的測試和老化設備的設計、製造、行銷和銷售。其產品包括FOX-XP、FOX-NP和FOX-CP晶圓接觸並行測試和老化系統、WaferPak全晶圓接觸器、DiePak Carrier、WaferPak Aligner、DiePak Autoloader和測試夾具。該公司由 Rhea J. Posedel 於 1977 年 5 月 25 日創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: RYTHM, Inc. engages in the development of hardware and software solutions for indoor agriculture. The company was founded on June 6, 2016 and is headquartered in Rolling Meadows, IL.
info.description_zh: RYTHM, Inc. 從事室內農業硬體和軟體解決方案的開發。該公司成立於2016年6月6日，總部位於伊利諾州羅林梅多斯。

Digital Brands Group, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of apparel. Its portfolio brands include Bailey 44, DSTLD, Harper and Jones, Stateside, and Sundry. The company was founded by Corey Epstein, Mark T. Lynn, and Kevin Morris on September 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
